Conclusion: 几何感知的各向异性路由能有效缓解潜在切片的冗余与纠缠，是提升神经算子在复杂网格与分布外场景下表现的通用且有效的方案。

Abstract: State-of-the-art neural operators scale to complex meshes via slice-and-process architectures, yet many rely on linear compatibility scores for latent tokenization. Under common feature normalization, such scores are equivalent to isotropic Euclidean clustering, while without normalization they induce unbounded linear decision regions. In both cases, they lack slice-specific anisotropic locality, which can lead to redundant and entangled latent slices. To address this, we propose Metric-Enhanced Token Routing Operator (METRO), a geometry-aware routing mechanism that replaces linear projection with a learnable Mahalanobis metric. By enabling each latent slice to learn a local anisotropic tensor, METRO shapes receptive fields into exponentially localized, oriented ellipsoids that naturally align with flow features like boundary layers and wakes. As a drop-in replacement, METRO yields consistent improvements across both Transformer and Mamba backbones. Empirically, our method achieves substantial performance gains on irregular domains, outperforming baselines on both standard PDE benchmarks and complex industrial design tasks. Finally, METRO exhibits enhanced robustness in out-of-distribution regimes across varying Reynolds numbers and geometric configurations.

</details>


### [159] [Private Component-by-Component Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05102)
*Dvir Karni,Eliad Tsfadia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在可实现（realizable）设定下研究差分隐私学习问题，提出用 LabelBoost 与双交替 reservoir 恢复精确可实现性，将隐私开销从 $\widetilde O(k/\varepsilon)$ 降至 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{k}/\varepsilon)$，并改进了半空间学习的样本复杂度上界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在可实现设定中，假设由 $k$ 个分量刻画。直接迭代私分量学习器会遇到障碍：对下一分量的近似选择可能破坏标注样本的精确可实现性，即便该分量局部准确。已有方法（如 ABMS 的闭包定理）在分量样本界上带有 $\widetilde O(k/\varepsilon)$ 的隐私开销，代价较高，因此需要降低该开销并保持可实现性。

Method: 采用 Beimel-Nissim-Stemmer 的 LabelBoost 过程恢复可实现性，并通过两个交替 reservoir 回收（recycle）数据。对 $d$ 维有限坐标网格（大小 $L$）上的半空间学习，利用精确可实现性使直接分量深度目标呈拟凹（quasi-concave）性质，再分别实例化 IPConcave 算法与 Cohen-Lyu-Nelson-Sarlós-Stemmer 的拟凹优化器。此外，将框架推广到布尔组合 $G(H_1,\ldots,H_k)$。

Result: 对目标隐私 $\varepsilon$，学习器相对单个分量学习步（目标精度 $\Theta(\alpha/k)$）的主动样本需求仅付出 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{k}/\varepsilon)$ 开销。半空间可实现样本复杂度达到 $\widetilde{O}\big(\frac{1}{\varepsilon\alpha}\min\{d^{2.5}\log^*L,\ d^{2.5}+d^{1.5}2^{\log^*L}\}\big)$，优于此前 $\widetilde{O}\big(\frac{1}{\varepsilon\alpha}\min\{\frac{1}{\alpha}d^{5.5}\log^*L,\ d^{2.5}2^{\log^*L}\}\big)$。对任意固定布尔函数 $G$，得到 $G(H_1,\ldots,H_k)$ 的 proper 私学习器，较 ABMS 闭包定理把开销从 $\widetilde O(k/\varepsilon)$ 降至 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{k}/\varepsilon)$。

Conclusion: 该工作通过 LabelBoost 加双 reservoir 的框架，在可实现设定下有效降低分量组合学习的隐私开销至 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{k}/\varepsilon)$，并借助拟凹结构显著改进半空间学习的可实现样本复杂度上界，同时将布尔组合的 proper 私学习推广并优于现有闭包结果。

Abstract: We study differentially private learning problems in the realizable setting, where a hypothesis is specified by $k$ components. A direct iteration of private component learners is obstructed by a simple difficulty: an approximate choice of the next component may destroy exact realizability of the labeled sample, even when the next component is locally accurate. We restore realizability using the LabelBoost procedure of Beimel, Nissim, and Stemmer [SODA '15, Algorithmica '21] and recycle data through two alternating reservoirs. The resulting learner, for a target privacy $\varepsilon$, pays only $\widetilde O(\sqrt{k}/\varepsilon)$ overhead relative to the active sample requirement of a single component learning step at target accuracy $Θ(α/k)$. For learning $d$-dimensional halfspaces over a finite coordinate grid of size $L$, exact realizability makes the direct component-depth objective quasi-concave. Instantiating the framework with the IPConcave algorithm of Nissim, Tsfadia, and Yan [SODA '26] and with the quasi-concave optimizer of Cohen, Lyu, Nelson, Sarl'os, and Stemmer [STOC '23] yields a realizable sample complexity of $\widetilde{O}\left(\frac{1}{\varepsilon α}\cdot \min\{d^{2.5} \log^*L, \:\: d^{2.5} + d^{1.5} 2^{\log^*L}\}\right),$ which improves on the previously known bound of $\widetilde{O}\left(\frac{1}{\varepsilon α}\cdot\min\{\frac{1}α\cdot d^{5.5}\log^*L,\:\: d^{2.5}2^{\log^*L}\}\right).$ We also apply the framework to Boolean compositions: given proper private learners for classes $H_1,\ldots,H_k$, we obtain a proper private learner for $G(H_1,\ldots,H_k)$ for any fixed Boolean function $G:\{0,1\}^k\to\{0,1\}$. Compared with the closure theorem of Alon, Beimel, Moran, and Stemmer [COLT '20], this reduces the overhead on a common component sample bound from $\widetilde O(k/\varepsilon)$ to $\widetilde O(\sqrt{k}/\varepsilon)$.

</details>


### [160] [Best-of-$N$ Guidance for Test-time Diffusion Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05108)
*Richard Lee Kim,Yeongmin Kim,Gyuwon Sim,Taekyu Kim,Minsang Park,Il-chul Moon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出BoNG方法，将Best-of-N采样的选择原理直接融入扩散反向去噪过程，通过粒子间非对称引导交互将粒子群推向高奖励区域，兼顾最终最优样本与平均生成质量，并支持多输出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型生成性能强，但与奖励模型衡量的人类偏好对齐不足。Best-of-N（BoN）作为简单有效的测试时对齐算法，仅在最终选择阶段使用奖励信息，不参与反向扩散轨迹，因此无法提升生成样本的平均对齐度，且主要用于单输出场景。

Method: 提出Best-of-N Guidance（BoNG），将BoN采样原则整合进反向扩散过程：对去噪粒子执行在线BoN选择，并在粒子间引入非对称引导交互，以当前BoN粒子作为其余粒子群的引导信号，从而在生成过程中重塑采样轨迹，使粒子群向高奖励区域迁移。

Result: 在36项实证对比中，BoNG有29项取得最佳表现，相对SMC与Vanilla BoN采样有80.56%的比较排名第一；同时支持多输出，ImageReward得分达到最新基于采样的引导方法的1.3倍，并实现1.6倍加速。

Conclusion: BoNG通过将BoN选择在线融入反向扩散并引入粒子级非对称引导，不仅超越Vanilla BoN的最终最优样本，还提升生成样本的平均质量，且具备多输出能力与效率优势。代码已在 https://github.com/aailab-kaist/BoNG 发布。

Abstract: Diffusion models achieve strong generative performance but often struggle to align generated samples with human preferences measured by a reward model. A simple yet effective algorithm for test-time alignment is Best-of-$N$ (BoN) sampling, which draws $N$ i.i.d. samples from a pre-trained diffusion model and outputs the single highest-reward sample. Despite its empirical success, BoN makes limited use of reward information, as it is incorporated only at the final selection stage without influencing the reverse diffusion trajectory during sampling. Consequently, BoN sampling does not improve the average alignment of generated samples and is primarily suited to single-output settings. We propose Best-of-$N$ Guidance (BoNG), a novel method that integrates the principle of BoN sampling directly into the reverse diffusion process. BoNG performs online BoN selection over denoising particles and adjusts the reverse diffusion process to steer the particle population toward higher-reward regions during generation. Specifically, by introducing an asymmetric guidance interaction among denoising particles, BoNG uses the current BoN particle as a guidance signal to the rest of the particle population. This particle-level interaction reshapes the sampling process toward higher-reward regions, enabling BoNG to improve not only the final best sample beyond Vanilla BoN sampling, but also the average quality of generated samples. Over 36 empirical comparisons, BoNG achieves the best performance in 29 cases, ranking first in 80.56% of the comparisons against SMC and Vanilla BoN sampling. BoNG also supports multi-output capability, achieving 1.3$\times$ ImageReward score of the latest sample-based guidance method with a 1.6$\times$ speedup. We release the code at https://github.com/aailab-kaist/BoNG.

</details>


### [161] [Bayesian Entropy-based Reordering for Calibrated Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05125)
*Zhejun Jiang,Mijung Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出BayesER，一种事后贝叶斯解码框架，利用预测不确定性指导掩码扩散语言模型的token提交顺序，在多个任务上降低校准误差且不损精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有掩码扩散语言模型的解码方法依赖softmax置信度来决定哪些位置足够可信并提交，但softmax置信度往往校准不良，导致位置排序与token选择不可靠。

Method: BayesER构建以预训练检查点为中心的轻量近似后验（类似Laplace-LoRA但不训练LoRA适配器），对后验样本的预测做平均，并用预测熵来优先处理可靠位置。

Result: 在代码生成、数学推理、规划与分子生成等基准上，BayesER相较常见解码方案（含置信度阈值解码）降低序列级校准误差，同时保持或提升精度；且在代码数据集上拟合的后验无需重拟合即可降低另一数据集上的校准误差。

Conclusion: 贝叶斯不确定性可作为一种可迁移信号，用于提升掩码扩散语言模型解码的可靠性。

Abstract: Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs) generate sequences by iteratively replacing masked tokens with model predictions. At each denoising step, the decoder chooses which positions are sufficiently confident to commit. Existing decoding methods typically rely on softmax confidence, which can be miscalibrated. We introduce BayesER (BAYESian Entropy-based Reordering), a post-hoc Bayesian decoding framework that uses predictive uncertainty to guide token commitment. In BayesER, we construct a lightweight approximate posterior centered at the pretrained checkpoint, similar to Laplace-LoRA but without training LoRA adapters. We average predictions over posterior samples and use predictive entropy to prioritize reliable positions. We examine how posterior predictions affect position ordering and token selection across benchmarks spanning code generation, mathematical reasoning, planning, and molecular generation. We show that BayesER reduces sequence-level calibration error while preserving or improving accuracy relative to common decoding schemes, including confidence-threshold decoding. Additionally, a posterior fitted on one code-generation dataset reduces calibration error on another without refitting, suggesting that Bayesian uncertainty may provide a transferable signal for more reliable MDLM decoding.

</details>


### [162] [Component-Level Evaluation of Adaptive PINN Training for CFD-Oriented Crystal Growth Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05127)
*Niruta Chapagain,Rohit Raj,Bertwin Kurisinkal Shine,Aditya A S*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 自适应权重PINN的总损失不可直接比较，应在PDE、边界条件、解误差等分项指标下评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PINN训练以PDE、边界条件和初始条件损失的加权和为目标，自适应方法在训练中改变权重，导致总损失在不同方法间不具可比性，易掩盖单一物理约束的退化。

Method: 在匹配设置下对比固定权重PINN、梯度归一化PINN（GNPINN）与规则型自适应控制器（AgenticPINN），使用热方程基准及简化的Czochralski定向热流问题；另用逐案例留出测试评估高斯过程代理模型在修正后的Czochralski CFD参数扫描上的表现。

Result: 晶体生长MLP实验中，自适应控制将PDE残差由10^-5量级降至10^-6量级，但边界条件损失由10^-5量级升至10^-2量级；热方程基准上GNPINN相对L2场误差最低（0.054），AgenticPINN PDE残差最小但相对L2误差达1.368；高斯过程代理中温度扫描温度场误差约6%，晶转扫描轴向速度误差约42%。

Conclusion: 自适应控制可在提升方程满足度的同时削弱其他物理约束，因此PINN训练应基于PDE残差、边界条件损失与解误差等独立分项指标评估，而非仅依赖加权总损失。

Abstract: Physics-informed neural network (PINN) training minimizes a weighted combination of partial differential equation (PDE), boundary-condition, and initial-condition losses. Because adaptive methods modify these weights during training, their weighted total losses are not always directly comparable. We compare fixed-weight PINN, gradient-normalized PINN (GNPINN), and a rule-based adaptive controller (AgenticPINN) under matched settings on a heat-equation benchmark and a simplified Czochralski-oriented thermal-fluid problem. In the crystal-growth MLP experiment, adaptive control reduced the PDE residual from the order of $10^{-5}$ to $10^{-6}$, while the boundary-condition loss increased from the order of $10^{-5}$ to $10^{-2}$. On the heat-equation benchmark, GNPINN achieved the lowest relative $L_2$ field error (0.054), whereas AgenticPINN obtained the smallest PDE residual but a relative $L_2$ error of 1.368. Gaussian-process surrogates were additionally evaluated using case-wise holdout tests on corrected Czochralski CFD parameter sweeps. The temperature-field error for the temperature sweep was approximately 6%, whereas the axial-velocity error for the crystal-rotation sweep was approximately 42%. These findings show that adaptive control can improve equation satisfaction while weakening other physical constraints. PINN training should therefore be evaluated using separate PDE, boundary-condition, and solution-error metrics rather than weighted total loss alone.

</details>


### [163] [Hidden in the Comments: A Context-Injection Attack Surface in Code LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05139)
*Noor Munir,Francesco Quinzan,Stephen Roberts*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究代码大模型（Code LLM）助手是否会因异构上下文中嵌入的不安全指令而生成漏洞代码，发现攻击条件下77.4%–92.3%的补全含中度及以上弱点，而良性条件下仅1.7%–5.1%，且指令微调最多只降低8.1%的脆弱性，与模型规模或专业化无明确关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码LLM助手从开放文件、导入模块、粘贴片段和注释等异构上下文中生成代码，这些来源可能不可信。作者希望探究：在无法访问模型权重或训练数据的情况下，上下文中嵌入的不安全指令能否将Code LLM引导至生成漏洞代码，从而识别推理阶段的攻击面。

Method: 评估10个开放权重Code LLM（3B–13B参数），包含4个基础模型和6个指令微调模型，覆盖10类Web应用弱点。设置攻击条件（在代码注释中嵌入不安全指令的补全任务）与良性条件（无恶意指令的任务）进行对比；采用等价性检验和三对匹配模型；并使用基于模式的检测器和生成后筛选进行验证。

Result: 攻击条件下77.4%–92.3%的补全含中度或更高弱点，良性条件下仅1.7%–5.1%。基础模型与指令微调模型平均脆弱输出分别为86.5%和84.5%，等价性检验和三对匹配模型表明指令微调后降幅至多8.1%。易感性同模型规模或专业化无明确关联。脆弱攻击输出中86.2%–91.0%被评为高或严重级别，且该效应在移除基于模式的检测器后依然存在。生成后筛选降低但未消除风险，最强筛选仍漏检约三分之一。

Conclusion: 推理阶段的上下文注入构成一个显著的攻击面，现有生成后筛选不足以完全缓解风险，因此需要面向来源感知（provenance-aware）的训练目标。

Abstract: Code large language model (Code LLM) assistants generate code from heterogeneous development contexts, including open files, imported modules, pasted snippets, and comments, much of which may originate from untrusted sources. We investigate whether insecure instructions embedded in such contexts can steer Code LLMs toward vulnerable code without access to model weights or training data. We evaluate ten open-weight Code LLMs spanning 3B--13B parameters, including four base and six instruction-tuned models, across ten web-application weakness classes. We compare completion tasks containing insecure instructions embedded as code comments with benign tasks without malicious instructions. Attack-condition completions contained a medium-or-higher weakness in {\bf 77.4--92.3}\% of cases, compared with {\bf 1.7--5.1}\% in the benign condition. Base and instruction-tuned models averaged 86.5\% and 84.5\% vulnerable outputs, respectively; equivalence testing and three matched model pairs indicated reductions of at most 8.1\% after instruction tuning. Susceptibility showed no clear association with model scale or specialization. Among vulnerable attack outputs, 86.2--91.0\% were rated high or critical, and the effect persisted without the pattern-based detector. Post-generation screening reduced but did not eliminate the risk, the strongest screen leaving roughly one-third undetected. These findings identify inference-time context injection as a substantial attack surface and motivate provenance-aware training objectives.

</details>


### [164] [Arithmetic Actor Heads and Training Stabilization for Out-of-Distribution Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05143)
*Yifan Zhang,Liang Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究在OOD幅度漂移下强化学习策略退化问题，提出因果-符号BAPR（CS-BAPR）系列，将六种训练稳定化设置与多种actor头（NAU+NMU二次修正、KAN、ReLU/Tanh-MLP）结合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习策略在分布外（OOD）幅度漂移下性能会显著退化，需要提升策略的鲁棒性与泛化能力。

Method: 以软演员-评论家（SAC）及其贝叶斯遗忘分段鲁棒（BAPR）前身为起点，构建CS-BAPR系列；在六种训练稳定化配置下，替换不同的actor头，包括带NMU启发式二次修正的神经加法单元（NAU）、Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN），以及使用ReLU或双曲正切激活的多层感知机（MLP）。

Result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据或性能指标，仅给出方法组合框架。

Conclusion: 通过将训练稳定化策略与多种符号/因果结构化的actor头结合，构建CS-BAPR家族以应对OOD幅度漂移下的策略退化；具体效果有待实验验证。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) policies can deteriorate under out-of-distribution (OOD) magnitude shifts. Starting from soft actor-critic (SAC) and its Bayesian Amnesic Piecewise-Robust (BAPR) predecessor, we study the causal-symbolic BAPR (CS-BAPR) family. The practical method combines six training-stabilization settings with alternative actor heads: a Neural Addition Unit (NAU) with a Neural Multiplication Unit (NMU)-inspired quadratic correction, a Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN), or a multilayer perceptron (MLP) with rectified linear unit (ReLU) or hyperbolic-tangent activations.

</details>


### [165] [Measuring Learned Monotone Temporal Aggregation at Matched Admissibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05196)
*Yew Lee Tan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文在固定"逐输入单调性"这一合规约束的前提下，比较"学习式聚合"与"手工聚合"，发现学习式单调通道在几何加权可分族内可与手工统计量相互替代，并在衰减区域覆盖、稀缺数据与超出训练支撑三方面具有 incumbent 特定优势，但存在连续性与时间定位等结构性失败边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 风险监管对分数施加方向性约束，既有部署管线（单调手工聚合 + 符号约束梯度提升）通过组合天然满足"分数对每个暴露输入单调非降"。因此常见的"约束 vs 非约束"对比实际上是在为 incumbent 免费获得的保证定价，问题设定不公平。作者希望双方都满足同一可采纳性（admissibility），从而单独衡量"学习聚合"本身的价值。

Method: 以递归网络为工具，其状态由经典风险统计量构成（指数加权移动平均 EWMA 与高水位标记，配合可学习变换），按构造对每个输入及每个 MC-dropout 采样均单调。通过函数回归（functional regression）分析学习到的单调通道与手工统计族之间的关系，并与 committed grid 驱动的树集成等最强工程化 comparator 在 AUC、样本量、支撑外行为等维度对比。

Result: 得到一条"subsumption boundary"：单条学习单调通道可逐成员复现几何加权可分族（Spearman ρ≥0.996）；对窗口统计量可逼近但有可测上限；在连续性（ρ=0.924）与时间定位（0.628）上结构性失败，在暴露下限（0.829）上为可学习性边界；引入一个显式可采纳基后每项失败均修复（秩相关 1.000）。在可分族内学习与工程聚合可替代，满样本与既定容量下学习通道从不统计落后；其优势具 incumbent 特性：committed grid 在未覆盖衰减区最高损失 0.019 AUC（学习通道在所有扫描点距最强工程 consumer 不超过 0.004），最高维 comparator 在稀缺数据下退化最快，训练支撑外 grid 驱动的树集成分数变平而严格递增的头部仍保持排序。没有单一 incumbent 在三轴上被全面支配。

Conclusion: 在可采纳性固定的公平设定下，学习式单调聚合在可分族内与手工聚合互为替代，并在衰减覆盖、数据稀缺鲁棒性与支撑外排序三方面具有 incumbent 特定优势，但受连续性与时间定位等结构性边界及暴露下限这一可学习性边界限制，可通过显式可采纳基修复。三类轴向上不存在单一被全面支配的 incumbent，选型取决于具体 incumbbent 的弱点。

Abstract: Risk regulation imposes directional constraints on scores; we adopt their strict per-input form -- the score monotone non-decreasing in every exposure input -- as a normative commitment. Deployed pipelines -- monotone hand-crafted aggregates feeding sign-constrained gradient boosting -- already satisfy it by composition, so constrained-versus-unconstrained comparisons price a guarantee the incumbent has for free. We instead hold admissibility fixed on both sides and measure what learning the aggregation is worth. Our instrument is a recurrent network whose state is classical risk statistics (an exponentially weighted moving average and a high-water mark with learned transforms), monotone by construction in every input and per MC-dropout sample. The central finding, by functional regression, is a subsumption boundary: a learned monotone channel reproduces the geometrically weighted separable family of hand-crafted statistics, one channel per member, to Spearman $ρ\ge 0.996$, approximates window statistics with measurable ceilings, and fails at consecutivity ($ρ= 0.924$) and time localization (0.628), both structural, and at the exposure floor (0.829), a learnability boundary. One explicit admissible basis repairs each failure (rank correlation 1.000). In or near the separable family, learned and engineered aggregation are substitutes, and the learned channel is never statistically behind at full sample size and specified capacity. Its advantages are incumbent-specific: a committed grid pays up to 0.019 AUC in decay regions it leaves uncovered (the learned channel stays within 0.004 of the strongest engineered consumer at every swept point); the highest-dimensional comparator degrades fastest with scarce data; and beyond the training support, grid-fed tree-ensemble scores go flat while a strictly increasing head keeps ranking. No single incumbent is dominated on all three axes.

</details>


### [166] [Cross-Time Directional Selection in Diffusion Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05199)
*Dhia naouali*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文直接比较了"经早期步骤变换后的扰动（shaped）"与"新采样各向同性噪声（fresh）"在剩余扩散采样步骤中的放大效应，发现shaped扰动在角度增益、潜变量RMS变化及感知特征变化上均系统性更强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准度量用新采样的各向同性噪声来评估晚期潜状态扰动的放大强度，但采样过程中实际遇到的扰动已被早期步骤变换过，二者性质不同。论文旨在直接对比这两种情形，验证标准度量是否会低估真实扰动的放大效应。

Method: 对每条轨迹，将来自较早步骤的中心化扰动传输到晚期状态，再以与新鲜各向同性扰动相同的幅度重放其方向；随后两者经历相同的剩余采样更新。比较shaped与fresh扰动在角度增益、端点潜变量RMS变化以及感知特征表示上的差异，并通过跨轨迹置换shaped方向进行对照实验。

Result: 在所研究的采样器中，shaped-to-fresh角度增益比值的中位数范围为1.14至2.35；在原始主队列的每条轨迹中，shaped角度增益均超过匹配的fresh扰动。以潜变量RMS衡量的端点变化也呈现相同模式。在感知特征表示中，早期采样方向导致端点特征变化更大，即使对应像素空间变化相当。跨轨迹置换shaped方向会削弱该效应（包括类内置换），说明其优势既依赖与接收轨迹的对齐，也依赖共享的方向结构。

Conclusion: 早期采样步骤塑造的扰动方向在剩余采样中被更强放大，标准用新鲜各向同性噪声的度量低估了这一效应；该优势取决于扰动与接收轨迹的对齐及共享方向结构，对理解扩散采样误差传播与扰动敏感性具有意义。

Abstract: How strongly do the remaining diffusion-sampling steps amplify a perturbation at a late latent state? Standard measurements answer this question with newly sampled isotropic noise, even though perturbations encountered during sampling have already been transformed by earlier steps. We compare these two cases directly. For each trajectory, we transport a centered perturbation from an earlier step to a late state, then replay its direction at the same magnitude as a newly sampled isotropic perturbation; both then undergo the same remaining
  updates. Across the samplers we study, median paired shaped-to-fresh angular-gain ratios range from $1.14$ to $2.35$. Shaped angular gain exceeds its matched fresh counterpart in every trajectory in the original main cohorts. The same pattern appears when endpoint change is measured by latent RMS. The effect also appears in perceptual feature representations: earlier-sampling directions cause larger feature
  changes at the endpoint, even when the corresponding pixel-space change is comparable. Permuting shaped directions across trajectories weakens the effect, including within class, indicating that the advantage depends on alignment with the receiving trajectory as well as on shared directional structure.

</details>


### [167] [Learning without Overwriting: A Theory of Self-Distillation and Supervised Fine-Tuning in Continual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05200)
*Shinichi Uemura,Taiji Suzuki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将LLM推理建模为DAG上的搜索，统一理论分析了在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）与监督微调（SFT）在持续学习中的动力学差异，以及预训练对后续性能的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPSD在提升推理能力的同时能保留已有知识，实证成功显著，但其在持续推理中的动力学机制尚未被充分理解，缺乏统一的理论解释。

Method: 将LLM推理建模为有向无环图（DAG）上的搜索过程，对后训练阶段（OPSD与SFT）在持续学习中的动力学及预训练对后续性能的影响进行统一理论分析，并给出优化保证。

Result: 建立三点核心结论：(i) 借助正确输出提示（hints）的OPSD通过提示结构诱导的稀疏而有效的梯度更新，实现不遗忘的持续学习；(ii) 对正确推理路径的SFT因沿训练路径的密集更新而覆盖旧信息，导致灾难性遗忘；(iii) 预训练的多样性对于后训练模型从中间状态出发的rollout能否到达正确输出至关重要。

Conclusion: 可靠的持续推理取决于后训练更新与预训练阶段所建立的推理结构之间的相互作用方式。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) of large language models (LLMs) has demonstrated the ability to improve reasoning capabilities while preserving previously acquired knowledge. Despite substantial empirical success, the dynamics of OPSD in continual reasoning remain incompletely understood. Modeling LLM reasoning as search over a directed acyclic graph, we provide a unified theoretical analysis of both the dynamics of post-training---OPSD and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) in continual learning---and the impact of pre-training on subsequent performance. Our findings establish three key insights with an optimization guarantee: (i) OPSD with hints from correct outputs enables continual learning without forgetting by sparse yet effective gradient descent updates induced by the hint structure. (ii) SFT on correct reasoning paths can lead to catastrophic forgetting due to dense updates along the training paths, which overwrite the information previously acquired. (iii) Diversity in pre-training is crucial for enabling a post-trained model to reach a correct output when a rollout starts from an intermediate state. Our results, supported by theoretical analysis, show that reliable continual reasoning depends on how post-training updates interact with the reasoning structure established during pre-training.

</details>


### [168] [Ranking Bandits for Carousel Interfaces with Observable Browsing Depth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05220)
*Takuma Yasuda,Atsuyoshi Nakamura*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究轮播界面下的排序赌博机问题：用户浏览深度可观测，形成暴露与点击的部分反馈，并提出UCB、TS、DMED三种算法，其中DMED在极限意义下达到渐近最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统排序赌博机模型（如cascade、position-based模型）通常将用户是否检查（examination）视为潜在变量，只根据点击反馈推断。而轮播界面可直接观察用户的最大浏览深度，因此能够区分“已展示但未被点击”与“从未展示”的条目。利用这一额外信号有望改进推荐系统的点击率与学习效率。

Method: 将问题形式化为排序赌博机：学习器展示含L个条目的列表，观察用户最大浏览深度，仅获得不超过该深度的位置的点击反馈；目标是在未知条目吸引力向量与浏览深度分布下最大化期望点击数。提出基于UCB、Thompson Sampling（TS）和DMED的三种算法，仅利用已观测到的暴露更新条目统计量。

Result: 为UCB算法推导出实例相关的对数上界；为DMED算法导出渐近上界，当参数α↓0时与下界吻合，从而在该极限下具有渐近最优性。合成浅浏览与深浏览环境、以及基于RecGaze交互日志参数化的实验表明：OD-TS最终平均遗憾与PBM-TS相近，而所提方法最终平均遗憾低于PBM-UCB。

Conclusion: 直接利用可观测浏览深度可有效改进排序赌博机的学习，所提算法在理论上具备遗憾保证与渐近最优性，并在模拟与真实日志参数实验中优于PBM-UCB，与PBM-TS表现相当。

Abstract: Carousel interfaces allow a recommender system to directly observe how far a user has browsed. This signal distinguishes displayed but unclicked items from items that were never displayed, whereas conventional ranking-bandit models, including cascade and position-based models, generally treat examination as latent. We formulate a ranking-bandit problem in which a learner presents a list of $L$ items, observes the user's maximum browsing depth, and receives click feedback only for positions up to that depth. The objective is to maximize the expected number of clicks under an unknown item-attractiveness vector and a browsing-depth distribution. We propose three algorithms based on UCB, Thompson Sampling, and DMED, all of which update item statistics only from observed exposures. We derive an instance-dependent logarithmic upper bound for our UCB-based algorithm and an asymptotic upper bound for our DMED-based algorithm that coincides with the lower bound as its parameter $α\downarrow 0$, establishing asymptotic optimality in this limit. Simulations in synthetic shallow- and deep-browsing environments, together with experiments parameterized from RecGaze interaction logs, show that OD-TS attains final mean regret similar to PBM-TS, while the proposed methods achieve lower final mean regret than PBM-UCB.

</details>


### [169] [EMG-GPT: Predictive Pretraining on Residual-Quantized EMG Tokens for Hand Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05235)
*Ettore Magni,Rolandos Alexandros Potamias,Stefanos Zafeiriou,Konstantinos Barmpas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EMG-GPT是一种基于因果Transformer的自监督模型，通过在冻结的RVQ离散化sEMG表征上进行深度自回归未来码预测，学习可迁移的时序表征，用于连续手部姿态估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: sEMG是一种低功耗、低成本的生物信号，适用于手部姿态估计与手势分类。作者希望探究：对sEMG进行自监督预训练，能否获得可用于连续手部姿态估计的可迁移表征。

Method: 提出EMG-GPT：一种因果Transformer模型，输入为来自冻结的残差矢量量化（RVQ）分词器的离散sEMG表征，通过深度自回归的未来码预测学习时序动态；模型将帧内整合与因果时序建模相结合，同时保留预训练码本的几何结构。

Result: EMG-GPT在回归（Regression）与跟踪（Tracking）两类任务上均取得有竞争力的结果。

Conclusion: 结果支持仅使用EMG进行预训练是一种学习可迁移sEMG表征的可行方法。

Abstract: Surface electromyography (sEMG) is a low-power, cost-effective biosignal for hand-pose estimation and gesture classification. In this work, we examine whether self-supervised pretraining on sEMG can yield transferable representations for continuous hand-pose estimation. We introduce EMG-GPT, a causal transformer-based model that operates on discrete sEMG representations from a frozen residual vector quantization (RVQ) tokenizer and learns temporal dynamics through depth-autoregressive future-code prediction. The model combines within-frame integration with causal temporal modeling while preserving the geometry of the pretrained codebook. EMG-GPT shows competitive results in both Regression and Tracking tasks, supporting EMG-only pretraining as a viable approach for learning transferable sEMG representations.

</details>


### [170] [Pythia: Toward Foundation World Models for Multimodal Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05240)
*Xilin Dai,Hongzhou Chen,Yifan Hu,Yiding Liu,Zewei Dong,Jiang-Ming Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Pythia，一种基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的时间序列基础世界模型，通过共享预训练学习上下文条件下的潜在动态，并将世界模型预训练与观测空间预测解耦。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型虽能跨异构领域统一预测，但文本上下文与辅助观测所蕴含的互补信息尚未被充分用于可复用的多模态预测表征，相关探索不足。

Method: Pythia 采用联合嵌入预测架构学习跨数据集的上下文条件潜在动态；引入带停止梯度的数值参考引导对预测未来状态的上下文修正；再以独立的概率解码器适配冻结的预测表征与观测历史，从而解耦世界模型预训练与观测空间预测。并通过一系列受控实验探究共享预训练下的世界模型设计及多模态信息融合方式。

Result: 在 MUSE 基准上，Pythia-Tiny 的 MASE 为 0.6879、WSQL 为 0.4269，相较已发布 MUSE 排行榜中最强模型的误差分别降低 6.26% 与 5.00%。实验结果支持将预测表征学习与概率读出分离，并显示实体描述、事件与协变量具有互补贡献。

Conclusion: 将预测表征学习与概率读出解耦的时间序列世界模型设计是有效的，多模态上下文（实体描述、事件、协变量）可提供互补信息，为可复用多模态预测表征提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Time-series foundation models offer a unified approach to forecasting across heterogeneous domains. Textual context and auxiliary observations provide complementary information about temporal dynamics, yet reusable multimodal predictive representations remain underexplored. We introduce Pythia, a foundation world model that learns context-conditioned latent dynamics across datasets through a joint-embedding predictive architecture. A stop-gradient numerical reference guides contextual corrections to predicted future states. A separate probabilistic decoder then adapts to the frozen predictive representation and observed history, decoupling world-model pretraining from observation-space forecasting. On MUSE, Pythia-Tiny's normalized mean absolute scaled error (MASE) and weighted sum quantile loss (WSQL) are 0.6879 and 0.4269, reducing errors by 6.26% and 5.00% relative to the strongest model evaluated in the published MUSE leaderboard. Through a series of controlled experiments, we investigate how to design a time-series world model through shared pretraining and how joint-embedding predictive learning can incorporate multimodal information. The results support separating predictive representation learning from probabilistic readout and show complementary contributions from entity descriptions, events, and covariates.

</details>


### [171] [Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Personal Context Recognition on ExtraSensory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05250)
*Hoang-Thang Ta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在ExtraSensory个人情境识别数据集上评测多种KAN变体，并与MLP、TabM对比，发现KAN在Macro-F1/Micro-F1上显著优于MLP且与TabM相当，但训练时间更长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KAN近年来在多种AI任务中受到关注，但其在个人情境识别任务上的表现尚缺乏系统评测，尤其是相对MLP、TabM等基线方法的性能与效率权衡不明确。

Method: 在ExtraSensory数据集上评测多个KAN变体，以MLP和TabM为基线；采用5个用户折、每折3个随机种子进行主实验，报告Macro-F1、Micro-F1与训练时间的平均值；并对网格大小、网格数量及数据归一化进行浅层消融实验。

Result: 所有评测的KAN变体在Macro-F1与Micro-F1上显著优于MLP，性能与TabM相当；但KAN变体通常需要更多训练时间，TabM在预测性能与训练效率之间取得更优平衡。

Conclusion: KAN在个人情境识别中具有潜力，但计算效率仍是其重要挑战；源代码已公开。

Abstract: Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs) have attracted increasing attention in recent years, with applications across a wide range of AI tasks. In this paper, we evaluate several KAN variants on the ExtraSensory dataset for personal context recognition and compare them with a multilayer perceptron (MLP) and TabM. We conduct the main experiments using five user folds and three random seeds per fold and report the average Macro-F1, Micro-F1, and training time. We also perform shallow ablation studies on grid size, the number of grids, and data normalization to examine their effects on KAN performance. The results show that all evaluated KAN variants significantly outperform MLP in terms of Macro-F1 and Micro-F1 and achieve performance comparable to TabM. However, KAN variants generally require more training time, while TabM provides a more favorable balance between predictive performance and training efficiency. These results suggest that KANs are promising for personal context recognition, while their computational efficiency remains an important challenge. Our source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/hoangthangta/ExtraSensory-KANs.

</details>


### [172] [Loopy: Low-Bit Quantization Framework for Looped Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05265)
*Zeyu LI,Yipu ZHANG,Jintao Chen,Xin LI,Wei ZHANG*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Loopy，一种面向循环语言模型的循环深度感知训练后量化框架，在目标部署深度选择共享低比特表示，八种设置下达SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环语言模型通过重复执行共享递归核心以参数高效方式扩展迭代测试时计算，训练后量化（PTQ）可降低其内存与推理成本；但量化共享核心引入的误差会向后传递影响后续核心。作者发现量化配置候选的排名会随循环深度变化，因此应在目标部署深度进行配置选择，然而在该深度上对全部候选进行全量校准评估代价高昂。

Method: Loopy将共享核心量化建模为循环深度感知的目标函数，依据候选表示在目标部署深度上的最终预测损失来选择共享低比特表示；候选表示由通道缩放（channel scaling）和正交旋转（orthogonal rotations）参数化，二者保持浮点计算等价但量化质量不同。为高效近似求解，Loopy以渐进方式将校准窗口分配给有潜力的候选，同时保持完整的目标深度执行，且仅使用前向评估，无需反向传播。

Result: 在八种设置中，Loopy在所有基线方法中取得最先进结果。在Ouro-1.4B、W4A4配置下，相较SpinQuant，Loopy将LAMBADA困惑度相对降低36.5%。

Conclusion: 循环深度感知的配置选择对共享核心量化至关重要，Loopy通过渐进式校准窗口分配实现了高效且SOTA的PTQ效果，代码已开源。

Abstract: Looped language models provide a parameter-efficient way to scale iterative test-time computation by repeatedly executing a shared recurrent core. Post-training quantization (PTQ) can reduce the memory footprint and inference cost of looped language models, but errors introduced by a quantized shared core affect subsequent cores. Among PTQ methods, channel scaling and orthogonal rotations preserve the floating-point computation while producing representations with different quantization quality. We find that quantization configuration candidate rankings can change with recurrent depth, motivating configuration selection at the target deployment depth. However, evaluating every candidate over the full calibration set at this depth is costly. We therefore propose Loopy, a PTQ framework that formulates shared-core quantization through a recurrent-depth-aware objective, selecting shared low-bit representations by their final prediction loss at the target deployment depth. Channel scaling and orthogonal rotations parameterize the candidate representations. To approximately solve this selection problem efficiently, Loopy progressively allocates calibration windows to promising candidates while preserving complete target-depth execution, using only forward evaluations. Across eight settings, Loopy achieves the state-of-the-art results among different baselines. On Ouro-1.4B under W4A4, Loopy reduces LAMBADA perplexity by 36.5% relative to SpinQuant. Our code is available at https://github.com/Shameless0817/Loopy-review.git.

</details>


### [173] [A Unified Scaling Law for Time Series Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05269)
*Xilin Dai,Yiding Liu,Zewei Dong,Jiang-Ming Yang,Qiang Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出统一缩放定律与时间序列学习理论，揭示模型容量与历史信息如何支撑预测，并在多任务、多检查点上验证预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解模型容量与历史信息（回看长度、预测视野）如何共同影响时间序列预测，并区分全样本模型与冻结TSFM利用历史信息的机制。

Method: 基于23个数据集-频率任务、6个域、21个检查点、18,768个实验单元，拟合五参数统一缩放定律（容量增益随历史增加、上下文增益趋于饱和、视野效应为共同平移）；并用高斯回归的学习理论分析规则识别与预测能力，辅以匹配历史比较、受控参数交换和激活干预。

Result: 在未使用Toto 2.0拟合的情况下，定律预测其视野平均容量缩放曲线，在输入长度2048和4096处的MAPE分别为1.09%和1.50%；匹配历史比较证实额外历史的预测价值，干预实验支持历史规则信息可保留、跨查询复用并贡献长上下文预测。

Conclusion: 研究为容量缩放、上下文分配以及能够保留并应用历史规则的模型开发提供依据。

Abstract: We develop a Unified Scaling Law and a Unified Theory of Time Series Learning to understand how model capacity and historical information support forecasting. Across different lookback lengths and forecast horizons, we analyze 18,768 experimental cells from 21 checkpoints on 23 dataset-frequency tasks spanning six domains. Our empirical methodology integrates local resource relations into a parsimonious, fitted five-parameter law: capacity gains increase with history, context gains diminish toward saturation, and horizon effects enter as a common shift. Fitted without Toto 2.0, the law predicts its horizon-averaged capacity-scaling curves with mean absolute percentage errors of 1.09% and 1.50% at input lengths 2048 and 4096. To understand how history supports prediction, our learning theory uses Gaussian regression to analyze rule identification and predictive capability. We hypothesize that full-shot models learn by accumulating information in weights, while frozen time series foundation models (TSFMs) use history by extracting information through activations. Matched-history comparisons establish the predictive value of additional history. Controlled parameter exchanges and activation interventions provide evidence that history-derived rule information can be retained, reused across queries, and used to recover a contribution to long-context prediction. Together, these findings inform capacity scaling, context allocation, and the development of models that retain and apply historical rules. Code and main results are available at https://github.com/Fifthky/UniScale.

</details>


### [174] [Fast Convergence through Distributed Augmentation for Class-Imbalanced Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05279)
*Arathi Nair M,J. Harshan,Anwitaman Datta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DAFL，一个分布式数据增强框架，通过建立增强量与联邦学习收敛的关系，为每个客户端-类别对确定最小增强量，在改善少数类F1的同时大幅降低训练时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习中的类别不平衡会损害少数类性能。常见做法是增强少数类样本以实现本地类别平衡，但现有方法将增强视为启发式手段，未建立增强量与联邦学习收敛之间的关系，导致过度增强和训练时间增加。

Method: 作者首先建立增强量与联邦学习收敛行为之间的关系；基于该洞见提出DAFL，通过联合最小化增强量与训练时间，并约束全局类别不平衡，为每个客户端-类别对确定所需的最小增强量。

Result: 实验结果表明，DAFL持续提升少数类F1分数，同时显著减少训练时间，在严重全局类别不平衡和高标签比例不平衡条件下尤为明显。

Conclusion: 通过理论刻画增强—收敛关系来指导增强量的最小化分配，可在不牺牲少数类性能的前提下提升联邦学习训练效率。

Abstract: In federated learning, mitigating class imbalance is essential to improve minority-class performance. A common approach to address this problem is to augment minority-class samples to achieve local class balance. Existing approaches treat augmentation as a heuristic and do not establish how the amount of augmentation influences the convergence of federated learning, leading to excessive augmentation and increased training time. To address this limitation, we first establish the relationship between augmentation and the convergence behavior of federated learning. Leveraging this insight, we propose DAFL, a distributed augmentation framework that determines the minimum augmentation required for each client-class pair by jointly minimizing augmentation and training time while constraining global class imbalance, thereby improving minority-class F1-score. Experimental results demonstrate that DAFL consistently improves minority-class F1-score while substantially reducing training time, particularly under severe global class imbalance and high label proportion imbalance.

</details>


### [175] [Smoothed Gradient Method for Nonconvex Federated Stochastic Bilevel Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05290)
*Xinwen Zhang,Peiran Yu,Zhaosong Lu,Hongchang Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种随机双重平滑梯度方法（stochastic doubly smoothed gradient method），用于非凸联邦随机双层优化，解耦上下层变量的学习率，并去除下层强凸假设。理论上获得 $O(\kappa^{15/2}/\epsilon^5)$ 的收敛速率与 $O(\kappa^4/\epsilon^3)$ 的通信复杂度，对条件数 $\kappa$ 的依赖显著优于现有方法，实验验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦随机双层优化在机器学习中应用广泛，但二阶 Hessian/Jacobian 矩阵计算开销大，因此已有工作转向一阶方法。然而现有方法存在三个主要缺陷：（1）对下层函数施加较强限制性假设（如强凸性）；（2）收敛速率对条件数 $\kappa$ 依赖过强；（3）上下层变量需要不同尺度的学习率，限制了实用性并增加超参调优难度。本文旨在同时缓解这三点问题。

Method: 提出随机双重平滑梯度方法（stochastic doubly smoothed gradient method）。核心设计是：通过双重平滑机制解耦上层与下层变量的学习率，使二者可采用统一（或独立且不耦合）的学习率尺度；同时不要求下层损失函数强凸，仅需较弱假设即可运行；方法为一阶方法，避免二阶 Hessian 与 Jacobian 计算。

Result: 建立了严格的理论保证：收敛速率为 $O(\kappa^{15/2}/\epsilon^5)$，通信复杂度为 $O(\kappa^4/\epsilon^3)$，其中 $\kappa$ 为条件数、$\epsilon$ 为解精度。与现有方法相比，这两个界对条件数 $\kappa$ 的依赖显著更优。大量实验验证了算法的有效性。

Conclusion: 该工作面向非凸联邦随机双层优化，提出的随机双重平滑梯度方法在放宽下层函数假设（无需强凸）、解耦上下层学习率的同时，取得对条件数依赖更优的收敛速率与通信复杂度，兼顾了理论保证与实用可调性，并通过实验得到验证。

Abstract: In recent years, federated stochastic bilevel optimization has attracted increasing attention due to its wide range of applications in machine learning. To reduce the computational overhead associated with second-order Hessian and Jacobian matrices, several first-order methods have been proposed. However, existing methods typically impose restrictive assumptions on the lower-level function, suffer from a strong dependence on the condition number in their convergence rates, and require different learning-rate scales for variables across the upper- and lower-level problems, limiting their practical applicability and complicating hyperparameter tuning. To address these challenges, we propose a stochastic doubly smoothed gradient method for nonconvex federated stochastic bilevel optimization problems, which decouples the learning rates of upper- and lower-level variables and does not require a strongly-convex lower-level loss function. We establish rigorous theoretical guarantees for the proposed algorithm, demonstrating an improved convergence rate of $O(κ^{15/2}/ε^5)$ and a communication complexity of $O(κ^{4}/ε^3)$, where $κ$ denotes the condition number and $ε$ represents the solution accuracy. Notably, these bounds exhibit significantly better dependence on the condition number $κ$ than those of existing methods. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our algorithm.

</details>


### [176] [Erased, Rerouted, or Rescaled? Post-Training and the Causal Quotient of a Language Model's Belief State](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05292)
*Weihan Li,Tianshi Zheng,Junhao Wu,Xinlei Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"奖励零核"（reward-null kernel）框架，将后训练中预训练信息的下场区分为三种可识别命运——擦除、改道（不再驱动决策但仍可解码）、重标度（方差缩小但仍被使用），并在受控模型与开源语言模型中验证了该区分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表征压缩的常用语言把"信息减少"笼统地混为一谈，无法区分信息究竟是被擦除、被改道还是仅被重标度，因此需要一套可操作、可测量的判据来厘清后训练对预训练知识的影响。

Method: 作者利用预训练能恢复贝叶斯信念状态的模型，构造只读取隐状态粗粒度函数的奖励，从而定义精确的奖励零核；借助该核分别测量信息是否仍可恢复、决策是否因果依赖它、以及它占据多少激活方差。理论上分析KL锚定强化学习、监督与无锚目标以及谱压缩的约束差异，并在受控环境与开源语言模型中做实证检验。

Result: 后训练大多对奖励零信息进行改道或重标度，信息仍可解码；无锚时决策可能不再使用该信息而表征仍存活，有锚时则继续使用；只有长期权重衰减下，且对奖励与下一词预测均不可见的区分才会被擦除。开源模型显示同样分离：上下文信念几何在深层谱压缩下仍可解码，类内行为依赖锚定。

Conclusion: 后训练相当于为预训练信念状态选取一个因果商：奖励定义决策等价性，锚定与状态更新保护被忽略的部分，优化则决定其余部分是擦除、改道还是重标度。

Abstract: What happens to information a pretrained model already encodes when post-training no longer rewards using it? The common language of representation compression conflates three fates: information may be erased, rerouted away from the decision while still represented, or rescaled to occupy less variance while still represented and used. We make these fates identifiable in models whose pretraining recovers Bayesian belief states. A reward that reads only a coarse function of the hidden state defines an exact reward-null kernel. The kernel lets us separately measure whether the information remains recoverable, whether decisions causally depend on it, and how much activation variance it occupies. Theory says what is protected: KL-anchored reinforcement learning preserves the reference policy's log-odds among equally rewarded outputs, supervised and unanchored objectives carry no such constraint, and spectral compression implies neither erasure nor loss of use. In controlled worlds, post-training mostly reroutes or rescales reward-null information and leaves it decodable. Without an anchor decisions can stop using it although the representation survives, and with one they keep using it. Erasure appears only under prolonged weight decay, for distinctions that neither reward nor next-token prediction can see. Open language models show the same dissociation: in-context belief geometry stays decodable under late-layer spectral compression, and within-class behavior depends on the anchor. Post-training thus selects a causal quotient of the pretrained belief state: the reward defines decision-equivalence, the anchor and the state update protect part of what it ignores, and optimization decides whether the rest is erased, rerouted, or rescaled.

</details>


### [177] [FlexCast: Adaptive Weather Forecasting from Arbitrary Field Sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05296)
*Yuang Zhang,Chen Hui,Weisi Lin,Haiqi Zhu,Xiulai Wang,Sun-Yuan Kung,Feng Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FlexCast，一种字段自适应气象预报模型，用单一参数集为ERA5 69字段注册表中任意可变基数子集生成对齐身份的预报。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多数深度学习气象模型将固定变量与气压层绑定到预设通道，导致模型难以跨大气场配置迁移。

Method: 元数据条件适配器编码变量身份、气压层与字段类型并与空间特征融合；共享rank-16投影由元数据门控调制生成字段特定特征；掩码集合融合聚合可用字段为固定宽度表示；多尺度U-Transformer处理融合特征；身份感知查询解码器输出所请求字段预报；学习标准化6小时增量并递归生成更长时效预报。

Result: 在2020年ERA5测试集上，FlexCast可跨不同字段配置运行；兼容的跨字段上下文对应更低预报误差，而错配上下文会增加误差。

Conclusion: FlexCast实现了单一参数集下的字段自适应预报，提升跨大气场配置的迁移能力，且预报性能对上下文兼容性敏感。

Abstract: Most deep learning weather models assign a fixed set of variables and pressure levels to predefined channels, limiting transfer across atmospheric field configurations. This dependence on a fixed field set limits the transferability of trained models across atmospheric field configurations. We propose FlexCast, a field-adaptive weather forecasting model that uses a single set of parameters to produce identity-aligned forecasts for variable-cardinality subsets drawn from a 69-field ERA5 registry. Specifically, a metadata-conditioned adapter the first encodes variable identity, pressure level, and field type and combines them with spatial features. Then, shared rank-16 projec?tions are modulated by metadata-dependent gates to produce field?specific features, while masked set fusion aggregates the available fields into a fixed-width representation. Subsequently, a multiscale U-Transformer processes the fused atmospheric features, while an identity-aware query decoder produces forecasts for the requested fields. Finally, FlexCast learns a standardized six-hour increment and applies it recursively to generate forecasts at longer lead times. Experiments on the 2020 ERA5 test set demonstrate that FlexCast operates across varying field configurations. Compatible cross-field context is associated with lower forecast errors, whereas mismatched context increases them.

</details>


### [178] [Do Neural Networks Learn Structure-Preserving Maps? A Case Study in Latent-to-Hilbert Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05297)
*Muhammad Adnan Shahzad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究探讨神经网络能否从压缩潜空间学习到希尔伯特空间表示的保结构映射，发现该映射近似线性且本质为秩4。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究神经网络能否学习从压缩潜空间到希尔伯特空间表示（量子态）的保结构映射，检验其映射的线性性、秩结构及与目标基的关系。

Method: 在MNIST上使用8维自编码器瓶颈，配合基于PCA角度编码的n量子比特乘积态目标；采用线性回归、MLP、核岭回归（RBF核）进行映射拟合，并分析余弦相似度、奇异值谱及子空间对齐。

Result: 潜变量到真实目标角度的线性回归达R²=0.98（MLP恢复角度R²=0.91）；学习映射主方向与目标诱导方向余弦相似度0.989，与输入主方向近乎正交（0.002）；映射为秩4，去除任一奇异方向使内积保持退化2.5–5.9倍；学习子空间与PCA基不重合，不同随机种子主方向一致但高阶秩发散；RBF核岭回归（IP误差0.0144）优于调优MLP（0.0197）。

Conclusion: 尽管目标角度经非线性sigmoid变换生成，整体映射在观测潜分布上近似线性且为本质秩4；学习子空间独立于构建目标的PCA基，低级结构在不同种子间稳定而高级结构不稳定；对于这类近似线性的保结构映射，经典核方法（如RBF核岭回归）可作为更简单有效的替代方案。

Abstract: We ask whether a neural network can learn a structure-preserving map from a compressed latent space to a Hilbert-space representation. Using an 8-dimensional autoencoder bottleneck on MNIST and $n$-qubit product-state targets from PCA-based angle encoding, we report four findings. Although the target angles are generated by a nonlinear sigmoid transformation of the latent projections, the resulting mapping is well approximated by a linear function over the observed latent distribution: linear regression from $z$ to the true target angles achieves $R^{2} = 0.98$, while regression to the MLP's recovered angles achieves $R^{2} = 0.91$. The learned map's primary direction is strongly aligned with the target-induced direction, with cosine similarity $0.989$, while remaining nearly orthogonal to the input's principal direction, with cosine similarity $0.002$. The map is genuinely rank-4: removing any singular direction degrades inner-product preservation by $2.5$--$5.9\times$ despite a singular-value spectrum with two dominant and two small values. The learned subspace does not coincide with the PCA basis used to construct the target, and different random seeds recover the same primary direction but diverge in higher ranks. Finally, kernel ridge regression with an RBF kernel outperforms a tuned MLP (IP error $0.0144$ vs.\ $0.0197$), suggesting that for approximately linear structure-preserving mappings, classical kernel methods may be a simpler and more effective alternative.

</details>


### [179] [ASCENT: Online Test-Time Training of Long-Horizon Agents via Self-Distillation of Verified Experience](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05303)
*Haodong Lu,Dong Gong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出在线智能体测试时训练（OaTTT）设定：LLM 智能体在部署过程中单次执行任务流，仅以终止验证信号作为学习信号，并在线更新可跨任务持久的权重。为此提出 ASCENT，通过对已验证轨迹进行自蒸馏（由冻结的初始 LLM 作为特权信息提供者）来更新 LoRA 快速权重，避免直接模仿或强化单次生成 token 导致的策略不稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于上下文适应的智能体将反思、记忆或技能以文本形式存储，其复用依赖正确的经验检索以及冻结策略的执行，无法将部署中积累的经验内化到模型参数中。而直接对单次执行轨迹的生成 token 进行模仿学习或强化学习会破坏策略稳定性，因此需要一种无需外部参考解或更强教师、且能稳定利用已验证经验的在线权重更新方法。

Method: 提出 ASCENT（Agentic Self-distillation for Cross-task EvolutioN at Test-time）。其核心是用 LLM 的冻结初始副本作为稳定模型，将已验证轨迹作为特权信息输入，预测沿该轨迹的下一 token 分布，并将这些分布蒸馏进持久的 LoRA 快速权重中，从而在后续任务上更新智能体。方法无需外部参考解或更强教师模型。此外，ASCENT 进一步移除无效动作轮次，蒸馏增强后的特权经验以提高执行效率。论文还刻画了其总体目标以及稀疏结果选择的局限性。

Result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 AppWorld 上，跨多种模型规模，ASCENT 随着经验积累提升任务成功率与交互效率，优于在线适应方法，并能迁移到留出场景。

Conclusion: 结果表明，智能体可以在没有单独训练阶段、也无需记忆检索的情况下，将已验证经验固化到自身权重中，验证了在线智能体测试时训练范式的可行性与有效性。

Abstract: A large language model (LLM) agent solves long-horizon tasks through many reasoning-action turns, with one verification signal at termination. Deployed agents face streams of related tasks, making their trajectories a natural resource for improvement. In-context adaptation agents store reflections, memories, or skills as text, so reuse depends on retrieving the right experience and on a frozen policy executing it. We study Online Agentic Test-Time Training (OaTTT), which trains the LLM's weights on its own execution trajectories during deployment. The agent executes each task once, in one pass over the stream, and the executed trajectory with its verification result is the only learning signal for weight updates that persist across tasks. Directly imitating or reinforcing the generated tokens of this single attempt destabilizes the policy. We introduce ASCENT (Agentic Self-distillation for Cross-task EvolutioN at Test-time), which instead self-distills verified experience. A stable version of the LLM, its frozen initial copy, receives the verified trajectory as privileged information and predicts next-token distributions along it with this hindsight. Distilling them into persistent LoRA fast weights updates the agent for later tasks, without an external reference solution or stronger teacher. By further removing invalid-action turns, ASCENT distills enhanced privileged experience for more efficient execution. We characterize its population target and the limits of sparse outcome selection. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and AppWorld at varied model scales, ASCENT improves task success and interaction efficiency as experience accumulates, outperforms online adaptation methods, and transfers to held-out scenes, showing that an agent can consolidate verified experience into its weights without a separate training phase or memory retrieval. Project page: https://artificer-ai-lab.github.io/ASCENT

</details>


### [180] [Robust Parameter-Efficient LLM Adaptation on Analog Hardware](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05318)
*Jindan Li,Zhaoxian Wu,Tianyi Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种与优化器无关、参数高效的LoRA适配方法，通过输入重塑与更新累积缓解模拟存内计算中的MVM噪声和有限电导态问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟存内计算能并行完成矩阵-向量乘法、减少数据搬运，适合在端侧执行大模型，但DAC精度有限、输入噪声和有限电导态会降低精度，而全模型重训练代价高昂。

Method: 基于LoRA的优化器无关、参数高效适配方法：固定模拟阵列上的预训练权重，仅训练LoRA权重；用输入重塑降低输入引起的MVM误差，用更新累积保留小幅更新后再写入有限状态器件；同时处理前向/反向MVM误差与物理权重更新误差。

Result: 在Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct与Llama-3-8B上，配合Muon和AdamW，输入重塑在含噪MVM下提升模拟LoRA微调效果；更新累积单独保留亚阈值更新，在有限分辨率编程（少至20个电导态）下显著改善适配；在多种含噪模拟设置下留出集负对数似然一致改善。

Conclusion: 输入重塑与更新累积可有效提升模拟存内计算上LoRA微调的鲁棒性与精度，为噪声和有限分辨率硬件下的端侧大模型适配提供可行方案。

Abstract: Analog in-memory computing is a promising platform for on-device execution of large language models because it performs matrix--vector multiplications (MVMs) in memory and in parallel, reducing data movement. However, limited digital-to-analog converter precision, input noise, and finite conductance states can degrade model accuracy, while full-model retraining to address these effects can be costly. We develop an optimizer-agnostic, parameter-efficient adaptation method based on Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), keeping the pretrained weights stored on analog arrays fixed while training the LoRA weights to adapt to downstream tasks and hardware non-idealities. Reliable adaptation requires handling errors in both forward and backward MVMs and physical weight updates. We use input reshaping to reduce input-induced MVM errors and update accumulation to retain small updates before programming them to finite-state analog devices. Across Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct and Llama-3-8B with both Muon and AdamW, input reshaping improves analog LoRA fine-tuning under noisy MVM computation. Update accumulation separately preserves sub-threshold updates and substantially improves adaptation under finite-resolution programming, including configurations with as few as 20 conductance states. Additional experiments show consistent held-out negative log-likelihood improvements across noisy analog settings.

</details>


### [181] [When Does Longer Reasoning Help? Predicting Mathematical Reasoning Through Discovery and Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05322)
*Adib Hasan,Lay Jain,Thanic Nur Samin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Discovery–Execution（DE）框架，通过"策略发现"与"条件执行"的卷积来预测留出集上的聚合缩放曲线；仅用短预算的独立尝试与 oracle-sketch 条件下的运行，即可估计在替代算力分配下沿留出推理轨迹的累积成功率，并在 35 道奥数题上验证了其优于几何外推的预测能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时算力能提升数学推理，但短预算运行能否预测"增加算力后"的推理性能缩放仍不明确，需要一种可从低成本实验外推长预算表现的方法。

Method: 提出 Discovery–Execution（DE）框架：将推理成功率分解为策略发现与条件执行两部分，用其卷积预测留出集的聚合缩放曲线。输入为独立短预算尝试与 oracle-sketch 条件化运行，从而估计在不同算力分配下沿留出推理轨迹的累积成功率。在 35 道新奥数题及 IMO-ProofBench Advanced 的非几何题上评估四个模型；并给出正则化 DE（R-DE）用于"继续或重启"决策。

Result: GPT 模型表现为接近饱和的执行，DE 框架下预测出几何式缩放；Claude Opus 4.8 引入实测执行信息后，单臂与双臂算力分配下的留出预测均显著优于几何外推。作为次要应用，R-DE 的继续/重启决策平均遗憾低于最优的模型专属事后策略。

Conclusion: 测量"条件执行"能提供短预算成功率无法捕捉的关于长推理的信息，说明短预算运行在结合执行建模后可预测长预算的推理缩放。

Abstract: Test-time compute can improve mathematical reasoning, but can short-budget runs predict how mathematical reasoning scales with additional compute? We introduce a Discovery--Execution (DE) framework that predicts the aggregate held-out scaling curves through a convolution of strategy discovery and conditional execution. From independent short-budget attempts and oracle-sketch-conditioned runs, the framework estimates cumulative success along held-out reasoning trajectories under alternate compute allocations. We evaluate four models on 35 fresh Olympiad problems and non-geometry problems from IMO-ProofBench Advanced. Under the DE framework, near-saturated execution predicts geometric scaling, as observed for the GPT models. For Claude Opus 4.8, incorporating measured execution substantially improves held-out forecasts over geometric extrapolation across one- and two-arm allocations. As a secondary application, regularized DE (R-DE) decisions to continue or restart yield lower average regret than the best model-specific retrospective policy. Together, these results show that measuring conditional execution provides information about longer reasoning that short-budget success rates do not always capture.

</details>


### [182] [Understanding the Weight Averaging Mechanism in LLM Training for Post-Training Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05329)
*Hanzhang Wang,Tianqi Shen,Zonglin Liu,Junze He,Difan Zou,Ziye Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究预训练中权重平均对PTQ的影响机制，将其形式化为"保留训练进度"与"扰动鲁棒性"的权衡，推导出统一平均核族并给出PTQ下权重平均的理论框架，实验验证了预测行为与策略有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM通常高精度预训练但低精度部署（PTQ）。已有研究表明预训练时权重平均可提升PTQ性能，优于学习率衰减，但其机制解释不足，导致性能增益不一致且脆弱，阻碍实际应用。

Method: 将权重平均形式化为保留训练进度与提升扰动鲁棒性之间的权衡；推导连续平均核族，统一传统策略并实现二者Pareto前沿；建立PTQ下权重平均的理论框架，分析量化粒度对扰动敏感性的影响。

Result: 理论表明更粗的量化更易受扰动影响，更细的量化受影响较小；实验验证了所预测的行为及提出的平均策略。

Conclusion: 为不同PTQ条件下执行权重平均提供统一理论指导，提升了权重平均技术的可靠性与可应用性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are typically pretrained in high precision but increasingly deployed with low-precision post-training quantization (PTQ). Recent studies have shown that using weight averaging during pretraining can improve PTQ performance compared with learning-rate decay, suggesting that it might provide a simple way to improve the pretraining-to-quantization transition. But the mechanism behind weight averaging remains insufficiently explained. This leads to inconsistent and fragile performance gains, thereby preventing practitioners from applying such a technique confidently. As a response, we formulate weight averaging as a trade-off between retaining training progress and improving robustness under perturbation. We further derive a continuous family of averaging kernels that unifies conventional strategies and achieves the Pareto frontier between the two competing goals. Critically, a theoretical framework for performing weight averaging under PTQ is developed. It can be shown that coarser quantization is more susceptible to perturbations, whereas finer quantization could be less affected. Thus, our results could provide unified theoretical guidance for performing weight averaging under different PTQ conditions. Experiments validate both the predicted behavior and the proposed averaging strategy. Code is available at https://github.com/MOFA-LAB/weight-averaging-for-ptq.

</details>


### [183] [Compact set-valued deep ensembling in multi-class classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05332)
*Kim-Dung Tran,Dang-Man Nguyen,Vu-Linh Nguyen,Xuan-Truong Hoang,Sébastien Destercke,Van-Nam Huynh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文针对深度集成学习中的训练/存储负担与慎重重（集合值）预测鲁棒性问题，提出使用紧凑集成（贝叶斯神经网络、带MC Dropout的CNN）产生概率预测，通过优化统计距离定义代表分布，进而给出任意效用下的贝叶斯最优预测（BOP），并构造可高效求解集合值BOP的集合效用族。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度集成学习面临三大挑战：成员网络的训练与存储开销大；面向多重效用（可能涉及奖励敏感性）的谨慎（集合值）预测鲁棒性不足；单一（单点）预测在风险下不够稳健。

Method: 1) 采用紧凑集成（贝叶斯神经网络、带Monte-Carlo dropout预测的卷积神经网络）以降低训练与存储成本，产出概率预测；2) 对每个查询实例，用这些概率预测通过优化某个统计距离来定义代表分布；3) 以代表分布定义任意效用下的贝叶斯最优预测（BOP）；4) 提出满足若干理想性质的集合效用族，其集合值BOP可被高效求解。

Result: 给出了所提集成学习框架潜在优势与劣势的经验性证据。

Conclusion: 紧凑集成结合代表分布与贝叶斯最优预测，可在缓解训练/存储负担的同时，通过集合效用族实现高效且更稳健的集合值预测，但框架仍存在需实证权衡的局限。

Abstract: This paper tackles visible challenges in deep ensemble learning, where deep neural networks serve as ensemble members: training and storage burdens, and robustness of cautious (set-valued) predictions targeting multiple utilities, which may involve reward-sensitivity. To mitigate the training and storage burdens, we propose to employ compact ensembles, such as Bayesian Neural Networks and Convolutional Neural Networks with the Monte-Carlo dropout prediction option, to produce probabilistic predictions. For each query instance, these probabilistic predictions are then used to define a representative distribution optimizing some statistical distance. The representative distribution is then employed to define the Bayes-optimal prediction (BOP) of any utility. To address the potential unrobustness of singleton prediction making, we propose a family of set-utilities satisfying some desirable properties and whose set-valued BOPs can be found efficiently. Empirical evidence is then given to illustrate the potential (dis)advantages of the proposed ensemble learning framework.

</details>


### [184] [Diffusion Transformers are Provably Optimal In-context Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05333)
*Guoji Fu,Tomoya Wakayama,Ryotaro Kawata,Atsushi Nitanda,Wee Sun Lee,Taiji Suzuki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从理论上分析了预训练 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 如何在上下文演示下学习并生成预测分布，证明其通过 score estimation 捕获任务不确定性，并在 Hölder 类测试任务上达到 minimax 最优速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式基础模型可在推理时仅凭少量演示（demonstrations）生成目标输出而无需更新参数，但少量演示无法唯一确定目标任务，因此如何学习和采样能反映任务不确定性的输出分布成为关键挑战。本文旨在为 DiT 的上下文生成能力提供理论解释。

Method: 作者对跨任务预训练的 Diffusion Transformer 进行理论分析：(1) 论证从有限演示中应生成的自然目标不是单一任务估计的输出，而是捕捉观测演示后剩余任务不确定性的预测分布；(2) 证明 DiT 可通过 score estimation 学习该预测分布，利用 attention 聚合演示信息、利用 diffusion 生成样本；(3) 在 Hölder 类测试任务上分析其统计速率。

Result: DiT 能够通过 score estimation 学习该预测分布，其中 attention 用于聚合演示信息、diffusion 用于生成样本；在充足的预训练资源和扩撒采样步数下，所得 DiT 在 Hölder 类测试任务上达到 minimax 最优速率。

Conclusion: DiT 可作为一种具有统计理论基础的上下文生成器（in-context generator），能够生成适应新任务的分布，同时保留有限演示中固有的不确定性，实现了对生成式基础模型推理时适应能力的理论刻画。

Abstract: Generative foundation models are attracting interest for their ability to produce desired outputs from demonstrations given at inference time, without updating parameters. However, since a few demonstrations cannot uniquely identify the intended task, the challenge is how to learn and sample from an output distribution that reflects this task uncertainty. In this work, we theoretically analyze how a Diffusion Transformer (DiT), pretrained across diverse tasks, learns and generates predictive distributions for a new query from demonstrations. We first show that the natural target to generate from finite demonstrations is not an output derived from estimating a single task, but rather a predictive distribution that captures the task uncertainty remaining after observing the demonstrations. We then prove that a DiT can learn this predictive distribution through score estimation, using attention to aggregate information from demonstrations and diffusion to generate samples. Owing to this property, with sufficient pretraining resources and diffusion sampling steps, the resulting DiT achieves the minimax optimal rate over a Hölder class of test-time tasks. These results imply that DiT acts as a statistically grounded in-context generator capable of generating distributions adapted to new tasks while retaining the uncertainty inherent in finite demonstrations.

</details>


### [185] [Green-Routed Neural Operators:\\Physics Determines Where the Network Reads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05337)
*Chenhao Si,Ming Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出偏微分方程（PDE）中输运场的物理角色与神经算子中的常规用法存在不匹配，提出Green-Routed Neural Operator（GRNO），用控制方程确定隐特征采样位置，在多个PDE系统上取得更优的长期预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在PDE中，输运场用于"选择读取坐标"，而神经算子通常仅将其视为普通输入值。这种角色不匹配限制了神经算子对输运机制的表达，导致长期自回归预测误差偏高。

Method: 提出GRNO：1）参数无关的方程适配器评估诊断关系，构造"偏离图（departure map）"，其值即为读取坐标；2）多尺度编码器-解码器结合中心读取与路由读取的隐特征，学习完整的有限时间更新；3）通过固定权重路由干预与独立训练的消融实验（仅输入输运场、学习位移替代方程指定路由、空间错位路由）验证机制。

Result: 在五个二/三维PDE系统、40步自回归评估中，GRNO在四个系统上取得最低平均最终相对L²误差，在Keller-Segel上保持竞争力。固定权重路由干预显示四个系统强烈依赖方向与空间对齐，Keller-Segel依赖较弱。消融实验中GRNO在全部五个系统上均优于各变体；并显著优于"直接对流物理状态+学习剩余更新"的方案。

Conclusion: 由方程指定的读取坐标可为长期PDE预测提供有效的结构性先验，纠正输运场"仅作输入"的角色错配是提升神经算子泛化与长时稳定性的关键。

Abstract: We identify a mismatch between the physical role of transport fields in many PDEs and their usual role in neural operators: PDEs use them to select read coordinates, whereas neural operators typically treat them only as input values. We address this mismatch with the Green-Routed Neural Operator (GRNO), which uses the governing equation to determine where latent features are sampled. A parameter-free equation adapter evaluates the diagnostic relation and constructs a departure map whose values are the read coordinates. A multiscale encoder-decoder combines centered and routed reads of latent features to learn the complete finite-time update. Across five two- and three-dimensional PDE systems, GRNO achieves the lowest mean final relative $L^2$ error on four under 40-step autoregressive evaluation and remains competitive on Keller-Segel. Fixed-weight route interventions reveal strong dependence on direction and spatial alignment in four systems, with weak dependence in Keller-Segel. In independently trained ablations, GRNO achieves lower mean errors than variants that supply the transport field only as an input feature, substitute a learned displacement for the equation-specified route, or apply the route with a spatial misalignment, across all five systems. It also substantially outperforms directly advecting the physical state and learning the remaining update, indicating that equation-specified read coordinates provide an effective structural prior for long-horizon PDE forecasting.

</details>


### [186] [On Semi-Markov Suboptimality in Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05338)
*Bingyun Liu,Yuheng Jing*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对分层强化学习中"承诺执行子任务"带来的次优性，将执行次优性与策略次优性分离，提出统一价值函数与四阶段广义分层Bellman方程，证明在有限奖励和一致终止条件下的分层策略/执行改进结果，并给出Markov执行最优的条件，从而实现执行选择的独立分解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分层强化学习利用时间上扩展的子任务进行探索，但对这些子任务执行的承诺（commitment）会同时限制部署与策略学习，产生两种不同的次优性来源，此前工作未将其明确区分与分析。

Method: 提出任务树与执行树以区分奖励目标、策略选择与决策中断；定义HRL统一价值函数（Unified Value Function），构建四阶段广义分层Bellman方程，对执行与策略两类损失进行统一分析；在任意层级深度上实例化执行改进与一阶段/两阶段策略改进。

Result: 在有限奖励和一致终止假设下，建立了分层策略改进与执行改进结果；证明当剩余节点策略固定时，任务子树兼容性与原执行模式下的节点策略最优性共同决定Markov执行何时最优；基于option和goal-conditioned的实验显示改变执行与改变学习目标带来互补收益，受控随机环境实验表明收益依赖随机转移强度与空间结构。

Conclusion: 该框架将执行设计确立为分层策略优化的显式组成部分，使行为、目标与部署的执行选择可以独立进行，从而解耦执行次优与策略次优。

Abstract: Hierarchical reinforcement learning uses temporally extended subtasks for exploration, yet committing to their execution can restrict both deployment and policy learning. We identify and separate the resulting execution and policy suboptimality. Task and execution trees distinguish reward objectives from policy choices and decision interruption. A Unified Value Function for HRL and a four-stage Generalized Hierarchical Bellman Equation then support a common analysis of both losses. Under bounded rewards and uniform termination, we establish hierarchical policy and execution improvement results. With the remaining node policies fixed, task-subtree compatibility and node-policy optimality under the original execution mode establish when Markov execution is optimal. The resulting decomposition leads to independent execution choices for behavior, targets, and deployment. We instantiate this principle through execution improvement and one-stage or two-stage policy improvement at arbitrary hierarchy depth. Option-based and goal-conditioned experiments demonstrate complementary gains from changing execution and changing the learning target. Controlled stochastic environments show how these gains depend on stochastic transition strength and spatial structure. This framework makes execution design an explicit component of hierarchical policy optimization.

</details>


### [187] [Reflections and Fragments: Securing LLMs Against Sequential Mosaic Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05346)
*Emanuele La Malfa,Saar Cohen,Gabriele La Malfa,Mickel Liu,Christian Schroeder de Witt,Natasha Jaques,Michael J. Wooldridge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"马赛克攻击"（多轮无害片段拼装成有害载荷）的防御理论，形式化"哨兵"在线状态机制，证明其在零失败防御与有帮助性之间的条件性最优性，并给出状态/查询下界与实践中的自博弈LoRA训练结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自博弈红队（攻击者-防御者零和博弈）假设攻击可被固定窗口内的近期提示捕获，但真实对手采用马赛克攻击：单轮片段无害、跨轮组合后有害，安全相关信息可能出现在任意早的交互历史中，因此固定有界窗口防御不足。

Method: 1）理论：证明任意固定长度的近期提示窗口一般不足；形式化"哨兵"（watchman）——一种将安全相关信息向前携带的在线状态机制；在显式假设下证明其可实现零失败防御且保持正的有益帮助性，在更强条件下为所有零失败防御者中最优。2）复杂度：给出精确哨兵需指数级状态、非结构化黑箱下精确恶意检测需指数级查询的下界，并讨论这些下界与可学习性的区别（状态下界构造可高效从标注样本学习）。3）提出受约束的优化公式：在零失败防御者中最大化最坏情况的有益帮助性，论证单纯自博弈均衡不能证明有用性。4）实证：在冻结LLM上通过多轮自博弈训练角色专属的攻击者与防御者LoRA适配器。

Result: 理论上证明固定窗口不充分、哨兵机制可实现零失败且正帮助性的防御并具最优性；精确哨兵需指数级状态、黑箱精确检测需指数级查询，且最坏情况安全性认证在受限访问下需要更多信息。实验上，攻击者的有害响应诱导能力增强，防御者对攻击的鲁棒性提升，且在未见攻击目标上也有改进。

Conclusion: 马赛克防御需要跨轮携带安全信息的在线状态机制而非固定窗口；零失败防御存在状态与查询层面的内在代价，但可学习性与最坏情况认证需区分对待；自博弈均衡本身不保证有用性，应以零失败约束下最大化最坏情况有益帮助性为目标；角色专属LoRA自博弈训练可同时提升攻防双方并具泛化性。

Abstract: Self-play red-teaming improves language-model safety by pitting attacker and defender roles against each other in a zero-sum game. However, real adversaries increasingly use mosaic attacks: multi-turn sequences whose individual fragments are innocuous in isolation yet assemble into a harmful payload. We develop a theory of mosaic defense that characterizes what is required to prevent such attacks without sacrificing helpfulness. We first show that no fixed bounded window of recent prompts is sufficient in general: safety-relevant information may occur arbitrarily far back in the interaction. We formalize a watchman, an online state mechanism that carries this information forward, and show that under explicit assumptions it enables zero-failure defense with positive benign helpfulness. Under stronger conditions, it is also optimal among zero-failure defenders. An exact watchman may nevertheless require exponentially many states, while exact maliciousness detection can require exponentially many queries in an unstructured black-box model. These state and query lower bounds do not by themselves imply hard learning: the construction underlying the state lower bound is efficiently learnable from labeled examples, whereas certifying worst-case safety can require substantially more information under restricted access. We also show that self-play equilibrium alone does not certify usefulness, motivating a constrained formulation that maximizes worst-case benign helpfulness among zero-failure defenders. Empirically, training role-specific attacker and defender LoRA adapters over frozen LLMs via multi-turn self-play strengthens both roles: attackers become more effective at eliciting harmful responses, while defenders become more robust to attack, with improvements also observed on unseen attack objectives.

</details>


### [188] [Task Inference Beyond Least Squares in Behavioral Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05350)
*Kuan-Hsun Tu,Chien-Sheng Chiang,Hsin-Wei Chen,Ping-Chun Hsieh,Tsung-Wei Ke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BLS方法，通过平衡奖励重构误差与后继测度不匹配来改进行为基础模型（BFM）的任务向量推断，实现免测试时策略学习的高效零样本策略检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行为基础模型（BFMs）通过从奖励函数推断任务向量，实现无需测试时策略学习的广泛下游任务求解。但现有方法通常采用普通最小二乘（OLS）推断任务向量，虽然高效，却忽略奖励排序约束，导致检索到的零样本策略的后继测度偏离最优策略，策略次优。

Method: 提出BLS，一种高效的测试时推断方法，在最小化奖励重构误差的同时降低后继测度不匹配。理论上给出由后继测度和奖励函数残差刻画的次优性差距上界；实验上在locomotion、manipulation和humanoid control基准上，将BLS叠加于最先进的BFM之上进行评测。

Result: 在多个基准（locomotion、manipulation、humanoid control）上，BLS在几乎可忽略的计算开销下优于现有的任务推断基线。

Conclusion: BLS通过联合优化奖励重构与后继测度失配，有效提升BFM零样本策略检索质量，兼顾效率与性能。

Abstract: Behavioral Foundation Models (BFMs) aim to solve a wide range of downstream tasks without test-time policy learning by inferring a task vector from the reward function. While efficient, the retrieved policies are often suboptimal because of how this task vector is inferred, typically with ordinary least squares (OLS). OLS minimizes reward reconstruction error but leaves the ordering of rewards unconstrained, which can bias the successor measure of the retrieved zero-shot policy away from that of the optimal policy. In this work, we propose BLS, an efficient test-time inference method that balances minimizing reward reconstruction error with reducing successor-measure mismatch. Theoretically, we provide a suboptimality gap upper bound characterized by both successor-measure and reward-function residuals. Empirically, we evaluate BLS on top of state-of-the-art BFMs across benchmarks for locomotion, manipulation, and humanoid control. BLS outperforms existing task inference baselines with negligible computational overhead. Project page: https://embodiedai-ntu.github.io/BLS

</details>


### [189] [Rethinking Tabular Foundation Models On Data Streams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05352)
*Nilesh Verma,Daniel Nowak-Assis,Afonso Lourenço,Albert Bifet,Bernhard Pfahringer,Maroua Bahri,Nick Jin Sean Lim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对表格基础模型（TFM）在数据流场景下的表现进行了系统研究，覆盖内存管理、计算成本以及概念漂移与标签延迟等流式特有挑战，发现TFM预测性能最优，但推理服务成本高昂，指出架构效率是未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TFM在表格基准上通过上下文学习超越传统机器学习模型，研究者进而希望将其用于数据流场景（数据持续到达且随时间演化）。在流上，TFM依靠更新上下文而非参数来适应，因此其精度与成本取决于保留哪些样本以及重建上下文的频率，这构成了本文研究的动机。

Method: 对TFM在数据流上进行系统性研究，考察内存管理、计算成本，以及概念漂移、延迟标签等流式特有挑战；分析TFM通过更新上下文（而非参数）进行适应的机制及其对精度和开销的影响。

Result: TFM取得最高的预测性能；简单保留最近样本的效果与现有内存管理技术相当；在漂移后比流式学习器恢复更快；在标签延迟下保持最高精度。但其服务成本很高，因为每次预测都要对几乎未变的上下文重新编码。

Conclusion: TFM在数据流上精度优势明显且对漂移、标签延迟鲁棒，但服务于流场景的效率不足；未来应聚焦架构效率以推动上下文流式学习的发展。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) outperform established machine learning models on tabular benchmarks through in-context learning. Building on this success, interest is growing in applying them to data streams, where data arrive continuously and evolve over time. On a stream, a TFM adapts by updating its context rather than its parameters, so its accuracy and cost depend on which examples it keeps and how often it rebuilds its context. We therefore present a systematic study of TFMs on data streams, covering memory management, computational cost, and stream-specific challenges such as concept drift and delayed labels. We find that TFMs achieve the highest predictive performance and that simply retaining the most recent examples is as effective as existing memory management techniques. They also recover faster than streaming learners after drift and keep the highest accuracy under label delay. This accuracy, however, comes at a high serving cost, since a nearly unchanged context is re-encoded at every prediction. These results point to architectural efficiency as the way forward for in-context stream learning.

</details>


### [190] [FACET: Factorized Asymmetric Conditioning for Efficient Transport in High-Fidelity Fluorescence Microscopy Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05353)
*Sazan Mahbub,Caleb N. Ellington,Eric P. Xing*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出概率生成框架FACET，通过因子化非对称条件建模实现高效、高保真的蛋白质亚细胞定位图像生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 荧光显微成像能揭示蛋白质定位，但同一细胞中可成像的蛋白数量有限。从氨基酸序列与细胞形态上下文出发生成图像，可实现未成像蛋白的计算机模拟定位。然而两者作用不对称：形态上下文与目标空间对齐，而序列是非空间的，需在上下文中指定蛋白依赖的定位，且存在跨蛋白共享的粗粒度模式与蛋白特异的细粒度变化。现有生成器对二者联合条件化，未分离各自所解释的部分。

Method: FACET（Factorized Asymmetric Conditioning for Efficient Transport）将上述结构编码为显式归纳偏置：序列语义从上下文未能解释的残差中学习；粗粒度定位规律通过语义记忆在蛋白间共享；蛋白特异变化建模为围绕其的有界残差。此外，采用保持方差的状态投影，使FACET能够在预训练扩散预测器上执行连续随机传输，参数开销极小。

Result: 在留出蛋白上，FACET相比骨干匹配的基线在Human Protein Atlas上空间重叠提升34.3%，在OpenCell上提升14.0%；FID分别降低27.2%和46.5%，同时网络评估次数减少75%。它还显著改善蛋白关联结构恢复，并给出校准更好的预测；详细消融实验显示各设计选择具有互补贡献。

Conclusion: 结果表明，实现高保真、高效且具生物学意义的细胞图像合成，关键在于因子化非对称条件建模，而非单纯扩大生成器容量。

Abstract: Fluorescence microscopy reveals where proteins localize, but only a limited number of proteins can be imaged in the same cell; generating these images from amino-acid sequence and the cell's morphological context enables in silico localization of unimaged proteins. The two conditions, however, play asymmetric roles: morphological context is spatially aligned with the target, whereas sequence is non-spatial and must specify protein-dependent localization within it, with recurring coarse patterns shared across proteins and finer protein-specific variation. Existing generators condition on both jointly, without separating what each explains. We introduce FACET (Factorized Asymmetric Conditioning for Efficient Transport), a probabilistic generative framework that encodes this structure as an explicit inductive bias: sequence semantics are learned from what context leaves unexplained, coarse localization regularities are shared across proteins through a semantic memory, and protein-specific variation is a bounded residual around them. A variance-preserving state projection further lets FACET perform continuous stochastic transport through a pretrained diffusion predictor with minimal parameter overhead. On held-out proteins, FACET improves spatial overlap by 34.3% on the Human Protein Atlas and 14.0% on OpenCell over a backbone-matched baseline, and reduces FID by 27.2% and 46.5%, respectively, with 75% fewer network evaluations. It also substantially improves protein-association structure recovery and yields better-calibrated predictions, while detailed ablations show complementary contributions from its design choices. These results identify factorized asymmetric conditioning, rather than generator capacity alone, as a key lever for high-fidelity, efficient, and biologically meaningful cellular image synthesis.

</details>


### [191] [The Effect of Missingness-Pattern Mismatch on Method Selection for Time-Series Classification: A Controlled Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05368)
*Ruiqi Zhao,Zishun Yuan,Zhentao Wang,Jiahao Quan,Kangzheng Li,Jianfan Deng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究验证集缺失模式与部署缺失模式不匹配对时间序列分类器选择的影响，发现不匹配平均降低测试平衡准确率1.14个百分点，且随缺失率升高而增大，主要集中于点掩蔽部署场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列分类器通常基于验证数据选择，但部署时的观测缺失模式可能与验证阶段不同。论文旨在检验这种缺失模式不匹配是否会影响基于验证的分类器选择，从而影响最终部署性能。

Method: 采用受控2×2设计，对64个单变量UCR数据集的验证集与测试集施加随机点缺失或循环块缺失掩蔽，缺失率设5%至30%共六档，用线性插值填补。训练数据保持完整，在三个预设候选模型（1NN-DTW、带Ridge分类器的MiniRocket、统计特征随机森林）中进行选择，并比较验证模式匹配与不匹配情形下、在同一掩蔽测试集上的选择结果。

Result: 验证不匹配使所选分类器的测试平衡准确率平均下降1.14个百分点（95% CI 0.79–1.51），64个数据集中有49个出现损失。5%缺失时损失可忽略，增至30%时达2.46个百分点。损失集中于点掩蔽部署（1.84个百分点），此时块掩蔽验证使选择偏离通常最优候选；块掩蔽部署的影响较小且不显著。不匹配在35.5%的配对比较中改变了所选分类器，但选择改变并不总是导致性能下降。补充分析采用非环绕线性块，结果一致且效应更大（1.67个百分点）。

Conclusion: 将验证数据的缺失模式与预期部署模式相匹配，是方法选择的简单保障措施，在高缺失率下尤为重要。

Abstract: Classifiers for time-series classification are commonly selected on validation data, but the temporal pattern of missing observations at deployment may differ from the pattern seen during validation. We examine whether such a mismatch affects validation-based classifier selection. In a controlled $2 \times 2$ design, validation and test sets of 64 univariate UCR datasets were masked with either random point missingness or circular block missingness at six rates from 5% to 30%, imputed by linear interpolation, and used to select among three prespecified candidates: 1NN-DTW, MiniRocket with a Ridge classifier, and a statistical-feature Random Forest. Training data remained complete, and selections made under matched and mismatched validation patterns were compared on the same masked test sets. Mismatched validation reduced the test balanced accuracy of the selected classifier by 1.14 percentage points on average (95% CI 0.79 to 1.51), with losses on 49 of the 64 datasets. The loss was negligible at 5% missingness and increased to 2.46 percentage points at 30%. It was concentrated in point-masked deployment (1.84 percentage points), where block-masked validation shifted selection away from the usually best candidate, while the effect for block-masked deployment was small and not significant. Mismatch changed the selected classifier in 35.5% of paired comparisons, but a changed selection did not always reduce performance. A supplementary analysis with non-wrapping linear blocks reproduced these findings with a larger effect (1.67 percentage points). Matching the missingness pattern of validation data to the expected deployment pattern is therefore a simple safeguard for method selection, particularly at higher missingness rates.

</details>


### [192] [Robust Ensemble Guidance for Scientific Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05371)
*Zixiang Li,Wei Wang,Yunchao Wei,Yao Zhao,Yue Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出鲁棒集成引导（REG），通过对集成预测的加权与裁剪两项简单修改，抑制观测坐标中预测散布大或残差极端者对集成校正的主导作用，在无额外模型评估开销下提升逆问题重建精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 集成引导将预训练扩散先验与黑箱前向模型结合，可在不通过物理模拟器求导的情况下求解逆问题。但预测散布大或残差极端的观测坐标会主导集成校正，损害重建精度，观测异质性问题未被充分重视。

Method: REG 使用集成预测散布来平衡观测尺度（加权），并自适应裁剪标准化残差（裁剪），以限制极端偏差的影响。两项操作复用现有粒子与前向预测，无需额外去噪器或前向模型评估。理论上在局部线性高斯模型下推导了一步估计风险降低的条件，界定单个观测坐标的影响上界，并刻画有限集成下收益持续的条件。

Result: 在 Navier-Stokes 反演、黑洞成像与声学全波形反演上，REG 均优于底层集成求解器；黑洞重建 PSNR 在三种观测机制下提升 6.2–8.2 dB，等预算比较下 Navier-Stokes 重建误差降低 26.4%。

Conclusion: 观测异质性与残差影响是设计可靠科学逆问题生成求解器的关键因素，简单的加权与裁剪即可显著改善集成校正效果。

Abstract: Ensemble guidance combines pretrained diffusion priors with black-box forward models to solve inverse problems without differentiating through the physical simulator. However, observation coordinates with large predictive spread or extreme residuals can dominate the ensemble correction, degrading reconstruction accuracy. We show that two simple modifications, weighting and clipping, substantially improve this correction. Our method, Robust Ensemble Guidance (REG), uses ensemble predictive spread to balance observation scales and adaptively clips standardized residuals to limit the influence of extreme discrepancies. Both operations reuse existing particles and forward predictions, requiring no additional denoiser or forward-model evaluations. Under a local linear Gaussian model, we derive conditions for reduced one-step estimation risk, bound the influence of individual observation coordinates, and characterize when these benefits persist with finite ensembles. Experiments on Navier-Stokes inversion, black-hole imaging, and acoustic full-waveform inversion demonstrate improved reconstruction over the underlying ensemble solver. In particular, REG increases black-hole reconstruction PSNR by 6.2-8.2 dB across three observation regimes and reduces Navier-Stokes reconstruction error by 26.4\% in a matched-budget comparison. These findings highlight the importance of observation heterogeneity and residual influence in designing reliable generative solvers for scientific inverse problems.

</details>


### [193] [Distributed Subliminal Learning: Replacing Model Updates with Random-Carrier Outputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05378)
*Dario Fenoglio,Gabriele Dominici,Martin Gjoreski,Marc Langheinrich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出分布式潜隐学习（DSL）协作学习原语：使用任务无关输入探测本地模型，仅传输载体输出，由协调者池化并蒸馏回共享模型，无需传输模型参数或任务相关代理数据，通信量与模型规模解耦。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
