Somewhere along the way it stops being able to become "anything" and becomes committed to, say, a horse rather than a truck. We measure when this happens, and what a trained model gets wrong about it, on CIFAR-10. The most direct measurement is to freeze a half-finished image, restart the generation from that point many times, and count how often each class comes out. We call this probability the committor. Measured this way, the model settles coarse questions (vehicle or animal?) at roughly twice the noise level of fine ones (which animal?). A much cheaper measurement, the noise level at which a classifier's opinion about two classes splits into two distinct groups, gets the order of these decisions right (rank correlation 0.73-0.88) but not their exact timing. We then compare pretrained models with their

</details>


### [227] [Training and Scaling Compute-Optimal Physiological Waveform Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05649)
*Pingzhi Li,Jie Peng,Shuqing Luo,Zachary Plotkin,Tianlong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 训练了Aether系列生理波形基础模型（20M–2.1B参数），在最多36.3M小时波形上预训练，拟合出模型规模、预训练时长与标注患者数的缩放律，并给出计算最优训练配方。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生理波形基础模型的缩放规律与计算最优训练策略尚不明确，缺乏可量化的训练配方。

Method: 训练逾百个模型（20M–2.1B参数），预训练数据达36.3M小时生理波形；基于MIMIC-III构建8项临床预测任务，用线性探测评估；拟合以模型规模、预训练时长、标注患者数预测下游排序误差（1-AUROC）的缩放律。

Result: 720M模型在8项任务上全面超越现有基线；缩放律在留出资源尺度上MAE为0.5%，外推至2.1B参数时MAE为0.9%。（1）计算最优：计算量增10.0×时，模型规模增1.2×、预训练时长增8.2×。（2）大模型更高效利用波形数据，从25M参数/4.8M小时起，规模翻倍可减少51.8%所需预训练时长。（3）预训练与临床监督相互增强：720M模型预训练从120K延长至36.3M小时，目标排序误差下标注患者需求降低61%。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了可量化的训练配方与可持续的缩放路径，为生理波形建模及下游临床预测指明方向。

Abstract: We investigate the scaling laws and compute-optimal training of physiological waveform foundation models (FMs). We train Aether, a family of over one hundred FMs ranging from 20M to 2.1B parameters, on up to 36.3M hours of physiological waveforms. We construct eight clinical prediction tasks from MIMIC-III and evaluate the FMs through linear probing. The 720M FM outperforms all existing baseline FMs across all eight tasks. A scaling law of model size, pretraining hours, and labeled patients predicts downstream ranking error, i.e. $1-\mathrm{AUROC}$, effectively with $0.5\%$ prediction MAE at held-out resource scales and $0.9\%$ MAE when extrapolating to 2.1B parameters. We present three findings: (1) Compute-optimal training scales both FM size and pretraining hours. Under the fitted law, a $10.0\times$ increase in compute FLOPs scales model size by $1.2\times$ and pretraining hours by $8.2\times$. (2) Larger FMs use waveform data more efficiently, and greater pretraining exposure increases the benefit of model scaling. Starting from 25M parameters and 4.8M pretraining hours, doubling FM size reduces the predicted hours needed for the same performance by $51.8\%$. (3) Pretraining and clinical supervision reinforce each other: more labeled patients increase the return to pretraining, while larger FMs and longer pretraining reduce labeling requirements. For the example of the 720M FM, extending pretraining from 120K to 36.3M hours reduces the predicted patient requirement by $61\%$ at a target ranking error. These findings provide a quantitative training recipe and a promising and durable scaling path for physiological waveform modeling and downstream clinical prediction.

</details>


### [228] [Graph Data Augmentation via Contrastive Generator Inversion ($\texttt{DCBA}$)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05653)
*Mateusz Stolarski,Michał Czuba,Łukasz Kraiński,Katarzyna Musial,Paweł Prałat,Bogumił Kamiński,Piotr Bródka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DCBA，一种基于模型的图数据增强方法，通过从观测网络中推断合成图生成器的配置，实例化为ABCD生成器，实现更准确鲁棒的参数恢复并显著提升社区检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图能自然表示复杂系统，但基于图的机器学习方法发展受限于大规模、多样化图数据集的稀缺性。传统图数据增强方法难以从观测网络中推断生成器配置以产生结构一致的合成图，因此需要一种模型化方法解决数据不足问题。

Method: DCBA采用基于模型的方法，从观测网络推断合成图生成器的配置，实例化使用ABCD生成器（生成具有社区结构的无标度网络）。模型通过多正样本对比目标与软负样本加权，学习图与生成器参数化的联合表示，从而预测ABCD配置，使其随机实现保留生成器编码的宏观结构特性。

Result: 实验表明，DCBA比算法化逆建模基线更准确、更鲁棒地恢复生成器参数。在下游社区检测任务中，将推断配置用于微调PRoCD，在合成网络上平均提升AMI 161%，在真实网络上平均提升273%。

Conclusion: DCBA为图数据增强提供了一种有效的基于模型的方法，能够从观测网络推断生成器配置并生成结构一致的合成图，显著提升下游任务性能，尤其在社区检测中效果突出。

Abstract: Graphs provide a natural representation of many complex systems, ranging from social platforms to ecosystems. However, the development of graph-based machine learning methods is often constrained by the limited availability of large and diverse graph datasets. In this paper, we introduce $\texttt{DCBA}$, a model-based approach to graph data augmentation that infers the configuration of a synthetic graph generator from an observed network. We instantiate the proposed framework using the $\texttt{ABCD}$ generator, which produces scale-free networks with community structure. Our model learns a joint representation of graphs and generator parametrisations using a multi-positive contrastive objective with soft negative weighting. The learned representation enables the prediction of an $\texttt{ABCD}$ configuration whose stochastic realisations preserve the macrostructural properties encoded by the generator. Experiments show that $\texttt{DCBA}$ recovers generator parameters more accurately and robustly than an algorithmic inverse-modelling baseline. Its downstream utility is further demonstrated in community detection, where inferred configurations used to fine-tune $\texttt{PRoCD}$ improve AMI on average by $161\%$ on synthetic and $273\%$ on real-world networks.

</details>


### [229] [Bellman-Centric Learning: Near-Optimal Regret for Linear Bandits with Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05659)
*Jingyuan Liu,Huiwen Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究带记忆的线性赌博机，提出RSM-LinUCB算法，证明记忆只带来加性遗憾代价（而非乘性耦合），并给出匹配下界与GLM扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 带记忆的线性赌博机中，过去动作通过已知有界矩阵值记忆映射产生内生非平稳性。需在记忆动态下权衡探索与利用，且此前界中记忆与时间跨度存在乘性耦合，作者希望厘清这种耦合是否为本质所需。

Method: 提出RSM-LinUCB算法，采用Bellman-centric设计：像线性赌博机一样学习、像强化学习一样规划。该设计引出新的遗憾分解，将记忆诱导误差与沿轨迹的累积奖励估计误差分离。并扩展至广义线性奖励。

Result: 证明高概率遗憾界 Õ(dRS(M+1)+σd√T)；证明匹配的极小极大下界，确立近最优性；表明记忆仅贡献加性代价（至多对数因子），乘性记忆-时域耦合非本质；GLM扩展保持该分离性；在合成实例及半合成KV缓存与语义缓存任务上优于基线。

Conclusion: 带记忆线性赌博机中记忆成本是可加而非乘性的，RSM-LinUCB达到近最优遗憾，且在广义线性奖励下保持该性质，实验验证了算法的有效性。

Abstract: We study linear bandits with memory, where past actions induce endogenous nonstationarity through an arbitrary known, bounded matrix-valued memory map. To trade off exploration and exploitation while accounting for the memory dynamics, we develop RSM-LinUCB, a Bellman-centric algorithm that learns as in linear bandits and plans as in reinforcement learning. This design admits a novel regret decomposition which separates the memory-induced error from the cumulative reward estimation error along the learner's trajectory. We prove a high-probability regret bound of $\widetilde O\big(dRS(M+1)+σd\sqrt T\big)$, where $T$ is the learning horizon, $d$ is the parameter dimension, $M$ is the memory length, $R$ and $S$ bound the memory-map operator norm and reward-parameter norm, respectively, and $σ$ is the sub-Gaussian noise scale. Our results reveal that the multiplicative memory-horizon coupling in prior bounds is not intrinsic: memory only contributes an additive cost, up to logarithmic factors. We also prove a matching minimax lower bound, establishing near-optimality. We further extend the algorithm to generalized linear rewards, preserving this separation with near-optimal memory and leading statistical dependence. Our algorithms outperform the baselines in numerical experiments on synthetic instances and semi-synthetic KV- and semantic-cache tasks.

</details>


### [230] [Sharp Integrality Gaps in Calibration Distance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05679)
*Zinan Wang,Xinhao Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了二元单位权重序列在总绝对变化代价下，确定性校准距离C与其分数松弛L之间的离线差距，将其最坏情况阶从先前结果O(√T)改进为紧确的Θ(T^(1/3))。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前工作（Qiao和Zheng, 2024）给出了C ≤ L + O(√T)的离线比较上界，但这一上界并非最坏情况下的紧确阶。本文旨在确定C与L之间离线差距的精确最坏情况渐近阶，并进一步刻画稀疏输入情形以及算法可计算性。

Method: 作者通过构造性上下界论证分析长度T输入上的差距上确界Δ_T：上界对所有输入成立，下界对每个T ≥ 216给出有理数构造输入。进一步针对具有m个不同预测的输入分析稀疏最坏情况，并在理性预测与精度设定下设计无网格的多项式时间过程，结合可分别赋值的单位同一性的二进制编码多重度。

Result: 证明Δ_T满足T^(1/3)/1000 ≤ Δ_T ≤ 41T^(1/3)（T ≥ 216），即最坏情况阶为Θ(T^(1/3))；对具有m个不同预测的输入有C ≤ L + m，无限制样本的最坏情况稀疏阶为Θ(m)；算法方面，给定精度η，可在多项式比特时间内返回界B ≤ L ≤ U且U − B < η，并给出代价至多U + m ≤ L + m + η的精确校准紧凑修复。

Conclusion: 本文确立了确定性校准距离与分数松弛间离线差距的紧确最坏情况阶Θ(T^(1/3))，改进了先前的O(√T)界，并将结果推广至稀疏情形与可计算的高效校准修复，为校准理论中的松弛代价提供了更精确的理论刻画。

Abstract: We study the offline gap between deterministic calibration distance C and its fractional relaxation L for binary unit-weight sequences under total absolute-change cost. We sharpen the offline comparison C <= L + O(sqrt(T)) (Qiao and Zheng, 2024, Theorem 2) to the sharp worst-case order Theta(T^(1/3)). If Delta_T is the supremum of C - L over length-T inputs, then T^(1/3)/1000 <= Delta_T <= 41T^(1/3) for T >= 216. The upper bound holds for every input, while each T >= 216 has a rational lower-bound input. For every input with m distinct forecasts, C <= L + m, and the unrestricted-sample worst-case sparse order is Theta(m). For rational forecasts and accuracy, with binary-encoded multiplicities of separately assignable unit identities, a grid-free polynomial-bit-time procedure returns B <= L <= U, U - B < eta, and an exactly calibrated compact repair of cost at most U + m <= L + m + eta.

</details>


### [231] [Square-Root Regret for Adversarial Multiplayer Bandits without Collision Information or Shared Randomness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05688)
*Chenyu Gan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究无碰撞信息、无共享随机性且无外部通信信道的对抗性多玩家多臂老虎机，通过构造性通信与同步协议实现近最优遗憾界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多玩家老虎机通常需要碰撞信息、共享随机性或通信信道来协调玩家。本文在更严苛的约束条件下（$K$ 个臂、$m$ 个带标签玩家、无碰撞观测、无共享随机性、无外部通信）研究对抗性奖励下的协调学习问题。

Method: 设计构造性通信与同步协议，采用蒙特卡洛公共构造器。利用正奖励观测建立共同学习时间表并在学习前同步玩家；将延迟通信代价计入正奖励支撑集，从而在反馈稀少时限制遗憾；随后采用慢-快学习过程，在交换分配与分数时维持有效奖励估计。

Result: 在预处理上以至少 $1-CN^{-32}$ 的概率，其中 $N=2Km(T+1)$，其固定发布输出对预处理后选定的任意无意识奖励序列同时满足 $R_T\le C K^{5/2}\sqrt T\log^2(2Km(T+1))$，$R_T$ 为玩家私有执行随机性下的期望遗憾。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，即使在无碰撞信息、无共享随机性、无外部通信的极端受限设置下，多玩家对抗性老虎机仍可通过基于正奖励信号的隐式通信与同步实现次线性遗憾。

Abstract: We study adversarial multiplayer bandits with $K$ arms and $2\le m<K$ labeled players, without collision information, shared randomness, or an external communication channel. We design a constructive communication and synchronization protocol with a Monte Carlo public constructor. With probability at least $1-CN^{-32}$ over preprocessing, where $N=2Km(T+1)$, its fixed published output satisfies \[
  R_T\le C K^{5/2}\sqrt T\log^2(2Km(T+1)) \] simultaneously for every oblivious reward sequence chosen after preprocessing. Here $R_T$ is expected regret over the players' private execution randomness. Positive reward observations establish a common learning schedule and synchronize players before learning begins. The cost of delayed communication is charged to the support of positive rewards, ensuring that periods with little useful feedback incur only limited regret. A slow--fast learning procedure then maintains valid reward estimates while assignments and scores are exchanged.

</details>


### [232] [Planetary Geospatial Foundation Models: A New Paradigm for Global Public Health](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05699)
*Arbaaz Muslim,Aviv Slobodkin,Katherine Wheeler-Martin,Eric Zhou,John Brittain,Martin Frasch,Hamsa Subramaniam,Jacob Bien,Hamed Sadeghi,Sarah Conderino,Stone Jiang,Ben Spoer,Daniel Neill,Mimi Sun,Joydeep Paul,Yun Liu,Tomer Shekel,Amy Chung-Yu Chou,Anna Carter,Charles Elliott,Aaron Bell,Reuven Sayag,Avinatan Hassidim,Niv Efron,Yossi Matias,Kasumi Widner,Eduardo Lopez Ortiz,José Alberto Díaz-Quiñonez,Moritz U. G. Kraemer,John Brownstein,Isaias Fernandes Co,Etien Luc Koua,Monica Bharel,Benjamin Rader,Lorna Thorpe,Marc Gourevitch,Shravya Shetty,Gautam Prasad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出并验证了谷歌地球AI的人口动态基础模型（PDFM）作为行星级地理空间基础模型，通过多模态搜索、移动性与环境信号构建可泛化的地点表征，在四个健康领域、五类任务、四个国家中弥补传统疾病预测的时空盲区。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统疾病预测受空间断层与时间滞后制约，导致疫情在未被察觉时升级、慢性病负担数年后才被量化，数据稀疏地区的高风险人群长期无法覆盖，从而影响资源部署的时机与目标。

Method: 构建行星级地理空间基础模型PDFM，将多模态搜索、移动性和环境信号编码为可泛化的地点表征，作为流行病学工作流的补充；通过独立全球健康案例研究进行验证，覆盖四个领域（疫苗可预防疾病、传染病、非传染性疾病、孕产妇心理健康）、五项任务（空间外推、插值/临近预报、概率预测、前瞻性预测、风险分层）和四个国家（美国、加拿大、墨西哥、刚果民主共和国）。

Result: PDFM在多项任务上弥补监测缺口：提升美加边境MMR疫苗接种覆盖率预测，捕捉国内模型遗漏的跨境行为溢出；对心血管疾病进行临近预报以加速数据可用性；改进墨西哥市级登革热短期预测以支持及时病媒控制；改善霍乱热点预测；在模型未见过的美国州别中为个体层面产后抑郁风险预测提供可迁移信号，但不能替代个体社会经济数据，也无法弥合人口学筛查缺口。

Conclusion: 这些结果表明地理空间基础模型在公共卫生监测中具备实际应用能力，可作为现有流行病学工作流的补充，提升预测的时空覆盖与部署时效；同时其作用存在边界，需与个体层面数据和筛查体系结合使用。

Abstract: The efficacy of traditional disease prediction is limited by spatial gaps and temporal lags, which impact the timing and targets of resource deployments. Outbreaks escalate undetected, chronic disease burdens are quantified years later, and at-risk populations in data-sparse regions remain unaddressed. Planetary geospatial foundation models complement existing epidemiological workflows to provide operational improvements, encoding multimodal search, mobility, and environmental signals into generalizable place representations. As illustrations of this complementarity, we present independent global health case studies of Google Earth AI's Population Dynamics Foundation Model (PDFM) -- a foundation model for geospatial inference -- across four domains (vaccine-preventable, communicable, noncommunicable, maternal mental health), five tasks (spatial extrapolation, interpolation/nowcasting, probabilistic forecasting, prospective forecasting, risk stratification), and four countries (USA, Canada, Mexico, and the Democratic Republic of the Congo). Across these case studies, PDFM addresses critical surveillance gaps across domains: improving US-Canada border MMR vaccination coverage predictions by capturing cross-border behavioral spillovers domestic models miss; nowcasting cardiovascular disease to accelerate data availability; enhancing short-term municipal Mexican dengue forecasts for timely outbreak vector control; improving forecasts of cholera hotspots; and adding a transferable signal to individual-level postpartum-depression risk prediction in US states the model had never seen, while not replacing individual socioeconomic data or closing demographic screening gaps. Together, these results showcase capabilities of geospatial foundation models for public health surveillance.

</details>


### [233] [Voltic: Distinguishing Volatility from Stochasticity in Recurrent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05700)
*Parsa Hejabi,Morteza Dehghani,Payam Piray*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将循环记忆的写入解读为贝叶斯滤波中的卡尔曼增益，并提出Voltic——一种保持协方差各向异性、噪声方差输入相关的循环记忆机制，采用对角与准对角两种假设密度近似以维持delta-rule形式与分块并行训练，在受控回忆任务、45M语言模型推理与检索上均优于门控基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环序列模型在每个token处需决定以多大强度覆写记忆，现有门控机制（如delta-rule）缺少对不确定性的显式建模。作者从贝叶斯滤波视角指出，该写入强度实为卡尔曼增益，由两个方向相反的方差来源决定：关联变化速度（volatility，波动性）与观测噪声（stochasticity，随机性），而现有方法未将此二者输入相关地建模。

Method: 首先证明门控delta-rule记忆的更新在等向不确定性下正是该滤波器形式；随后提出Voltic，保持协方差各向异性并使两种噪声方差均为输入相关，使写入成为携带序列累积不确定性的向量值。为避免逐token传播稠密协方差、破坏并行训练，给出对角与准对角两种假设密度近似，二者均保持记忆更新的delta-rule形式并可复用其分块（chunked）核。

Result: 在关联变化且观测被污染的受控回忆任务上，Voltic领先所有基线；在同时结合波动性与随机性的任务上，其相对最强基线的优势在外推尺寸上比训练尺寸更大。在45M参数语言模型中，Voltic在八任务推理平均上领先，并在超出训练上下文长度时取得高于门控基线的检索准确率，吞吐量接近这些基线。

Conclusion: 从不确定性递推推导写入强度，可使记忆对变化更敏感、更具响应性；该框架为循环记忆提供了原理性且可并行训练的设计路径。

Abstract: Recurrent sequence models must decide how strongly to overwrite their memory at each token. Read as Bayesian filtering, this write is the gain of a Kalman update, set by uncertainty from two sources that pull it in opposite directions: volatility, how quickly the underlying associations change, and stochasticity, how noisy each observation of them is. First, we show that the update of gated delta-rule memories is the form this filter takes under isotropic uncertainty. Next, we introduce Voltic, a recurrent memory that keeps the covariance anisotropic and makes both noise variances input-dependent, so the write is vector-valued and carries uncertainty accumulated over the sequence. A dense covariance would have to be propagated token by token, ruling out the parallel training these models depend on. We therefore give two assumed-density approximations, diagonal and quasi-diagonal, both of which leave the memory update in delta-rule form and reuse its chunked kernels. On controlled recall tasks in which associations change and observations are corrupted, Voltic leads all baselines. On the task combining volatility and stochasticity, its margin over the strongest baseline is larger at both extrapolation sizes than at the training sizes. In 45M-parameter language models it leads an eight-task reasoning average and achieves higher retrieval accuracy beyond the training context length than gated baselines, at throughput close to those baselines. Deriving the write from an uncertainty recursion therefore makes memory more responsive to change.

</details>


### [234] [From Pixels, Without Pre-training: Joint Generative and Self-Supervised Representation Learning in One Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05711)
*Vicente Balmaseda,Ching-Long Lin,Tianbao Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SCION 在单模型中联合进行自监督表示学习与生成，实现无需标签或预训练模型的自条件生成，在 ImageNet 256×256 上以 JiT-L 达到 5.89 FID（无引导）与 3.47 FID（表示引导）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强图像生成模型依赖类别标签、冻结的预训练编码器或单独训练的自动编码器，生成因此受制于监督或预训练（需标注标签、需目标域预训练的编码器/自编码器）。作者希望在同一模型中联合学习生成与自监督表示，实现无需标签和预训练模型的自条件生成。其核心难点在于两类目标不匹配：对比学习需要干净的增强视图、偏好粗粒度不变语义；而流匹配需要含噪图像、必须保留对比学习所丢弃的细粒度细节与空间结构。

Method: 提出 SCION（Self-conditioned Generation on Self-supervised representation），核心是一个以流时间步与一个嵌入为条件的单一像素空间编码器。表示学习时，条件嵌入为所有图像共享的可学习全局向量，编码器的 [CLS] token 产生由对比损失训练的语义表示；生成训练时，条件嵌入为图像自身的 [CLS] 表示，patch token 经解码器预测图像。为在推理时无需参考图像采样，联合学习嵌入上的先验分布。通过梯度范数平衡与 stop-gradient 机制在单次训练中实现联合优化；整个方法自监督且自包含，无需标签或预训练模型。

Result: 在 ImageNet 256×256 上，采用 JiT-B 配方且无表示引导时，SCION 达 8.92 FID，优于类别无条件 iREPA（对齐预训练 DINOv2，46.44）与以其为条件的 RCG（14.27）。采用 JiT-L 时，SCION 无引导达 5.89 FID，表示引导下达 3.47 FID，优于采用 ADM 配方的 RCG（6.24）。

Conclusion: SCION 证明生成与自监督表示学习可在单一自包含模型内成功联合训练，无需标签或预训练模型即可实现有竞争力的自条件生成，并在 FID 上超越依赖预训练编码器条件的现有方法。

Abstract: Strong image generation models are conditioned on class labels, aligned to frozen pretrained encoders, or built on separately trained autoencoders. While effective, generation then depends on supervision or pretraining: labels must be annotated, and encoders or autoencoders pretrained for the target domain. We study joint generative and self-supervised representation learning in a single model, enabling self-conditioned generation without labels or pretrained models. This is challenging because the objectives are mismatched: contrastive learning consumes clean augmented views and favors coarse, invariant semantics, while flow matching consumes noisy images and must preserve the fine detail and spatial layout that contrastive learning discards. We propose SCION (Self-conditioned Generation on Self-supervised representation), whose core is a single pixel-space encoder conditioned on the flow timestep and an embedding. For representation learning, this conditioning embedding is a learned global vector shared across images, with the encoder's [CLS] token yielding the semantic representation trained by the contrastive loss. For generative training, the conditioning embedding is the image's own [CLS] representation, while patch tokens pass through a decoder to predict the image. To sample without a reference image at inference, we jointly learn a prior over the embedding. Gradient-norm balancing and stop-gradient mechanisms enable joint optimization in one run. SCION is self-supervised and self-contained, with no labels or pretrained models. On ImageNet 256x256, with the JiT-B recipe and no representation guidance, SCION reaches 8.92 FID, surpassing class-unconditional iREPA, which aligns to pretrained DINOv2 (46.44), and RCG, which conditions on it (14.27). With JiT-L, SCION achieves 5.89 FID without guidance and 3.47 with representation guidance, outperforming RCG with the ADM recipe (6.24).

</details>


### [235] [ReMaD: Tuning-free Domain Adaptation for Classification and Out-of-Distribution Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05718)
*Elijah Bolluyt,Cristina Comaniciu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ReMaD（降秩马氏距离），一种无需微调的基于原型距离的分类与OOD检测精化方法，通过拟合潜在空间闭式分布统计量并去除未使用特征来适配新领域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模预训练模型适配新分类领域通常依赖微调或超参数搜索，成本高且需OOD先验知识。作者希望在不训练、无需OOD数据先验的前提下，利用预训练模型的嵌入直接实现分类与OOD检测，并解决潜在空间分布与新领域不匹配的问题。

Method: 利用目标数据集嵌入拟合潜在空间中的闭式分布统计量，构建原型分类与OOD检测；分析大模型处理新数据集时的分布特性，据此对马氏距离做简单修改——通过降秩（移除未使用特征）将模型潜在空间分布适配到新领域，无需微调或超参数搜索。

Result: 在四个目标数据集上测试，将现有大型预训练图像嵌入模型适配到其训练能力之外的新分类领域，在分类与OOD检测两项任务上均取得有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: ReMaD表明，通过闭式分布统计与降秩马氏距离，可在零训练、零超参搜索条件下有效适配预训练模型至新领域，兼顾分类与OOD检测，为无微调适配提供了简单有效的方案。

Abstract: We introduce Reduced-rank Mahalanobis Distance (ReMaD), a novel prototypical distance-based refinement to classification and out-of-distribution (OOD) detection using pretrained models without finetuning. We use embeddings of the target dataset to fit closed-form distribution statistics in the model's latent space which can classify in-distribution samples and detect OOD samples, all without training or prior knowledge of the OOD data. Building on prototype classification and OOD detection, we analyze the distribution properties of large pretrained models when processing new datasets; based on this analysis, we formulate a simple modification to Mahalanobis Distance to adapt models' latent space distributions to new domains by removing unused features, without the finetuning or hyperparameter searches required by other adaptation procedures. We demonstrate the efficacy of this method to adapt existing large pretrained image embedding models to new classification domains outside their trained capabilities by testing across four target datasets, with competitive performance in both classification and OOD detection.

</details>


### [236] [CIPHER-MoE: Balancing Efficiency and Routing Fidelity in Trillion-Scale MoE Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05744)
*Jing Li,Jian Meng,Yingmeng Gao,Suming Qiu,Linyuan Qiu,Dongfang Li,Baotian Hu,Binfan Zheng,Rongqian Zhao,Weijian Sun,Xin Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CIPHER-MoE通过亲和度感知的专家-令牌过滤与显式容量控制，缓解MoE大模型训练中的专家负载不均衡，无需额外硬件或复杂运行时设计，实现最高64.9个百分点热点专家负载降低与1.10×–1.94×训练加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE在LLM训练中面临系统级挑战：非均匀令牌路由导致专家与设备间负载高度不均，进而破坏训练稳定性。万亿参数规模下，不均衡进一步放大资源开销——欠载专家浪费算力与硬件利用率，热点专家则需额外资源承载过载工作。已有方法依赖复杂并行策略或资源重分配，会引入额外资源需求与高编排复杂度，在计算资源受限的万亿参数训练场景下难以承受。

Method: 提出CIPHER-MoE，在保持路由器令牌侧Top-K选择不变的前提下缓解负载不均衡。方法采用亲和度感知的专家到令牌过滤（affinity-aware Expert-to-Token filtering），并配合显式容量控制来削减热点专家工作负载，不增加额外硬件资源，也不需要复杂的运行时设计。

Result: 在包括DeepSeek-V4-Pro在内的大规模MoE模型上评估，Top-1专家工作负载最高降低64.9个百分点，训练加速达1.10×–1.94×，同时保持训练质量。

Conclusion: CIPHER-MoE以轻量、无需额外资源的方式有效缓解MoE训练负载不均衡，兼顾效率与训练质量，为受限算力下的大规模MoE训练提供了可行方案，源码即将开源。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has been widely adopted in recent large language model (LLM) architectures. However, scaling up MoE in LLM training introduces system-level challenges on training, where non-uniform token routing can lead to highly imbalanced workloads across experts and devices, further destabilizing the training process. With trillion-scale LLMs, imbalanced expert workloads further amplify the resource cost of MoE training, resulting in degraded training efficiency and hardware utilization for underloaded experts, while hot experts require additional resources to accommodate excessive workloads. Recent studies address imbalanced MoE training through intricate parallelism strategies or resource reallocation. However, these system-level approaches often introduce additional resource requirements and considerable orchestration complexity, which become increasingly difficult to afford when training trillion-parameter LLMs under constrained computational resources. This work introduces CIPHER-MoE, which mitigates MoE workload imbalance while keeping the router's token-side Top-K selection unchanged. CIPHER-MoE applies affinity-aware Expert-to-Token filtering with explicit capacity control to reduce hotspot expert workloads without additional hardware resources or complex runtime design. The proposed method has been evaluated on large-scale MoE models, including DeepSeek-V4-Pro, showing up to 64.9 percentage points Top-1 expert workload reduction and 1.10$\times$-1.94$\times$ training acceleration, while preserving the training quality. The source code will be released soon.

</details>


### [237] [Beyond In-Distribution Preservation: Recovering Generalization in Quantized VLAs via Vulnerability-Oriented Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05745)
*Shen Ruan,Wenchang Gao,Jin Wang,Siao Liu,Zhoxizhuoma,Dongchun Ren,Xin Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究后训练量化VLA策略在环境扰动下的鲁棒性与泛化性，发现量化策略虽保持分布内性能却对微小环境变化脆弱，且动作差异集中在少数 rollout 状态。为此提出 PIVOT-Q 框架，选择性地对脆弱状态进行在线策略蒸馏修正。在七个 LIBERO-Plus 环境变体上，PIVOT-Q 持续优于全状态蒸馏，且仅用其 7.4% 的状态级蒸馏预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练量化已被证明能在标准评测条件下保持 VLA 性能，但其是否保留全精度模型的鲁棒性与泛化性尚缺乏系统研究。作者希望探究量化 VLA 策略在环境扰动下的表现，并据此设计更有效的量化后恢复方法。

Method: 作者系统研究了后量化 VLA 策略在环境扰动下的鲁棒性与泛化性，发现动作差异集中于少量 rollout 状态，且教师指导在不同差异程度状态下效果相反。基于此提出 Policy-Induced Vulnerability-Oriented Tuning (PIVOT-Q)：一种脆弱性感知的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）框架，以冻结的全精度策略为教师，选择性地修正量化学生 rollout 中遇到的脆弱状态。该方法利用短视界上的折扣累积差异识别脆弱状态，施加相位平衡的稀疏监督，并使用 Behavioral Anchor 防止不必要的改变。

Result: 在七个 LIBERO-Plus 环境变体上的实验表明，PIVOT-Q 在多种 VLA 骨干和量化方法上实现一致的性能恢复，在所有设置下持续优于全状态蒸馏，且仅使用其 7.4% 的状态级蒸馏预算。

Conclusion: 有效的量化后恢复需要选择性地干预脆弱状态，而非对学生进行全局蒸馏。PIVOT-Q 通过脆弱性感知的选择性在线策略蒸馏，在低预算下实现了鲁棒性与泛化性的恢复。

Abstract: Post-training quantization has been shown to preserve VLA performance under standard evaluation conditions, but whether it preserves the full-precision model's robustness and generalization remains underexplored. In this study, we systematically study the robustness and generalization of post-quantized VLA policies under environmental disturbances. Empirical results show that quantized policies can become fragile to subtle environmental variations despite retaining comparable in-distribution performance. We further observe that action discrepancies are concentrated in a small subset of rollout states, while teacher guidance has opposite effects depending on discrepancy: it improves generalization at high-discrepancy states but can degrade it at low-discrepancy states. These findings reveal that effective post-quantization recovery requires selectively intervening on vulnerable states rather than globally distilling the student. We therefore propose Policy-Induced Vulnerability-Oriented Tuning (PIVOT-Q), a vulnerability-aware On-Policy Distillation (OPD) framework that selectively corrects vulnerable states encountered during quantized-student rollouts using the frozen full-precision policy as a teacher. PIVOT-Q identifies vulnerable states using discounted accumulated discrepancies over a short horizon, applies phase-balanced sparse supervision, and uses a Behavioral Anchor to prevent unnecessary changes. Experiments under seven LIBERO-Plus environmental variations demonstrate consistent recovery across multiple VLA backbones and quantization methods. Notably, PIVOT-Q consistently outperforms full-state distillation across all settings while using only 7.4% of its state-level distillation budget. Our code is available at https://github.com/ruanruan-andy/PIVOT-Q.

</details>


### [238] [AdaSpark: Adaptive DSpark with Online Learning for Tree Verification and N-gram Fill](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05774)
*Liquan Liu,Yifan Zhang,Bowei Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AdaSpark 是一种无需预先 profiling 或校准的推测解码调度器，它在服务过程中在线学习验证宽度与候选接受概率，从而自适应地选择树的宽度与排序，实现比 DSpark 更快的解码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有块级 drafters（如 DSpark）的调度器通常依赖服务前测量的验证时间表或模型，并仅用一个在线缩放因子修正，接受概率则取自 drafter 的置信度估计或离线拟合的映射。这种方式缺乏自适应性与准确性，无法在服务中动态优化验证宽度。

Method: AdaSpark 在服务过程中学习两个量：1）拟合各验证宽度下的验证时间随上下文的变化函数，学习哪些宽度值得提供；2）将每个候选的接受概率拟合到目标的验证结果，以 drafter 的置信度头作为输入之一，并用该拟合而非置信度头来排序和确定树的尺寸。同一模型还对请求自身文本的 n-gram 续写进行定价，使 drafted 与文本派生的候选在同一 best-first 顺序中竞争行数。宽度通过按长期解码速率对时间定价来选择。

Result: 在六个公开数据集的单轮与多轮对话上，针对三个 dense 目标和一个 mixture-of-experts 目标，AdaSpark 使用相同 drafters 时比 llama.cpp 的 DSpark 解码快 1.5-3.1 倍。搭载 AdaSpark 的 imparo 引擎比使用三 token 链（llama.cpp 默认设置）的 imparo 快 1.17-1.52 倍，且该增益仅来自调度器。无需宽度扫描，AdaSpark 在任何 dense 目标或上下文段上最多比最佳固定树宽度慢 0.3%。在 mixture-of-experts 目标上，它与最佳固定宽度持平，而其他 4 到 16 行的固定宽度慢 5-14%。

Conclusion: AdaSpark 通过在线学习验证时间与接受概率，实现了无需预先 profile、校准或扫描的自适应调度，在多种目标和数据集上显著加速解码，并在不进行宽度扫描的情况下达到或接近最佳固定宽度的性能。

Abstract: Block drafters such as DSpark propose ranked candidates for several positions in one forward pass, and a tree verifier checks them in one pass of the target. The number of rows to verify trades the tokens a wider tree is expected to accept against the time a wider verify takes. Most schedulers that choose this number take the verify time from a table or model measured before serving, corrected online by at most one scale factor, and take acceptance from the drafter's confidence estimates or from a map fitted offline.
  AdaSpark learns both quantities while it serves, with no profile, calibration or sweep in advance. It learns which verify widths are worth offering and fits each one's verify time as a function of context. It fits each candidate's acceptance probability to the target's verify outcomes, with the drafter's confidence head as one input, and orders and sizes the tree by that fit instead of by the head. The same model prices n-gram continuations of the request's own text, so drafted and text-derived candidates compete for rows in one best-first order. The width is chosen by pricing time at the long-run decode rate.
  On single- and multi-turn conversations from six public datasets, on three dense targets and one mixture-of-experts target, AdaSpark decodes 1.5-3.1x faster than llama.cpp's DSpark with the same drafters. Our imparo engine with AdaSpark is 1.17-1.52x faster than imparo running with a three-token chain (the default llama.cpp setting); this gain comes from the scheduler alone. Without a width sweep, AdaSpark is never more than 0.3% slower than the best pinned tree width on any dense target or context band. On the mixture-of-experts target it ties the best pinned width, and the other pinned widths from 4 to 16 rows are 5-14% slower.

</details>


### [239] [Image resolution enhancement for advanced semiconductor nodes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05809)
*Lucas Rencker,Omid Tajalizadehkhoob,Khalid Elsayed,Artem Khachaturiants,Helda Pahlavani,Yan Guo,Jakob van de Laar,Erik Simons,Niranjan Saikumar,Hamed Sadeghian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于神经网络的超分辨率增强框架，用于高吞吐量扫描探针显微镜（SPM）图像，以在不牺牲产率的前提下提升测量分辨率。作者在200 nm周期线/空间结构上验证了该框架，并通过迁移学习在100 nm周期结构上以更小数据集重新训练与校准模型，展示了模型的复用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先进半导体节点不断逼近特征尺寸极限，要求亚纳米级分辨率的量测能力，同时需满足在线工艺控制所需的高吞吐量。尽管新型测量方法与工具架构已显著提升SPM吞吐量，但进一步缩短成像时间成为关键挑战，因此需要借助机器学习提升已测图像的分辨率以提取关键参数。

Method: 设计并采用基于神经网络的图像分辨率增强器（resolution enhancer）用于SPM图像，提出其通用框架。在200 nm周期的线/空间结构上进行测量以验证框架有效性；并利用迁移学习，将预训练的模型在100 nm周期线/空间结构的较小数据集上重新训练与校准。

Result: 该框架在200 nm周期线/空间结构测量中展现出有效性；通过迁移学习，针对略有差异的结构（100 nm周期）能够以更小的数据集完成新模型的再训练与校准，表明预训练模型具备可复用性。

Conclusion: 基于神经网络的SPM图像分辨率增强框架可在保持高吞吐量的同时提升成像分辨率，且通过迁移学习可高效适配新结构，为半导体在线量测提供可行的降本增效路径。

Abstract: Advanced semiconductor nodes are pushing the limits of feature sizes and require metrology with sub-nm resolution without compromising on the throughput as needed for in-line process control. Recently, high-throughput scanning probe microscopy (SPM) based metrology and inspection tools capable of meeting these needs have been introduced to the market and qualified for use in HVM. While innovative measurement methods and tool architecture have allowed for a leap of improvement in throughput, the next step in further reducing imaging time can be obtained through the application of machine learning for enhancing the resolution of measured images for extraction of relevant parameters. In this work, we provide the general framework under which a neural network-based resolution enhancer is designed and used for SPM images. We showcase the effectiveness of this framework using measurements performed on Line/Space structures with a pitch of 200 nm. For the reusability of a pre-developed pre-trained model, we additionally leverage transfer learning and show that a new model for slightly differing structures can be re-trained and calibrated with a smaller data set of measurements performed on Line/Space structures with a pitch of 100 nm.

</details>


### [240] [Feature identification for parameter extraction and defect detection using machine learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05812)
*Yan Guo,Helda Pahlavani,Artem Khachaturiants,Khalid Elsayed,Jakob van de Laar,Erik Simons,Niranjan Saikumar,Hamed Sadeghian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出一个通用框架，用高速扫描探针显微镜(SEM)图像训练机器学习网络，用于先进半导体节点在线工艺控制中的特征检测(参数提取)或缺陷识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先进半导体节点的工艺控制对量测设备提出更高要求：不仅要提升分辨率与吞吐量，还需提取更丰富的数据以帮助工程师微调工艺、提高良率。向3D结构的转变要求从层间差异很大的结构中提取关键尺寸参数；EUV时代随机缺陷增多，需在满足HVM产能的低分辨率下检测nm级缺陷。这两类需求都迫使开发针对特定层与设备的专用图像处理算法，而定制算法的开发成本高，ML方法有望加速该过程。

Method: 提出一个通用框架，将高速扫描探针显微镜系统获得的图像用于训练神经网络，分别面向特征检测(用于参数提取)或缺陷识别两类任务。

Result: 给出了该通用框架，使基于ML的图像处理方法能够加速面向参数提取的特征检测与缺陷识别的算法开发。（摘要未给出定量实验结果）

Conclusion: ML图像处理可加速半导体量测中专用算法的开发，高速扫描探针显微镜图像可作为训练数据，统一支撑特征检测与缺陷识别两类工艺控制任务。

Abstract: Process control of advanced semiconductor nodes is not only pushing the limits of metrology equipment requirements in terms of resolution and throughput but also in terms of the richness of data to be extracted to enable engineers to finetune the process steps for increased yield. The move towards 3D structures requires extraction of critical dimension parameters from structures which can vary largely from layer to layer. For in-line process control, the necessary automation forces the development of layer and equipment-specific dedicated image processing algorithms. Similarly, with the increase in stochastic defects in the EUV era, detection of defects at the nm scale requires the identification of features captured in low resolution to meet the throughput requirements of HVM fabs, which can again lead to custom algorithm development. With the emergence of ML-based image processing methods, this process of algorithm development for both cases can be accelerated. In this work, we provide the general framework under which the images obtained from high-speed scanning probe microscopy-based systems can be used to train a network for either feature detection for parameter extraction or defect identification.

</details>


### [241] [Usefulness of Quantile-Aware Diffusion Modeling for Highly Imbalanced Tabular Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05825)
*Abu Talha,Peng Liu,Souradyuti Paul*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Quantile-TabDDPM，通过分位数正则化去噪目标改进扩散模型，用于高度不平衡数据下少数类合成与欺诈检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高度不平衡数据在金融科技、医疗等领域普遍存在，少数类往往最关键。标准扩散模型因采用二次误差损失，缺乏结构敏感性，难以刻画重尾分布与稀有极端值，导致对少数类样本的生成能力不足。

Method: 提出 Quantile-TabDDPM，将标准二次误差损失与分位数损失项结合，构造分位数正则化去噪目标，以显式捕获稀有事件，同时保留原始去噪目标的理论基础。

Result: 在具有极端类别不平衡特征的信用卡交易数据集上进行了广泛评估，结果表明扩散合成数据生成与分位数正则化去噪目标的结合，为不平衡数据欺诈检测提供了稳健有效的框架。

Conclusion: 分位数正则化可增强扩散模型对少数类与重尾分布的建模能力，是解决高度不平衡分类问题的有效途径。

Abstract: Classification problem in the context of highly imbalanced data is a major challenge in many real-world applications (e.g., FinTech, healthcare, etc.). In these cases, the vast majority of instances belong to a single class and a small fraction represent the minority class (often the most critical class). Recently, diffusion models have emerged as powerful approaches to reduce the degree of ``imbalanced-ness'' in the dataset; they work by generating synthetic data by capturing complex data distributions using iterative transformations. However, standard diffusion models are not inherently suited to highly skewed or heavy-tailed data, due to inbuilt quadratic error loss, which lacks the structural sensitivity to capture rare, extreme values, and minority-class nuances. We propose a novel approach, namely, Quantile-TabDDPM, based on a quantile-regularized denoising objective that combines the standard quadratic error loss with a quantile loss term to explicitly capture rare events while preserving the theoretical grounding of the original denoising objective. We extensively evaluated our approach on a real-world credit card transaction dataset characterized by extreme class imbalance. The results demonstrate that the integration of diffusion-based synthetic data generation with a quantile-regularized denoising objective provides a robust and effective framework for fraud detection in highly imbalanced datasets.

</details>


### [242] [Selecting Long-Horizon Trajectories for Reliable and Efficient Terminal-Agent Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05831)
*Cuong Dang,Hoang Anh Just,Ruoxi Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究终端智能体模仿学习中"监督视野"（保留多少轨迹token用于训练）的设计维度，发现更长视野提升可靠性但会饱和，并据此提出选择性长视野精炼方法，以更少数据与训练时间取得更优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 终端智能体通常通过模仿长教师轨迹训练，但每条轨迹中应监督多少部分尚未被探索。监督视野直接影响可靠性与训练成本，且会塑造智能体行为（早停、错误恢复、过度坚持），因此需要系统研究该设计轴。

Method: 作者定义监督视野为保留训练的轨迹token数量，并在Terminal-Bench等基准上对比不同视野（如12K vs 16K）。通过偏差-复杂度界分析饱和现象：更长监督降低时序监督偏差，但增加异质后期历史带来的有限样本估计误差。基于该分析提出"选择性长视野精炼"：先在短前缀上训练，再仅对在热启动模型下最可能的续写进行精炼。

Result: Terminal-Bench上12K视野比16K解出更多任务（29±0.7 vs 26±0.8）且训练时间少30%。选择性长视野精炼在16K下将成功尝试从110±2.7提升至126±2.1，至少六次成功解出的任务从9±0.7提升至14±0.6；用一半数据仍达122±2.4并减少23%训练时间。迁移性上，Terminal-Bench v2.0从64±2.6提升至73±2.1，OpenThoughts-TBLite从137±2.7提升至155±2.2。

Conclusion: 监督视野是影响终端智能体可靠性与成本的关键设计轴，但其收益存在饱和。对于长视野监督，选择正确的轨迹比全部训练更重要，选择性长视野精炼能稳定优于完整长视野训练。

Abstract: Terminal agents are commonly trained by imitating long teacher trajectories, yet how much of each trajectory to supervise remains unexplored. We study the \emph{supervision horizon}, the number of trajectory tokens retained for training, and show that it is a key design axis for reliability and cost. Reliability improves with longer horizons but saturates: on Terminal-Bench, a 12K-token horizon solves more tasks than 16K ($29\pm0.7$ vs.\ $26\pm0.8$) while requiring 30\% less training time. The horizon also shapes agent behavior: short horizons cause premature termination, intermediate horizons yield productive error recovery, and long horizons induce over-persistence. We analyze this saturation through a bias--complexity bound, in which longer supervision reduces temporal supervision bias but increases finite-sample estimation error from more heterogeneous late-stage histories. Guided by this analysis, we propose \emph{selective long-horizon refinement}, which first trains on short prefixes and then refines only on continuations that are most likely under the warm-start model. It consistently outperforms full long-horizon training. At 16K, it raises successful attempts from $110\pm2.7$ to $126\pm2.1$ and tasks solved in at least six of eight attempts from $9\pm0.7$ to $14\pm0.6$; with half of the long-horizon data, it still reaches $122\pm2.4$ while cutting training time by 23\%. The gains transfer across benchmarks, from $64\pm2.6$ to $73\pm2.1$ on Terminal-Bench v2.0 and from $137\pm2.7$ to $155\pm2.2$ on OpenThoughts-TBLite. For long-horizon supervision, selecting the right trajectories matters more than training on all of them.

</details>


### [243] [HiER-BLS: A Hierarchy-Guided and Error-Correcting Robust Incremental Broad Learning System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05834)
*Gongli Zhang,C. L. Philip Chen,Zhulin Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 HiER-BLS，将层级引导的表示增长与纠错学习耦合，用于宽学习系统（BLS）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BLS 支持解析训练与增量扩展，但其增长缺乏对新模块应从哪些输入学习的指导；同时权重误差会使已学输出跨越类别边界，导致预测偏移。

Method: 方法上，连续模块依据特征重要性和相关性选择输入，同时保留早期表示；演化分支通过子空间大小与样本置信度引导编码学习器，使其学习经验同时影响特征视图与监督信息。理论方面，针对有限宽读出层，分析码字相关性如何变换拟合类别分数，并给出预测保持依赖于实际输出到最近解码边界距离与模型对权重误差敏感度之间的关系。

Result: 在五个图像和五个表格数据集上，相较代表性 BLS 变体取得更好的分类性能。组件研究表明，即使引导分支单独精度较低，层级引导仍有益于编码分支，融合两者分数可进一步提升。在干净精度基本饱和后，更长码字在更强高斯权重误差下仍能持续提升精度。

Conclusion: 研究表明层级引导与纠错学习相结合能有效提升 BLS 的分类性能与权重误差鲁棒性，且更长码字对误差环境下的精度保持具有持续增益。

Abstract: Broad Learning System (BLS) supports analytical training and incremental expansion, but its growth needs guidance on which inputs new blocks should learn from. Weight errors pose a further challenge by displacing learned outputs across class boundaries. We propose HiER-BLS to couple hierarchy-guided representation growth with error-correcting learning. Successive blocks focus on inputs selected by feature importance and correlation while preserving earlier representations. The evolving branch guides encoded learners through subspace size and sample confidence, so its learning experience informs both their feature views and supervision. For finite broad readouts, we show how codeword correlations transform fitted class scores. Prediction preservation depends on the distance from the actual output to the nearest decoding boundary relative to the model's sensitivity to weight errors. Experiments on five image and five tabular datasets demonstrate improved classification performance over representative BLS variants. Component studies show that hierarchy guidance benefits the encoded branch even when the guiding branch has lower standalone accuracy, with further gains from combining their scores. Longer codes continue to improve accuracy under stronger Gaussian weight errors after clean accuracy has largely saturated.

</details>


### [244] [CACFG: Curvature-Aware Classifier-Free Guidance and Optimal Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05845)
*Max Collins,Dasith de Silva Edirimuni,Jordan Vice,Tim French,Ajmal Mian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将无分类器引导（CFG）采样建模为连续时间最优控制问题，发现CFG对应无约束控制集下的解，并据此提出曲率感知CFG（CACFG），通过球面约束控制集改善中高引导强度下的生成质量与多样性权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CFG是扩散模型条件生成的标准机制，但存在两个问题：高引导强度会损害图像质量与多样性；CFG违背了有原则的扩散采样动力学，且现有解释在理论上相互矛盾，也无法推广到实践中使用的确定性采样器。作者希望同时解决这两个问题。

Method: 将CFG采样刻画为连续时间最优控制问题，把采样轨迹视为使目标条件概率最大化的控制序列，求解相应的Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman方程，证明在特定路径代价与无约束控制集下可还原出CFG。进而指出控制集无约束是CFG在高引导强度下失效的原因，并提出CACFG：借鉴VAE训练中的高斯正则化，将控制集约束在一个超球面上。

Result: 分析表明CFG采样产生的控制输入经常违反该超球约束；在多种扩散模型、数据集与引导调度下，CACFG在中高引导强度下取得更优的生成质量，且质量—多样性权衡比常规CFG更缓和。

Conclusion: CFG可被理解为无约束最优控制，其高引导强度失效源于控制缺乏约束；通过引入基于高斯正则化的球面约束（CACFG），可在保持条件对齐的同时缓解质量与多样性退化，为CFG提供了统一的理论解释与实用改进方案。

Abstract: Diffusion models generate samples by learning to reverse a fixed corruption process, and classifier-free guidance (CFG) is the standard mechanism for conditioning this process on a desired class or prompt. CFG can be applied at varying guidance strengths, and while higher strengths improve image quality and conditional alignment, too high a guidance strength can degrade image quality and diversity. Furthermore, CFG violates principled diffusion sampling dynamics, and existing explanations for why it works despite the violation disagree on the underlying theory or do not extend to deterministic samplers used in practice. We address both these issues. We first frame CFG sampling as a continuous-time optimal control problem, treating the sampling trajectory as a sequence of controls chosen to maximise the probability of the desired condition. Solving the resulting Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equation shows that CFG is recovered under specific path costs when using an unconstrained control set. We argue this lack of constraint is responsible for CFG's failure at high guidance strengths, since it permits the sampling path to move arbitrarily far from the current image estimate. To fix this, we propose curvature-aware CFG (CACFG), which constrains the control set to a hypersphere informed by the Gaussian regularisation used when training variational autoencoders. We show that the control inputs produced by CFG sampling routinely violate this bound, and that across diffusion models, datasets, and guidance schedules, CACFG achieves superior generative quality at mid-to-high guidance strengths with a less severe quality-diversity tradeoff than regular CFG.

</details>


### [245] [RepICL: Reusable In-Context Prediction Across Heterogeneous Representation Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05852)
*Yu-Hsiang Liu,Kuan-Yu Chen,Chih-Sheng Chen,Meng-Hsuan Chang,Yu-Chen Den,Tien-Hao Chang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 RepShiftBench 基准与 RepICL 元学习框架，证明少样本预测过程本身可被学习并跨数据集、表征空间与模态复用，其中情节白化是关键增益来源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 冻结表征被广泛复用于下游分类，但每个新任务通常仍需单独拟合新的预测器。作者追问：少样本预测过程本身能否只学一次，并在不同数据集与表征空间之间复用。现有评估缺乏对"未见数据集、未见编码器、二者联合未见、未见模态"的分离考察，也缺乏对上下文学习器与逐情节独立拟合逻辑回归的系统比较。

Method: 1) 构建 RepShiftBench 基准，含 1,218 个编码器—数据集任务，覆盖文本、图像、音频，并分离评估四类泛化设置；2) 提出 RepICL，一个元训练的上下文学习器，在预测前通过"情节白化"（episodic whitening）对每个情节做规范化；3) 给出归纳式变体 RepICL-I 与直推式变体 RepICL-T；4) 通过消融实验定位增益来源，并分析增益在哪些查询上集中。

Result: 基准揭示显著差距：逐情节独立拟合的逻辑回归在所有设置中均优于所有被评估的上下文学习器。RepICL-I 在全部 12 个基准设置中超越逻辑回归，RepICL-T 显著优于现有直推式方法。消融表明情节白化是主要增益来源，但它并非普遍有益的预处理步骤。两种变体的增益集中在"简单支撑原型指向错误类别"或"真类与竞争类之间区分度不足"的查询上；当支撑集覆盖有限、导致类别可分性判断失真时，直推式带来的额外增益最大。

Conclusion: 共享的少样本预测过程能够泛化到训练时所见的表征空间之外，说明"学习一次、处处复用"的预测器具备可行性；情节白化是核心机制，但其收益具有条件依赖性，需结合查询难度与支撑集覆盖情况来理解与使用。

Abstract: Frozen representations are widely reused for downstream classification, yet each new task typically requires fitting a new predictor. We ask whether the few-shot prediction procedure itself can instead be learned once and reused across datasets and representation spaces. To study this question, we introduce RepShiftBench, comprising 1,218 encoder--dataset tasks across text, image, and audio, with separate evaluation of generalization to unseen datasets, unseen encoders, jointly unseen datasets and encoders, and unseen modalities. The benchmark exposes a substantial gap: Logistic Regression fitted independently on each episode outperforms every evaluated in-context learner across all settings. We introduce RepICL, a meta-trained in-context learner that canonicalizes each episode through episodic whitening before prediction. Its inductive variant, RepICL-I, surpasses Logistic Regression in all 12 benchmark settings, while RepICL-T substantially outperforms existing transductive methods. Ablations identify episodic whitening as the primary source of these gains, while showing that it is not a universally beneficial preprocessing step. Across both variants, the gains concentrate on queries for which simple support prototypes favor the wrong class or provide little separation between the true class and competing classes. Transduction provides its largest additional gains when limited support coverage gives a misleading view of class separation. Together, these results demonstrate that a shared few-shot prediction procedure can generalize beyond the representation spaces observed during training.

</details>


### [246] [The Blind Spot Paradox: When Adaptive Classifiers Defeat Drift Detectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05853)
*Raphaël Minato,Fabrice Popineau,Arpad Rimmel,Bich-Liên Doan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文揭示自适应分类器（ARF）的误差流监控概念漂移存在结构性矛盾：内部自适应会在累积检测器（CUSUM、Page-Hinkley）达到阈值前抹去漂移误差证据，导致检测盲区与误报泛滥。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统概念漂移检测器假设误差流在阈值前保持漂移信号，但自适应模型的内部更新循环与外部监控形成操作冲突：模型恢复过快会"擦除"检测所需的累积证据。作者希望量化这一冲突的边界与后果。

Method: 以Adaptive Random Forest (ARF)为对象进行插桩分析，追踪漂移后误差瞬态被各组件（增量叶子更新、背景树替换）吸收的比例；推导有限时域下累积证据无法越过阈值的边界条件，并定义临界幅度下限Δe_c；在合成漂移、ARMA-GARCH序列（ProteuS）、表格基准（BAF、INSECTS）上验证，并在标准阈值下做合成扫描。

Result: 幸存树通过增量叶子更新单独吸收了漂移后98.6%的误差瞬态；首次背景树替换仅占该被擦除误差量的0.71%，却使外部检测率下降31个百分点；临界幅度下限Δe_c=0.120，低于此值误报预算将阻止任何检测；合成扫描在标准阈值下盲区出现在Δe≈0.25，而经典基准SEA（Δe≤0.21）因幅度不足未能触及。

Conclusion: 累积型漂移检测器与自适应模型更新存在根本性冲突，表现为平稳流上的漏检与噪声基线上由内部树替换引发的误报洪泛；经典基准因漂移幅度偏低掩盖了该盲区，需重新审视误差流监控范式的适用边界。

Abstract: Monitoring concept drift from an adaptive classifier's error stream creates an operational conflict with the model's own update loop. When internal adaptation outpaces evidence accumulation, accuracy recovers before cumulative detectors (CUSUM, Page-Hinkley) can reach threshold. Instrumenting an Adaptive Random Forest (ARF) shows that surviving trees absorb 98.6% of the post-drift error transient through incremental leaf updates alone. The first background tree swap accounts for just 0.71% of this erased error volume, but drops external detection rates by 31 percentage points. We derive the finite-horizon boundary where cumulative evidence fails to cross threshold and measure a critical magnitude floor ($Δe_c = 0.120$) below which false-alarm budgets preclude detection. This failure manifests as missed shifts on stationary streams and false-alarm flooding triggered by internal tree swaps on noisy baselines. We validate on synthetic shifts, ARMA-GARCH series (ProteuS), and tabular benchmarks (BAF, INSECTS); on the synthetic sweep at a standard threshold, the blind spot appears at $Δe \approx 0.25$, showing why classical benchmarks like SEA ($Δe \le 0.21$) failed to reach it.

</details>


### [247] [TurboPairFormer: Fast and Stable Protein Folding Model Training with an Optimized Triangle Attention Kernel](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05854)
*Yide Ran,Chelsea Lowman,Jan Domański,David Hartmann,Jenke Scheen,Jennifer Wei,Chuan Li,Jianwen Xie,Zhaozhuo Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TurboPairFormer：面向 NVIDIA Hopper GPU 的三角注意力实现，通过 key-tile 并行反向算法与输出残差补偿，兼顾确定性、低显存与 BF16 数值精度，在 OpenFold3 中取得最优训练性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AlphaFold3 风格模型的三角注意力计算量随 token 数呈三次方增长；其共享 pair bias 在 query、key 归约之外引入跨注意力切片的额外梯度归约。现有开源后端处理这些归约时依赖重复概率重算、浮点原子加或完整 score 梯度存储，且从 BF16 舍入后的前向输出计算 softmax 反向修正会损失数值精度。作者希望同时解决效率与精度问题。

Method: 提出 TurboPairFormer，针对 NVIDIA Hopper GPU：(1) key-tile 并行反向算法——每个概率 tile 仅重算一次，同时用于 query、key、value 与 pair-bias 梯度，并采用有序部分归约实现确定性累加，避免浮点原子操作和完整 score 梯度存储；(2) 输出残差补偿——保留输出舍入残差的 BF16 近似，在 FP32 下更准确地计算反向修正，同时不改变 BF16 输出。

Result: 在 BF16 输入、crop size 384/640/768、head dim 16/32 下，TurboPairFormer 相对 FP64 参考取得对比实现中最低的 query、key、pair-bias 梯度 RMSE；消融实验中残差补偿使 RMSE 降低 28%–47%。在 600 个输入案例、固定执行条件下，五次重复调用的四个梯度均逐位一致。集成到 OpenFold3（配合三角乘法 kernel）后，在 16 张 H100 上取得最低的单优化器步 GPU 计算时间，相对 OpenFold3 Triton 后端加速 1.73×，相对 cuEquivariance 在 crop size 768 时加速 1.13×。

Conclusion: TurboPairFormer 通过确定性、低存储的反向算法与残差补偿，在保持 BF16 输出不变的前提下提升了梯度精度，并在大规模多卡训练中实现优于现有后端的计算效率，适用于 AlphaFold3 类生物分子模型的三角注意力场景。

Abstract: Triangular attention is a core computation in AlphaFold3-style biomolecular models, with cubic cost in token count. Its shared pair bias adds a gradient reduction across attention slices to the usual reductions over queries and keys. The open-source backends we examine handle these reductions through repeated probability recomputation, floating-point atomics, or full score-gradient storage. Separately, computing the softmax backward correction from BF16-rounded forward outputs loses numerical precision. We present TurboPairFormer, a triangular attention implementation for NVIDIA Hopper GPUs that addresses both issues. Our key-tile-parallel backward algorithm recomputes each probability tile once for the query, key, value, and pair-bias gradients, using ordered partial reductions for deterministic accumulation without floating-point atomics or full score-gradient storage. Output-residual compensation retains a BF16 approximation of the output-rounding residual to compute the backward correction more accurately in FP32, without changing the BF16 output. With BF16 inputs at crop sizes 384, 640, and 768 and head dimensions 16 and 32, TurboPairFormer achieves the lowest mean query, key, and pair-bias gradient RMSE against an FP64 reference among the implementations compared in this paper. Residual compensation reduces these RMSE values by 28-47% in controlled ablations. All four gradients are bitwise identical across five repeated calls in all 600 input cases under fixed execution conditions. Integrated into OpenFold3 with our triangle multiplication kernels, TurboPairFormer achieves the lowest GPU computation time per optimizer step among the evaluated backend configurations on 16 H100 GPUs, with speedups of $1.73\times$ over OpenFold3's Triton backend and $1.13\times$ over cuEquivariance at crop size 768.

</details>


### [248] [CCQ: A Multi-State Child Care Quality Dataset to Support AI for Children's Health Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05863)
*Victor Li,Yuzhang Xie,Ziwei Dong,Qingyang Zhu,Wenjing Ma,Carl Yang,Jinbing Bai,Huiwen Xu,Jiaying Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文发布了CCQ数据集，整合12个州59,372条儿童保育机构记录，通过LLM自动流水线匿名化、清洗并标准化为文本与表格两个版本，并基准测试了传统ML、表格基础模型与语言模型在质量评级预测上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 早期儿童保育质量是儿童生长发育的关键决定因素，但相关研究受限于数据集碎片化、非研究友好且隐私受限。作者希望构建大规模、去标识化的数据集来推动AI与儿童健康交叉领域的数据科学研究。

Method: 构建CCQ数据集，整合12个美国州共59,372条保育机构记录，覆盖多种机构类型与数据模式；采用基于LLM的自动化策展流水线，对原始州记录进行匿名化、清洗和标准化，输出清洗文本版和完全预处理表格版两个版本；在质量评级预测和重要特征分析任务上，基准测试传统机器学习、表格基础模型和语言模型。

Result: 在单一州内，基于预处理表格的表格分类器表现最佳。跨州场景下，零样本迁移性能接近随机水平，但少量目标州监督即可恢复大部分州内性能，且在其他州预训练对微调语言模型有增益。

Conclusion: 作者公开两个数据集及全部代码，以加速AI驱动的儿童保育质量研究，最终改善儿童健康与发展。

Abstract: High-quality child care in early life is a critical determinant of children's growth and development. Research on child care quality has been constrained by fragmented, non-research-friendly, and privacy-bound datasets. We present CCQ (Child Care Quality), a large-scale, de-identified dataset for applied data science research at the intersection of AI and early childhood health. CCQ integrates 59,372 child care provider records across 12 U.S. states, covering diverse provider types as well as data schemas. To ensure research utility while protecting privacy, we implement an automated, LLM-based curation pipeline that anonymizes, cleans, and standardizes raw state records into two complementary releases: a cleaned textual release and a fully preprocessed tabular release. We also benchmark traditional machine learning models, tabular foundation models, and language models on quality rating prediction and important features analytics. Within a state, tabular classifiers on the preprocessed tables perform best. Across states, zero-shot transfer is near chance, but modest target-state supervision recovers most of the within-state performance, and pretraining on other states benefits finetuned language models. We release both datasets with all code to accelerate AI-driven research on child care quality and ultimately improve children's health and development.

</details>


### [249] [Off-Policy Merging Beats On-Policy Self-Distillation for Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05872)
*Chen Henry Wu,Thomas Zhang,Aditi Raghunathan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"grafting"方法：通过在早期donor checkpoint上学习权重更新、缩放更新幅度（模型合并）、并对敏感方向进行掩码，将off-policy数据高效地注入到后训练模型中，在持续学习任务上帕累托优于SFT和on-policy自蒸馏(OPSD)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统观点认为on-policy训练是持续学习的必要条件，但实际中新知识/新能力数据往往是off-policy的；现有方法OPSD虽试图将off-policy数据转为on-policy信号，却会导致推理能力崩溃。作者希望找到一种不依赖昂贵on-policy采样的持续学习方案。

Method: 提出grafting（嫁接）配方，包含三步：(1)在较早的donor checkpoint（最好在预训练结束前）上学习更新，再将权重更新应用到后训练模型；(2)缩放该权重更新，等价于一种模型合并形式；(3)当新数据分布与后训练模型差异较大时，对最敏感的更新方向进行掩码。

Result: 在多种持续学习设置下（专家轨迹蒸馏、STaR与Pedagogical RL自改进、预训练截止后知识注入），grafting在新任务与旧任务性能上均帕累托优于SFT和OPSD，同时避免了昂贵的on-policy采样。

Conclusion: off-policy merging优于OPSD用于持续学习；本工作挑战了"on-policy训练是RL训练模型持续学习必要条件"这一传统认知。

Abstract: A long-standing goal of AI is a model that can continually learn and improve itself. On post-trained models, supervised finetuning (SFT) on new data often causes poor generalization and catastrophic forgetting. As such, the conventional wisdom is that on-policy training is a prerequisite for continual learning. In practice, however, data containing new knowledge or capabilities are often off-policy. While methods such as on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) try to bridge this gap by converting off-policy data into on-policy signal, they have been shown to cause reasoning collapse. In this paper, we show that off-policy merging beats OPSD for continual learning. We first show that SFT learns a useful signal from new data, but naively applying its update interferes with existing capabilities. We reduce this interference with a simple recipe we term grafting, which changes where the update is learned and how it is applied: (1) learning the update on an earlier donor checkpoint, ideally even before the end of pretraining, and applying the weight update to the post-trained model; (2) scaling the weight update, equivalent to a form of model merging; and (3) optionally, masking the most sensitive update directions when the new data distribution is far from the post-trained model. Across continual learning settings including (1) distilling from expert traces, (2) self-improvement with STaR and Pedagogical RL, and (3) injecting knowledge after pretraining cutoff, grafting Pareto-dominates both SFT and OPSD in new-task and old-task performance, while avoiding expensive on-policy sampling. Therefore, our work challenges on-policy training as a necessity for continual learning on RL-trained models.

</details>


### [250] [Global Communication or Graph-Specific Memory?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05874)
*Hamed Shirzad,Danica J. Sutherland*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在静态图的直推式设定下，共享记忆（如虚拟节点、全局通信）本质上是一个常量，直接优化共享记忆与全局通信方法效果相当，因此该设定不适合评估GNN的全局通信能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可扩展图Transformer常在静态大图上以直推式方式训练与评估，其全局通信组件（如虚拟节点、共享记忆）借鉴自语言模型等领域；但在单一固定图上，输入不变，共享记忆在测试时只是常量，这引出对其真实作用与评估有效性的质疑。

Method: 作者将多种可扩展图Transformer组件统一表述为“常数大小共享记忆”（类似虚拟节点），提供对整个图的压缩信息；并通过对比实验，将直接优化共享记忆的做法与全局通信方法进行比较。

Result: 初步证据表明，直接优化共享记忆的表现与全局通信方法相似；常规的局部消息传递模型同样可以将类似信息嵌入其权重中。

Conclusion: 在静态单图的直推式设定下，共享记忆不应被视为动态压缩机制；该设定可能不适合评估图神经网络中的全局通信，需要更合适的评测协议。

Abstract: Scalable Graph Transformers are commonly trained and evaluated on static large graphs in a transductive setup. Many scalable Graph Transformer components can be formulated as a constant-size shared memory, similar to virtual nodes, providing compressed information about the whole graph. The counterpart of these models in language models and other domains is justified as the input changes, and this mechanism learns to compress some useful information about the input. In transductive learning on a single fixed graph, however, any shared memory can be seen as a constant at test time. This raises the question of what exactly this shared memory does in this static setup. We give preliminary evidence that optimizing a shared memory directly performs similarly to global communication methods, and so normal local message-passing models can embed similar information in their weights. Thus, these settings may be a poor fit for evaluating global communication in graph neural networks.

</details>


### [251] [OGAM: Connecting Systematic Testing to Runtime Assurance through Object-Grounded Attention Monitoring for VLA Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05878)
*Haki Darwish,Xiangyu Yin,Changwen Li,Rongjie Yan,Francisco Gomes de Oliveira Neto,Chih-Hong Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Object-Grounded Attention Monitoring（OGAM），将系统化测试与运行时保障连接起来：测试揭示成功与失败执行间的注意力差异，OGAM利用该信号在有限测试集之外拦截失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA策略的基准测试仅覆盖少量规范指令，而穷尽式部署测试不可行，因此需要一种能将测试中发现的问题推广到运行时、提前阻断失败的方法。

Method: 通过动作模板与物体的成对组合生成场景化指令，并单独测试保持语义的复述；在每个动作查询处，将梯度加权视觉注意力经物体掩码投影，并按指令角色分组以跨任务、跨策略比较；用动态时间规整将注意力过程与成功参考对齐，并在成功回合上进行保形校准，以α=0.05的标称误停目标设定持续偏差的早停阈值。

Result: 全部87个基准外案例在OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT、UniVLA和π0.5上均暴露问题行为：24条可行指令无一完成，不可行或危险请求还触发行为替换。在四种策略上，OGAM在20秒预算内于中位5-12秒拦截了87-100%的失败回合，实测误停率为3-5%，且无需失败标注训练。

Conclusion: 有限测试能够识别出支持在线干预的注意力模式，从而在失败完全展开之前进行拦截。

Abstract: Benchmarks expose vision-language-action (VLA) policies to few canonical instructions, while exhaustive deployment testing is impossible. We introduce Object-Grounded Attention Monitoring (OGAM), connecting systematic testing to runtime assurance: testing reveals attention divergence between successful and failed executions, and OGAM uses this signal to stop failures beyond the finite suite. We generate scene-grounded instructions through pairwise combinations of action templates and objects, and separately test meaning-preserving paraphrases. All 87 out-of-benchmark cases reveal problematic behavior across OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, UniVLA, and $π_{0.5}$: none completes any of the 24 feasible instructions, while infeasible or hazardous requests also trigger behavior substitution. At each action query, we project gradient-weighted visual attention through object masks and group it by instruction role for comparison across tasks and policies. Dynamic time warping aligns this course with a successful reference despite speed differences; conformal calibration on successful episodes sets the early-stopping threshold for sustained deviations, with a nominal false-stop target of $α=0.05$. Across four policies, OGAM stops 87-100% of failed episodes at median times of 5-12s within a 20s budget, with observed false-stop rates of 3-5%, without failure-labeled training. Finite testing thus identifies attention patterns that support online intervention before failure fully unfolds.

</details>


### [252] [The Optimization Landscape of Learning Compacted Context Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05885)
*Thomas Villeneuve,Alex Sandomirsky,Charles O'Neill,Max Kirkby,Michael Psenka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究持续学习中的KV缓存压缩问题，指出在冻结基座模型上优化KV压缩是一个平坦且脆弱的优化难题，并提出一种极简的Perceiver架构，在连续上下文压缩中不仅匹配完整Perceiver Transformer，还在压缩效用上超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将上下文压缩视为直接的内存操作（不改变基座权重），已有工作把KV压缩建模为学习一小组KV向量以匹配完整KV缓存。但通过冻结基座模型进行优化非常困难，损失地形平坦且脆弱。作者希望刻画这些优化困难的成因并提出更有效的压缩方案。

Method: 严格刻画使KV压缩优化困难的因素；设计一种大幅简化的基于Perceiver的架构，与完整Perceiver Transformer进行对比，在连续上下文压缩任务上评估。

Result: 简化的Perceiver架构在连续上下文压缩上性能匹配完整Perceiver Transformer，并在压缩效用（compaction utility）上优于基线；结果覆盖Finance、Legal、Gutenberg和Code四个领域的MCQ任务。

Conclusion: 在冻结基座模型下优化KV压缩存在固有的优化困难，而极简的Perceiver式架构即可有效实现上下文压缩，兼具性能与压缩效用优势。

Abstract: Many works approach continual learning through the lens of infinite context windows. As an agent puts more observation into context (concretely the KV cache), compacting said context is akin to direct memory manipulation, without affecting the base model's weights. Many works pose KV compaction as an optimization problem: learn a smaller set of KV vectors that matches the behavior of the full KV cache. While this preserves base model behavior, optimizing through a frozen base model results in a highly nontrivial optimization problem with a brittle and flat loss landscape. In this paper, we characterize what makes these optimization problems difficult and demonstrate that a heavily simplified Perceiver-based architecture not only matches performance of a full Perceiver transformer in continuous context compaction, but outperforms baselines on compaction utility. Results are presented on MCQ tasks across Finance, Legal, Gutenberg, and Code.

</details>


### [253] [Collaborative Personalized Preference Alignment for LLMs under Data Deficiency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05898)
*Liyan Yang,Yige Yuan,Zhiqin Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出APO（近似帕累托最优）方法，通过用户分组与梯度下降+控制上升协调冲突目标，学习支持少样本个性化适配的对齐器初始化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实用户对LLM多目标偏好高度异质，个性化训练面临用户反馈稀缺问题；跨用户学习共享初始化可支持少样本适配，但异质偏好与竞争目标导致用户间及用户内梯度冲突，阻碍有效初始化学习。

Method: APO先按更新兼容性对用户分组以减少干扰；组内结合梯度下降与控制上升协调竞争目标，逼近帕累托前沿上偏好特定点，得到接近组内用户最优的初始化；再用少样本本地适配的更新迭代精炼该初始化。同时建立单步本地协作更新的条件次优性界，并刻画初始化误差对后续随机适配的影响。

Result: 在Fed-ChatbotPA与UltraFeedback数据集上，仅使用20个本地样本即持续优于现有方法。

Conclusion: APO通过分组与帕累托协调有效学习共享初始化，缓解梯度冲突，显著提升少样本个性化对齐效果，并给出理论保障。

Abstract: Real-world users often exhibit highly heterogeneous preferences over multiple objectives for LLM responses. A lightweight aligner can tailor these responses to individual preferences, but scarce user-specific feedback makes personalized training difficult. Learning shared initializations across users can support few-shot adaptation. However, heterogeneous preferences and competing objectives cause gradient conflicts across users and within each user, hindering effective initialization learning. This raises a central question: \textbf{how can we collaboratively learn aligner initializations that support few-shot adaptation to diverse user preferences?} To answer this question, we propose \textbf{A}pproximate \textbf{P}areto \textbf{O}ptimality (APO). We first group users whose updates are compatible, so that their information can be combined with less interference. Within each group, we combine gradient descent with controlled ascent to coordinate competing objectives and move towards preference-specific points on the Pareto front. This produces an initialization that is close to the optima of the users in the group. We then iteratively refine it using updates from few-shot local adaptation, making it more effective for personalization. Furthermore, we establish conditional suboptimality bounds for a one-local-step collaborative update and characterize how initialization error affects subsequent stochastic adaptation. Experiments on Fed-ChatbotPA and UltraFeedback show consistent improvements over existing methods using only 20 local examples.

</details>


### [254] [On Hyperparameter Tuning on the Test Set](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05902)
*Matteo Fregonara,Tom Viering,Jan van Gemert*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过实证研究质疑"禁止在测试集上调参"的教条。在MNIST-1D、CIFAR-10和GLUE的三个任务上，系统考察测试集调参导致的性能膨胀。结果表明该效应真实显著，但常小于其他噪声来源；多数情况下测试集调参得到的模型与验证集调参相同，且模型排名基本保持不变，因此一致的测试集调参未必使基准失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习教材普遍将"在测试集上调参"视为严重错误，认为其会夸大结果、破坏基准公正性，甚至可被视为学术造假。然而实践中此类行为确有发生，因此亟需了解其真实后果。作者旨在以实证方式检验这一戒律，量化测试集调参的实际危害程度。

Method: 在MNIST-1D、CIFAR-10及GLUE基准的三个任务上，系统性地将超参数在测试集上调优，并与在验证集上调优的结果进行对比，测量由此产生的性能膨胀幅度、所选模型的差异以及模型排名的一致性。

Result: 测试集调参确实带来真实且显著的性能膨胀，但其幅度常小于其他噪声来源。在许多情况下，测试集调参选择出的模型与验证集调参完全相同；更重要的是，模型之间的相对排名在测试集调参后基本保持不变。

Conclusion: 一致的测试集调参可能并不会使基准或模型选择失效。作者呼吁对测试集调参持更细致的观点，并鼓励研究者公开报告其在测试集上调参的行为。

Abstract: "Don't tune hyperparameters on the test set" is often stated in machine learning textbooks. Violating it is considered a cardinal sin that produces misleadingly optimistic results, corrupts benchmark integrity, and thus can even be interpreted as scientific fraud. Yet evidence suggests that test set hyperparameter tuning does occur in practice, making it all the more important to understand its actual consequences. So how bad is it, really? In this work we question this dogma and put it to an empirical test. We systematically study the magnitude of the performance inflation caused by tuning the hyperparameters on the test set for MNIST-1D, CIFAR-10, and three tasks from the GLUE benchmark. Our experiments show that while the effect is real and significant, it is frequently small relative to other sources of noise. In many cases, we find that tuning on the test set recovers exactly the same model as when tuning on the validation set. Most importantly, we find that the rankings of models remain essentially preserved after tuning on the test set and therefore that consistent test-set tuning may not invalidate benchmarks or model selection. Our results call for a more nuanced view of tuning hyperparameters on the test set, stimulating researchers to openly report test tuning.

</details>


### [255] [CoHyFuse: Condition-wise Hypergraph Fusion with Global Connectome in Task-fMRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05913)
*Boseong Kim,Haejun Chung,Ikbeom Jang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出条件感知的ROI中心超图框架CoHyFuse，从任务态fMRI构建状态特异的多ROI超边结构并与全时段FC融合，在认知/年龄预测及ADHD分类上取得更优且可解释的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统任务态fMRI连接组方法将不同条件聚合为静态成对图，边缘化了状态依赖的神经重构信号，掩盖了条件特异的、以ROI为中心的多脑区组织模式。

Method: CoHyFuse以ROI为中心构建条件感知超图：基于条件wise功能连接（FC）画像嵌入生成任务状态特异的关联矩阵，使同一ROI在不同任务阶段形成不同的多ROI超边；并引入条件特异的邻域规模K_q自适应调整各任务态的超边尺度；所得条件嵌入与互补的全时段FC分支进行双视角融合用于预测。

Result: AABC队列（N=1,074）中，FCC预测MAE 7.83±0.10、R² 0.439±0.026；VISMOTOR年龄预测MAE 7.52±0.37、R² 0.592±0.022，均为所评估基线中最佳。CMI-HBN ADHD分类基准（N=223）取得72.0±2.1% macro-AUC、74.2±2.9%准确率。消融研究支持条件wise关联矩阵构建与双视角融合的贡献；遮挡分析显示Distraction条件为主要驱动因素，并指向SAN–FPN及SAN内超边定义的ROI集模式。

Conclusion: 状态解析的ROI集合结构可提供超出全时段FC的互补预测信息，CoHyFuse为下游队列分析提供了可解释、状态分辨的连接组视角。

Abstract: Task-fMRI connectomes reveal state-dependent neural reconfigurations, yet conventional methods marginalize these signals by aggregating distinct conditions into static pairwise graphs, thereby obscuring condition-specific multi-ROI organization. We introduce CoHyFuse, a condition-aware ROI-centered hypergraph framework that constructs a task-state-specific incidence matrix from condition-wise functional connectivity (FC)-profile embeddings, allowing the same ROI to form different multi-ROI hyperedges across task phases. Condition-specific neighborhood sizes $K_q$ further adapt the hyperedge scale to each task state, and the resulting condition embeddings are fused with a complementary whole-session FC branch for prediction. In the AABC cohort (N=1,074), CoHyFuse achieved the best mean out-of-fold predictive performance among evaluated baselines on FACENAME Fluid Cognition Composite (FCC) prediction (7.83$\pm$0.10 MAE, 0.439$\pm$0.026 \(R^2\)) and VISMOTOR age prediction (7.52$\pm$0.37 MAE, 0.592$\pm$0.022 \(R^2\)). In an auxiliary CMI-HBN attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) classification benchmark (N=223), CoHyFuse obtained 72.0$\pm$2.1\% macro-AUC and 74.2$\pm$2.9\% accuracy. Ablation studies support the contributions of condition-wise incidence construction and dual-view fusion, suggesting that state-resolved ROI-set structure provides complementary predictive information beyond whole-session FC alone. Occlusion analysis identifies the Distraction condition as the primary driver of model prediction, pointing toward the Salience/Ventral Attention Network (SAN)--FrontoParietal Network (FPN) and within-SAN hyperedge-defined ROI-set motifs as candidate model-relevant patterns. This framework provides an interpretable, state-resolved view of the connectome for downstream cohort analysis.

</details>


### [256] [Large Stepsizes Federated Learning on Logistic Regression with Linearly Separable Data: The Case of Heterogeneous Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05915)
*Hok Fong Wong,Hoi-To Wai,Chung-Yiu Yau*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新审视了FedAvg算法训练多项逻辑回归模型的问题，在任意大步长与异构更新规则下证明其对于线性可分数据的稳定性与收敛性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有FedAvg理论分析通常限制于小步长或同构更新假设，缺乏对任意大步长及设备进行不同次数本地更新的异构场景的理论刻画，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 作者针对线性可分数据、任意大步长以及每轮设备执行不同本地更新次数的异构更新规则，对FedAvg进行理论分析，并进行数值实验验证。

Result: 证明FedAvg在任意步长下稳定，目标值以O(1/R)速率收敛至零；当R足够大时目标值单调下降，并被O(1/(RT_avg))界定，其中T_avg为每轮平均本地更新步数；同时表明设备异构性的影响渐近消失。

Conclusion: 在线性可分数据下，FedAvg对任意步长稳定且收敛速率不受设备异构性限制，数值实验支持该理论发现。

Abstract: This paper revisits the distributed learning problem for training a multinomial logistic regression model with the Federated Averaging ($\texttt{FedAvg}$) algorithm. We concentrate on a scenario with arbitrarily large stepsizes and heterogeneous update rules where the devices may perform a different number of local updates in each round. We show that, with linearly separable data, $\texttt{FedAvg}$ is stable with any stepsizes and the objective values converge to zero at the rate of ${\cal O}(1/R)$, where $R$ is the number of communication rounds. Our result also demonstrates that the effects of device heterogeneity vanish asymptotically. For sufficiently large $R$, the objective values decrease monotonically and is bounded by ${\cal O}( 1 / (R T_{\rm avg}))$, where $T_{\rm avg}$ is the average number of local update steps per communication round across devices. Numerical experiments support our findings.

</details>


### [257] [Non-invasive Seizure Detection Using Wearable Wrist-worn Accelerometry and Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05919)
*Nilushika Udayangani Hewa Dehigahawattage,Kishor Nandakishor,Marimuthu Palaniswami*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究基于单腕加速度计与ResNet时序深度神经网络，实现多种癫痫发作（含短时事件）的可穿戴无创检测，灵敏度95.65%，误报率0.15次/24小时，AUC-ROC 0.98、AUC-PRC 0.67，显示可用于长期门诊癫痫监测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有癫痫诊疗依赖昂贵的视频脑电（VEEG）监测，需专业人员且仅限院内、具侵入性；癫痫日记则因漏报而不可靠，易导致错误治疗决策。因此需要可耐受、可行的长期门诊无创癫痫检测方案。

Method: 纳入79名在VEEG监测下的患者佩戴单腕加速度计采集数据；由认证癫痫专科医师审阅同步VEEG并标注发作起始、终止及类型；据此构建基于时间序列ResNet架构的深度神经网络，用于区分发作与非发作事件。

Result: 在总计5576小时记录评估中，发作检测灵敏度达95.65%，总体误报率为0.15次/24小时；在20名出现46次惊厥性发作的患者上平均，AUC-ROC为0.98，AUC-PRC为0.67。

Conclusion: 该系统有望用于长期门诊癫痫监测；后续需在更大数据集上验证，并评估对其他发作类型的检测效用。

Abstract: Seizure monitoring and detection are crucial for reducing the morbidity and mortality associated with seizures. Current epilepsy care, often involving expensive video-electroencephalography (VEEG) monitoring, requires specialized expertise and is limited to in-hospital settings, and intrusive in nature. Seizure diaries, on the other hand, suffer from unreliability due to under-reporting, leading to incorrect therapeutic decisions. Wearable non-invasive seizure detection may offer a more tolerable and feasible solution for long-term ambulatory monitoring. This study explores a wearable remote monitoring system utilizing a single wrist-worn accelerometer device and capable of detecting multiple types of seizures, including shorter duration events. We enrolled 79 patients under video-electroencephalography monitoring to wear accelerometer devices and collect data. Concurrent VEEG recordings were reviewed by board-certified epileptologists to produce annotations, including seizure onset, offset, and seizure type. Using this data, we constructed a deep neural network based on the time-series ResNet architecture, which could discriminate among seizure and non-seizure events. Our proposed approach achieved a seizure detection sensitivity of 95.65% and an overall false alarm rate of 0.15/24 hours during the evaluation, which spanned 5576 hours of total recording. Additionally, it resulted in an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC) of 0.98 and an area under the precision-re call curve (AUC-PRC) of 0.67 when averaged over 20 patients who experienced 46 convulsive seizures. These promising results suggest that the proposed seizure detection system can be effectively used for long-term ambulatory seizure monitoring. Future steps include validating our findings in larger datasets and assessing the utility of detection for additional seizure types.

</details>


### [258] [Beyond Transport Cost: Routing Differences between Flow Matching and Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05921)
*Eungyeol Han,Jong-Seok Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出在基于最优传输（OT）的流匹配（FM）中，仅用传输代价衡量耦合设计并不充分，提出应将“路由”（每个噪声样本到达的目标）与代价分离，并验证了路由感知耦合能带来方向一致的生成改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在生成模型中，OT 被用于改进 FM，主要通过降低噪声-数据耦合代价。但不同的噪声到输出分配可能产生几乎相等的代价，因此一个关键问题浮现：仅凭代价是否足以指导耦合设计？

Method: 作者将传输代价与路由（每个噪声样本所到达的目标）分离进行考察；通过数值实验展示 FM 与 OT 可在路由上不同而代价相近；在学习的神经 FM 中检验其后果，并以精确 FM 路由作为 oracle 构建路由感知的训练耦合，与代价匹配的“仅代价”对照进行对比。

Result: 数值上显示 FM 与 OT 可在路由存在差异的同时保持代价接近；在神经 FM 中，路由感知耦合相对代价匹配、仅代价的对照，在生成上取得方向一致的改进。

Conclusion: 研究强调代价最小化可能忽略路由层面的差异，主张在评估基于 OT 的 FM 耦合设计时同时使用代价与路由两个维度。

Abstract: In generative models, Optimal Transport (OT) is used to improve Flow Matching (FM) by reducing noise-data coupling cost. However, different noise-to-output assignments can yield nearly equal costs, raising a key question. Is cost alone sufficient to guide coupling design? We address this question by separating transport cost from routing, i.e., the destination reached by each noise sample. We show numerically how FM and OT can differ in routing while remaining close in cost. We examine its consequences in learned neural FM. Using the exact FM routing as an oracle, we further construct a routing-aware training coupling and find that it yields a directionally consistent improvement in generation over a cost-matched, cost-only counterpart. Our findings highlight what cost minimization can overlook and motivate using both cost and routing to evaluate the design of OT-based FM couplings. Code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [259] [The Arbitrary-Placement Problem in Entropy-Minimizing Selection, and a Residual-Entropy Formulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05925)
*Alyssa H. Shin,Claire H. Shin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对基于熵的选择目标（最小化 Shannon 熵 H(p_A)）的"退化解"问题，提出"残差熵"D = H(p_A) - H(p_β)，并给出理论刻画与多任务实证验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 最小化 Shannon 熵 H(p_A) 会奖励"自信的选择"，而不区分被选候选是否具有信息量——只要分布尖锐，H(p_A) 就会变小，因此存在"退化"：选择行为与选择是否有信息价值脱钩。作者希望为"选择"提供一个既可判安全、又能度量是否有信息量的准则。

Method: 引入由候选信任权重诱导的分布 p_β，定义残差熵 D = H(p_A) - H(p_β)。通过理论证明给出 D 的精确恒等式 D = -KL(p_A‖p_β) - Δ，其中 Δ 衡量"分数诱导分布"与"信任剖面"是否偏好同一候选。随后分析边界情形（均匀信任下 D≤0；任一 one-hot 极限下 D→0），并在中间选择区间证明：当按信任排序与按信息量排序逐对一致时 D≤0，且给出基于领先候选对竞争对手 margin 的更紧证书。结论不依赖具体打分函数，适用于静态与动态变化信息。

Result: 实验包括：(1) 基于梯度的 mixture-of-experts 路由器，验证排序条件在真实优化过程中可以成立，且当候选不可互换、选择被直接使用（而非平均）时，正确排序带来下游性能提升；(2) 类别不平衡任务中，margin 重加权匹配或优于固定强度基线；(3) 生产级视频预测系统中，信息性选择使 MSE 下降约 20%，并迁移到近缘物种。

Conclusion: 残差熵既可作为选择过程的安全判据，又可作为判断"该选择是否具有信息量"的可用信号，且与候选打分函数无关、对静态与动态信息均适用，在理论分析与多场景实证中均得到支持。

Abstract: Entropy-based selection objectives suffer from a fundamental degeneracy: minimizing Shannon entropy $H(p_A)$ rewards confident selection regardless of whether the selected candidate is informative. We address this limitation with the residual entropy $D = H(p_A) - H(p_β)$, where $p_β$ is induced by candidate trust weights. We prove the exact identity $D = -\mathrm{KL}(p_A\Vert p_β) - Δ$, where $Δ$ measures whether the score-induced distribution and trust profile favor the same candidates. Boundary cases establish basic safety: under uniform trust, $D\leq0$ automatically, so an equal-trust, non-starving state is never penalized, while at any one-hot limit, $D\to0$ regardless of the selected candidate. For the intermediate regime where selection occurs, we prove that $D\leq0$ when candidate ordering by trust agrees pairwise with ordering by informativeness, and derive a tighter certificate based on the leading candidate's margin over its competitors. These results are independent of the candidate-scoring function and apply to both stationary and dynamically changing information. Experiments with a gradient-based mixture-of-experts router confirm that the ordering conditions can hold during real optimization and show that correct ordering improves downstream performance when candidates are non-interchangeable and selections are used directly rather than averaged. Beyond routing, margin-based reweighting matches or outperforms fixed-strength baselines in a class-imbalance task, while informative selection in a production video-prediction system reduces MSE by approximately 20$\%$ and transfers to a related species. Residual entropy, therefore, provides a safety criterion for selection and a usable signal for deciding when that selection is informative.

</details>


### [260] [ThunderSyncRL: Lossless Acceleration of Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05935)
*Seil Kang,Hangoo Kang,Tarun Suresh,Youngeun Kim,Shreyas Pimpalgaonkar,Seong Jae Hwang,Azalia Mirhoseini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 ThunderSyncRL：在无策略陈旧的前提下，一旦所需输入确定即启动梯度计算，通过梯度流式化消除同步训练中的管线气泡，加速 GRPO 与 OPD 训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型从生成答案转向在交互环境中追求长时程目标，后训练此类智能体需要长且异构的轨迹。同步系统会让学习引擎在 rollout 与验证完成前空闲，产生管线气泡；异步训练虽可重叠 rollout 与学习，却引入策略陈旧问题。

Method: ThunderSyncRL 在所需输入全部确定后立即开始梯度计算，且不产生策略陈旧。针对 GRPO，某条轨迹的奖励到达即计算该轨迹的得分梯度，无需等待整组；针对 OPD，在沙箱中工具调用运行时，即对每个已完成智能体轮次的教师评分动作计算梯度。论文证明梯度流式化产生的 GRPO 与 OPD 更新与批同步训练一致，且不改变目标函数。

Result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 与 Terminal Bench 4.0 上，达到相同性能的训练速度最高比同步训练快 1.9 倍；在固定预算下，因零策略陈旧，性能最高优于异步训练 2.47 个百分点。

Conclusion: 通过梯度流式化实现无策略陈旧的加速后训练，在不改变 GRPO/OPD 目标与更新结果的前提下消除管线气泡，兼顾同步训练的稳定性与异步训练的吞吐优势。

Abstract: Language models are moving beyond generating answers to pursuing long-horizon goals in interactive environments. Post-training these agents requires long, heterogeneous trajectories, and synchronous systems leave learner engines idle until rollout and verification finish. To squeeze out these pipeline bubbles, asynchronous training overlaps rollout and learning across updates, but comes at the cost of policy staleness. We introduce ThunderSyncRL, which starts gradient computation as soon as all required inputs are fixed, without policy staleness.
