For group relative policy optimization (GRPO), ThunderSyncRL computes each trajectory's score gradient as soon as the reward for that trajectory arrives, without waiting for the group. For on-policy distillation (OPD), it computes gradients for each completed agentic turn's teacher-scored actions while tool calls run in the sandbox. We prove that gradient streaming produces the same GRPO and OPD updates as batch-synchronous training, without changing either objective. On SWE-bench Verified and Terminal Bench 4.0, we train models to the same performance up to $1.9 \times$ faster than synchronous training. With zero policy staleness, ThunderSyncRL also outperforms asynchronous training at a fixed budget by up to $2.47$ percentage points.

</details>


### [261] [Discovered, Not Designed: Population Evolution for Collaborative and Compute-Intensive Model Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05950)
*Bo Peng,Lizhu Zhang,Yuhang Zhou,Mingyi Wang,Yifan Wu,Serena Li,Xiangjun Fan,Zhuokai Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Population Evolution (PE)分层协作框架，通过共享实验证据连接局部搜索，并构建RMD-Bench评估跨任务迁移与昂贵训练场景下的模型进化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM驱动的进化虽支持迭代式模型开发，但两个实际问题尚未充分探索：一是如何找到可跨相关任务迁移的模型设计，二是当训练成本高昂时如何维持持续改进。

Method: PE通过共享实验证据连接进行中的局部搜索，在相关训练实例上评估代码改动并共享结果以指导后续提案及向更大训练规模的提升；针对高成本目标，PE搜索小型训练子集，并通过同行与中间评估筛选候选方案后再进行全目标训练。同时提出RMD-Bench，涵盖排序、观看时长预测、RL算法发现及LLM/VLM预训练。

Result: 在匹配源迭代数下，PE将排序任务平均最佳局部增益从7.01%提升至8.97%，观看时长任务从2.84%提升至3.85%，并在三个联合发现系列中均改善最佳大规模结果；观看时长发现中，5种框架中的4种与全部4种提议器均获提升。共享目标侧校准的新推荐数据集上，所有PE设计均优于参考。匹配总GPU算力时，LLM发现任务最佳相对精度增益为2.48%、13个成功候选，而直接进化为0.92%、无成功候选；VLM损失下降达8.78%对5.05%。

Conclusion: PE通过分层协作与跨实例证据共享，有效提升了跨任务迁移能力与昂贵训练场景下的进化效率，在多项任务与算力匹配条件下显著优于独立进化方法。

Abstract: LLM-driven evolution enables iterative model development, but two practical goals remain underexplored: finding model designs that transfer across related tasks and sustaining improvement when training is expensive. We introduce Population Evolution (PE), a collaborative, hierarchical framework that connects ongoing local searches through shared experimental evidence. PE evaluates code changes across related training instances and shares the results to guide subsequent proposals and promotion to larger training scales. For expensive targets, PE searches small training subsets and screens candidates through peer and intermediate evaluations before full-target training. We introduce RMD-Bench to evaluate both settings across ranking, watch-time prediction, RL algorithm discovery, and LLM/VLM pretraining. Compared with standalone evolution at matched source iterations, PE raises mean best local gains from 7.01% to 8.97% in ranking and from 2.84% to 3.85% in watch-time, while improving the best larger-scale outcome in all three joint-discovery families. In watch-time discovery, PE improves best larger-scale gains with four of five harnesses and all four proposers. On new recommendation datasets under shared target-side calibration, every evaluated PE design improves over the reference in mean performance. Under matched total GPU compute, completed LLM discovery runs yield a best relative accuracy gain of 2.48% and 13 successful candidates for PE, versus 0.92% and none for direct evolution. VLM loss reduction reaches 8.78% versus 5.05% under matched total GPU compute.

</details>


### [262] [MEND: RL For Flow Models via Proximal Velocity Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05954)
*Shreshth Saini,Neil Birkbeck,Yilin Wang,Balu Adsumilli,Alan C. Bovik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MEND是一种基于近端速度匹配的流模型强化学习后训练方法，通过奖励上限与二次位移代价筛选更新，无需KL项、冻结参考模型或优势权重，100步即可超越约4k步的Flow-GRPO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流模型奖励后训练方法存在两类低效：一类在KL惩罚或冻结参考模型下对自身样本重加权，常需数千次更新；另一类直接反传奖励并移动所有样本，却不检验该移动是否值得其步长。因此需要一种更高效、且对更新幅度有代价约束的方法。

Method: 提出MEND，基于近端速度匹配（proximal velocity matching）。在每个prompt组内对奖励设上限，已高分的样本不再移动；在上限之下，沿奖励梯度提出移动方案，仅当受限奖励增益超过二次位移代价时才接受该移动；随后模型回归到由此得到的速度目标。方法不含KL项、冻结参考模型与优势权重。

Result: 在100次更新下，MEND在与基座模型图像距离相同时，于六个评测器中的五个上超过约4k次更新的Flow-GRPO；在等预算协议下，于四种训练奖励的每个评测更新点均超越ReFL与DiffusionNFT，PickScore达24.03（对比23.92与23.43）；300次更新、三奖励的训练亦在其训练的三个奖励上全面超过五奖励的DiffusionNFT模型。

Conclusion: MEND是一种通用且易采用的方法：适用于任何具备可微奖励的流骨干网络，在显著更少的更新次数下取得更优性能。

Abstract: Reward post-training of flow models either reweights the model's own samples under a KL penalty or a frozen reference, often for thousands of updates, or backpropagates the reward and moves every sample without checking that the move is worth its size. We introduce MEND, a reinforcement learning method built on proximal velocity matching. MEND caps rewards within each prompt group, so samples that already score well receive no move. Below the cap, it proposes moves along the reward gradient and accepts one only when its capped reward gain exceeds a quadratic displacement price. The model then regresses onto the resulting velocity targets, with no KL term, frozen reference model, or advantage weights. In 100 updates, MEND outperforms Flow-GRPO (about 4k updates) on five of six evaluators at the same distance to base-model images. Under an equal-budget protocol, it surpasses ReFL and DiffusionNFT at every evaluated update across four training rewards, reaching PickScore 24.03 versus 23.92 and 23.43, respectively. A 300-update three-reward run also surpasses the five-reward DiffusionNFT model on all three rewards it trains on. MEND is general and easy to adopt: it applies to any flow backbone with a differentiable reward.

</details>


### [263] [Physics-Informed but Not Physics-Consistent: Error Geometry and Subspace Projection for Neural AC Power Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05959)
*Changhun Kim,Timon Conrad,Redwanul Karim,Karan Pahlajani,Julian Oelhaf,David Riebesel,Tomás Arias-Vergara,Andreas Maier,Johann Jäger,Siming Bayer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 神经潮流求解器虽电压预测准确，但未必物理一致；误差存在大量偏离主导解子空间的分量，对此提出的标定解子空间投影（CSP）在四类模型上显著降低功率不平衡残差并改善电压幅值精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经潮流求解器（含新兴基础模型）在电压预测上精度较高，但高精度并不等价于物理一致的解。即便复电压存在微小误差，也会导致较大的交流功率平衡残差，即存在"精度—一致性差距"。作者希望刻画并缩小这一差距，明确输出误差几何结构对物理一致性的影响。

Method: 在真实2224节点英国电网（GBnetwork）场景上，对PIGNN-GC、GridSFM、gridfm-graphkit、LUMINA四个模型开展研究，并对GridSFM在31个系统上进行跨电网评估。利用在训练集交流潮流解上拟合的SVD基底，分析神经预测误差中偏离主导解子空间的分量；在此基础上提出标定解子空间投影（CSP）：先仅用训练数据做偏差标定，再投影抑制子空间外的预测分量。

Result: 误差分析表明，神经预测误差包含大量位于主导解子空间之外的分量。相对于标定后的预测，CSP使PIGNN-GC、GridSFM、gridfm-graphkit、LUMINA的平均功率不平衡（Mean PB）分别下降67.0%、37.8%、40.5%、68.9%，同时四个模型的电压幅值精度均得到提升。

Conclusion: 输出误差的几何结构是影响神经交流潮流物理一致性的重要因素；基于SVD解子空间的后处理投影可在不牺牲（甚至改善）电压精度的情况下显著提升物理一致性，为物理一致的神经AC潮流求解提供了新视角与简单有效的方案。

Abstract: Recent neural power-flow solvers, including emerging foundation models, achieve accurate voltage predictions, yet such accuracy does not necessarily imply physically consistent solutions. Even small complex voltage errors can yield large AC power-balance residuals. We study this accuracy-consistency gap across PIGNN-GC, GridSFM, gridfm-graphkit, and LUMINA on realistic 2224-bus Great Britain network (GBnetwork) scenarios, with cross-grid evaluation of GridSFM over 31 systems. Using a singular value decomposition (SVD) basis fitted to training AC power-flow solutions, we find that neural prediction errors contain substantial components outside the dominant solution subspace. To address this mismatch, calibrated solution-subspace projection (CSP) suppresses off-subspace prediction components after train-only bias calibration, reducing Mean PB by 67.0%, 37.8%, 40.5%, and 68.9% for PIGNN-GC, GridSFM, gridfm-graphkit, and LUMINA, respectively, relative to calibrated predictions, while improving voltage-magnitude accuracy in all four models. These results identify output-error geometry as an important factor in physics-consistent neural AC power flow. Code: https://github.com/Kimchangheon/neural-acpf-error-geometry

</details>


### [264] [Strategic Multi-Agent Learning for Interpretable Action Valuation of All Players in Football](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05961)
*Kenjiro Ide,Taiga Someya,Kohei Kawaguchi,Keisuke Fujii*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出受马尔可夫完美均衡（MPE）启发的足球球员动作价值评估框架，将每次控球建模为有限时程动态博弈，每位球员为自主智能体，并用EDMS与Q值分解提升可解释性。基于95场J1联赛数据，与独立RL基线对比显示该框架产生更具情境敏感性的动作排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 足球动作估值需考虑22名球员间的策略互动（含无球跑动与防守站位）。现有强化学习方法多在球队层面聚合决策或独立估计球员价值，导致球员间的策略相互依赖表征不足。

Method: 将每次控球建模为有限时程动态博弈，球员作为策略依赖当前状态的自主智能体；以MPE作为启发式求解概念而非精确均衡。采用可扩展决策状态（EDMS）并分解Q值为后继特征基与线性奖励权重向量，价值基先经线性TD初始化再非线性精化。

Result: 用95场J1联赛跟踪与事件数据，与独立RL基线比较。因两种形式的TD误差目标空间不同，TD MSE仅用于同形式内一致性检验。固定EDMS下，基线在99.21%的无球状态中给前向移动最高价值，而所提方法最常见方向仅占17.63%。球队层面平均Q值与赛季期望进球的关联在基线上为负、所提方法上为弱正。定性分析展示了无球跑动与防守站位的情境依赖估值。

Conclusion: 所提表述产生更具情境敏感性的动作排序，但该对比未分离出MPE启发的成分。未来需进一步界定各组件贡献。

Abstract: Valuing player actions in football requires accounting for strategic interactions among 22 players, including off-ball movements and defensive positioning. Existing reinforcement-learning-based methods commonly aggregate decisions at the team level or estimate player values independently, leaving strategic interdependence among players insufficiently represented. This study proposes an action valuation framework inspired by Markov perfect equilibrium (MPE) for all players. Each possession is modeled as a finite-horizon dynamic game, with each player represented as an autonomous agent whose policy depends on the current game state. MPE is used as a motivating solution concept rather than an exact equilibrium. To improve interpretability, we use Expandable Decision-Making States (EDMS) and decompose the Q-value into a successor-feature basis and a linear reward-weight vector. The value basis is estimated by linear TD initialization followed by nonlinear refinement. Using tracking and event data from 95 J1 League matches, we compare the proposed formulation with an independent reinforcement learning baseline. Because the two formulations define TD errors in different target spaces, TD MSE is used only for within-formulation consistency. With EDMS fixed, the independent baseline assigns the highest value to forward movement in 99.21% of evaluated off-ball states, whereas the most frequent direction under the proposed formulation accounts for 17.63%. Team-level average Q-values show a negative association with season-level expected goals for the baseline and a weakly positive association for the proposed formulation. Qualitative analyses illustrate context-dependent valuations of off-ball movements and defensive positioning. Overall, the proposed formulation produces more context-sensitive action rankings, although the comparison does not isolate the MPE-inspired component.

</details>


### [265] [Fast Last-Iterate Convergence in Zero-Sum Markov Games with Bandit Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05968)
*Yuheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究带bandit反馈的未知双人零和折扣Markov博弈中的last-iterate收敛问题，提出ARTD算法，在均匀击中时间假设下实现当前策略对偶间隙的Õ(t^{-1/4})高概率收敛率，显著优于已有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在未知双人零和折扣Markov博弈中，玩家仅通过单条轨迹独立学习、无法观测对方动作（bandit反馈），现有方法（如Cai等2023）的last-iterate收敛率仅为Õ(t^{-1/(9+ν)})，收敛缓慢，亟需更快的当前策略收敛保证。

Method: 提出自适应正则化TD学习（ARTD）：将快速时序差分平均与有界值更新分离以稳定策略学习；随值估计进展自适应调整log-barrier正则化，控制策略误差与值误差；算法无需知晓击中时间界、时间视界或置信水平。

Result: 在均匀击中时间假设下，ARTD对当前策略实现Õ(t^{-1/4})的对偶间隙界，且对所有轮次和起始状态同时以高概率成立，改进了Cai等（2023）在相同反馈模型与假设下的Õ(t^{-1/(9+ν)})速率（任意固定ν>0）。

Conclusion: 通过分离TD平均与值更新、以及自适应log-barrier正则化，ARTD在玩家独立从bandit反馈学习的条件下，实现了实际所玩策略的快速last-iterate收敛，且无需预知问题相关参数。

Abstract: We study last-iterate convergence in unknown two-player zero-sum discounted Markov games with bandit feedback. The players learn independently along a single trajectory without observing each other's actions. We develop Adaptive Regularized TD Learning (ARTD), which achieves a $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(t^{-1/4})$ duality gap bound for the current policies under a uniform hitting time assumption, with high probability simultaneously over all rounds and starting states. This improves the $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(t^{-1/(9+ν)})$ rate of Cai et al. (2023), for any fixed $ν>0$, under the same feedback model and hitting time assumption. Our algorithm requires no knowledge of the hitting time bound, the time horizon, or the confidence level. To stabilize policy learning as value estimates change, we separate fast temporal difference averaging from bounded value updates. We adapt log-barrier regularization to the progress of value estimation, controlling both policy and value errors throughout learning. Together, these mechanisms enable fast convergence of the policies actually played, even when the players learn independently from bandit feedback.

</details>


### [266] [Reachability-Aware Diffusion Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05969)
*Hikmet Simsir,Kutay Demiray,Ozgur S. Oguz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RADPO——一种无模型的安全感知扩散策略优化方法，将预测性首次命中可达性估计与累积成本预算反馈相结合，在十个连续控制安全任务上实现了更优的奖励-成本权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散策略能为连续控制强化学习提供表达力强的动作分布，但安全感知的在线扩散策略优化研究不足，尤其是无需显式动力学模型、仅利用预测性可达性信息的方法尚属空白。

Method: RADPO学习折扣首次命中可达性价值，刻画成本事件的折扣风险并对较早发生的事件赋予更大权重，据此塑造奖励；另设类似对偶变量的乘子，按实际回合成本相对预算的偏差调整塑形强度；扩散Actor通过在奖励critic评分的候选动作上做加权去噪回归来改进。方法无需学习动力学模型、无需动作对critic求梯度、也无需对反向扩散采样器求导。

Result: 理论上给出了可达性价值的性质，并证明累积可达性惩罚是未来折扣累积成本的保守代理。实验上在十个连续控制安全任务中，RADPO取得了有竞争力的奖励-成本权衡，在若干任务上相对基线大幅降低了约束违反。

Conclusion: 理论与实证分析表明，将可达性与累积预算反馈相结合，是构建安全感知扩散策略的可行途径。

Abstract: Diffusion policies provide expressive action distributions for continuous-control reinforcement learning. However, safety-aware online diffusion policy optimization remains underexplored, particularly methods that use predictive reachability information without an explicit dynamics model. We propose Reachability-Aware Diffusion Policy Optimization (RADPO), a model-free method that combines predictive first-hit safety estimation with cumulative-cost budget feedback. RADPO learns a discounted first-hit reachability value that captures the discounted risk of a cost event, assigns larger weight to events that occur sooner, and uses this signal to shape the reward. A separate dual-like multiplier adjusts the shaping strength according to realized episodic costs relative to a prescribed budget. The diffusion actor improves through weighted denoising regression on candidate actions scored by the reward critic. Our approach requires neither a learned dynamics model, action gradients through the critics, nor differentiation through the reverse diffusion sampler. We establish theoretical properties of the reachability value and show that accumulated reachability penalty provides a conservative surrogate for future discounted cumulative cost. Across ten continuous-control safety tasks, RADPO achieves competitive reward-cost trade-offs, with substantial reductions in constraint violations on several tasks relative to the compared baselines. Our theoretical and empirical analysis supports that combining reachability with cumulative budget feedback is a viable approach to safety-aware diffusion policies.

</details>


### [267] [Transfer-Stratified On-Policy Distillation for RL-Improved Reasoning Teachers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05974)
*Xiaoyu Chen,Bo Shao,Tiangang Zhu,Bintao Wu,Linjun Shou,Fengge Wu,Feng Sun,Wenbiao Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究强化学习提升后的教师模型在指导更小规模学生模型时，哪些改进能够真正迁移，并提出一种按迁移性分层筛选与路由的在线策略蒸馏方法（TS-OPD），在数学推理任务上取得最优的平均正确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL（如GRPO）能显著提升推理教师的性能，但教师端收益未必能等量迁移到更小的在线策略学生，现有工作多以单一标量指标衡量教师强度，忽视了迁移的结构性差异。

Method: 在数学推理场景中系统比较GRPO前后的教师谱系、多种学生规模、直接GRPO以及多种在线策略蒸馏目标；在此基础上提出TS-OPD：依据学生与教师联合采样成功率对训练问题进行筛选与分类，将"获取型"问题路由至带门控的前向KL，将"巩固型"问题路由至带门控的反向KL，并引入熵刹车以保护采样覆盖度。

Result: 在使用GRPO改进教师的主要对比中，TS-OPD在宏平均正确率上是最强的学生目标函数，但pass@K表现较为混杂；消融实验表明收益主要来自问题路由与token门控，而非跳过困难问题。

Conclusion: OPD应被视为一种迁移感知的过程：更强的教师只有在监督方向与token预算匹配学生当前可观测能力时才有效，而非仅因教师端点更强就必然带来学生提升。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning can substantially improve a reasoning teacher, but it is unclear which of those improvements survive when the teacher supervises a smaller on-policy student. We study this question in mathematical reasoning by comparing teacher lineages before and after GRPO, multiple student scales, direct GRPO, and several on-policy distillation objectives. The central finding is that transfer is structured rather than scalar: teacher strength alone does not make dense distillation competitive, while an RL-improved teacher creates useful but metric-dependent student gains. This motivates Transfer-Stratified On-Policy Distillation (TS-OPD), which screens training problems by the joint sampled success of the student and teacher, routes acquisition problems to gated forward KL, routes consolidation problems to gated reverse KL, and adds an entropy brake to protect sampled coverage. Across the main comparison, TS-OPD is the strongest student objective for macro average correctness with the GRPO-improved teacher, while pass@K remains more mixed. Ablations show that the gains come from routing and token gating rather than skipping problems. These results support a transfer-aware view of OPD: stronger teachers help when the supervision direction and token budget match the student's observed ability, not merely because the teacher endpoint is stronger.

</details>


### [268] [StagQ: Constraint-Driven Multi-Precision Weight Quantization for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05977)
*Zhe Wei,Mengqi Guo,Yuan Yuan,Jiunn Bin Lim,Boyi Pan,Michael Bi Mi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: StagQ是一种多精度权重量化格式：以2比特分组仿射基为主流，后接可配置数量的1比特细化平面（二进步长），每个支持精度均为可读前缀，由共享元数据推导的仿射映射解码，无需逐权查找表，并用稀疏边记录保存网格拟合最差的少数权重。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨多部署集群服务LLM需要多种权重量化精度点。传统做法存储多份不同精度的权重副本，存储开销大；而单一流式多精度格式可让前缀即为合法的低精度编码，从而用一份存储服务所有精度。本文旨在设计这样的多精度权重格式并提升其精度与解码/推理效率。

Method: 主流为2比特分组仿射基，后接可配置数量的1比特细化平面，采用二进（dyadic）步长调度；每个支持精度对应一个可读前缀，通过所有精度共享元数据推导的仿射映射解码，无需per-weight查找。稀疏边记录（sparse side record）在网格拟合前后填充，用于保存网格服务最差的少数权重。编码器提供两种配置。

Result: 2比特下较便宜的配置在Llama-3.1-8B、Phi-4、OLMo-2-7B上比最强多精度基线高3.1–7.0 MMLU点，且逻辑比特率略低；3比特下在Llama-3.1-8B领先、Phi-4以更高比特率领先、OLMo-2-7B持平；4比特下三者均持平但比特率更高。在NVIDIA A100 GPU上batch-one矩阵-向量乘积（合成权重）测试中，kernel在多数形状-精度组合下快于两个基线kernel。

Conclusion: StagQ以单流前缀式多精度设计实现了精度与效率的兼顾：低精度下显著优于多精度基线，高精度下与基线持平，并在A100上多数情形下具备更快的解码kernel，验证了前缀可读多精度格式的可行性。

Abstract: Serving a large language model (LLM) across a fleet of deployments requires several weight-precision operating points. Multi-precision formats serve them all from one stream whose prefixes are valid lower-precision codes, instead of storing multiple copies. We present StagQ, a multi-precision weight format whose main stream is a 2-bit group-wise affine base followed by a configurable number of 1-bit refinement planes on a dyadic step schedule. Every supported precision is a readable prefix, decoded by an affine map derived from metadata shared across all precisions, with no per-weight lookup. A sparse side record, filled both before and after the grid is fitted, holds out the few weights the grid serves worst. We report two configurations of the encoder. At two bits the cheaper one leads the strongest multi-precision baseline on Llama-3.1-8B, Phi-4, and OLMo-2-7B by 3.1 to 7.0 MMLU points, at a slightly lower logical rate. At three bits it leads on Llama-3.1-8B, leads on Phi-4 at a higher rate, and ties on OLMo-2-7B. At four bits it ties on all three, at a higher rate. In a batch-one matrix-vector product on an NVIDIA A100 GPU, timed on synthetic weights, our kernel is faster than the two baseline kernels in most shape-precision cases.

</details>


### [269] [EpicWorldModel: Exploration-driven Planning with Latent World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05996)
*Bowen Feng,Julian Ost,May Mei,Anirudha Majumdar,Felix Heide*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 EpicWorldModel 框架，用流匹配目标训练随机 JEPA 隐世界模型，在部分可观测场景下预测多个可能未来状态，并以流预测方差作为探索信号指导 CEM 规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于 JEPA 的隐世界模型本质上是确定性的，在完全可观测场景下表现良好；但当历史观测与动作对应多个合理未来（如遮挡导致）时，该范式失效。因此需要在部分可观测且存在内在不确定性的环境下构建随机隐世界模型。

Method: 提出 EpicWorldModel：将预测器与隐表示空间联合训练，在条件历史中缺失目标相关场景内容时，采用流匹配（flow-matching）目标直接预测多个潜在未来状态；并利用流预测方差作为预测熵上界的代理，将其作为探索引导信号嵌入基于交叉熵方法（CEM）的规划中，以在达成目标与探索可能藏有被遮挡目标的区域之间取得平衡。

Result: 在一系列隐空间规划实验中取得最佳或持平的表现，相比 LeWorldModel，成功率最高提升约 22%。

Conclusion: 以流匹配训练的随机 JEPA 能有效建模部分可观测环境中的多模态未来，流预测方差可作为实用的探索信号；结合 CEM 规划可在不确定性区域中兼顾目标达成与探索，验证了该框架的有效性。

Abstract: Latent world models based on Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) are deterministic by design. While successful in fully observable scenarios, this paradigm breaks down when past observations and actions lead to multiple plausible future possibilities, e.g., due to occlusion. We introduce EpicWorldModel, a framework to train stochastic JEPAs for environments and tasks with inherent uncertainty under partially observability. We jointly train the EpicWorldModel predictor with its latent representation space to directly predict multiple potential future states using a flow-matching objective, when the goal-relevant scene content is absent from the conditioning history. We show that flow predictive variance, motivated by its relation to an upper bound on predictive entropy, serves as a useful exploration guidance for planning. By incorporating this uncertainty signal into Cross-Entropy Method (CEM)-based planning, our approach balances goal-reaching with exploration of uncertain regions where occluded goals are most likely to be located. We demonstrate the effectiveness of EpicWorldModel through a series of latent planning experiments with the best or on-par performance across tasks, showing up to 22% empirical improvement in success rate over LeWorldModel.

</details>


### [270] [Langevin Flow Maps: Efficient Molecular Dynamics and Transition Path Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05998)
*Sam McCallum,Niklas Rindtorff,Alexander Tong,James Foster*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Molecular dynamics simulations proceed by integrating the Langevin equations over many small femtosecond timesteps. This poses a challenge for estimating ensemble properties and transition dynamics that occur on much longer timescales. We introduce Langevin Flow Maps, which extend machine-learned force-fields to additionally learn the stochastic Langevin integrator. We show that Langevin Flow Maps enable large-timestep molecular dynamics and recover accurate dynamical properties of the system, while running an order of magnitude faster than current machine-learned force fields. Further, by training on a diverse molecular dataset, we demonstrate a path towards transferable Langevin Flow Maps.

</details>


### [271] [Learning While Scheduling Jobs under Context-Dependent Service Rates: An Anytime Rate-Optimal Algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06006)
*Seoungbin Bae,Dabeen Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究上下文排队赌博（CQB）问题，提出WISE算法，在未知时域、无协方差下界、仅假设容量松弛的条件下，实现了时间t处速率最优的$\widetilde{\mathcal O}(t^{-1/2})$队列长度遗憾，并给出改进与新颖的下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CQB工作的衰减遗憾保证要么衰减速率次优，要么需要已知固定时域（horizon）；此外它们通常需要逐上下文的slack假设以及特征协方差最小特征值严格正的下界，这些都过于苛刻。论文旨在放宽这些假设并达到速率最优的遗憾。

Method: 提出WISE（Widest Interval Selection with Elimination）算法。分析使用workload potential，衡量等待作业在其最优服务器上所需的期望服务尝试数；其在非空轮次上的漂移包含由容量松弛保证的负项与次优服务选择带来的误差。进而用椭圆势能计数（elliptical potential count）限制WISE选择宽置信区间的频率，从而限制服务误差较大的轮数。假设仅需容量松弛（最优服务器服务下的期望到达负载低于服务容量），不要求协方差下界。

Result: WISE在每足够大的时刻t上无需知道horizon即达到速率最优的$\widetilde{\mathcal O}(t^{-1/2})$队列长度遗憾，且不需要协方差下界。论文同时改进了已有下界的到达率依赖，并显式给出其对特征维度与服务器数量的依赖；还证明了另一个下界，量化归一化容量松弛减小时遗憾的增加，据作者所知这是CQB的首个此类下界。仿真显示即使逐上下文slack失效时遗憾仍较小。

Conclusion: WISE在更弱假设（容量松弛、无需已知horizon、无协方差下界）下实现了速率最优的队列长度遗憾，并提供了更精细及新类型的下界，拓展了CQB的理论理解。

Abstract: We study contextual queueing bandits, where a learner schedules jobs while learning unknown service rates modeled by logistic functions of job-server features. Performance is measured by queue length regret, the expected excess queue length at round $t$ relative to an oracle that knows the service rates. Existing decaying-regret guarantees either have a suboptimal decay rate or require a known fixed horizon. They also assume context-wise slack and a strictly positive minimum eigenvalue of the feature covariance. In this paper, we propose WISE (Widest Interval Selection with Elimination), achieving rate-optimal $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(t^{-1/2})$ queue length regret at every sufficiently large time without knowing the horizon. We assume capacity slack, meaning that expected incoming workload under best-server service is below service capacity, and impose no covariance lower bound. Our analysis uses a workload potential measuring the expected service attempts needed by waiting jobs on their best servers. Its drift on nonempty rounds combines a negative term ensured by capacity slack with errors from suboptimal service choices. Then an elliptical potential count bounds how often WISE selects wide confidence intervals, thereby limiting the number of rounds with large service errors. We also sharpen the arrival-rate dependence of an existing lower bound and make its dependence on feature dimension and server count explicit. We prove another lower bound that quantifies the increase in regret as the normalized capacity slack decreases; to our knowledge, this is the first such lower bound for CQB. Simulations show small regret even when context-wise slack fails.

</details>


### [272] [Ultrasound Operator Guidance Using World Modeling and Retrieval Based Action Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06008)
*Noortje I. P. Schueler,Hans van Gorp,Ruud J. G. van Sloun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种“检索诱导的潜在转移模型”，将超声探头引导建模为世界模型中的多步规划与检索问题，无需硬件追踪，仅凭实时超声图像即可引导用户到达目标切面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超声检查质量高度依赖操作者的专业水平，而检查需求增长快于合格超声技师的供给，因此需要操作引导系统帮助经验不足的用户把探头移动到目标切面。既有方法在建模取得动态上存在困难。

Method: 使用V-JEPA 2.1作为主干，将观测编码到解剖相关切面彼此邻近的潜在空间；从包含编码潜在状态及对应探头位置与姿态的参考数据库中检索相似切面；不学习参数化转移函数，而是直接用数据库中物理执行的转移构建非参数、检索诱导的转移模型，支持滚动时域规划。部署时仅依赖实时超声图像流，无需探头追踪硬件；实时场景中通过蒸馏在CPU上运行。

Result: 在颈动脉超声上，所提规划器在回顾性闭环实验中86%的回合到达目标切面，两个代表性基线分别为52%和43%，且在每个目标切面上均优于二者，包括较难的颈内、颈外动脉纵切面。针对未见志愿者的前瞻性可行性研究在CPU实时运行下达到83%的目标切面可达率。

Conclusion: 由于规划由与任意可编码目标潜在的邻近度驱动，同一世界模型可导航回任何此前采集的、患者特定的帧，从而支持例如围术期或随访监测中可重复的纵向成像。

Abstract: Ultrasound is widely used, but acquisition quality is heavily dependent on the operator's knowledge and expertise. With demand for examinations outpacing the supply of trained sonographers, operator-guidance systems aim to close this gap by instructing a less trained user how to move the probe toward a target view. In this paper, we propose a retrieval-induced latent transition model for ultrasound acquisition dynamics, formulating ultrasound operator guidance as multi-step planning and retrieval in a world model. Using a V-JEPA 2.1 backbone, observations are first encoded into a latent space where anatomically related views lie close together. We then retrieve similar views from a reference database containing encoded latent states and corresponding probe positions and orientations. Rather than learning a parametric transition function, we directly use physically executed transitions from the database to establish our nonparametric, retrieval-induced transition model that supports receding-horizon planning. At deployment, guidance is generated from the live ultrasound image feed alone, without any probe tracking hardware. Applied to carotid ultrasound, the proposed planner reaches the target view in 86% of retrospective closed-loop episodes, versus 52% and 43% for representative baselines, outperforming both on every target view, including the challenging longitudinal internal and external carotid artery views. A prospective feasibility study on unseen volunteers, run in real time on a CPU using distillation, reaches 83% target-view reachability. Because planning is driven by proximity to any encodable goal latent, the same world model can navigate back to any previously acquired, patient-specific frame, supporting reproducible longitudinal imaging for e.g. perioperative or follow-up monitoring.

</details>


### [273] [Spectral Geometry of Attention: From Information Routing to Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06012)
*Giulio Viganò,Simone Melzi,Maks Ovsjanikov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该工作从谱几何与算子理论视角研究Transformer注意力，将每个注意力头视为token序列上函数Hilbert空间之间的泛函映射，并推导出Token Difference Operator，用其谱结构刻画token空间信息的路由方式。作者指出欧氏谱受"沉没"效应结构性偏置，将质量集中与真实路由能力混淆；改用在注意力诱导的内在概率几何中重新表述token空间后，token差分谱能解耦沉没效应与路由能力，并给出头输出维度的谱描述，从而统一解释注意力图、沉没、路由塌缩与输出维度。基于此还提出一种注意力不确定性估计器，在长上下文输入上增益最大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有对注意力机制的分析多为启发式，缺乏统一的算子层面理论刻画；传统的欧氏谱分析会把注意力质量集中（sink）与真实的信息路由能力混为一谈，从而产生结构性偏置，难以准确度量注意力头的路由能力与输出维度。

Method: 将每个注意力头建模为token序列上函数Hilbert空间之间的泛函映射，推导Token Difference Operator；利用注意力诱导的内在概率几何重构token空间，使token差分谱解耦sink效应与路由能力，并据此刻画头输出的有效维度；进而把注意力启发式建立在谱几何之上，设计注意力不确定性估计器。

Result: 提出统一的算子理论框架，可在同一框架内解释注意力图、sink现象、路由塌缩与输出维度；所提出的注意力不确定性估计器可与基于概率的分数互补，在长上下文输入上取得最大提升。

Conclusion: 以谱几何和算子理论重新刻画注意力，能够克服欧氏谱的sink偏置，提供对路由能力与输出维度的更本质描述，并为实践中的不确定性估计提供更有效的工具。

Abstract: In this work, we study transformer attention through the lens of spectral geometry and operator theory. We view each attention head as a functional map between Hilbert spaces of functions on the token sequence and derive a Token Difference Operator, whose spectral structure controls how token-space information is routed to the output. We show that standard Euclidean spectra are structurally biased by sinks, conflating mass concentration with genuine routing capacity. By recasting token space in the intrinsic probability geometry induced by attention, the token difference spectrum disentangles sink effects from routing capacity and provides a spectral description of the dimensionality of the head output. This yields a unified framework for analyzing attention maps, explaining sinks, routing collapse, and output dimensionality within a single operator-theoretic framework. In practice, by grounding attention heuristics in spectral geometry, we develop a novel attention-based uncertainty estimator that complements probability-based scores, with the largest gains on long-context inputs.

</details>


### [274] [Adaptive Expert Guidance for Efficient On-Policy Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06019)
*Daniele Affinita,Ming Xu,Rudolf Reiter,Davide Scaramuzza,Pascal Fua*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种让学习器与次优专家在每轮训练中交替控制的方法，将专家的控制占比作为单一可学习参数，与策略用同一on-policy目标联合优化。专家占比随学习器变强而衰减直至消失，从而兼顾早期引导与最终超越专家，在34个任务上提升了样本效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: On-policy强化学习（如PPO）在大规模并行仿真下已成主流，但从零学习样本效率低，且未利用可能存在的次优专家（启发式、基于模型的控制器或相关任务上训练的策略）。专家可用于引导早期训练，但其次优性会限制最终性能。核心挑战在于平衡专家引导与奖励学习。现有方法通过混合权重、调度或评估驱动的课程来设定专家影响，或用额外学习组件（专家动作上的critic、辅助智能体）自适应调整，但均未用与策略本身相同的on-policy目标来优化该影响。

Method: 让学习器与专家在每个训练回合内交替控制，将专家的控制占比设为单一可学习参数，与策略用同一on-policy目标联合优化。训练早期学习器受益于专家，随着学习器能力增强其控制占比下降，最终完全消失，使学习器独立行动并超越次优专家。

Result: 在两个基准、34个任务上评估，涵盖离散与连续动作空间，使用学习型与基于模型的专家。相比有引导和无引导基线提升了样本效率，且超参数变化需求极小。专家控制占比随学习器提升衰减至零，在专家不再有用时消失。

Conclusion: 专家控制占比作为可学习参数与策略联合优化，能自动实现引导到独立学习的过渡，兼顾样本效率与最终性能，方法通用且超参数鲁棒。

Abstract: With massively parallel simulation, on-policy Reinforcement Learning methods such as PPO have become standard in many domains. However, learning from scratch is sample-inefficient and fails to exploit the potential existence of a suboptimal expert, such as a heuristic, a model-based controller, or a policy trained on a related task. Such an expert is often available and can guide early training, but its sub-optimality limits final performance. The challenge then becomes balancing expert guidance against learning from rewards. Existing methods set the expert's influence through a blending weight, a schedule, or an evaluation-driven curriculum. Alternatively, they adapt it with additional learned components such as critics over expert actions or auxiliary agents. However, none optimizes it using the same on-policy objective as the policy itself. We propose a method in which the learner and the expert alternate control within each training episode, and the expert's share of control is a single learnable parameter optimized jointly with the policy. The learner benefits from the expert early in training, but its share of control declines as the learner becomes more competent, until eventually vanishing completely. This leaves the learner acting alone and better than the suboptimal expert. We evaluate our method on 34 tasks across two benchmarks, spanning discrete and continuous action spaces, using both learned and model-based experts. Our method improves sample efficiency over guided and unguided baselines while requiring minimal hyperparameter variation. The expert's share decays to zero as the learner improves, vanishing when the expert is no longer useful.

</details>


### [275] [Joint Precision Neural Networks: Task-Aware Dependency and Predictive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06023)
*Andrea Cavallo,Samuel Rey,Antonio G. Marques,Elvin Isufi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Precision Neural Networks (PNNs) 与 PNN-Joint 框架，联合估计稀疏精度矩阵与图神经网络权重，实现任务感知图推断，在低数据场景下鲁棒且性能领先。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 信号处理与机器学习中，从数据中挖掘有意义的潜在结构是关键挑战。PCA 与协方差神经网络 (VNN) 基于协方差矩阵，无法区分直接与间接相关性；精度矩阵（逆协方差）虽能编码条件独立性，但其有限样本估计不稳定，且现有正则化估计器（如 graphical lasso）与下游任务无关。因此需要解决任务感知的图推断问题。

Method: 提出 PNN-Joint 框架，通过交替优化方案联合估计稀疏、具统计基础的精度矩阵与图神经网络权重。作为支撑，引入 Precision Neural Networks (PNNs)——一类在精度估计器上运行的图卷积网络，并建立其与 PCA、VNN 的谱联系及其对有限样本误差的稳定性分析。

Result: 在合成数据、真实神经影像与运动传感器数据集上的大量实验表明：PNN-Joint 能生成高度可解释的任务感知图，在低数据场景下表现出显著鲁棒性，并在真实任务上持续取得最优或次优性能。

Conclusion: 精度矩阵可作为任务感知图推断的有效基础，PNN-Joint 兼顾统计可解释性与任务性能，为联合学习稀疏精度结构与图网络权重提供了可行范式。

Abstract: Exploiting meaningful latent structures from data to solve downstream tasks is a fundamental challenge in signal processing and machine learning. While Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and coVariance Neural Networks (VNNs) successfully leverage the covariance matrix to process data, they inherently capture both direct and indirect correlations. The precision matrix (inverse covariance) overcomes this by explicitly encoding conditional independencies, making it largely studied in graphical lasso and graph topology identification. However, finite-sample precision estimates are notoriously unstable, and regularized estimators remain task-agnostic. In this work, our principal contribution is tackling the challenging problem of task-aware graph inference. We propose Precision Neural Networks-Joint (PNN-Joint), a framework that jointly estimates a sparse, statistically grounded precision matrix alongside graph neural network weights via an alternating optimization scheme. As a foundational framework to support this, we introduce Precision Neural Networks (PNNs), a broader class of graph convolutional networks operating on precision estimators, and establish their spectral connections to PCA and VNNs alongside their stability to finite-sample errors. Extensive empirical evaluations on synthetic data, as well as real-world neuroimaging and motion sensor datasets, demonstrate that PNN-Joint yields highly interpretable task-aware graphs, exhibits remarkable robustness in low-data regimes, and consistently achieves the best or second-best performance among competitors on real-world tasks.

</details>


### [276] [MercerFlow: Flow Matching in a Kernel-Induced Latent Space for Probabilistic Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06039)
*Ilya Kuleshov,Egor Serov,Alexey Zaytsev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出用先验核的Mercer特征基作为条件流匹配(CFM)时间序列预测中的线性隐空间映射，使MLP骨干在五个GluonTS基准上匹配或超越TSFlow的CRPS，同时训练显存降低约4.7倍、每轮时间降低3.5–4.4倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概率流匹配预测受益于数据匹配先验，但该先验引入的局部相关性通常需RNN、S4或Transformer等序列骨干来吸收，导致显存与每轮训练时间开销高。廉价替代方案是MLP隐空间流匹配，但先验与线性隐映射选择之间的关系在CFM预测中研究不足，而该选择强烈影响性能：Fourier/DCT等固定变换仅对OU先验良态，PCA映射依赖训练集且对训练–测试漂移敏感。

Method: 提出使用先验核的Mercer特征基作为线性隐映射：该基精确对角化中心化协方差、与训练数据解耦，并能适应非平稳与周期先验。在统一协议下与TSFlow对比，于ETTh1、ETTh2、Weather、Electricity、Traffic五个GluonTS基准上评估MLP隐空间CFM预测。

Result: 在五个GluonTS基准上，所得MLP在CRPS上匹配或优于TSFlow，训练显存约为其1/4.7，每轮训练时间为其1/3.5–1/4.4。

Conclusion: 先验核的Mercer特征基是一种与训练数据解耦、适应非平稳与周期先验的线性隐映射，使MLP骨干在CFM时间序列预测中兼具精度与显著更低的训练成本。

Abstract: Recent work has shown that probabilistic flow matching for time series forecasting benefits from a data-matched prior. The resulting prior introduces local correlations, which a sequential architecture usually absorbs: a recurrent neural network (RNN), a structured state-space model (S4), or a Transformer. However, such a backbone costs GPU memory and time per epoch. A cheaper alternative is MLP-based latent-space flow matching: embed the time series via an invertible map to a single latent vector and learn the flow there, so a tabular MLP can treat the series as a set of features. The relationship between the prior and the choice of linear latent map is understudied in conditional flow matching (CFM) forecasting, yet we found it strongly affects performance. Fixed transforms such as Fourier or discrete cosine (DCT) are only well-conditioned for Ornstein--Uhlenbeck priors, while a principal-component (PCA) map fit to the data is a strong but training-set-dependent reference sensitive to train--test shift. Instead, we propose to use the Mercer eigenbasis of the prior kernel: it diagonalises the centred covariance exactly, decouples from training data, and adapts to non-stationary and periodic priors. On five GluonTS benchmarks (ETTh1, ETTh2, Weather, Electricity, Traffic) under a shared protocol with TSFlow, the resulting MLP matches or beats it on CRPS at about $4.7\times$ less training memory and $3.5\times$--$4.4\times$ less time per epoch.

</details>


### [277] [GO-Based Clustering for Learning Cluster-Level Causal Gene Regulatory Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06042)
*Azlaan Mustafa Samad,Wei Zhang,Adèle H Ribeiro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GO4CD，用基因本体(GO)构建多粒度、生物可解释且更易满足可容许性的基因划分，结合CLOC学习簇级因果网络；在E.coli子网络中不可容许率仅18.1%，远低于语义相似度基线的65.3-82.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维基因调控网络(GRN)因果关系发现计算困难且因密集连接而难以解释；将基因聚为功能模块可提升可处理性与生物学可解释性。但现有簇级因果发现方法假设已给定可容许划分(要求簇间图无环)，而构造这样的划分本身很困难。

Method: GO4CD：利用Gene Ontology按共享生物过程对基因分组，并通过本体层次传播注释，从而得到多种粒度的划分，同时优先选择更可能可容许的划分；随后与簇级因果学习算法CLOC集成，分别在条件独立性的oracle设定与基于多元条件独立检验的模拟基因表达数据上评估真实马尔可夫等价类的恢复情况。

Result: 在多个E.coli调控子网络上评估，GO4CD不可容许比例为18.1%，而基于语义相似度的基线为65.3-82.3%。

Conclusion: GO4CD显著更适合在具有生物学意义的基因簇上学习因果GRN，在保持多粒度生物学解释性的同时大幅提升簇间划分的可容许性。

Abstract: Discovery of causal relationships in high-dimensional Gene Regulatory Networks (GRN) is computationally challenging and often difficult to interpret due to dense connections. Therefore, grouping genes together into functional modules can improve tractability and biological interpretability. However, existing cluster level causal discovery methods assume access to a predefined admissible partitions, requiring the graph over clusters to be acyclic. Constructing such partitions is therefore challenging. In this work, we introduce GO-based Clustering for Causal Discovery (GO4CD), an algorithm that uses Gene Ontology (GO) to construct biologically meaningful gene partitions at multiple levels of granularity, while favoring those more likely to be admissible for causal discovery. GO4CD groups together genes participating in a shared biological process, and propagates gene annotations through the ontology hierarchy to achieve different granularity of partitions. Furthermore, we integrate GO4CD with Causal Learning over Clusters (CLOC) algorithm and evaluate recovery of true Markov equivalence class both with an oracle of conditional independencies and on simulated gene expression data using multivariate conditional independence tests. We evaluate GO4CD on multiple E.coli regulatory subnetworks and find that it is inadmissible in 18.1% of the cases, compared with 65.3-82.3% for the semantic-similarity baselines. Our results indicate that GO4CD is substantially better suited to learning causal GRNs defined over biologically meaningful gene clusters.

</details>


### [278] [Pay to Learn, Share to Earn: Incentivized Federated Multi-Player Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06062)
*Pavamana K J,Chandramani Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种激励感知的联邦多玩家多臂老虎机框架，玩家通过分享信息获得奖励、购买信息支付成本，并设计了Buying-UCB算法，兼顾个体探索与协作学习，理论上给出了群体遗憾与购买成本的上界，刻画了完全协作与完全独立学习之间的权衡，并通过实验验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦老虎机框架通常假设所有玩家都愿意与服务器共享本地观测，但现实中玩家多为自利个体，若无明确激励则不愿参与协作，这一假设不切实际。因此需要引入激励机制来建模玩家的参与行为。

Method: 提出激励感知的联邦老虎机框架：玩家向服务器分享信息可获得奖励，从服务器购买信息则需支付成本；并设计了基于UCB的Buying-UCB算法，将分享激励与信息获取成本同时纳入学习过程，以平衡个体探索与协作学习。

Result: 理论上推导了群体遗憾与购买成本的上界，并进一步刻画了完全协作式联邦学习与完全独立学习之间的权衡关系；大量数值实验验证了理论结论，并展示了该框架在不同协作与定价机制下的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过引入激励与成本机制，该框架在玩家自利场景下实现了协作学习与个体利益的平衡，Buying-UCB算法在群体遗憾和购买成本上具有理论保证，为联邦多玩家老虎机的激励设计提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Federated multi-player multi-armed bandit problems model collaborative sequential decision-making where multiple players interact with a common bandit environment and share information through a central server to accelerate learning. Existing federated bandit frameworks typically assume that all players willingly share their local observations with the server. However, this assumption is often unrealistic in practical settings where players are self-interested and may not participate in collaboration without explicit incentives. To address this challenge, we propose an incentive-aware federated bandit framework in which players receive rewards for sharing information with the server and incur costs when buying information from the server. We develop a UCB-based algorithm, termed Buying-UCB, that balances individual exploration and collaborative learning by incorporating both sharing incentives and information acquisition costs into the learning process. We theoretically analyze the proposed algorithm and derive upper bounds on the group regret and buying cost. Our analysis further characterizes the trade-off between fully collaborative federated learning and completely independent learning. Extensive numerical experiments validate the theoretical findings and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework under different collaboration and pricing regimes.

</details>


### [279] [Boosting Transferable Adversarial Attacks against Deep Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06083)
*Zexin Li,Ruili Yao,Yiming Zeng,Xiaoxue Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将迁移型黑盒攻击形式化为每步扰动预算下的回报最小化问题，指出移植图像分类的每步攻击（FGSM/MI-FGSM/NI-FGSM）虽可迁移但不强于同预算随机噪声；为此提出轨迹级攻击，在滚动时域上借助可微环境模型与温度平滑的替代策略优化扰动序列。在CartPole-v1的10个DQN/DDQN智能体、100组替代—受害策略对上，该方法在白盒、跨模型、跨算法设置中均优于每步攻击与随机噪声。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多数DRL对抗攻击假设白盒访问受害策略，这一前提在实际中很少成立；因此需要研究更具现实性的迁移型黑盒攻击。

Method: 将攻击建模为每步扰动预算下的回报最小化；先用FGSM、MI-FGSM、NI-FGSM配合每步目标进行迁移测试；随后提出轨迹级攻击：通过环境可微模型与温度平滑的替代策略，在滚动时域上优化一整段扰动序列，优化器保持不变。

Result: 移植图像分类的每步攻击所生成的扰动虽能迁移，但强度不超过同预算的随机噪声；轨迹级攻击在CartPole-v1上对10个DQN与DDQN智能体、100组替代—受害策略对，于白盒、跨模型与跨算法三种设置下均超过每步攻击与随机噪声。

Conclusion: 仅靠每步目标的迁移攻击在DRL中效果有限，轨迹级建模与温度平滑的可微替代是提升黑盒迁移攻击强度的有效途径。

Abstract: Most adversarial attacks on deep reinforcement learning (DRL) assume white-box access to the victim policy, which rarely holds in practice. This paper studies transfer-based black-box attacks on DRL: the attacker crafts observation perturbations on a white-box surrogate agent and feeds them to an unknown victim. We formulate the attack as return minimization under a per-step perturbation budget. We first show that transplanting transferable image-classification attacks (FGSM, MI-FGSM, and NI-FGSM) with a per-step objective yields perturbations that transfer but are no stronger than random noise of the same budget. We then propose a trajectory-level attack that optimizes a sequence of perturbations over a receding horizon through a differentiable model of the environment and a temperature-smoothed surrogate policy, with the same optimizers. On CartPole-v1 with ten DQN and DDQN agents and 100 surrogate--victim pairs, the trajectory-level attack outperforms per-step attacks and random noise in the white-box, cross-model, and cross-algorithm settings.

</details>


### [280] [Rethinking Least-Core Computation in Contextual-Distractor Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06087)
*Hiroshi Kera,Toshinori Yamauchi,Sai Ganesh Nagarajan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究最小核心（least core）归因中支付选择与联盟采样对解释的影响，提出熵最小核心（ELC）——一种收敛到核仁的平滑近似方法，实现高效、稳定的归因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 最小核心作为Shapley式平均的替代方案，能揭示在稀有高价值情境中造成重大损害的玩家，但其分配通常不唯一，不同分配会改变解释结果，因此需要研究支付选择与联盟采样对归因的影响。

Method: 通过实验考察选择器（selector）选择与联盟采样对最小核心归因的影响；提出熵最小核心（ELC），一种平滑近似方法，其唯一极小值沿温度连续路径逼近核仁（nucleolus），并使用全部联盟约束与良好定义的选择器进行计算，支持GPU加速。

Result: 选择器选择对区分有用与有害贡献至关重要；采样会降低有害玩家识别能力，即使有用玩家仍能被良好识别。ELC比基于LP的核仁求解器更快逼近核仁，且支付误差小，在更大规模问题上可实现GPU加速；在完整联盟上下文干扰游戏中，ELC的识别准确率与最小范数选择器相当，且对干扰项的危害排序更准确。

Conclusion: ELC作为一种具有明确定义选择器的平滑最小核心方法，能够高效、稳定地逼近核仁，为游戏论归因提供更可靠的解释，尤其在有害玩家识别与危害排序方面表现优异。

Abstract: Game-theoretic attribution explains a model by assigning credit to its features or training examples. The least core has attracted interest as an alternative to Shapley-style averaging because it can expose players that cause substantial harm in rare, high-value contexts. However, least-core allocations are generally nonunique, and the choice of allocation can affect the resulting explanation. In this study, we investigate how payoff selection and coalition sampling affect least-core attribution. Our experiments show that selector choice matters for distinguishing useful and harmful contributions, and that sampling can degrade harmful-player identification across the tested selectors even when useful players remain well identified. These observations motivate efficient computation with all coalition constraints and a well-defined selector. We introduce entropic least core (ELC), a smooth approximation whose unique minimizer follows a continuous path along the temperature to the nucleolus, a classical refinement of the least core. Our experiments show that ELC approximates the nucleolus faster than an LP-based nucleolus solver while retaining small payoff errors, with further GPU acceleration at larger problem sizes. In the tested full-coalition contextual-distractor games, ELC matches the minimum-norm selector in identification accuracy and more accurately ranks distractors by harm.

</details>


### [281] [Lossy Compression of PDE Training Inputs: Field Reconstruction Error Does Not Order the Cost to a Trained Operator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06095)
*Huy Hoang Le*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文指出"压缩后的场重建误差（率失真理论给出的比特数）"并不能决定"在压缩数据上训练的算子精度"，并提出用探针（probe）度量压缩扰动经由解算子传播后的透射比例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 算子学习基准以全精度存储、已达TB级规模；率失真理论能给出存储场所需比特数，但实践者真正关心的是在压缩数据上训练的算子会有多准。作者要证明前者无法决定后者，并找出原因与量化方法。

Method: 在保持目标与测试输入为全精度的情况下压缩输入场。利用"解算子会衰减其输入的扰动"这一性质，将压缩后的场送入已按全精度训练好的代理模型（surrogate），测量该代理传递了多少扰动，得到透射因子（transmission factor）；同时对比传统字段重建误差与该透射因子在不同PDE族上的表现，并考察相对L2目标下的变化。

Result: 透射比例与底层方程的平滑行为一致，且跨PDE族跨度超过两个数量级；字段重建误差计算发生在衰减之前，无法看到该效应。在MSE训练的算子下，重建误差使104次代价比较中的36次发生反转，而基于相同前向传播构建的探针只反转12次。PDEBench中初始条件相同的两个族，在相同字段误差下下游表现相差三倍。在参考配方的相对L2目标下，差距收窄，但族级中位透射因子的排序不变。

Conclusion: 一个全精度训练轮次后，探针仅靠前向传播即可评估整条率曲线，在所测编解码器与架构上对数据集与码率排序一致；但其绝对量级不可跨设置迁移。因此存储精度指标不能替代面向下游算子精度的评估。

Abstract: Operator-learning benchmarks are stored at full precision and have grown to terabyte scale. Rate-distortion theory says how many bits the stored field needs, while a practitioner needs to know how accurate an operator trained on the compressed data will be. We show that the first does not determine the second, and measure why, compressing the input fields while targets and test inputs stay at full precision. A solution operator attenuates a perturbation of its input. Pushing a compressed field through a surrogate already trained at full precision measures how much of the perturbation that surrogate transmits. The fraction is consistent with the smoothing behaviour of the underlying equation, and it spans more than two orders of magnitude across PDE families. Field reconstruction error is computed before the attenuation and cannot see it. For operators trained with mean squared error it inverts 36 of 104 cost comparisons across datasets, where a probe built from the same forward passes inverts 12. Two families that PDEBench stores with identical initial conditions differ threefold downstream at identical field error. Under the relative-L2 objective of the reference recipe the separation narrows, while the ordering of the family-level median transmission factors is unchanged. After one full-precision training run, the probe evaluates an entire rate curve by forward passes alone. It ranks datasets and rates consistently across the codecs and architectures we test, while its magnitude does not transfer between them.

</details>


### [282] [On the Geometry of Multimodal Saturation: Riemannian VICReg](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06096)
*Nessim Ben Abbes,Duc Han Le,Sabri Mtibaa,Van-Tam Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文发现在自监督学习中引入第三模态反而会损害性能（称为"多模态饱和"），并提出Riemannian VICReg（R-VICReg），通过负曲率乘积因子上的测地线距离对齐视图，将第三模态有益的概率从44.4%提升至64.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督学习的普遍预期是第三模态应提升或至少保持性能，但在九个图像-文本-表格数据集上，作者观察到三模态模型反而劣于其最佳双模态子集，这一反直觉失败（多模态饱和）需要解释与解决。

Method: 作者将失败归因于对齐几何，并提出Riemannian VICReg（R-VICReg）。它推广经典VICReg：在可学习的负曲率乘积因子上以测地线距离的平方对齐视图，当曲率趋于零时精确退化为VICReg。

Result: 在VICReg下，55.6%的配对运行中三模态模型劣于其最佳双模态子集；SimSiam下为51.1%。在同一组45次配对运行中，R-VICReg将第三模态有益的概率从44.4%提升到64.4%，增益集中在VICReg饱和之处。

Conclusion: 多模态饱和是自监督学习中普遍存在的对齐几何问题；采用负曲率流形上测地线对齐的R-VICReg可缓解该问题，使第三模态更可能带来性能提升，并将VICReg作为曲率为零的特例保留。

Abstract: In self-supervised learning, a third modality should improve, or at least preserve, performance. Across nine image-text-tabular datasets, we show that it instead harms performance: the trimodal model underperforms its own best bimodal subset in 55.6% of paired runs under VICReg. The same failure occurs in 51.1% of paired runs under SimSiam. We call this failure multimodal saturation. We propose that the failure lies in the alignment geometry. Riemannian VICReg (R-VICReg) generalizes classical VICReg: it aligns views by squared geodesic distance on learnable negative-curvature product factors and recovers VICReg exactly as curvature vanishes. Over the same 45 paired runs, R-VICReg raises the probability that the third modality helps from 44.4% to 64.4%, with gains concentrated where VICReg saturates.

</details>


### [283] [Flash-OPD: Fast On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06105)
*Wei Chen,Junle Chen,Yitong Yang,Zhaoyang Xu,Jiaxin Lin,Yuxuan Liang,Xiaofang Zhou,Kai Wang,Rui Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Flash-OPD，将on-policy蒸馏的轨迹长度控制问题转化为轨迹级可靠性边界验证问题，根据累积低兼容事件的首达实现自适应停止，加速2.2×–7.5×且精度不降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: On-policy蒸馏需在student生成轨迹上提供密集teacher监督，但长rollout的生成与评估成本高。现有加速方法依赖开环rollout调度或闭环horizon调整；而不同轨迹的监督可靠性长度差异大，单一horizon难以匹配：过短截断有用监督，过长在可靠区域外浪费算力。

Method: 核心洞察：轨迹可靠性边界无需在生成前预测。将可靠性视为累积低teacher-student兼容事件的首次到达（first-passage），边界在采样前未知，但基于已观测前缀可精确判断是否到达。Flash-OPD由rollout-horizon控制转向轨迹级边界验证：交织缓存生成与teacher验证，按每条轨迹观测到的兼容事件独立停止；仅用近期事件率调度下一次验证点，实际停止决策始终依赖精确累积计数，从而避免估计误差导致过早终止，同时降低验证开销。

Result: 在多种数据集与teacher-student设置下，Flash-OPD相比标准OPD取得2.2×–7.5×加速，同时保持或提升准确率。

Conclusion: 以首达事件视角将长度控制重构为可精确判定的边界验证，配合计数-调度分离机制，可在不牺牲监督质量的前提下显著降低OPD训练成本，为自适应轨迹蒸馏提供有效方案。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories, but generating and evaluating long rollouts incurs substantial training cost. Existing acceleration methods reduce this cost through open-loop rollout schedules or closed-loop horizon adaptation. However, supervision compatibility can vary substantially across trajectories, making a single rollout horizon difficult to match their heterogeneous reliable lengths: an overly short horizon may truncate useful supervision, while an overly long one wastes computation beyond reliable regions. Our key insight is that the trajectory-specific reliability boundary need not be predicted before generation. By viewing reliability as the first-passage of accumulated low teacher--student compatibility events, the boundary is inherently unknown before sampling, yet whether it has been reached can be determined exactly from the observed prefix. Building on this insight, we propose *Flash-OPD*, which shifts from rollout-horizon control to adaptive trajectory-level boundary verification. *Flash-OPD* interleaves cached generation with teacher verification and independently stops each trajectory according to its observed compatibility events. To reduce verification overhead, the recent event rate is used only to schedule the next verification point, while the actual stopping decision always relies on the exact cumulative count. This separation prevents estimation errors from causing premature termination while enabling efficient verification during generation. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets and teacher--student settings show that *Flash-OPD* achieves $2.2\times$--$7.5\times$ speedups over standard OPD while maintaining or improving accuracy.

</details>


### [284] [ORCA: The Annealed Spectral Conditioning Optimizer for Faster, Better LLM Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06116)
*Yuanshi Liu,Boyuan Jiang,Liang Hou,Xin Tao,Pengfei Wan,Zhouchen Lin,Cong Fang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 ORCA（Orthogonal Regularization, Cooled After）优化器干预方法：在训练早期施加强但短暂的正交正则化，随后移除，使权重先获得更宽的谱再自由适应。在 130M–8B 的 LLaMA、Qwen3 与细粒度 MoE 模型上，ORCA 的最终验证损失低于 Muon，其相对 Muon 的损失下降幅度达到或超过 Muon 相对 Adam 的下降幅度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代 LLM 优化器（如 Muon）常产生比 Adam 有效秩更高的权重矩阵，但进一步的谱控制收益有限。作者指出背后的张力：集中谱会抑制耦合权重矩阵中的梯度方向、拖慢优化；而贯穿训练始终维持的约束又限制任务特化适应，抬高可达损失下界。

Method: ORCA 是一种最小化的优化器干预：训练早期施加强但临时的软正交正则化，之后移除该正则化，从而早期受益于更宽的谱、后期自由适应。无需改动架构，额外开销极小。

Result: 在 LLaMA、Qwen3 及细粒度 MoE 模型（130M 至 8B 参数）上，ORCA 最终验证损失低于 Muon；相对 Muon 的损失降低幅度匹配或超过 Muon 相对 Adam 的降低幅度。消融实验支持"早期塑形、后期释放"的设计。

Conclusion: 通过"早期强正交正则、后期移除"的临时约束策略，可在不改变架构、开销极小的前提下突破持续谱约束带来的损失下界限制，稳定优于 Muon。

Abstract: Modern LLM optimizers such as Muon often produce weight matrices with higher effective rank than Adam, yet further spectral control has delivered only modest gains. We identify a tension behind this result: concentrated spectra can suppress gradient directions in coupled weight matrices and slow optimization, while constraints maintained throughout training can limit task-specific adaptation and raise the attainable loss floor. We introduce ORCA (Orthogonal Regularization, Cooled After), a minimal optimizer intervention that applies strong but temporary soft orthogonality regularization early in training, then removes it. This allows the weights to benefit from a broader spectrum early on and adapt freely afterward. Across LLaMA, Qwen3, and fine-grained mixture-of-experts models ranging from 130M to 8B parameters, ORCA achieves lower final validation loss than Muon. Its loss reduction relative to Muon matches or exceeds Muon's reduction relative to Adam. Ablations support the early-shaping, later-release design. Further, ORCA requires no architectural changes and adds minimal overhead.

</details>


### [285] [Mind the Drift: Diagonal Linear Networks Under Large Learning Rates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06120)
*Aniket Sanyal,Tom Jacobs,Rebekka Burkholz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究对角线性网络中大学习率下的动力学，揭示两种隐式偏置（Gain 与 Drift）共同决定回归解的稀疏性，并证明大学习率可用于调控隐式偏置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大学习率会使神经网络训练轨迹偏离经典梯度流行为，Edge of Stability 提供了理解该动力学的视角；作者希望探究大学习率是否以及如何影响稀疏解的恢复与模型选择。

Method: 在对角线性网络上进行理论分析：定义 Gain（梯度下降相对梯度流的平均离散化误差）并推导与之密切关联但被忽视的 Drift（不同离散化误差间的不平衡），分析两者对解稀疏性的竞争影响；并设计干预实验主动操控 Gain 以验证理论。

Result: Gain 在某些区间单调增长并偏向更稠密、更平坦的插值解；Drift 的影响取决于其与潜在解的对齐关系，可抵消或强化 Gain 的效果，其行为主导模型选择，尤其在早期训练阶段。干预实验通过操控 Gain 成功恢复了更尖锐、更稀疏的解。

Conclusion: 大学习率并非普遍阻碍稀疏解的恢复；相反，通过 Gain 与 Drift 的竞争机制，可以主动利用大学习率来调控训练的隐式偏置，实现更稀疏的解。

Abstract: Large learning rates can qualitatively change the trajectory of neural network training, often pushing optimization into regimes far from classical gradient-flow behavior. The Edge of Stability (EoS) offers a valuable lens on the dynamics such learning rates induce. We study corresponding dynamics in diagonal linear networks, where we uncover a competition between two distinct implicit biases that jointly determine the sparsity of the recovered solution in regression settings. Complementary to the Gain, which captures the average discretization error accumulated by Gradient Descent relative to Gradient Flow, we derive a closely associated but overlooked quantity: the Drift. Under large learning rates, it describes an imbalance between different discretization errors and represents a systematic shift in the optimization trajectory. While the Gain grows monotonically in certain regimes, and can bias towards denser, flatter interpolators, the impact of the Drift depends on its alignment with potential solutions, which can either counteract or reinforce the effect of the Gain. Consequently, its behavior drives model selection, particularly during early training epochs. To validate our theoretical insights, we introduce an intervention that actively steers the Gain to recover sharper, sparser solutions. Thus, our analysis reveals that large learning rates do not universally hinder the recovery of sparse solutions. On the contrary, they can be harnessed to control the implicit bias of training.

</details>


### [286] [Integrating Survival-Based Aging Models with Data-Driven RUL Prognostics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06128)
*Abhishek Srinivasan,Juan Carlos Andresen,Sepideh Pashami,Anders Holst*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种概率融合框架，通过失效概率分布将基于磨损的退化模型与基于传感器的数据模型结合，实现剩余寿命（RUL）估计的不确定性感知集成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RUL估计方法分为两类：基于磨损的老化模型（刻画累积退化）与基于传感器的数据模型（反映瞬时健康状态），二者各自仅提供部分信息，缺乏统一整合机制。

Method: 基于显式结构假设，建立磨损、潜在健康状态、传感器观测与失效之间的关联，推导出带自适应权重的概率组合规则；实验中磨损分量用参数化生存模型学习，传感器分量用1D-CNN配合事后不确定性模型学习。

Result: 在多个N-CMAPSS数据集上，融合模型相较单一分量提升了点预测精度，保持了C-index，并给出更窄且校准良好的预测区间。

Conclusion: 磨损型生存模型与传感器型深度学习模型具有互补作用，其概率化融合为全生命周期内更稳健、一致的预测性维护提供了结构化路径。

Abstract: Predictive maintenance requires reliable remaining useful life (RUL) estimation. Existing methods mainly follow two paradigms: wear-based aging models that capture cumulative degradation and sensor-driven data models that reflect instantaneous health conditions, each providing only partial information. In this work, we propose a probabilistic fusion framework that integrates wear-based and sensor-based prognostic components through failure probability distributions. Based on explicit structural assumptions linking wear, latent health, sensor observations, and failure, we derive a principled combination rule that enables uncertainty-aware integration with adaptive weighting of the components. Experimentally, we assess this combination rule by learning the wear-based component using a parametric survival model and the sensor-based component using a 1D convolutional neural network (1D-CNN) with a post-hoc uncertainty model. Evaluation on multiple N-CMAPSS datasets demonstrates that the fused model improves point accuracy, preserves the C-index, and produces narrower yet well-calibrated prediction intervals compared to either component alone. The results highlight the complementary roles of wear-based survival model and sensor-based deep learning model, and show that their probabilistic integration provides a structured pathway toward more robust and consistent prognostics over the life-time.

</details>


### [287] [Machine learning for journal entry testing: A type-aware evaluation of anomaly detectors under a review budget](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06133)
*Jan Gronewald,Michel Scherer,Nijat Mehdiyev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出类型感知的日记账异常检测评估框架（含 FSR 等指标），并在多个真实与合成账本上系统比较多种无监督检测器，揭示高命中率可能掩盖系统性类型盲点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统日记账异常检测评估在全量样本上使用 ROC-AUC、精确率和召回率，忽略了审计复核预算约束以及被检出的异常类型分布，导致"高命中率"的评价无法反映实际审计价值，因此需要引入类型感知的评估方法。

Method: 提出类型感知评估指标：单类型召回（per-type recall）、按预算占比封顶的公平份额类型召回（FSR）、类型覆盖度（type coverage）和首次命中排名（first-hit rank）。在四个真实客户账本（注入类型化异常）和一个公开合成账本上，评估九种无监督检测器、一个监督参考模型，以及反馈驱动的 DeepSAD 半监督方法；并比较独热编码与频率编码的表示影响。

Result: 最大客户账本上，PCA、AE、VAE 平均在前 100 条记账中命中 98 个异常，但其中至少 95.8 个属于同一类型；FSR 转而偏好 kNN 检测器，并在 4 个客户账本中的 3 个改变了排名第一的检测器。表示方式亦有影响：独热编码可暴露未见账户，频率编码则基本无法检出未见对方账户。公开账本上，HBOS 与 ECOD 在 1,386 条内覆盖全部八种标记，而 kNN 虽在 1,000 条时命中数领先，但直到第 4,641 位才首次命中交叉清算类异常，监督行级参考模型在 1,000 条内未命中该标记。DeepSAD 复核协议将每 100 次复核的平均命中从 40.0 提升至 68.3，但类型覆盖度仅从 2.7 升至 3.0。

Conclusion: 高命中率可能掩盖系统性的类型盲点；类型感知评估（如 FSR）能更真实地反映审计价值。反馈驱动方法可提升命中率，却倾向于强化既有检测模式而非扩大异常类型覆盖，因此需要引入类型覆盖度等指标以防止检测偏差。

Abstract: Journal entry anomaly detectors are commonly evaluated on the full population with ROC-AUC, precision and recall, ignoring the review budget and which anomaly types are found. We propose a type-aware evaluation combining per-type recall, fair-share type recall (FSR), which caps each type's credit at its budget share, type coverage and first-hit rank. We evaluate nine unsupervised detectors, a supervised reference and feedback-driven Deep Semi-Supervised Anomaly Detection (DeepSAD) on four real client ledgers with injected typed anomalies and a public synthetic ledger. On the largest client ledger, principal component analysis (PCA), an autoencoder (AE) and a variational autoencoder (VAE) each place on average 98 anomalies among the first 100 postings, but at least 95.8 belong to one type. FSR instead favours a nearest-neighbour (kNN) detector and changes the top-ranked detector on three of four client ledgers. Representation also matters: one-hot encoding exposes unseen accounts, whereas frequency encoding leaves unseen contra accounts largely undetected. On the public ledger, the Histogram-Based Outlier Score (HBOS) and Empirical Cumulative Distribution-Based Outlier Detection (ECOD) reach all eight markings within 1,386 entries, whereas kNN, the hit leader at 1,000 entries, first reaches cross-linked clearing at rank 4,641, and the supervised row-level reference misses this marking within 1,000 entries. There, the adaptive DeepSAD review protocol raises mean hits per 100 reviews from 40.0 to 68.3 but type coverage only from 2.7 to 3.0. These findings show that high hit rates can conceal systematic blind spots and suggest that feedback can reinforce existing detection patterns without broadening anomaly coverage.

</details>


### [288] [Co-Optimizing Graph Sparsification and Approximate Computing for Energy-Efficient FPGA-Based GCN Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06138)
*Nathaniel Kaye Mellor,Shreejith Shanker,George Floros*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于FPGA的GCN加速器，将DSpar图稀疏化、8位量化与近似乘法器结合，在AMD Kria KV260上验证了稀疏化与近似计算的互补协同优化可显著提升边缘端GCN推理的效率与能效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GCN在处理图结构数据上表现强大，但其稀疏图聚合带来较高的计算与内存开销，难以部署在资源受限的边缘平台，因此需要在精度与效率间寻找可行的加速方案。

Method: 在AMD Kria KV260 FPGA上实现GCN加速器，融合DSpar图稀疏化、8位量化与近似乘法器；在Cora、LastFM Asia和Amazon Photo三组密度差异较大的图上，系统探究稀疏化与近似计算的交互作用，重点分析GCN计算中累积深度对近似算术效果的影响。

Result: 近似乘法器的有效性由GCN计算中的累积深度决定：应用于稀疏聚合操作时最有效，图稀疏化通过降低聚合深度进一步提升其可行性。在Amazon Photo上实现最高9.88倍加速并保持86.6%分类精度，在Cora上实现1.52倍加速与77.0%精度，总功耗低于1 W。

Conclusion: 图稀疏化与近似计算是互补技术，其协同优化能够在边缘FPGA平台上实现高效、低功耗的GCN推理。

Abstract: Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) have emerged as a powerful framework for learning from graph-structured data, yet their deployment on resource-constrained edge platforms remains challenging due to the computational and memory demands of sparse graph aggregation. This work presents an FPGA-based GCN accelerator that combines DSpar graph sparsification, 8-bit quantization, and approximate multipliers on the AMD Kria KV260. Evaluated on Cora, LastFM Asia, and Amazon Photo, the design explores the interaction between sparsification and approximation across graphs with widely varying densities. Results show that the effectiveness of approximate arithmetic is governed by accumulation depth within GCN computations. Approximate multipliers are most effective when applied to sparse aggregation operations, while graph sparsification further improves their viability by reducing aggregation depth. The combined approach achieves up to 9.88$\times$ speedup while maintaining 86.6\% classification accuracy on Amazon Photo, and 1.52$\times$ speedup with 77.0\% accuracy on Cora, with total power consumption below 1 W. These results demonstrate that graph sparsification and approximate computing are complementary techniques whose co-optimization enables efficient low-power GCN inference on edge FPGA platforms.

</details>


### [289] [TIGER: Time-Series Classification with In-Context-Learning Gated Ensemble of Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06156)
*Johann Faouzi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TIGER 提出用三种通用分类器（Ridge、Extra Trees、Naive Bayes）作用于四类时间序列表示，将十二个基学习器预测堆叠为元特征，并通过自适应元分类规则（加权硬投票或 TabICLv2 上下文学习）产生最终预测，在 142 个 UCR 数据集上取得优于 HIVE-COTE 2.0 等六种算法的平均准确率、平衡准确率和 F1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列分类集成方法（如 HIVE-COTE 2.0）为每种表示家族配备专门设计的分类算法，并使用固定、非自适应的融合规则，导致系统复杂且融合策略缺乏数据自适应性。作者希望用统一的小型通用分类器组合替代定制算法，并引入能按数据集自适应选择的元分类规则，以在简化设计的同时提升分类精度。

Method: 对来自四个不同表示家族的四种表示，分别应用同一组三个通用分类器（Ridge、Extra Trees、Naive Bayes），得到十二个基学习器；将其预测堆叠成元特征矩阵。最终预测由自适应元分类规则产生：根据每个类别平均可用训练样本数，在每个数据集上独立地在加权硬多数投票与 TabICLv2（一种预训练表格基础模型，以上下文学习方式充当元分类器）之间进行选择。方法仅含一个超参数，且仅在 20 个数据集的开发子集上调优。

Result: 在取自 UCR 时间序列分类档案的 142 个数据集基准上，TIGER 在六种对比算法（含 HIVE-COTE 2.0）中获得最佳平均准确率、平衡准确率和 F1 分数，并显著优于其余五种算法。其自适应规则明显优于单独使用两种组成元分类方法中的任一种。唯一超参数在 20 数据集开发子集上调优后可泛化到完整评估基准。

Conclusion: TIGER 表明，以统一的小型通用分类器组合替代各表示家族的定制算法，并结合按数据集聚类规模自适应的元分类融合规则，能够在不依赖大量调参的情况下超越当前最先进的时间序列分类集成方法；论文还通过大量消融实验刻画了设计选择，并报告了被考察后弃用的替代方案。

Abstract: A representation family is a distinct way of extracting features from time series. Ensemble algorithms that combine several representation families remain the most accurate approach to time series classification. Current state-of-the-art ensembles, most notably HIVE-COTE~2.0, pair a bespoke classification algorithm with each representation family and combine their predictions using a fixed, non-adaptive rule. We present TIGER (Time-series classification with In-context-learning Gated Ensemble of Representations), which instead applies the same small portfolio of three general-purpose classifiers (Ridge, Extra Trees, and Naive Bayes) to four representations from four distinct families, stacking the resulting twelve base learners' predictions into a meta-feature matrix. The final prediction is produced by an adaptive meta-classification rule that chooses, independently for each data set, between a weighted hard majority vote and TabICLv2, a pretrained tabular foundation model used in-context as a meta-classifier, based on the mean number of training samples available per class. On a 142-data-set benchmark drawn from the UCR time series classification archive, TIGER obtains the best mean accuracy, balanced accuracy, and F1-score among six compared algorithms, including HIVE-COTE~2.0, and significantly outperforms each of the other five individually. TIGER's adaptive rule also meaningfully outperforms either of its two constituent meta-classification methods used alone, and its single hyperparameter, tuned using only a twenty-data-set development subset, is shown to generalize to the full evaluation benchmark. We further characterize TIGER's design through an extensive set of ablation experiments and report the design alternatives that we investigated and ultimately discarded.

</details>


### [290] [Anosognosia in LLMs: Probing Self-Awareness of Quantized Computational Substrate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06174)
*Yoshihiro Izawa,Gouki Minegishi,Yoko Yamakata*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 受失认症启发，研究LLM能否识别自身计算基底的量化退化。结果：现有模型无法自我报告量化状态，生成文本几乎无量化痕迹，但内部表示含有方法特异指纹；仅靠单次输出难以判断，跨量化级别联合训练的LoRA可在已知方法上读出指纹，却无法泛化到未见方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 借鉴神经学中的失认症（患者无法识别自身能力损伤），探究LLM能否觉察由量化引起的自身计算基底退化，即模型的自我监控能力。

Method: 测试模型对自身量化状态的自我报告能力，并以其自身生成文本作为外部线索；采用线性探针（linear probing）分析生成文本与内部表示中的量化痕迹；通过训练使模型识别严重退化输出（如4-bit），并训练跨量化级别共享的LoRA读取内部指纹，评估其对未见量化方法的泛化。

Result: 现有模型无法自我报告量化状态，即使提供自身生成文本为线索；生成文本几乎不含量化痕迹，而内部表示存在清晰且方法特异的指纹；模型训练后能通过对比识别4-bit等严重退化输出，但无法从单一输出判断；共享LoRA可读出内部指纹，却在不曾见过的量化方法上失败，仅将方法特异指纹映射为标签。

Conclusion: 尽管外部自我观察在部分人类失认症中可恢复觉察，但在LLM中更可行的路径可能在于其内部表示；研究揭示了LLM自我监控在泛化性上的根本局限。

Abstract: Can LLMs recognize degradation in their own computational substrate? Inspired by anosognosia, a neurological condition in which patients fail to recognize impairments in their own abilities, we investigate whether LLMs can recognize degradation in their computational substrate induced by quantization. We first show that existing models fail to self-report their quantization state, even when provided with their own generated text as an external cue. Linear probing reveals that, while generated text carries almost no trace of quantization, internal representations contain clear, method-specific fingerprints. Through training, models learn to identify severely degraded outputs such as those of 4-bit models by comparison, yet still fail to do so from a single output. A shared LoRA trained jointly across quantization levels succeeded in reading out internal fingerprints, but fails on unseen quantization methods, merely mapping method-specific fingerprints to labels. Whereas external self-observation can restore awareness in some cases of human anosognosia, our results suggest that the more promising route to enabling such awareness in LLMs may lie in their internal representations. Our results highlight fundamental limits of generalizability to LLM self-monitoring.

</details>


### [291] [Anlu: Enabling In-Context Time Series Anomaly Detection in Foundation Models via Counterfactual Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06180)
*Tian Lan,Yifei Gao,Yimeng Lu,Xuming An,Meng Wang,Yue Pan,Wenjun He,Chen Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究时间序列异常检测（TSAD）中的上下文学习（ICL），提出"参考条件检测"设定：由参考记录提供正常行为证据，模型参数在推理时冻结。为迫使模型真正利用参考，作者提出反事实监督（为一查询配对两个支持不同正常规则的参考并分别标注），并设计Anlu模型（在冻结的TSFM上加参考记忆与零初始化门控适配器）。在TSB-AD-U的350条序列上，Anlu将冻结TSFM的平均VUS-PR从0.542提升至0.607；将参考替换为零则降至0.499。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列模式是否异常往往取决于被监控过程的运行工况（regime）：缺失事件在某一工况下可能是故障，在另一工况下则属常规，而仅凭查询本身无法判断适用哪种工况。此外，仅提供参考并不足够——当训练异常可仅凭查询被识别时，检测器会直接拟合目标而忽略参考。

Method: 提出参考条件检测框架：查询配参考记录，推理时模型参数冻结。提出反事实监督——将一个查询与两个支持不同正常规则的参考配对，并在每种参考下分别标注该查询；在两标签不一致的位置上，任何忽略参考的检测器都无法同时拟合两个目标。模型Anlu在冻结的、面向异常检测预训练的时间序列基础模型（TSFM）上引入参考记忆（reference memory）和零初始化门控适配器（zero-initialized gated adapters），从该监督中学习。

Result: 在350条TSB-AD-U评测序列上，Anlu将冻结TSFM的平均VUS-PR从0.542提升到0.607；将参考替换为全零后，Anlu得分降至0.499，表明性能提升确实来自对参考的有效利用。

Conclusion: 反事实监督可有效防止检测器忽略参考，使参考条件的时间序列异常检测真正依赖参考提供的工况证据；Anlu在冻结TSFM上取得稳定提升，且消融（置零参考）证实参考信息是增益来源。

Abstract: Whether a time-series pattern is anomalous often depends on the operating regime of the monitored process. A missing event can signal a fault in one regime and be routine in another, and the query alone may not reveal which regime applies. We study in-context learning (ICL) for time series anomaly detection (TSAD) through reference-conditioned detection, where a reference record provides evidence about expected behavior and model parameters remain fixed at inference. Supplying the reference is not enough: when training anomalies are recognizable from the query alone, the detector can fit its targets while ignoring the reference. We therefore introduce counterfactual supervision, which pairs one query with two references that support different normal rules and labels the query under each. At positions where the two labels disagree, no detector that ignores the reference can fit both targets. Anlu learns from this supervision by adding a reference memory and zero-initialized gated adapters to a frozen time-series foundation model (TSFM) pretrained for anomaly detection. On the 350 TSB-AD-U evaluation sequences, Anlu raises the mean VUS-PR of the frozen TSFM from 0.542 to 0.607. Replacing the reference with zeros lowers Anlu's score to 0.499.

</details>


### [292] [Two-Point Local Optimality in $k$-Means via Boundary-Point Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06182)
*Wenlong Lyu,Xujie Xiao,Yuheng Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 $r$-点局部最优性（重点研究 $r=2$），证明改进型两点移动的结构性质，并提出 BPS-2PLS 算法，在保持两点局部最优的同时将候选点规模降至 $m=\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}}(\log n)$，在十二个基准中十个取得最低平均 WCSS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Lloyd 算法与 D-local（Li et al., 2025）优化方法对 $k$-means 仅提供较弱的局部最优性保证，且解的质量对初始化敏感。为增强局部最优性、降低初始化敏感性，作者引入更强的局部最优性准则。

Method: 定义 $r$-点局部最优性：任意至多 $r$ 个样本的重新分配都不降低目标函数，聚焦 $r=2$。针对穷举两点认证的 $\mathcal{O}(n^2(k^2+d))$ 计算瓶颈，证明两条结构性质：(i) D-local 最优解的任意改进型两点移动必涉及两次重分配共用的簇；(ii) 仅 certificate-defined 边界点可参与改进点对。据此提出 Boundary-Point-Screened Two-Point Local Search (BPS-2PLS)，通过边界点筛选缩减候选集并终止于两点局部最优。

Result: 理论：对固定 $k,d$ 且簇占用非消失，在有限支撑有界密度分布或高斯混合的 i.i.d. 采样下，保留候选点数 $m=\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}}(\log n)$。实验：十二个基准中十个达到最低可得平均 WCSS；子采样研究中，最大测试规模下筛选平均仅保留 0.10%–2.81% 的样本。

Conclusion: BPS-2PLS 以结构化筛选将两点局部搜索的计算代价降至对数级候选规模，实现更强的两点局部最优保证并提升解质量与初始化鲁棒性。代码已开源。

Abstract: Lloyd's algorithm and the discrete local (D-local) optimization method (Li et al., 2025) for $k$-means provide only weak local-optimality guarantees, and their solution quality remains sensitive to initialization. In this paper, we introduce $r$-point local optimality, under which no reassignment of at most $r$ samples decreases the objective function, and focus on $r=2$. The main computational obstacle is the $\mathcal{O}(n^2(k^2+d))$ cost of exhaustive two-point certification for $n$ samples in $d$ dimensions and $k$ clusters. To address this challenge, we prove that (i) every improving two-point move of a D-local optimum must involve a cluster shared by both reassignments, and (ii) only certificate-defined boundary points can participate in an improving pair. Exploiting this structure, we propose Boundary-Point-Screened Two-Point Local Search (BPS-2PLS), which terminates at a two-point local optimum. For fixed $k,d$ and nonvanishing cluster occupancy, the number $m$ of retained candidates satisfies $m=\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}}(\log n)$ under i.i.d. sampling from a bounded-support distribution with bounded density or from a Gaussian mixture. Across twelve benchmarks, BPS-2PLS attains the lowest available mean WCSS on ten. In a subsampling study, screening retains 0.10% to 2.81% of samples on average at the largest tested sizes. The code is available at https://github.com/lwl-learning/BPS-2PLS.

</details>


### [293] [Loss-Invariant Projections as Passive Probes of Learned Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06195)
*Akshay Chandrasekhar,Pavlo Melnyk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"被动探针"方法，用固定的、未训练的、与属性无关的随机投影观察训练中演化的表征，以分离表征几何变化与任务难度可及性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络学到的特征表征常包含超出最终任务输出所直接使用的结构。作者希望研究这类结构，并避免探针自身在训练中适应所研究属性，从而能区分表征本身的变化与探针的适应。

Method: 以S^2上的预测任务为动机，比较等价的向量参数化与Hermitian参数化，发现存在额外的损失不变迹坐标；据此构造通用框架，将固定随机投影作为学习特征的观测器（被动探针），因其损失不变且与所研究属性无关，可反映表征相对于固定观测器的变化；并用被动探针集成来反映目标对齐等任务相关信息。

Result: 被动探针可反映目标对齐等任务相关信息；在表面法向估计与图像修复等回归任务中，最终难度的可及性随训练增加，而在图像分类中保持接近初始水平；与学习式线性探针比较显示，可恢复性与被动可及性在训练中演化不同。

Conclusion: 被动探针能够分别刻画表征几何的变化以及最终任务难度的可及性，为分析神经网络表征结构提供了新工具。

Abstract: Learned feature representations in neural networks often contain structure beyond that directly used by the final task output. We study this structure using $\textit{passive probes}$ that apply fixed, untrained, property-independent projections to representations as they evolve during training. We motivate this approach through the task of prediction on $S^2$ where equivalent vector and Hermitian parameterizations reveal an additional loss-invariant trace coordinate. This motivates a general construction in which fixed random projections serve as observers of learned features. Because the observer is loss-invariant and independent of the property being studied, changes in accessibility reflect changes in the representation relative to the fixed observer rather than adaptation of the observer itself. We show that ensembles of passive probes can directly reflect task-relevant information such as target alignment. Under our constructions, the accessibility of eventual difficulty evolves differently across tasks. It increases during training in the regression tasks of surface-normal estimation and image inpainting but remains near its initial level in image classification. Comparisons with learned linear probes further show that recoverability and passive accessibility can evolve differently during training. Together, these results show how passive probes can separately characterize changes in representation geometry and the accessibility of eventual task difficulty.

</details>


### [294] [Structured Representation Learning for Behavior Cloning: How can we learn to safely control a nuclear power plant?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06211)
*Perceval Beja-Battais,Alain Grosset{ê}te,Nicolas Vayatis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文以压水堆负荷跟踪的行为克隆任务为案例，指出组件级精度不等于系统级安全，提出按物理时间尺度分离隐空间的结构化模仿学习架构，并将其用于热启动NMPC以实现可行性与效率的兼顾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业控制中学习模型通常以聚合精度评价，但嵌入式部署后，组件级精度无法保证系统级安全；作者希望研究这一精度与安全之间的落差，并探索学习控制器在受严格安全约束的工业系统（压水堆负荷跟踪）中的可靠使用方式。

Method: 在模仿专家NMPC策略的行为克隆任务上，提出结构化架构：将不同时间尺度的变量编码到各自独立的隐空间，以反映系统物理分解，再在乘积隐空间上训练控制器模仿专家；进行长时域 rollout 对比共享嵌入基线，并做敏感性分析以检验表征可解释性；最后用该模型热启动NMPC优化器而非独立执行控制。

Result: 长时域 rollout 中，分离嵌入同时提升精度与可行性，优于共享嵌入基线；敏感性分析显示模型学到与系统物理一致的可解释表征。但无论何种架构，独立部署仍有百分之几的轨迹不可行。以该方法热启动NMPC后，恢复完全可行性并接近最优成本，计算时间相较专家控制器减少约15%，在工况突变时减少更多。

Conclusion: 组件级精度不能保证系统级安全；物理分解式分离隐空间可改善长时域模仿精度与可行性，并提供可解释表征；独立部署的学习控制器仍难保证硬约束可行性，而将其作为NMPC的热启动可兼顾可行性、近优成本与计算加速，是更稳妥的工程落地路径。

Abstract: Learned models for industrial control are usually judged by aggregate accuracy, but accuracy at the component level does not guarantee safety once it is embedded in the system it is meant to serve. We study this gap on a behavior-cloning task: imitating an expert Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) policy for load-following of a Pressurized Water Reactor (PWR), an industrial system with tight safety constraints. We propose a structured architecture encoding variables from each timescale into separate latent spaces, reflecting the physical decomposition of the system, before training a controller to imitate the expert on the product latent space. On long-horizon rollouts, separated embeddings improve both accuracy and feasibility compared with a shared-embedding baseline. Sensitivity analysis further shows that our model yields interpretable representations aligned with the system's physics. However, standalone deployment still leaves several percent of trajectories infeasible regardless of the architecture. Using our method to warmstart the NMPC optimizer rather than acting standalone, we recover full feasibility and near-optimal cost while still cutting computation time by $\sim$15% relative to the expert controller, and even more for abrupt operating changes.

</details>


### [295] [Sampling Allocation of LinUCB: Optimal Design Limits in the Small-Gap Regime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06213)
*Yujie Liu,Vincent Y. F. Tan,Yunbei Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究小间隙情形下LinUCB的采样分配，证明其经验采样分布收敛到D-最优设计集合，并由此得到regret常数刻画与奖励参数的渐近统计推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小间隙（gap为n^{-1/2}量级）是导致最坏情形regret下界的关键困难实例，LinUCB在此近乎最优，但其自适应采样究竟如何分配样本、是否具备统计效率尚不清楚。作者希望连接regret驱动的在线学习与信息高效的实验设计。

Method: 采用平均场（mean-field）视角，用经验采样分布这一宏观对象刻画自适应决策在时域上的平均效应，并分析该分布在n→∞时的极限。

Result: 证明LinUCB诱导的经验采样分布在小间隙情形收敛到D-最优设计集合；据此刻画了渐近regret的主导常数；并证明正则化最小二乘估计量满足中心极限型定理。

Conclusion: 小间隙情形下LinUCB不仅接近最优的minimax regret，其采样分配对学习奖励参数也是渐近有效的，从而将regret优化与信息高效实验设计联系起来，并支持有效的统计推断。

Abstract: We study the sampling allocation of LinUCB in the small-gap regime, where the reward gaps are of order at most $n^{-1/2}$ over the decision horizon $n$. This scaling captures the hard instances underlying worst-case regret lower bounds, for which LinUCB is known to be near optimal up to logarithmic factors in $n$.
