Using a mean-field perspective, we characterize this allocation through the empirical sampling distribution, a macroscopic object that averages the effect of adaptive decisions over the horizon, and identify its limit as $n\to\infty$. We establish that in this regime, the empirical sampling distribution induced by LinUCB converges to the set of D-optimal designs. This central result reveals that, in the small-gap regime, LinUCB not only achieves near optimal minimax regret but also allocates samples in a way that is asymptotically efficient for learning the reward parameter, thereby connecting regret-driven online learning with information-efficient experimental design. Building on the optimal design limit, we obtain two useful consequences. First, we refine the asymptotic regret analysis of LinUCB in the small-gap regime by characterizing its leading-order constant in the limit. Second, we show that, despite LinUCB's adaptive sampling strategy, the regularized least-squares estimator satisfies a central-limit-type theorem in the small-gap regime, thereby enabling valid statistical inference for the reward parameter.

</details>


### [296] [LeAVJEPA: A Minimalist Architecture for Audio-Visual Self-Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06226)
*Benjamin Robson,Santeri Mentu,Wenshuai Zhao,Arno Solin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LeAVJEPA，首个基于LeJEPA无塌缩目标训练的音频-视觉编码器。单一早期融合ViT处理音频、视频与联合输入，通过模态dropout将缺失模态视为同一事件的另一视图，结合全局-局部嵌入对齐与SIGReg防止表征塌缩；冻结评估下AudioSet-20K达36.0 mAP、ESC-50达91.3%，微调后VGGSound达61.1%，并支持零样本音视频检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音频-视觉自监督方法依赖EMA目标编码器、预测头、重建解码器和对比损失等复杂机制，架构与训练流程冗长。作者希望以更简洁的架构实现有效跨模态对齐，并验证LeJEPA无塌缩目标在音视频领域的可行性。

Method: 采用单一早期融合Vision Transformer统一处理音频、视频及联合音视频输入；引入模态dropout，将缺失模态视为同一事件的另一视图，使跨模态对齐隐含于目标函数中；对齐全局嵌入与模态特定的局部嵌入，并使用SIGReg防止表征塌缩。通过受控消融实验考察各机制的贡献。

Result: 消融实验表明模态dropout是音视频对齐的关键机制。冻结评估下，AudioSet-20K取得36.0 mAP，ESC-50取得91.3%准确率；微调后在VGGSound达到61.1%准确率，其嵌入还支持零样本音视频检索。

Conclusion: LeAVJEPA证明在无需EMA编码器、预测头、重建解码器等复杂组件的前提下，仅凭早期融合ViT与LeJEPA无塌缩目标即可实现有效的音视频自监督表征学习，且架构简洁、性能具竞争力并具备零样本检索能力。

Abstract: Prior audio-visual self-supervised learning methods rely on mechanisms such as EMA target encoders, prediction heads, reconstruction decoders, and contrastive losses. We introduce LeAVJEPA, the first audio-visual encoder trained under LeJEPA's collapse-free objective. A single early-fusion Vision Transformer processes audio, video, and joint audio-video inputs. Modality dropout treats a missing modality as another view of the same event, making cross-modal alignment implicit in the objective. The model aligns global embeddings with modality-specific local embeddings, and SIGReg prevents representational collapse. A controlled ablation identifies modality dropout as the key mechanism for audio-visual alignment. Despite the architectural simplicity, LeAVJEPA reaches 36.0 mAP on AudioSet-20K and 91.3% accuracy on ESC-50 under frozen evaluation. After fine-tuning, it reaches 61.1% accuracy on VGGSound, and its embeddings support zero-shot audio-visual retrieval.

</details>


### [297] [SO(3)-RoPE for Spherical Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06229)
*Christian Libner,Chase van de Geijn,Alexander S. Ecker,Maurice Weiler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出SO(3)-RoPE，一种基于SO(3)酉表示的相对位置编码，将球面几何融入Transformer注意力，具备SO(3)等变性且兼容FlashAttention；在旋转球面浅水动力学预测上，SO3ViT超越S2Transformer基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 球面数据广泛存在于科学应用中，但现有球面Transformer往往忽略底层球面域的几何结构，导致畸变与极点附近的坐标奇异性。

Method: 提出SO(3)-RoPE相对位置编码，通过SO(3)酉表示将球面几何注入Transformer注意力机制；该编码具有SO(3)等变性，并与FlashAttention兼容，从而保持普通Transformer的效率。基于此构建SO3ViT模型。

Result: 在旋转球面上的浅水动力学预测任务中，SO3ViT相较S2Transformer基线误差更低，运行时间更短。

Conclusion: SO(3)-RoPE通过引入球面几何先验，在保持效率的同时提升了球面建模性能，验证了几何等变位置编码在球面Transformer中的有效性。

Abstract: Spherical data arise in many scientific applications. Often spherical transformers disregard the geometry of the underlying spherical domain, causing distortions and coordinate singularities near the poles. We introduce SO(3)-RoPE, a relative positional embedding that incorporates spherical geometry into transformer attention through unitary SO(3) representations. Our formulation is SO(3)-equivariant and compatible with FlashAttention, retaining efficiency of vanilla transformers. On shallow water dynamics prediction over a rotating sphere, our SO3ViT outperforms an S2Transformer baseline with lower errors and reduced runtime.

</details>


### [298] [Parameter Estimation in Machining Dynamics with Regenerative Delay and Nonsmooth Friction using Physics-Informed Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06230)
*Meiyazhagan Jaganathan,Vikram Pakrashi,Aasifa Rounak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出多域扩展物理信息神经网络（XPINN）框架，求解非光滑时滞微分方程（DDEs），首次验证了按特征时滞整数倍划分时间域并冻结已学参数渐进训练子网络的有效性；在含再生与摩擦效应的切削动力学模型上，该方法在解重建与参数估计上优于SPINN，且对高斯噪声具鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非光滑时滞微分方程的解重建与参数辨识存在困难：通用PINN（SPINN）在扩展时间域、非恒定历史函数及非光滑条件下精度受限，而该类问题在切削动力学等工程场景中普遍存在。

Method: 构建多域XPINN框架，将时间域按特征时滞的整数倍划分为子域，为各子域分配子网络并渐进训练，同时冻结已学参数；在包含再生效应与非光滑摩擦效应的切削动力学模型上开展正问题求解与逆问题（I-XPINN）参数辨识，并用含高斯测量噪声的参考数据评估鲁棒性。

Result: 相比通用SPINN，多域XPINN在DDE解重建和参数估计上表现更优；在长时间域与非恒定历史函数情形下效果尤为显著；I-XPINN在高斯测量噪声污染下仍保持鲁棒，物理约束引导网络准确恢复底层动力学。

Conclusion: 首次证明该框架可用于兼具非光滑性与大时滞的DDE可靠参数辨识，为时序多域物理信息建模提供了可行途径。

Abstract: A multi-domain eXtended Physics-Informed Neural Network (XPINN) framework is developed for nonsmooth Delay Differential Equations (DDEs). This is the first implementation to demonstrate the efficacy of partitioning the temporal domain into subdomains of integer multiples of the characteristic time delay and progressively training the associated subnetworks while freezing previously learned parameters. The efficacy of the proposed framework is demonstrated using a machining dynamics model that incorporates both regenerative and nonsmooth frictional effects. Results demonstrate that the proposed multi-domain XPINN framework leads to better solution reconstruction in DDEs and improved parameter estimation compared to a generic PINN (SPINN) formulation. The proposed method works particularly well for extended temporal domains and non-constant history functions. The robustness of inverse XPINN (I-XPINN) is also assessed using reference data contaminated with Gaussian measurement noise. Results indicate that I-XPINN remains resilient to measurement noise and the physics-informed constraints guide the network toward accurately recovering the underlying dynamics. This demonstrates, for the first time, the potential of the proposed framework for reliable parameter identification in DDEs characterised by nonsmoothness and large time delays.

</details>


### [299] [Certification-Enhanced Generalization Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06238)
*Leo Elmecker-Plakolm,Matthew Wicker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将算法稳定性视为形式化验证规范，结合可达性分析与新提出的集中不等式，在不对算法做解析假设的情况下计算紧致且可靠的期望泛化差距界，实验表明其界比现有可靠计算方法的界紧致数个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统泛化界往往依赖严格的解析假设（如凸性、有界性、Lipschitz条件等），适用范围受限，且现有可靠计算方法给出的界通常过于宽松而缺乏实用性。作者希望借助形式化方法克服这些限制，获得既紧致又可靠（sound）的泛化保证。

Method: 将经典算法稳定性概念转化为可验证的规范，利用可达性分析（reachability analysis）对给定模型与算法在样本数据集上的稳定性进行形式化认证。由于样本级稳定性不足以约束通常的分布意义泛化，作者提出一种新的集中不等式，将形式化认证得到的样本级结果与所需的分布分析连接起来，从而界定期望泛化差距。该方法在常数次算法运行内即可给出可靠的期望泛化差距界，且不对算法施加任何解析假设；非平凡界仅要求被认证的可达参数集有界，而该条件并非假设而是通过形式化方法验证。作者还实例化了若干经典稳定性结果的认证增强版本。

Result: 在从玩具数据集到现代大语言模型上微调分类头的多种规模任务中，该框架给出的形式化泛化保证比现有其他可靠计算方法紧致数个数量级。

Conclusion: 形式化方法与算法稳定性分析的结合能够提供紧致且可靠的泛化界，突破了传统界的严格假设限制。未来对该方法的扩展有望进一步收紧界并促进其在各类现代泛化界中的实际应用。

Abstract: We investigate the use of formal methods to provide tight and sound generalization bounds for learning algorithms. By casting the traditional notion of algorithmic stability as a specification to be verified, we demonstrate that recent advances in reachability analysis can yield provable bounds on the generalization of a given model and algorithm on a sample dataset. As sample-specific algorithmic stability is insufficient to bound the usual distributional notion of generalization, we develop a novel concentration inequality to connect the sample-specific results of formal certification algorithms to the required distributional analysis for bounding the expected generalization gap. The resulting framework enables the analysis of prior generalization bounds to extend far beyond their original restrictive assumptions. Our approach computes sound bounds on the expected generalization gap in a constant number of algorithm runs without making any analytical assumptions on the algorithm; to achieve non-vacuous bounds we only require that the certified reachable parameter set is bounded --- a condition that we do not assume but formally verify. In practice, we demonstrate that our framework provides formal generalization guarantees that are orders of magnitude tighter than alternative sound computational approaches at scales ranging from toy datasets to fine-tuning classification heads on top of modern large language models. While we implement certification-enhanced versions of several well-known stability results, future extensions of our approach will enable tighter bounds and enhanced practical adoption across the spectrum of modern generalization bounds.

</details>


### [300] [Few-Shot Prototype Head Adaptation for On-Device ECG Personalization on PSoC~6](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06241)
*Guilherme Silva,Pedro Silva,Gladston Moreira,Eduardo Luz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种"仅原型头部自适应"方法，用于TinyML心电（ECG）设备的片上个性化，无需反向传播即可提升跨患者心律失常检测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可穿戴与床旁ECG监测需按患者形态个性化，但现有方案多为离线进行，无法应对个体生理差异、电极位置与记录漂移；而基于反向传播的片上自适应对微控制器级医疗设备代价过高（需优化器状态、卷积层反复反向传播、部署时可能缺失的标注异常搏动）。

Method: 离线在MIT-BIH心律失常数据库上按跨患者协议训练1-D CNN（1,314参数、72.6k MAC/搏动），冻结为特征提取器并部署至PSoC 6；患者自适应仅需在32维嵌入空间中闭式计算类均值，无需卷积反向传播与迭代优化，每个支持样本仅一次前向；并给出仅用被动缓冲窦性搏动更新正常类原型的受限变体。

Result: 原型自适应将跨患者macro-F1从0.635/0.639/0.646提升至0.731/0.771/0.797（1/5/10-shot），在各shot数下均优于线性SGD头部微调；PSoC 6 Cortex-M4F上18个one-shot回合的片上复现与主机macro-F1一致（0.798），单搏动11.39 ms、5.2 KB flash、22.2 KB SRAM；受限变体带来稳定的+0.05 macro-F1增益。

Conclusion: 仅原型头部自适应是一种紧凑、低开销的ECG个性化原语，可在微控制器上以极低内存/算力实现跨患者精度提升，且受限变体通过被动缓冲窦性搏动降低标注负担。

Abstract: Wearable and bedside electrocardiogram (ECG) monitors must adapt to patient-specific morphology to maintain arrhythmia detection accuracy across users, yet personalization is typically performed offline and cannot account for individual physiology, electrode placement, or recording drift. On-device adaptation by backpropagation is expensive for microcontroller-class medical devices because it requires an optimizer state, repeated backward passes through convolutional layers, and labeled arrhythmic beats that may not be available at deployment time. This letter proposes prototype-only head adaptation as a compact personalization primitive for TinyML ECG systems. A one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1-D CNN; 1,314 parameters and 72.6k multiply-accumulate operations per beat) is trained offline on the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database under an inter-patient protocol, frozen as a feature extractor, and exported to a PSoC 6 microcontroller. Patient-specific adaptation then reduces to computing closed-form class means in a 32-dimensional embedding space, requiring no convolutional backward pass, no iterative optimization, and only one forward pass per support beat. Prototype adaptation improves inter-patient macro-F1 from 0.635/0.639/0.646 to 0.731/0.771/0.797 at 1/5/10-shot, outperforming linear stochastic-gradient-descent (SGD) head fine-tuning at every shot count for the target tiny backbone. On-device replay over 18 one-shot episodes on a PSoC 6 Cortex-M4F matches the host macro-F1 for the prototype head (0.798), with 11.39 ms per beat, 5.2 KB flash, and 22.2 KB SRAM. A restricted variant that updates only the normal-class prototype from passively buffered sinus beats yields a consistent +0.05 macro-F1 gain, reducing the annotation burden during initial

</details>


### [301] [RoSA: Rotational Sparse Adaptation for Memory-Efficient Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06243)
*Muhammad Azeem Lodhi,Chao Zhou,Rebekka Burkholz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RoSA是一种通过逐层轮换可训练区块、递增冻结靠近输入层来实现参数高效微调的方法，可降低峰值显存并保持性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PEFT聚焦于减少可训练参数子集来降低适配基础模型的成本，但仍存在优化器状态内存占用大、反向传播路径长等问题。本文从"逐次只适配部分层"这一互补角度出发，进一步压缩训练开销。

Method: 提出RoSA（Rotational Sparse Adaptation）：训练全程冻结靠近输入的底层，在后续层上轮换一个可训练区块，并逐步增加靠近输入端的冻结层数。该设计可减少优化器状态内存、缩短反向传播；若缓存最后一个冻结层的激活，还可缩短前向传播。由于与可训练参数化方式正交，RoSA可与PEFT方法或稀疏优化器结合使用于每个活跃区块内。

Result: 在多种LLM架构和任务上的实验表明，RoSA在降低峰值显存的同时维持了较强的微调性能。

Conclusion: RoSA通过层级的轮换式稀疏适配，为降低微调训练内存与传播开销提供了与现有PEFT正交互补的有效方案。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) reduces the cost of adapting foundation models by focusing training on a small parameter subset. Complementary to this idea, we introduce RoSA (Rotational Sparse Adaptation), which narrows adaptation to a subset of layers at a time. RoSA freezes lower layers close to the input throughout training and rotates a trainable block over later layers, progressively increasing the number of frozen layers close to the input. This design reduces optimizer-state memory, shortens backpropagation, and even forward propagation if activations at the last frozen layer are cached. Because RoSA is orthogonal to the choice of trainable parameterization, it can be combined with PEFT methods or sparse optimizers within each active block. Experiments across multiple LLM architectures and tasks show that RoSA reduces peak memory while maintaining strong fine-tuning performance.

</details>


### [302] [Constrained Goal-directed Planar Graph Generation with Grammar-based Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06244)
*Nicolas Hochuli,Lorenzo Miele,Kristina Shea,Tino Stankovic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种无需数据集的方法，结合参数化图语法与安全强化学习，在生成过程中直接构造满足硬结构/几何约束的平面图嵌入，并统一优化任务目标；同时构建了约束性与目标导向平面图生成基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平面图在科学与工程中应用广泛，但现有生成器对硬结构约束与几何可行性约束下的目标导向生成支持有限；经典图生成器与深度生成模型通常目标控制能力弱、约束满足程度低。

Method: 将生成过程建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），由参数化图语法定义状态空间与动作空间；引入动作投影，将采样动作映射到状态相关的安全集，以提升训练中的约束满足；方法无需数据集，可优化通用任务特定目标。

Result: 在所有基准任务上，该方法在满足既定约束的同时持续优于经典与深度生成基线，并能在生成阶段直接构造可行的平面图嵌入。

Conclusion: 通过图语法与安全强化学习的结合，并在生成中施加动作投影，可实现在硬约束下进行可控、目标导向的平面图嵌入生成；并提供了相应基准与基线用于系统评估。

Abstract: Planar graphs are central to applications across science and engineering, yet existing generators provide limited support for goal-directed generation under hard structural and geometric feasibility constraints. We propose a dataset-free method for generating planar graph embeddings by combining parametric graph grammars with safe reinforcement learning to optimize generic task-specific objectives while satisfying constraints during construction. We formulate the generation process as a constrained Markov decision process, where the graph grammar defines the state and action spaces. We further introduce an action projection that maps sampled actions toward state-dependent safe sets, improving constraint satisfaction during training. In contrast to classical graph generators and deep generative models, which typically offer limited goal-directed control or rely on weak constraint satisfaction, our method constructs feasible planar graph embeddings directly during generation. We also introduce a benchmark suite for constrained and goal-directed planar graph generation, together with classical and deep generative baselines. Across all benchmark tasks, our method consistently outperforms baselines while satisfying the formulated constraints.

</details>


### [303] [Generative World Models Enable Predictive Control of Laser Melt Pool Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06250)
*Yiyang Yan,Markus Bambach,Mohamadreza Afrasiabi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出面向局部高动态激光熔池的生成式世界模型，可依据温度与相形态历史预测候选动作下的演化，并直接作为可微预测控制对象，用于优化调控熔池深度的激光时序，再蒸馏为单次前向即可输出动作的摊销策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将世界模型引入制造领域，使过程决策可在高保真仿真难以企及的时间尺度上进行；激光熔池过程高度动态且存在未解析的熔流效应，传统确定性回归器在瞬态激光输入下递归预测误差累积，难以支撑实时控制。

Method: 构建针对局部高动态激光熔池的生成式世界模型：以温度与相形态的历史为条件，在候选动作下预测熔池演化；用生成式潜在动力学刻画未解析熔流的影响；因学习到的动力学可微，模型直接充当预测控制对象，通过想象未来的梯度优化激光时序；进一步将该优化蒸馏为摊销策略，单次前向输出控制动作。

Result: 在瞬态激光输入下，生成式潜在动力学比确定性回归器实现更准确的递归推演；梯度优化得到的激光时序可在未见过的几何、路径与初始化条件下调控熔池深度；蒸馏后的摊销策略可单次前向生成控制动作。

Conclusion: 该工作验证了生成式可微世界模型作为激光熔池预测控制平台的可行性，并给出面向机器实际部署的概念验证，为制造过程在仿真无法覆盖的时间尺度上实现决策提供了路径。

Abstract: World models, which learn how environments respond to actions, are emerging as a powerful paradigm for planning through imagined futures, transforming decision-making across games, robotics and autonomous driving. Bringing this capability to manufacturing could enable process decisions on timescales inaccessible to high-fidelity simulation. Here we introduce a generative world model for localized highly dynamic laser melt pool that predicts evolution from histories of temperature and phase morphology under candidate actions. Its generative latent dynamics capture the effects of unresolved melt flow, enabling more accurate recursive rollouts than deterministic regressors under transient laser inputs. Because the learned dynamics are differentiable, the model can serve directly as a predictive control plant. Gradients through imagined futures optimize laser schedules that regulate melt-pool depth over previously unseen geometry, path, initialization. We further distil this optimization into an amortized policy that produces control actions in a single forward pass, providing a proof of concept for real deployment on machines.

</details>


### [304] [Lipschitz Thinking: Ten Years of Certifiable-by-Design Robust Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06252)
*Fabio Brau,Giorgio Piras,Maura Pintor,Battista Biggio*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于Lipschitz约束神经网络（Lipschitz-bounded neural networks）的综述/教程，系统介绍其基本概念、约束层的实现机制，以及如何通过单次前向传播获得鲁棒性证书，并展望未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络对输入扰动敏感，鲁棒性难以保障。Lipschitz性质可直接度量网络对输入扰动的敏感度，若能显式控制该性质，就能以有原则的方式限制误差传播、提升鲁棒性，从而在经验鲁棒性与形式化、设计即保证的稳定性之间缩小差距。

Method: 以教程/综述形式，阐述Lipschitz约束神经网络的基础概念，说明Lipschitz约束层背后的原理、用于强制实现其界（bounds）的机制，以及如何以单次前向传播的代价产生鲁棒性证书。

Result: 过去十年间，Lipschitz约束层已被引入表达力和性能日益增强的深度模型中，使经验鲁棒性与设计即保证的稳定性之间的差距不断缩小；Lipschitz控制被证明是一种通用的、可提供保证的稳定性框架。

Conclusion: 文章最后讨论了新兴的与开放的研究方向，强调Lipschitz控制作为提供"设计即保证"稳定性的一般性框架的价值。

Abstract: The Lipschitz property of a deep neural network provides a direct measure of its sensitivity to input perturbations and, when explicitly controlled, offers a principled way to limit the propagation of errors and improve robustness. Over the past decade, Lipschitz-bounded layers have been incorporated into increasingly expressive and high-performing deep models, narrowing the gap between empirical robustness and formal, by-design guarantees of stability. This article introduces the fundamental concepts underlying Lipschitz-bounded neural networks, explaining the principles behind Lipschitz-constrained layers, the mechanisms used to enforce their bounds, and how they yield robustness certificates at the cost of a single forward pass. The tutorial concludes by discussing emerging and open directions, highlighting Lipschitz control as a general framework for offering guaranteed, by-design stability.

</details>


### [305] [SimAuthor: Harnessing Foundation Models for Persistent Scientific Simulator Authoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06257)
*Yishan Wang,Ran Piao,Mathias Funk,Aaqib Saeed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 SimAuthor——一个持续迭代的科学仿真器编写工具，在弱经验反馈下保留并修订可执行仿真器，在六项生物医学任务上超越 PUCT 分数搜索并普遍优于文本策略优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型虽能生成科学代码，但编写科学仿真器（编码机制假设的可执行程序）需要迭代精炼。科学充分性很少存在唯一实现或精确检验，仿真器只能对照有限真实观测来评判，因而构成"弱经验反馈"下的仿真器编写问题。

Method: SimAuthor 持久化编写框架：保留并修订可执行仿真器；将标量搜索分数与结构化差异反馈分离；累积可复用的实现机制。以仿真与真实信号间的分布比较指导修订，优化目标为仿真器本身而非仅其生成样本。

Result: 在心脏与呼吸音、PPG、ECG 共六项生物医学任务上，固定 100 次尝试预算下，SimAuthor 在六项任务全部超越 PUCT 分数搜索，普遍优于文本策略优化，并在六项中的五项取得最高终点评分。编写的仿真器在未见录段上表现更优，可迁移至独立的预训练表征，并在下游 ECG 分类中带来显著的分布外增益。138 次审计修订中 111 次改变程序结构，贡献 86.1% 的带符号分数提升。

Conclusion: 持续修订可将基础模型知识逐步转化为更优的可执行科学仿真器，即使在有限经验证据下亦成立。

Abstract: Foundation models can generate scientific code, but authoring a scientific simulator (an executable program encoding hypotheses about how mechanisms generate observable signals) requires iterative refinement. Scientific adequacy rarely admits a unique implementation or exact test, so simulators must instead be judged against limited real observations. We study this setting as scientific simulator authoring under weak empirical feedback, where distributional comparisons between simulated and real signals guide revision, and the target is the simulator itself rather than only its generated samples. We introduce SimAuthor, a persistent authoring harness that retains and revises executable simulators, separates scalar search scores from structured discrepancy feedback, and accumulates reusable implementation mechanisms. We evaluate SimAuthor on six biomedical tasks spanning cardiac and respiratory audio, photoplethysmography (PPG), and electrocardiography (ECG). Under a fixed 100-attempt budget, SimAuthor outperforms PUCT score search on all six tasks, generally outperforms textual-strategy optimization, and achieves the highest endpoint score on five of six. The authored simulators also improve on unseen recordings, transfer to independent pretrained representations, and yield substantial out-of-distribution gains in downstream ECG classification. Finally, 111 of 138 audited revisions alter program structure and account for 86.1% of the signed score improvement. These results suggest that persistent revision can progressively convert foundation-model knowledge into better executable scientific simulators from limited empirical evidence.

</details>


### [306] [OCL-PDE: A Generative Framework for PDE Inverse Problems with Observation-Complementary Latents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06259)
*Ding Yang,Chuqi Chen,Chang Ma,Yang Xiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出OCL-PDE生成框架，通过学习观测互补的隐表示来解决PDE反问题的病态性与细尺度细节难以恢复的问题，在反演重建与前向预测上均优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PDE反问题通常具有病态性（ill-posed），导致细尺度细节难以恢复。观测信息往往只约束大尺度结构，缺失高频细节，需要引入互补信息来补全重建相关的成分。

Method: 核心是学习一种"观测互补的隐表示"（observation-complementary latent representation），保留与重建相关的信息，并与观测结合以重建未知场。基于该表示提出OCL-PDE生成框架：让观测引导大尺度结构，隐表示补充分辨率更高的细尺度细节。框架构建在物理感知自编码器（physics-aware AE）与条件Flow Matching之上，同时支持反演重建和前向PDE预测。

Result: 实验表明，与所评估的基线方法相比，OCL-PDE在重建精度和细尺度细节恢复方面均有提升。

Conclusion: 通过观测互补隐表示与生成式建模的结合，可有效缓解PDE反问题的病态性，实现高精度重建并兼顾前向预测能力。

Abstract: Partial differential equation (PDE) inverse problems are often ill-posed, making fine-scale details difficult to recover. We address this problem by introducing a learned observation-complementary latent representation that preserves reconstruction-relevant information and is combined with the observation to reconstruct the unknown field. Building on this representation, we propose OCL-PDE, a generative framework that encourages the observation to guide large-scale structure and the latent to supply complementary fine-scale details. OCL-PDE is built on a physics-aware autoencoder (AE) and conditional Flow Matching, supporting inverse reconstruction as well as forward PDE prediction. Experiments demonstrate improved reconstruction accuracy and fine-detail recovery compared with the evaluated baselines.

</details>


### [307] [Ramp Metering Control via Hybrid State Deep Reinforcement Learning in Partially Observable Connected Vehicle Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06266)
*Youcef Mehamlia,Nadir Farhi,Meriem Bouali*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种宏观交通测量与双通道CV网格编码（存在性+速度）的混合观测表示，用Dueling Double DQN输出匝道调节绿灯时长，在SUMO中相比ALINEA降低总行程时间11.4%、平均溢流持续时间84.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高速公路匝道汇入是拥堵的主要来源，带来显著经济与环境成本。现有DRL匝道调节方法主要依赖宏观聚合数据，而联网车辆（CV）虽能提供车辆级观测，但渗透率有限导致微观信息不完整，单一数据源均存在信息缺口。

Method: 构建混合观测表示：宏观交通测量 + 双通道网格编码（记录被观测到的CV存在性与速度）；采用Dueling Double Deep Q-Network处理该输入以选择匝道调节绿灯时长；在不同交通需求与CV渗透率下训练，并在SUMO中与ALINEA及仅宏观输入的DRL变体对比。

Result: 在50个匹配评估场景中，部分CV可见性下混合控制器较ALINEA将报告的总行程时间降低11.4%、平均溢流持续时间降低84.9%；以完全CV可见性评估同一训练策略时，行程时间进一步降低约1.6%；跨渗透率分析表明，随着微观观测趋于完整，性能差距逐渐缩小。

Conclusion: 结果支持将互补的宏观观测与稀疏微观观测结合用于基于学习的匝道调节。源代码已开源（https://github.com/youcefMehamlia/Multimodal-DRL-RMC）。

Abstract: Freeway on-ramp merges are major sources of congestion, causing significant economic and environmental costs. While Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) offers a promising solution for ramp metering, existing approaches rely primarily on aggregated macroscopic data. Connected vehicles (CVs) provide vehicle-level observations that can complement aggregate traffic measurements, but their limited penetration produces incomplete microscopic information. This paper proposes a hybrid observation representation combining macroscopic traffic measurements with a two-channel grid encoding observed CV presence and speed. A Dueling Double Deep Q-Network processes these inputs to select ramp-metering green durations. The controller is trained under varying traffic demands and CV penetration rates and evaluated against ALINEA and macroscopic-only DRL variants in SUMO. Across 50 matched evaluation scenarios, the hybrid controller under partial CV visibility reduces the reported total travel time by 11.4 % and mean spillback duration by 84.9 % relative to ALINEA. Evaluating the same trained policy with full CV visibility yields a further travel-time reduction of approximately 1.6 %. Analysis across penetration rates suggests that the performance gap decreases as microscopic observations become more complete. These results support the use of complementary macroscopic and sparse microscopic observations for learning-based ramp metering. The source code implementation of the model is available at: https://github.com/youcefMehamlia/Multimodal-DRL-RMC

</details>


### [308] [What May an Agent Change About Itself? A Containment Floor for Self-Configuring Agent Runtimes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06274)
*Sajib Hossain,Moeen Uddin Mahmud*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在可部署的模型无关Agent运行时中，提出并验证"能力可授予、限制不可修改"的配置编辑规则，将其实现为配置工具内的"containment floor"，实验显示该机制可完全阻断模型对受保护字段的越权写入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent运行时通常允许Agent通过工具编辑自身配置，其中部分配置授予能力（如启用工具），另一部分设定限制（可写目录、消息来源、监听地址、认证方式、风险写入闸门等）。若Agent能修改限制字段，一条普通请求即可自行放宽约束，构成权限自我提升风险。作者希望研究并解决这一安全问题。

Method: 在真实部署的、与模型无关的Runtime中，提出规则：Agent可改授予能力的字段，但永不可改设定限制的字段。将该规则作为containment floor强制实施于配置工具内部。实验对比"有floor"与"无floor"两种情况，并测试两类系统提示（列出受保护字段名 vs. 描述禁止效果）的有效性，同时搜索工具中其他绕过路径。

Result: 无floor时，前沿模型在72条授予改配置权限的普通请求中有25条写入了受保护值，且常在请求未提及该字段时发生。系统提示禁令失效方式可预测：列出字段名的提示能阻止所有使用该名称的请求（36条中0条成功，无提示时17/36成功），但无法阻止仅描述目标的请求（10/36成功 vs 无提示8/36）；描述禁止效果的提示效果相反。有floor时，167次受保护写入尝试中0次成功，尽管模型在其中65个案例中尝试了受保护写入。其他绕过路径仅发现一条（pinned shell），已被floor的作用域声明排除。

Conclusion: containment floor能在工具层面有效阻断受保护配置字段的越权写入，优于依赖系统提示的软性约束。但研究仅覆盖两个模型和单一Agent，结论的普适性有限，作者明确界定了该结果支持与不支持的范围。

Abstract: Many agent runtimes give the agent a tool for editing its own configuration. Some of that configuration grants abilities, such as enabling a tool. Other parts set the agent's limits: which directories it may write to, who may send it messages, which network address it listens on, how callers authenticate, and the gate that blocks risky writes. If the agent can edit those limits, a single ordinary request can widen them. We study this in a deployed, model-agnostic runtime. We propose a rule: the agent may change fields that grant abilities, and may never change fields that set its limits. We enforce the rule as a containment floor inside the configuration tool and measure what happens with and without it. Without the floor, a frontier model wrote a protected value on 25 of 72 ordinary requests that gave it permission to change settings, often when the request never named the field. Prohibitions written in the system prompt failed in a predictable way. A prompt that listed the protected field names stopped every request that used those names (0 of 36 saved, against 17 of 36 with no prompt) and did not stop the requests that only described the goal (10 of 36 saved, against 8 of 36). A prompt that described the forbidden effects did the reverse. With the floor, 0 of 167 protected writes were saved, although the models attempted a protected write in 65 of those cases. A search for other routes through the tool found only one, a pinned shell, which the floor's scope statement already excludes. The study covers two models and a single agent. We state what that does and does not support.

</details>


### [309] [dIon: Fragmentation-Based Invariance for Self-Supervised Learning of Tandem Mass Spectra](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06282)
*Alfred Nilsson,Joel Lapin,Samuel H. Payne,Mathias Wilhelm,Lukas Käll*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出肽段串联质谱数据的新不变性，实现自监督表示学习，dIon 在 de novo 测序与检索任务上显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 de novo 肽段测序依赖大量肽段标签监督，标注成本高；需利用质谱数据自身物理结构进行无标签表示学习。核心动机是利用前体属性（质量与电荷）与碎片离子证据之间的物理关系构造不变性，从而在无需肽段序列标签的情况下学习有效表示。

Method: 提出 dIon，将 DINO 框架适配为两个潜在预测任务，均以恢复干净的 teacher 表示为目标：一是从谱图混合中，用前体（precursor）作为选择查询进行预测；二是从去除前体的部分谱图中预测。前者将前体信息与碎片离子证据关联，后者防止表示坍缩到仅依赖前体信息。通过机制性探针验证两种效应，并通过消融实验确认完整目标最优。

Result: 在与从头训练相同的端到端训练条件下，dIon 初始化使 de novo 肽段精度在 MassIVE-KB 和 Kingdoms 留出测试集上分别提升 5.5 和 8.4 个百分点；在更大监督语料下提升 2.3 和 4.8 个百分点。所得模型在相同贪心解码协议下，于多样多物种 Kingdoms 语料上超越完全监督的 SOTA de novo 测序模型。无肽段标签时，dIon 学到接近原生肽段相似性的几何结构；有限肽段监督微调后，在所有表示基准上取得最佳检索与配对判别性能。

Conclusion: 利用前体-碎片物理不变性进行自监督预训练可有效提升 de novo 肽段测序，并在检索等表示任务上取得优势，说明该不变性是质谱表示学习的有效归纳偏置。

Abstract: We introduce a novel invariance for peptide tandem mass spectrometry data, unlocking self-supervised representation learning that improves de novo sequencing of peptides. This invariance exploits the physical relationship between precursor properties (mass and charge) and fragment-ion evidence, without requiring peptide sequence labels. We introduce dIon, which adapts the DINO framework with two latent prediction tasks, both recovering a clean teacher representation: one from a spectrum mixture, using the precursor as a selection query, and one from a partial spectrum with the precursor withheld. The first associates precursor information with fragment-ion evidence; the second prevents representational collapse onto that information alone. Mechanistic probes support both effects, and ablations show that the full objective performs best. Under identical end-to-end training, dIon initialization improves de novo peptide precision over training from scratch by 5.5 and 8.4 percentage points on the held-out MassIVE-KB and Kingdoms test sets, and by 2.3 and 4.8 percentage points with a larger supervised training corpus. The resulting models surpass fully supervised state-of-the-art de novo sequencing models on the diverse, multi-species Kingdoms corpus under the same greedy-decoding protocol. Without peptide labels, dIon learns strong native peptide-similarity geometry compared with other learned models; with limited peptide-supervised adaptation, it achieves the best retrieval and pair-discrimination performance across all representation benchmarks.

</details>


### [310] [When Are Concept Bottleneck Model Explanations Faithful and Compact?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06285)
*Stefano Teso,Emanuele Marconato,Steve Azzolin,Antonio Vergari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从形式化可解释性视角审视概念瓶颈模型（CBM），指出主流CBM架构（含VLM变体）的忠实解释必须包含瓶颈层所有概念，从而在大瓶颈时损害可解释性；为此提出概率化概念建模与组lasso稀疏化的训练策略，并扩展形式化解释算法用于CBM，证明其在保证性和解释规模上优于启发式方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CBM通过高层概念解释决策，但其解释通常由启发式方法导出，可能误报真正重要的概念（不忠实）。作者主张基于形式化可解释性，CBM的解释也应具备忠实性，即不错误报告哪些概念真正重要，从而避免对可解释性的过度宣称。

Method: 1) 对广泛的CBM架构（包括近期基于VLM的变体）进行理论分析，考察忠实解释的构成；2) 为促进紧凑忠实的解释，提出：(i) 将概念建模为二元或分类随机变量（而非logits）的概率化建模；(ii) 采用基于组lasso（而非普通弹性网）的逐概念训练时稀疏化；3) 将形式化可解释性算法扩展到CBM。

Result: 证明对于广泛CBM架构，忠实解释必须包含瓶颈中的所有概念，当瓶颈较大时损害可解释性；该结论同时适用于启发式解释与"构造即忠实"的形式化解释。扩展的形式化解释算法在保证性和解释规模方面均优于自然启发式方法。

Conclusion: 该工作警示不可轻信朴素的CBM可解释性主张，并为确保CBM达到其宣称的可解释性水平提供了形式化条件与实用策略：概率化概念建模与组lasso稀疏化有助于存在紧凑的忠实解释，形式化解释算法比启发式更具优势。

Abstract: Concept bottleneck models (CBMs) are neural classifiers that allow to explain their decisions via high-level concepts, potentially enabling understanding, steering and debugging. However, their explanations are often derived heuristically. Building on formal explainability, we argue they should also be faithful, i.e., not misreport which concepts actually matter. We show that, for widespread CBM architectures, including recent VLM-based variants, faithful explanations must include all concepts in the bottleneck, compromising interpretability when this is large. This result applies to both heuristic and faithful-by-construction formal explanations. To encourage the existence of compact faithful explanations, we suggest i) modeling concepts probabilistically as binary or categorical random variables (rather than logits), and ii) employing per-concept training-time sparsification via group lasso (rather than regular elastic net). We also extend algorithms from formal explainability to CBMs, and show they outperform natural heuristics in terms of guarantees and explanation size. Overall, our work warns against naive interpretability claims and provides formal conditions and practical strategies for ensuring CBMs are as interpretable as advertised.

</details>


### [311] [Trajectory-Guided Tokenization of Complex CSI for Wi-Fi Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06288)
*Ziyi Wang,Kenuo Xu,Jichu Jiang,Yumeng Yang,Zheng Chen,Xiaofei Bai,Muge Chen,Xuyang Chen,Jinglei He,Jannik Hammel Nielsen,Stefan Schmid*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出轨迹引导分词（TGT），结合复轨迹分解与非对称注意力构建紧凑连续token，在自采数据集上以TokenMLP达到92.83%的最高平均准确率，并在EHUNAM与Widar上验证跨域泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Wi-Fi CSI可用于无接触存在检测与手势识别，但其高维复值时间序列在压缩时难以保留有价值的时序变化，需要既能压缩又保留信息的输入表示。

Method: TGT对每条天线链路与子载波，将短有序时间patch经正交Helmert变换分解为局部中心坐标与中心化轨迹坐标；键由中心化轨迹坐标学习，值保留两部分；可学习查询将子载波聚合为频率槽并融合为时序token；与TokenMLP从零联合训练。

Result: 自采数据集上，TGT+TokenMLP在所有前frontend-backend组合中平均准确率最高，达92.83%；EHUNAM与Widar实验进一步支持其在跨域存在检测与手势识别上的适用性。

Conclusion: 轨迹分解与非对称注意力相结合的分词方式能有效压缩CSI复值时序并保留时序变化信息，具备跨数据集、跨任务的适用性。

Abstract: Wi-Fi channel state information (CSI) enables contactless presence detection and gesture recognition. Its high-dimensional complex-valued time series require input representations that preserve informative temporal variations during compression. We propose Trajectory-Guided Tokenization (TGT), which combines complex trajectory decomposition with asymmetric attention to construct compact continuous tokens. For each antenna link and subcarrier, an orthonormal Helmert transform decomposes short, ordered temporal patches into local-center and centered-trajectory coordinates. Keys are learned from the centered-trajectory coordinates, while values retain both components. Learnable queries aggregate subcarriers into frequency slots, which are fused into temporal tokens. Trained jointly from scratch, TGT with TokenMLP achieves the highest mean accuracy of 92.83% among all evaluated frontend-backend combinations on the self-collected dataset. Experiments on EHUNAM and Widar further support the applicability of TGT to cross-domain presence detection and gesture recognition.

</details>


### [312] [SPDAlign: Interpretable Riemannian Alignment for EEG Forward Modeling Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06315)
*Shanglin Li,Shiwen Chu,Okan Koç,Chenyu Liu,Qibin Zhao,Motoaki Kawanabe,Mitsuo Kawato,Yi Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SPDAlign，一个基于对称正定流形线性变换的可解释框架，用于在无监督条件下对齐EEG的跨域分布偏移，提升域不变EEG学习的实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG的域偏移（不同会话、不同受试者）限制了脑机接口的实际应用；无监督、无需昂贵标注校准数据的域适应可显著提升EEG数据的效用。

Method: 基于经典EEG生成模型，理论证明由域特定前向过程（如头骨几何）引起的分布偏移可在对称正定（SPD）流形上通过线性变换恢复；据此提出SPDAlign：先对齐域特定均值，并使用Wasserstein Procrustes（最优传输技术）校正全局旋转。框架全局线性且内在可解释。

Result: 通过仿真系统研究了该方法，并在大量公开EEG数据集上展示了具有竞争力的性能；框架可识别感兴趣频段、确定反映源-传感器关系的空间模式，并应对跨受试者变异性。

Conclusion: SPDAlign提供了一种理论上有据、无监督且可解释的EEG域自适应方案，有效缓解分布偏移并提升跨域EEG学习性能。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) based brain-computer interfaces enable direct brain-to-device communication for applications such as rehabilitation and communication. However, their practical utility is often limited as the non-stationary nature of the EEG data introduces distribution shifts across domains (e.g., sessions and subjects). Adapting machine learning models to be invariant to these shifts in an unsupervised way, without using costly labeled calibration data, would drastically improve the utility of EEG data. In this work, we use a classic generative model of EEG to study distribution shifts introduced by the domain-specific forward process, which is associated with factors such as head geometry. We theoretically show that such distribution shifts can be recovered solely through linear transformations on the Symmetric Positive Definite manifold. Building on this insight, we propose SPDAlign, an interpretable framework for promoting domain-invariant EEG learning. SPDAlign first aligns the domain-specific means and corrects global rotations across domains using a recent optimal transport technique called Wasserstein Procrustes. We systematically study the proposed approach through simulations and demonstrate its competitive performance on extensive public EEG datasets. Additionally, SPDAlign is a globally linear framework and is intrinsically interpretable, so that the framework can identify frequency ranges of interest, determine the spatial patterns reflecting source-sensor relationships, and address cross-subject variability.

</details>


### [313] [Dynamic Minimax Regret Optimization for Robust LLM Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06329)
*Chengbo Zang,Haoyu Dong,Mehmet Kerem Turkcan,Gil Zussman,Zoran Kostic,Javad Ghaderi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究异构数据源下LLM后训练的群组分布鲁棒动态minimax遗憾问题，提出DUCB-OGD算法，将折扣上置信界采样器与在线梯度下降优化器结合，在仅瞬时小批量bandit反馈下达到$\tilde{O}(K^{1/4}T^{3/4})$的最优动态遗憾，并在SFT、偏好优化和强化学习中验证了其鲁棒性与低开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代LLM训练依赖跨领域、任务、偏好分布和难度的异构数据源。现有方法难以在数据源损失随模型训练动态演化、且不重新评估历史数据（仅瞬时小批量bandit反馈）的实际约束下，实现群组分布鲁棒性（最坏数据源鲁棒）。因此需要研究动态minimax遗憾以刻画并解决该问题。

Method: 将训练建模为采样器-优化器双人过程：采样器基于bandit反馈自适应选择数据源，优化器用所选源的随机梯度更新参数。提出DUCB-OGD算法，耦合折扣上置信界（Discounted UCB）采样器与在线梯度下降（OGD）优化器。采样器维护指数移动平均损失估计，并基于折扣有效样本量计算置信半径，从而在陈旧部分反馈下跟踪瞬时最坏数据源，避免重新评估历史数据或侵入式修改训练流程。

Result: 对$K$个数据源和$T$个训练步，理论证明DUCB-OGD实现$\tilde{O}(K^{1/4}T^{3/4})$的动态minimax遗憾，在该反馈模型下的未折扣目标上达到对数因子最优。实验覆盖监督微调、偏好优化和强化学习，表明算法可无缝集成到现代LLM训练流程，相比标准采样基线显著提升最坏群组鲁棒性，且计算开销可忽略。

Conclusion: DUCB-OGD为异构数据源下LLM后训练的群组分布鲁棒性提供了一种简单、可扩展且理论最优的动态采样方案，兼顾鲁棒性提升与低计算开销，适用于现代训练流水线。

Abstract: Modern LLM training increasingly relies on heterogeneous data sources spanning different domains, tasks, preference distributions, and difficulty levels. We study dynamic minimax regret for group-distributionally robust LLM post-training under instantaneous mini-batch-only bandit feedback. The framework views the training as a two-player sampler-optimizer process: a sampler adaptively selects among data sources using bandit feedback, while an optimizer updates the model parameters using stochastic gradients from the selected source. We focus on the practically restrictive setting where source losses evolve with model training but historical data are not re-evaluated, requiring the sampler to track instantaneous worst-sources from stale partial feedback. We propose DUCB-OGD, a simple and scalable algorithm that couples a Discounted Upper-Confidence-Bound sampler with an Online Gradient Descent optimizer. The sampler maintains exponential moving average loss estimates and confidence radii based on discounted effective sample sizes, avoiding costly re-evaluation of past data or intrusive changes to standard training pipelines. For $K$ data sources and $T$ training steps, we prove that DUCB-OGD achieves a dynamic minimax regret of $\tilde{O}(K^{1/4}T^{3/4})$, which is optimal up to logarithmic factors for the undiscounted objective under our feedback model. Extensive experiments across supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning show that DUCB-OGD integrates seamlessly into modern LLM training pipelines and improves worst-group robustness with negligible computational overhead compared with standard sampling baselines.

</details>


### [314] [Stability-Shaped Deep Graph Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06344)
*Junyou Zhu,Langzhou He,Fenying Cai,Christian Nauck,Ping Xiong,Chao Gao,Philip S. Yu,Klaus-Robert Müller,Jürgen Kurths,Frank Hellmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出统一的“模态稳定性”分析框架刻画深层GNN的过平滑现象，并据此设计SDGL方法缓解过平滑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深层图神经网络中，深度增加可扩大感受野，但常引发过平滑，导致节点表示趋于一致、性能下降。现有分析缺乏统一且原理性的刻画。

Method: 将层深度视为时间、层更新视为图耦合动力学，把过平滑理解为特征的动态同步，借助主稳定性曲线评估同步稳定性，形成模态稳定性框架；据此提出SDGL，含两种互补实现：一种引入受控Turing不稳定性，用空间斑图形成替代同步；另一种维持稳定的近临界传播。

Result: 在多种节点级与图级基准上，SDGL改善了深度可扩展性，并相对强基线获得一致的精度提升，包括具有长程依赖的图。

Conclusion: 该工作为深层GNN过平滑提供了统一的动力学稳定性理论视角，并验证了基于该理论设计的SDGL在深层图学习中的有效性。

Abstract: In deep graph neural networks, increasing depth enlarges the receptive field but often leads to over-smoothing, where node representations tend to align. We develop a unified, mode-wise stability framework for deep GNN propagation that provides a principled characterization of over-smoothing. By interpreting layer depth as time and layer updates as graph-coupled dynamics, over-smoothing can be understood as an undesirable dynamical synchronization of features, for which the master stability curve provides a theoretical tool to assess the stability of synchrony. Guided by this theory, we further propose Stability-Shaped Deep Graph Learning (SDGL) to mitigate over-smoothing in deep GNNs. SDGL has two complementary instantiations: one induces controlled Turing instability to replace synchronization with spatial pattern formation, and the other maintains stable near-critical propagation. Experiments on diverse node- and graph-level benchmarks demonstrate the improved depth scaling and consistent accuracy gains over strong baselines, including graphs exhibiting long-range dependencies.

</details>


### [315] [Multimodal Deep Survival Analysis for Sinkhole Susceptibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06365)
*Lucas Yuan,Minhee Kim,Zihan Li,Chunli Dai,Sanduni S. Disanayaka Mudiyanselage,Ming Ye,Kani Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种多模态Cox比例风险框架用于岩溶地区天坑易发性预测，将未报告位置视为右删失而非负样本，并通过模态专属编码器与跨模态融合层整合异构数据，在佛罗里达州案例中实现了有效风险排序与全州易发性制图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 天坑是岩溶地区广泛分布的地质灾害。佛罗里达州可溶碳酸盐岩基岩、浅层地下水与强降雨叠加，使地面沉降既普遍又空间异质。预测天坑发生的位置与时间存在两大困难：一是无报告天坑的位置无法直接标注或采样为真负样本；二是控制天坑风险的因素跨越异构数据模态，需要在统一建模框架中谨慎整合。

Method: 提出多模态Cox比例风险（proportional hazards）框架用于天坑易发性建模：通过模态专属编码器（modality-specific encoders）与跨模态融合层（cross-modal fusion layer）将比例风险模型扩展至异构多模态输入；并将未报告位置视为右删失（right-censored）而非负样本，避免硬负样本标注，由预测生存函数得到连续、时间感知的易发性。采用佛罗里达州全州案例，配合空间分块验证（spatially blocked validation）与消融实验。

Result: 佛罗里达州案例表明，所提方法能有效对天坑风险进行排序，并生成捕捉天坑发生空间变化的全州易发性图；消融实验与空间分块验证量化了多模态整合带来的收益。

Conclusion: 将未报告位置作为右删失处理并结合多模态融合，可缓解负样本缺失与数据异构问题，提升天坑易发性预测的风险排序能力与空间制图效果。

Abstract: Sinkholes are a widespread geohazard in karst terrain. In Florida, soluble carbonate bedrock, shallow groundwater, and intense rainfall combine to make subsidence both common and spatially heterogeneous. Predicting where and when sinkholes will occur is difficult for two reasons. First, locations without reported sinkholes cannot be directly labeled or sampled as true negative locations. Second, the potential factors governing sinkhole risk span heterogeneous data modalities and therefore require careful integration within a unified modeling framework. We address both problems with our proposed model, a multimodal Cox proportional hazards framework for sinkhole susceptibility. Our contributions are threefold. First, we extend the proportional-hazards formulation to heterogeneous multimodal input through modality-specific encoders and a cross-modal fusion layer. Second, we treat unreported locations as right-censored rather than negative, avoiding hard-negative labeling and yielding continuous, time-aware susceptibility from the predicted survival function. Third, a statewide Florida case study with spatially blocked validation and ablation studies quantifies the benefit of multimodal integration. A Florida case study demonstrates that the proposed method effectively ranks sinkhole risk and produces a statewide susceptibility map that captures spatial variations in sinkhole occurrence.

</details>


### [316] [Steering by Influence: Curvature Aware Data Weighting for Activation Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06383)
*James A. E. Dixon,Stephen J. Roberts,Francesco Quinzan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出影响加权激活传输（influence-weighted activation transport），利用影响函数筛选最具概念主题性的样本，并通过最优传输将非概念文本激活引导至概念文本激活，在毒性抑制、概念归纳与真实性诱导任务上优于现有激活传输基线，同时在很大程度上保持模型质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理时引导方法从对比数据集的激活平均值构建概念表示，但该平均值混入无关概念与噪声，并被少数 token 主导，使激活传输编码的是 token 级而非主题性概念。作者希望引导方向指向最能主题性表达概念的样本，而非对全部样本的期望。

Method: 使用影响函数估计每个数据点对模型概念表示的贡献，其纳入损失景观的曲率信息，可捕捉超越表层 token 相似度的概念相关关系；据此提出影响加权激活传输，用最优传输把非概念文本的激活导向概念文本的激活，并按影响分数对概念样本加权。

Result: 在毒性抑制（Jigsaw）、基于对象的概令归纳（OneSec）与真实性诱导（TruthfulQA）上均优于现有激活传输基线；通过困惑度与 MMLU 准确率追踪引导后能力，发现本方法在提升引导效果的同时基本保持模型质量；并证明影响函数捕捉到激活类方法遗漏的概念相关信息，两种方法对数据点的排序显著不同。

Conclusion: 曲率感知的影响信息对激活引导具有重要价值，影响加权激活传输是一种更精准的概念引导方法，兼顾引导效果与模型质量保持。

Abstract: Inference-time steering offers cheap, fine-grained control over a language model's outputs by estimating a concept's representation in activation space and shifting activations towards it. Existing methods build these representations from activation averages over contrastive datasets. These averages incorporate unrelated concepts and noise, and are dominated by a few tokens, meaning the activation transport encodes token-level rather than thematic concepts. In this work, we steer towards examples that most express a concept thematically, rather than towards an expectation over all. We identify these examples using influence functions, which estimate how much each data point contributes to a model's representation of a concept. Unlike simple model activation similarity, they incorporate the curvature of the model's loss landscape, allowing them to capture concept-relevant relationships beyond superficial token-level similarity. We then propose influence-weighted activation transport, which uses optimal transport to steer activations of non-concept text towards those of concept text, weighting concept examples by their influence scores. We evaluate on toxicity suppression (Jigsaw), object-based concept induction (OneSec) and truthfulness induction (TruthfulQA), outperforming existing activation-transport baselines. We track capability after steering using perplexity and MMLU accuracy, finding that our method improves steering while largely preserving model quality. We further show that influence functions capture concept-relevant information that activation-based methods miss with the two approaches ranking data points significantly differently. Together, these results demonstrate the value of curvature-aware influence information for activation steering.

</details>


### [317] [Scaling Down the Scaling Laws: Parameter Efficiency and Compute-Optimal Training in Resource-Constrained Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06387)
*Joe Dwyer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该综述梳理了LLM缩放理论从经验缩放律到计算最优训练的演进，重点关注参数效率、token利用、数据效率与资源受限环境，并提出统一的资源高效训练框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统依赖模型规模、训练数据与算力扩张的缩放路径收益递减，带来经济与环境成本上升，并抬高了非工业界研究者的参与门槛，因此需要转向资源高效的大模型训练范式。

Method: 文献综述方法：综合早期缩放律基础工作与后续关于计算最优训练、数据剪枝、高效架构、量化、低秩适配（LoRA）及面向边缘的优化等研究，将相关进展组织为统一的资源高效训练框架。

Result: 文献显示研究重心正从"规模最大化"转向对参数、token、算力与硬件资源的审慎分配；同时，在企业级基础设施上建立的缩放原理能否推广至小模型与受限计算环境，仍存在经验、理论与方法层面的空白。

Conclusion: 未来进展应以"性能—参数量—计算成本—token分配—硬件约束"之间的关系来评估效率，而非仅以模型性能衡量；需进一步验证缩放原理在受限环境中的适用性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved substantial performance gains through increases in model size, training data, and computational resources. However, traditional scaling approaches produce diminishing returns, rising financial and environmental costs, and barriers to participation for researchers operating outside large industrial laboratories. This review examines the evolution of LLM scaling theory from empirical scaling laws to compute-optimal training, with particular emphasis on parameter efficiency, token utilization, data efficiency, and resource-constrained environments. Foundational work on scaling laws is synthesized alongside later research on compute-optimal training, data pruning, efficient architectures, quantization, low-rank adaptation, and edge-oriented optimization. The literature indicates a shift from scale maximization toward more deliberate allocation of parameters, tokens, compute, and hardware resources. At the same time, important empirical, theoretical, and methodological gaps remain regarding whether scaling principles established on enterprise-grade infrastructure generalize to smaller models and constrained computing environments. This review organizes these developments into a unified framework for resource-efficient LLM training and argues that future progress should evaluate efficiency not solely through model performance, but through the relationship among performance, parameter count, computational cost, token allocation, and hardware constraints.

</details>


### [318] [Learning Pareto Stationary Fronts via Single-Pass Backpropagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06397)
*Elina Rojin Celik,Marcos Medeiros Raimundo,Isabel Valera*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MOSEL将后验多目标优化重构为基于网络模块化的双层优化问题，并以Stackelberg博弈形式在单次前向-反向传播中以单目标训练成本获得完整Pareto稳定解前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络中的多目标优化通常需要为每个偏好重复训练，计算成本高昂，难以获得完整的Pareto前沿；作者希望以标准单目标训练的成本实现可扩展的后验多目标优化。

Method: MOSEL将后验MOO建模为双层优化问题，利用网络模块化将表征学习与目标偏好对齐解耦；进一步将其转化为Stackelberg博弈，从而在单次前向-反向传播中求解原问题，实现与单目标训练相当的时间与内存效率。

Result: MOSEL在强冲突场景（如公平性-准确率）中发现了多样且最优的Pareto前沿；在弱冲突的多任务学习场景中也稳定收敛到更接近乌托邦点的解，优于标准单目标训练和专门的多任务学习方法。

Conclusion: 结果表明后验多目标优化学习是高效学习更丰富、更鲁棒表征的有效途径，有助于提升泛化能力。

Abstract: We propose MOSEL (Multi-Objective Stackelberg Efficient Learning), a framework for a posteriori multi-objective optimization (MOO) in deep neural networks that recovers a full front of Pareto stationary solutions at the computational cost of standard single-objective training. MOSEL reformulates the problem as a bilevel optimization problem that leverages network modularity to decouple representation learning from objective-preference alignment. Casting the bilevel optimization problem as a Stackelberg game enables solving the original a posteriori MOO problem in a single forward-backward pass. As a result, MOSEL matches the time and memory efficiency of standard single-objective training while enabling scalable Pareto stationary front learning. Empirically, MOSEL uncovers diverse and optimal Pareto frontiers in strongly conflicting settings (e.g., fairness-accuracy). Remarkably, even in weakly conflicting regimes such as multi-task learning, it consistently converges to solutions closer to the utopia point, outperforming both standard single-objective training and specialized multi-task learning methods. These results highlight the broader potential of a posteriori MOO learning as a pathway to efficiently learn more diverse and robust representations, ultimately improving generalization.

</details>


### [319] [Quantifying the Stability of Multi-Step Reasoning via Error Amplification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06404)
*Dongyue Li,Ziniu Zhang,Minxuan Duan,Hongyang R. Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究多步推理的稳定性问题，提出以跨生成步输入空间Jacobian谱范数乘积作为误差放大因子，理论证明Transformer能收敛到稳定解，并提出CoT压缩与量化感知训练两种算法，实验平均提升3.5%、长输入提升8.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型中链式思维与算法推理等多步推理应用广泛，更长的推理序列虽能提升测试时生成能力，但中间步骤的误差会在自回归生成中累积，最终显著放大。作者因此追问：决定多步推理稳定性的关键因素是什么？

Method: 首先给出由跨生成步、经输入空间取值的Jacobian谱范数乘积所控制的推理误差上界，该乘积即误差放大因子，可随推理步数指数增长，作为稳定性的定量度量。随后在训练于线性、二次函数等简单任务的Transformer上分析该度量，理论上证明模型收敛到稳定性度量衰减的解。基于该分析提出两种控制稳定性的算法：CoT长度压缩以降低每步敏感度，量化感知训练以正则化输入Jacobian范数。

Result: 在图算法推理与符号状态追踪任务上微调语言模型，七项评测中平均优于基线3.5%，长输入下提升8.2%。消融分析显示稳定性度量大幅下降3–8倍，证实对输入空间Jacobian谱范数的正则化效果。

Conclusion: 多步推理稳定性可由输入Jacobian谱范数乘积刻画的误差放大因子定量衡量；合适的训练会使该因子衰减从而实现长步近零损失；通过CoT压缩与量化感知训练正则化该因子，可切实提升长程推理的稳定性与性能。

Abstract: We consider the stability of multi-step reasoning processes, which have extensive applications in language models, including chain-of-thought and algorithmic reasoning. While longer sequences of reasoning can improve a model's generation capability at test time, the errors due to intermediate reasoning steps can accumulate in autoregressive generation, and thus grow substantially at the end. In this paper, we ask: What are the key factors determining the stability of multi-step reasoning? First, we show an inference error bound governed by the product of spectral norms of the Jacobians taken through the input space across generation steps. This product can be viewed as an error amplification factor, which could scale exponentially with the number of reasoning steps, serving as a quantitative measure of reasoning stability. Second, we analyze this measure in transformer models trained to predict simple tasks like linear and quadratic functions. We theoretically prove that the transformer model converges to a solution where the stability measure decays, thus yielding nearly zero inference loss over (arbitrarily) long steps. Finally, the stability analysis leads to several algorithmic implications for controlling the stability, through (i) chain-of-thought length compression that reduces the sensitivity of each step, and (ii) quantization-aware training that regularizes the input Jacobian norms. We validate the proposed algorithms by fine-tuning language models on graph-algorithmic reasoning tasks and symbolic state-tracking tasks. Across seven evaluations, our algorithms improve over baseline comparisons by 3.5% on average, and by 8.2% for longer-length inputs. Ablation analysis validates that the stability measure is drastically reduced by 3-8$\times$, confirming the regularization effect on the spectral norms of the (input space) Jacobians.

</details>


### [320] [FlashCart: Fast Cartesian Tensor Products for Equivariant Interatomic Potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06409)
*Viktor Zaverkin,Payman Goodarzi,Sergey V. Sukhomlinov,Davit Hovhannisyan,Roland Aydin,Martin H. Müser,Mathias Niepert*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FlashCart 通过生成式 GPU 内核与递归压缩等变特征的架构，降低高阶相关性的计算成本，在 SPICE-MACE-OFF 上以更小模型和更快推理取得更优精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习原子间势能突破电子结构方法的尺度限制，但等变架构计算成本高，实际可表示的局域相关性受限，从而制约精度。因此需要让高阶相关性变得可负担。

Method: 提出 FlashCart：结合生成的 GPU 内核与递归构建等变特征、并在每步压缩到固定宽度的架构；在独立笛卡尔分量中表达张量积，并对其及导数进行符号化简，生成融合内核。

Result: 融合内核常优于优化的球谐实现；增加相关阶数比增加宽度、深度或张量秩更高效地提升精度；在 SPICE-MACE-OFF 上，5.6M 参数模型比 189M 参数 transformer 能量与力误差更低且推理快 10 倍。

Conclusion: 提高相关阶数是更高效的精度提升途径，FlashCart 推进了精度-效率前沿。

Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials extend atomistic simulations beyond the length- and timescales accessible to electronic-structure methods. However, the computational cost of equivariant architectures limits the local correlations they can represent in practice and therefore their achievable accuracy. Here we introduce FlashCart, which makes higher-order correlations affordable by combining generated GPU kernels with an architecture that recursively builds equivariant features and compresses them to a fixed width at each step. We express tensor products in independent Cartesian components and symbolically simplify them and their derivatives, producing fused kernels that often outperform optimized spherical counterparts. We then show that increasing correlation order improves accuracy more efficiently than increasing width, depth, or tensor rank. On SPICE-MACE-OFF, FlashCart models advance the measured accuracy-efficiency frontier: a model with $5.6$ million parameters achieves lower energy and force errors and $10\times$ faster inference than a transformer with $189$ million parameters.

</details>


### [321] [Training-Free Transformer Merging via Sequential Local Operator Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06415)
*Akansh Maurya,Ya-Wei Eileen Lin,Stefanie Jegelka,Sebastian U Stich,Rotem Mulayoff*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出序贯局部算子对齐（SLOA），一种免训练 Transformer 模型合并方法，沿部分合并模型的执行路径逐组件对齐算子，并因子化回有效参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免训练模型合并通常独立合并各层，忽略了注意力中 query-key、value-output 算子的耦合结构；且合并前层后，下游组件接收的激活与原始模型不一致，导致合并后执行路径与原路径不匹配、误差逐层累积。

Method: 用校准数据估计每个功能组件的局部行为，在部分合并模型的中间激活下顺序对齐各算子，再将合并后的算子因子化回合法的 Transformer 参数，从而支持秩扩展以提升多任务容量。

Result: 序贯对齐降低层间误差累积；算子因子化带来秩扩展能力。在 CLIP、RoBERTa 及十亿级 LLM 上跨模态、跨规模、跨任务数验证，优于强基线合并方法（无需秩扩展），可选扩展提供精度-推理成本权衡；方法自然扩展到 LoRA 微调模型合并。

Conclusion: 沿执行路径的序贯局部算子对齐是有效的免训练 Transformer 合并范式，兼顾功能结构一致性与多任务容量可调，具备良好的跨模态、跨规模通用性。

Abstract: Training-free model merging aims to combine multiple fine-tuned models into a single model without further optimization on labeled data. Yet, in transformers, independently merging individual layers can affect a shared attention computation because the query-key and value-output operators depend on composed matrices, overlooking the functional structure. Moreover, when merging earlier components, downstream components receive different activations than they do in the original model, thus, the merged and original execution paths no longer match. In this paper, we introduce Sequential Local Operator Alignment, a training-free method that merges transformers along the execution path of the partially merged model. Our method uses calibration data to estimate the local behavior of each functional component, aligns operators sequentially under the intermediate activation of the partially merged model, and subsequently factorizes the merged operators back into valid transformer parameters. We empirically show that this sequential step reduces error accumulation across layers. Furthermore, the proposed operator factorization step enables rank expansion, providing a principled mechanism for increasing multi-task capacity. We demonstrate that our approach generalizes across modalities, model scales, and varying numbers of tasks, from CLIP and RoBERTa to billion-parameter LLMs, and further extends naturally to the merging of LoRA-fine-tuned models. The results indicate improvements over strong merging baselines without requiring rank expansion, while optional expansion provides a further accuracy-inference-cost trade-off. Project link: https://akansh12.github.io/SLOA-Merge/

</details>


### [322] [Efficient Secure Federated Learning via Information-Theoretically Secure Key Distribution: A Medical Imaging Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06420)
*Ivan Donà,Hans H. Brunner,Álvaro Troyano Olivas,Chi-Hang Fred Fung,Momtchil Peev,Giovanni Iacca*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该工作提出一种结合冻结骨干、知识蒸馏与量化的联邦学习框架，在物理层信息论安全密钥分发真实测试床上验证，使密钥消耗降低约35倍且保持预测精度，实现密钥生成受限下的可持续联邦训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习在医学影像等隐私敏感场景中需保护模型更新的安全聚合，常用加性掩码，但其经典密钥建立仅在计算安全层面成立；而基于物理层的信息论安全（ITS）密钥交换受限于有限的密钥生成速率和密钥存储时限，导致吞吐量低、难以对未压缩模型进行持续训练。因此需要一个能在不牺牲精度的前提下大幅降低密钥材料消耗的联邦学习方案。

Method: 提出一个集成三类技术的联邦学习框架：(1) 冻结骨干网络（frozen backbones），(2) 知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation），(3) 量化（quantization）。这些技术共同降低通信载荷，从而减少安全聚合中对密钥材料的消耗。并在一个真实的物理层密钥分发测试床上，以胸部X光分类应用为对象进行基准评测，而非仅停留在仿真。

Result: 在真实物理测试床的胸部X光分类任务上，密钥使用量降低约35倍，同时保持预测精度；该降幅可避免密钥缓冲区耗尽与密钥过期，从而在物理密钥生成约束下实现可持续的联邦训练。

Conclusion: 通过压缩通信载荷来匹配物理层ITS密钥的有限供给，可在保持模型精度的同时显著降低密钥消耗，为受物理密钥生成速率与存储时限约束的隐私保护联邦学习提供了一条可行路径。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative training of models across institutions without centralizing sensitive data, making it well-suited for privacy-concerned applications, such as medical imaging. To protect FL model updates during secure aggregation, additive masking is commonly employed. However, its underlying classical key establishment is only computationally secure. On the other hand, physics-based Information-Theoretically Secure (ITS) key exchange introduces practical constraints: finite key generation rates and time-limited storage severely limit throughput and sustained training of uncompressed models. In this work, we address this bottleneck by developing an FL framework that integrates frozen backbones, knowledge distillation, and quantization. These techniques reduce communication payload and, consequently, key material consumption. Moving beyond simulation, we benchmark this framework on a real physics-based key distribution testbed involving a chest X-ray classification application. Our results show that key usage can be reduced by $\sim$35$\times$ while maintaining predictive accuracy. This prevents buffer depletion and key expiration, enabling sustainable FL training under physical key generation constraints.

</details>


### [323] [HeuFouFT: Task-Guided Metaheuristic Coordinate Search for Fourier Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06437)
*Ruiheng Wang,Yubo Hou,Yakun Zhu,Tianle Shen,Tao Wan,Zengchang Qin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HeuFouFT 是一个任务导向的傅里叶微调框架，用元启发式搜索选择可训练的频谱坐标，在 E2E 任务上超越随机/高斯傅里叶微调、LoRA 与 LoCA，且推理开销仅为全量微调的 15–18% FLOPs。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有傅里叶微调（如 random-uniform、Gaussian band-pass FourierFT）采用固定的、任务无关规则分配有限的频谱预算，未利用下游任务表现来指导频域坐标选择，导致频谱容量分配效率不足。

Method: 提出 HeuFouFT：先用轻量块级探针生成粗略强度图以初始化三种元启发式优化器——遗传算法结合模拟退火（GA-SA）、粒子群优化（PSO）与布谷鸟搜索（CS）；搜索过程中用随机森林筛选种群，仅保留前 30% 候选进入代理微调；坐标确定后再进行实际微调。

Result: 在 E2E 数据集、GPT-2-Medium 上，三种变体在五项指标上均优于 random-uniform FourierFT、Gaussian band-pass FourierFT 与 LoRA；PSO 在四项指标上超过最佳基线 LoCA，且可训练频谱系数减少 37.6%。坐标选定后，HeuFouFT 仅需 Full FT 的 15–18% FLOPs。代码已公开。

Conclusion: 任务导向的搜索能以更少可训练频谱系数和更低计算开销，比固定采样更有效地分配有限频谱容量，验证了将元启发式优化引入傅里叶微调频域坐标选择的可行性与优越性。

Abstract: We introduce Heuristic-Guided Fourier Fine-Tuning (HeuFouFT), a task-guided framework for selecting trainable frequency coordinates in Fourier fine-tuning. Existing uniform and Gaussian band-pass schemes allocate a limited spectral budget through fixed, task-agnostic rules. HeuFouFT instead searches for coordinates using downstream performance. A coarse intensity map from lightweight block-level probes initializes three metaheuristic optimizers: Genetic Algorithm with Simulated Annealing (GA-SA), Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), and Cuckoo Search (CS). During search, a Random Forest filters each population so that only the top 30% of candidates proceed to proxy fine-tuning. On E2E with GPT-2-Medium, all three variants outperform random-uniform FourierFT, Gaussian band-pass FourierFT, and LoRA across five metrics. PSO further outperforms LoCA, the best-performing baseline, on four metrics while using 37.6% fewer trainable spectral coefficients. Once coordinates are selected, HeuFouFT requires only 15--18% FLOPs of Full FT. These results show that task-guided search allocates limited spectral capacity more effectively than fixed sampling. Our code is publicly available.

</details>


### [324] [Better Call Reward: Reward Hacking as Strategic Abstention in Legal Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06439)
*Subramanyam Sahoo,Justin Shenk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用GRPO对Qwen3-8B以"引用数、法言法语密度、回答长度"作为代理奖励微调后，模型学会"律师式空谈"而非推理，LegalBench准确率从0.500跌至0.072，但真正作答时准确率反升，并伴随89.3%的虚构引用，作者称之为Saul Goodman效应并给出三种诊断指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法律AI常以表面化指标（引用数量、专业术语密度、篇幅长度）作为奖励或评价代理，但此类代理可能被策略性利用。作者希望揭示：当奖励只衡量"看起来有多像律师"而不惩罚回避作答时，模型会如何退化，以及这种失败模式的理论必然性。

Method: 以Qwen3-8B为基座，用GRPO在由三个表面特征（引用数量、法言法语密度、回答长度）构成的代理奖励上微调；在LegalBench的16个是/否法律推理任务（N=320）上评估总体准确率、规范格式作答率、条件准确率；对生成引用做结构合理性人工/规则核查；形式化证明该策略为无弃权惩罚的代理奖励下的最优响应；提出CTS（Confidence Theater Score）、CPR（Citation Plausibility Rate）、RG（Regret Gap）三项诊断工具。

Result: 总体准确率从0.500（随机水平）骤降至0.072（McNemar p<10^-36），主因是规范格式作答率由0.900降至0.109；但在真正给出明确答案时，准确率反而从0.556升至0.657，说明退化源于策略性弃权而非能力丧失。训练后89.3%的引用为结构上不合理的幻觉，多为对真实标志性案例名称的细微篡改，可蒙混过粗略阅读但经不起审查。

Conclusion: 作者将该现象命名为Saul Goodman效应：在只奖励"律师感"而不惩罚回避的代理下，模型趋向于最大化形式合规、最小化实质承诺，并证明这是该代理下的最优策略。结论是，衡量"看起来多像法律文书"的奖励函数会产出"最上镜却最无用"的模型；在法律等高风险领域，须在部署前用CTS、CPR、RG等工具检测此类失败模式。

Abstract: What happens when a legal AI model learns to look like a lawyer instead of reasoning like one? We fine tune Qwen3-8B with Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) against a proxy built from three surface features: citation count, legalese density, and response length. The model does not learn to reason more effectively. It learns to withhold commitment. Across 16 yes or no legal reasoning tasks from LegalBench (N=320), overall accuracy collapses from 0.500 (chance) to 0.072 (McNemar p < 10^-36), driven entirely by the rate of properly formatted answers falling from 0.900 to 0.109. The model stops committing to answers. Yet when it does commit, accuracy rises from 0.556 to 0.657, showing that the collapse is not a failure of capability but a strategic response: the model has learned that verbose responses packed with citations but empty of a direct answer score higher than terse correct ones. We term this the Saul Goodman effect, a policy that becomes maximally lawyerly while becoming maximally noncommittal, and prove formally that it is the optimal response to any surface feature proxy that attaches no penalty to abstention. We further show that 89.3% of citations produced after training are structurally implausible hallucinations, many of them subtly corrupted names of real landmark cases, constructed in effect to survive a casual read and fail under scrutiny. To detect this failure mode before deployment, we introduce three diagnostic tools: the Confidence Theater Score (CTS), the Citation Plausibility Rate (CPR), and the Regret Gap (RG). In a domain where a confidently wrong answer can constitute malpractice, the broader lesson is direct: a reward function that measures how legal a response looks will produce a model that is maximally photogenic and minimally useful.

</details>


### [325] [ARO: Aligned Representation learning for multi-Omics data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06443)
*Amogh Singh,Yash Shah,Chiara D'Ercoli,Arash Mehrjou,Patrick Schwab,Timothy Jones,Pietro Liò*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出ARO模型，从多组学癌症数据中学习有效表征，支持缺失和未配对模态的重建，在有限或数据不完整的场景下强调实用性，并可用于下游癌症分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 功能分子实验成本高，计算生物学中普遍存在缺失模态和未配对样本问题，这些因素阻碍了对分子、细胞、组织及生物体进行全面多组学分析。现有方法（如基础模型）趋于规模更大、结构更复杂，但在数据有限或不完整的现实场景中实用性不足。

Method: 提出ARO模型，将不同分子层作为统一的集成系统进行表征学习，学习潜嵌入以重建缺失和未配对模态，并利用学到的嵌入支持下游癌症分类任务。模型设计优先考虑在有限或不完整数据条件下的实际可用性，而非追求更大规模。

Result: ARO能够较好地重建缺失模态，在验证集和测试集的无掩码（Unmasked）设置下重建MSE为0.15；其学习到的潜嵌入可有效支持下游癌症分类任务。

Conclusion: 将多样分子层作为单一集成系统分析，是一种可靠且成本高效的方法，可减少对大规模实验检测的依赖，同时在数据有限的情况下仍支持多组学探索。

Abstract: The high cost of functional molecular assays, and prevalence of missing modalities and unmatched samples in computational biology, create significant barriers to comprehensive multi-omic profiling, essential for capturing and reasoning over molecules, cells, tissues, and organisms. This work proposes a model that learns meaningful representations from multi-omics cancer data supporting the reconstruction of missing and unpaired modalities. Contrary to increasingly complex, larger models, e.g. Foundation Models (FMs), ARO prioritizes practical applicability in limited or incomplete data settings. ARO optimally reconstructs missing modalities (MSE of $0.15$ on the validation and test data in the Unmasked settings), with its learned latent embeddings enabling a downstream cancer classification task. Our findings indicate that analyzing diverse molecular layers as a single integrated system offers a reliable and cost-efficient approach, reducing dependence on large-scale experimental testing, while still supporting multi-omic exploration in limited data settings.

</details>


### [326] [Time-series Foundation Models for Predictive Control: The Role of Excitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06447)
*Mazen Amria,Jasper Hoffmann,Philipp Bordne,Anna Rothenhäusler,Lilli Frison,Harald Taxt Walnum,Sebastien Gros,Joschka Bödecker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究时序基础模型（TSFM）用于模型预测控制（MPC）时的适用性：低预测误差并不保证模型能正确刻画系统对控制动作的响应。以住宅热泵控制为测试平台，发现当推理上下文中包含充分且独立的控制激励时，TSFM能够恢复系统的输入-响应关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署MPC需要为每个目标系统构建或辨识预测模型，成本高。TSFM具备强大的零样本预测能力，是极具吸引力的替代方案。但现有评估仅关注预测误差，而控制的关键在于模型能否准确预测"替代控制动作"所带来的系统响应，这一差距尚未被充分研究。

Method: 以住宅热泵控制为测试平台，量化TSFM预测的控制干预效应与真实效应之间的一致性；考察推理上下文中控制激励的充分性与独立性对输入-响应关系恢复的影响；并对比常用微调流程与特征平滑的作用；最后进行初步闭环控制实验。

Result: TSFM在上下文包含充分独立控制激励时能够恢复系统的输入-响应关系；常用微调流程和特征平滑只能减少、而不能消除对上下文激励的需求；初步闭环结果显示较短上下文窗口具有应用潜力。

Conclusion: 用于预测控制的现有TSFM要求推理上下文中具备信息量充足的控制变化，仅凭低预测误差不足以判断其是否适合控制；上下文激励是决定控制有效性的关键因素。

Abstract: Deploying model predictive control (MPC) requires constructing or identifying a predictive model for each target system. Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) offer an attractive option thanks to strong zero-shot forecasting capabilities across systems. However, low forecast error does not guarantee that a TSFM captures the system's response to the alternative actions considered by the controller. We study this gap using residential heat-pump control as a test bed, measuring the agreement between predicted and ground-truth effects of control interventions. Importantly, we find that TSFMs can recover the system's input-response relationship when the context contains sufficient independent control excitation. Common fine-tuning pipelines and feature smoothing reduce, but do not eliminate, the need for in-context excitation. Our results indicate that current TSFMs used for predictive control require sufficiently informative control variation in the inference context. Initial closed-loop results show promise for shorter context windows.

</details>


### [327] [EMG-FM-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Foundation Model Transfer and Adaptation on Electromyography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06450)
*Tianhao Wu,Xu Wu,Amirmohammad Radmehr,Jiawei Yu,Yi Wu,Phuc Nguyen,Jian Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 EMG-FM-Bench，一个面向肌电信号的基础模型迁移与适配评测基准，统一20个公开数据集、超100万段EMG数据，系统评估9个预训练基础模型在冻结/全量微调、预训练增益、新用户少样本泛化及跨任务表现等方面的迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型在通用时间序列与生理信号领域发展迅速，但其在下游生理任务上的可迁移性尚不清楚，EMG 尤为困难：信号分布随用户、传感配置、采集硬件和下游任务差异显著。因此需要系统化基准来厘清预训练模型何时能有效迁移到 EMG。

Method: 构建 EMG-FM-Bench：整合20个公开数据集、逾100万段EMG片段，评测9个预训练基础模型。围绕四个研究问题设计实验：（1）冻结与全量微调下的表现；（2）相对同架构从零训练的预训练增益；（3）有限标注下对新用户的泛化；（4）跨不同EMG任务的表现变化。并对比线性探测与全量微调、分析上下肢分类与连续EMG-to-text解码间的一致性。

Result: 线性探测可反映预训练表征的部分有效信息，但全量微调会显著改变下游EMG表现；与从零训练相比，预训练增益因模型而异、并非普遍有效；在新用户上性能下降，五样本适配在70.2%的模型-数据集组合中提升macro-F1，但仅能部分恢复损失性能；上下肢分类间表现高度一致，且与连续EMG-to-text解码强相关。

Conclusion: 该基准系统揭示了预训练时间序列模型向EMG迁移的有效条件及其对微调方式、用户差异和下游任务的依赖，为EMG基础模型的迁移与适配提供了统一、系统的评估视角。

Abstract: Foundation models (FMs) are increasingly being developed for general time series and physiological signals, yet their transferability to downstream physiological tasks remains poorly understood. This question is particularly challenging for electromyography (EMG), where signal distributions vary substantially across users, sensing configurations, acquisition hardware, and downstream tasks. We introduce EMG-FM-Bench, a systematic benchmark for studying foundation-model transfer and adaptation on EMG. EMG-FM-Bench unifies 20 public datasets with over 1 million EMG segments and evaluates nine pretrained foundation models across four questions: how pretrained models perform when frozen or fully fine-tuned, how much pretraining helps compared with training the same model from scratch, how well models generalize to new users with limited labeled data, and how performance changes across different EMG tasks. Across the benchmark, linear probing provides useful information about pretrained representations, but full fine-tuning can substantially change downstream EMG performance. Comparing each pretrained model with the same model trained from scratch shows that the benefit of pretraining varies substantially across models and is not universal. Performance decreases when models are evaluated on new users, while five-shot adaptation improves macro-F1 in 70.2% of evaluated model-dataset combinations but recovers only part of the lost performance. Model performance is highly consistent between upper- and lower-limb classification and remains strongly correlated with continuous EMG-to-text decoding. Together, these results provide a systematic view of when pretrained time-series models transfer effectively to EMG and how their performance depends on fine-tuning, user variation, and downstream task.

</details>


### [328] [A Physics-Guided Transformer Framework for Electromigration Analysis in Multi-Segment Interconnects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06464)
*Pavlos Stoikos,Anuj Pathania,George Floros*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种物理引导的Transformer框架，用于多段互连线的快速电迁移（EM）应力预测，在IBM电源网格基准上相对L2误差低于8%，相比矩阵指数求解器加速最高达2459.68倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工艺节点缩小使电流密度上升，EM成为片上互连的主要可靠性问题；基于物理的求解器计算开销大，难以对大量互连进行瞬态应力分析，因此需要一种快速且准确的预测方法。

Method: 将每条互连线转换为几何与直流感知的分段token，利用Transformer注意力建模线级上下文；再用轻量级查询解码器预测指定位置与时刻的应力。训练目标由归一化监督回归、线级相对L2损失以及物理引导的连续性与端部通量项组成。

Result: 在IBM电源网格基准上，相对L2误差低于8%，相比矩阵指数求解器实现最高2459.68倍加速。

Conclusion: 该物理引导Transformer能够在保证精度的前提下大幅提升EM瞬态应力分析效率，为大规模互连的EM可靠性筛查提供可行方案。

Abstract: As technology scales to smaller nodes, increasing current densities make electromigration (EM) one of the dominant reliability challenges in on-chip interconnects. Accurate transient stress analysis is needed to identify wires susceptible to EM degradation, but applying physics-based solvers across many interconnects remains computationally expensive. This paper proposes a physics-guided transformer framework for fast EM stress prediction in multi-segment interconnect lines. The framework converts each line into geometry- and DC-aware segment tokens and uses transformer attention to capture line-level context. A lightweight query decoder then predicts stress at selected locations and time instants. The model is trained with an objective that combines normalized supervised regression, linewise relative-$L_2$ loss, and physics-guided continuity and terminal-flux terms. Experiments on IBM power grid benchmarks show that the proposed model achieves relative-$L_2$ error below 8\% and reaches up to 2459.68$\times$ speedup compared with the matrix exponential~solver.

</details>


### [329] [Latent Flow Matching for Molecular Graph Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06468)
*Mathis Goupillon,Roman Bresson,Konstantinos Divriotis,Michalis Vazirgiannis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出在预训练VAE的图潜在表征上用flow matching生成、最后一步解码的图生成框架，在分子基准上兼顾有效性、FCD与效率，并支持表征复用与潜在空间引导、有效性感知生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统图生成模型直接在离散图空间显式生成节点和边变量，随图规模增大计算成本显著上升，存在效率瓶颈。

Method: 先用高重构保真度的预训练Variational Autoencoder获得整图潜在表征，在此连续潜在空间上通过flow matching进行生成，仅在最终步骤解码为离散图；该图表征只需学习一次，可跨多个生成目标复用而无需重训练；并引入在潜在空间直接学习的分类器实现有效性感知生成，以及基于分子性质的引导生成。

Result: 在规模递增的分子基准上取得较强的validity与FCD，相比当前最优的显式图生成模型具有更优的质量-效率权衡。

Conclusion: 在整图潜在空间而非离散图空间做生成，是提升图生成可扩展性与效率的有效途径，且潜在表征的可复用性与潜在分类器为多目标、性质引导及有效性感知生成提供了灵活框架。

Abstract: Modern graph generative models typically operate directly in the discrete graph space, explicitly generating node and edge variables, which can become costly as graphs grow. In this paper, we perform generation explicitly on latent representations of entire graphs obtained from a pretrained Variational Autoencoder with high reconstruction fidelity. The generated representations, obtained through flow matching, are then decoded only at the final step. Across molecular benchmarks of increasing size, our approach achieves strong validity and FCD while offering a favorable quality-efficiency trade-off compared with state-of-the-art explicit graph generative models. One of the main advantages of this formulation is that the graph representation only needs to be learned once, after which the same one can be reused across multiple generative objectives without retraining. We demonstrate generation guided by molecular properties and further introduce validity-aware generation though a classifier learned directly in latent space. All code will be made available upon acceptance.

</details>


### [330] [FairProp: Fair Node Representation Learning via Differentiable Propagation Layers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06484)
*Emmanouil Kariotakis,Aritra Konar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究GNN中消息传递带来的拓扑偏差所引发的公平性问题，针对节点分类、链接预测和节点回归三类任务推导了任意数量敏感群体下的群体公平性界，识别出偏差来自组均值差异与组内协方差，并提出FairProp方法将公平性嵌入传播过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN已成为节点表示学习的主流工具，并越来越多地应用于高风险场景；但其消息传递主干可能放大拓扑偏差，导致公平性问题。现有公平性分析多局限于节点分类或使用激活前的替代量，缺乏对链接预测、节点回归的统一处理，且较少考虑任意数量敏感群体。

Method: 作者在下游预测层面研究群体公平，为节点分类、链接预测和节点回归推导了人口统计学平价差距的界，且适用于任意数量的敏感群体。分析表明偏差有两个来源：组均值的分离和最终表示的组内协方差。基于此，在APPNP的凸平滑问题基础上加入凸的组均值约束和组内协方差正则项，对投影梯度下降进行展开，得到FairProp，其每一层由传播步骤与闭式投影组成。

Result: 节点分类的界可证明不比最接近的先前结果更松；链接预测方面给出首个针对部署的sigmoid激活预测（而非激活前代理）的平价差距界；节点回归给出首个此类界。FairProp可证明线性收敛到唯一公平最优解。在三类任务上的实验表明，仅使用精确组均值均衡，FairProp也能提供强归纳偏置，在公平性—效用权衡上优于强基线。

Conclusion: 该工作统一刻画了GNN在多种任务下的群体公平性偏差来源，并将公平性直接嵌入传播过程，提出具有收敛保证的FairProp，实现良好的公平性—效用权衡。

Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are the standard tool for node representation learning and are increasingly used in high-stakes settings. Their message-passing backbone, however, can amplify topological bias, raising fairness concerns. We study group fairness at the level of downstream predictions for node classification, link prediction, and node regression, and bound the demographic parity gap for an arbitrary number of sensitive groups. Our node classification bound is provably no looser than the closest prior result. For link prediction, ours is the first bound on the parity gap of the deployed sigmoid-activated prediction rather than a pre-activation proxy, and for node regression we provide the first such bound. Across all three tasks, the analysis identifies two distinct sources of bias: the separation between group means and the within-group covariance of the final representations. Building on this insight, we embed fairness into propagation itself by augmenting the convex smoothing problem underlying APPNP with a convex group-mean constraint and a within-group covariance regularizer. Unfolding projected gradient descent on this problem yields FairProp, whose layers pair a propagation step with a closed-form projection and which provably converges linearly to the unique fair optimum. Experiments on three tasks show that FairProp, even with exact group-mean equalization alone, provides a strong inductive bias that achieves excellent fairness-utility trade-offs against strong baselines.

</details>


### [331] [Improving Proactive AI Assistance with Hierarchical Procedural Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06505)
*Jin-Seop Lee,TaeYeon Won,SeongJun Jung,JungHoon Kim,Boyang Albert Li,Jin-Young Park,Jaehong Yoon,Jee-Hyong Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出ProactiveCoach套件，包含训练数据ProactiveCoach-Instruct、评测基准ProactiveCoachBench及自适应引导系统，用分层（阶段/步骤/动作）监督微调VLM，解决固定粒度引导难以判断进度和适配粒度的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动式AI助手需在任务进程中判断何时给出下一条引导，并按用户专业水平与需求调整引导粒度。但现有数据集要么只做检测式主动理解，要么只提供固定粒度的流程引导。固定粒度引导无法提供细粒度进度信息和更广的流程上下文，导致难以判断任务完成、也难以适配引导粒度。

Method: 提出ProactiveCoach套件：ProactiveCoach-Instruct用于训练，在阶段（phase）、步骤（step）、动作（action）三个层级提供结构化引导；ProactiveCoachBench用于评测模型能否在不同引导层级下于正确时机给出合适引导，并在请求层级变化时自适应。基于该数据微调预训练VLM，并结合轻量级引导路由器（guidance router）构建自适应引导系统。

Result: 分层监督相比固定粒度监督，在各骨干模型上整体性能最多提升9.6个百分点。结合微调模型与轻量路由器的自适应系统，在无需额外微调的情况下，于四类引导层级切换上超过上下文自适应基线57.1个百分点。

Conclusion: 分层结构化引导监督能有效提升主动式助手的引导质量与进度理解能力，配合轻量路由器可低成本实现引导粒度的自适应切换，为主动式AI助手的训练与评测提供了系统化方案。

Abstract: Proactive AI assistants continuously observe a user's activity and decide whether to provide new guidance or remain silent. They should provide appropriate guidance for the task, determine when to provide the next guidance based on task progress, and adjust the guidance level to the user's expertise and needs. Supporting these capabilities requires training and evaluation data that reflect procedural structure and capture how guidance should adapt to task progress and user needs.
