However, existing datasets either focus on detection-based proactive understanding or provide procedural guidance at a fixed granularity. Fixed-granularity guidance provides limited information about fine-grained progress and broader procedural context, making it difficult to determine completion and adapt guidance granularity. To address these limitations, we introduce the ProactiveCoach suite, comprising ProactiveCoach-Instruct for training, ProactiveCoachBench for evaluation, and fine-tuned VLMs with an adaptive guidance system. ProactiveCoach-Instruct provides hierarchically structured guidance at the phase, step, and action levels for learning task progress and procedural context. ProactiveCoachBench evaluates whether models provide appropriate guidance at the right time across different guidance levels and adapt when the requested level changes. We fine-tune pretrained VLMs on ProactiveCoach-Instruct and demonstrate its effectiveness across backbones. Compared with fixed-granularity supervision, hierarchical supervision improves overall performance across backbones by up to 9.6%p. We further build an adaptive guidance system by combining our fine-tuned model with a lightweight guidance router. Without additional fine-tuning, our system outperforms the in-context adaptation baseline by 57.1%p across four guidance-level transitions. Our project page is available at https://jinsuby.github.io/ProactiveCoach/.

</details>


### [332] [Xaurora: Generative Weather Forecasting with Denoising Stochastic Interpolants from a Foundation Model Prior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06509)
*Eliot Walt,Miltiadis Kofinas,Nikolaj Mücke,Efstratios Gavves,Dim Coumou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将Aurora确定性大气基础模型改造为生成式集合预报模型Xaurora，提出去噪随机插值方法并引入回放缓冲区支持SDE轨迹概率化训练，以参数与样本高效的方式逼近SOTA集合预报性能，13分钟生成15天预报。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大气基础模型多为确定性模型，难以生成大集合以支持不确定性量化、极端天气风险评估与长时效预报；同时从零训练的计算开销巨大甚至难以承受。

Method: 以预训练的确定性先验模型（Aurora基础模型）为起点，将其转化为生成式集合预报模型。提出新的生成方法——去噪随机插值（Denoising Stochastic Interpolants），并结合回放缓冲区用于随机微分方程（SDE）推演，实现SDE轨迹的概率化训练。Xaurora由小型Aurora微调而来。

Result: Xaurora在全球集合预报指标上接近当前最优水平，并与大型Aurora版本具有竞争力；方法在参数与样本上均高效，能够在13分钟内生成具有预报技巧的15天预报。

Conclusion: 确定性基础模型可被高效扩展为更强的随机（生成式集合）模型，为概率化天气预报提供低成本的可行路径。

Abstract: Deep learning has revolutionised weather forecasting in recent years, especially through atmospheric foundation models, which offer competitive skill for a fraction of the computational costs of classic physics-based models. However, most existing foundation models are deterministic, limiting the generation of large ensembles for accurate uncertainty quantification, extreme weather risk assessment, and long-range weather forecasting. Furthermore, these models incur a large, often prohibitive, computational overhead to train from scratch. To address these shortcomings, we turn a pretrained deterministic prior model, namely the Aurora foundation model, into a generative ensemble-prediction model. To that end, we introduce a novel generative method, Denoising Stochastic Interpolants, combined with a replay buffer for Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) rollout, enabling probabilistic training of SDE trajectories. Our stochastic foundation model, Xaurora, is finetuned from the small Aurora version, yet it approaches the state-of-the-art on global ensemble metrics and is competitive with the large version of Aurora. Our method is parameter and sample efficient, and generates skilful 15-day forecasts in 13 minutes. Our results demonstrate that deterministic foundation models can be efficiently extended into even stronger stochastic models.

</details>


### [333] [Conditional Flow Matching for Single-Neuron Electrophysiology: Capturing Multimodal Responses Across Stimuli](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06520)
*Cameron Schofield,Luca Ghafourpour,Philip H. Wong,Costas A. Anastassiou,Richard E. Turner*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出用条件流匹配生成模型刻画单神经元电生理响应的随机性，在人类皮层中间神经元模型上复现了特征分布、放电时序与兴奋性曲线，并再现阈值附近的放电/非放电共存及去极化阻滞附近的双模态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同一刺激在同一神经元上会产生差异明显的电压响应，传统生物物理详细模型通常用大量确定性参数集合来刻画这种变异性，代价是数十万CPU小时；现有机器学习代理模型延续了"一个刺激映射到单一响应"的局限，无法表达响应的分布与多模态结构。

Method: 将单神经元电生理建模为条件生成任务：采用flow matching训练一个以输入电流为条件的速度场，从而对给定刺激生成电压响应的条件分布，而非单一确定性输出。

Result: 在两类人类皮层中间神经元的生物物理详细模型上，生成响应在电生理特征分布、脉冲时序结构和兴奋性曲线上与参考高度一致，甚至与对应人类皮层神经元的实验记录吻合；在放电阈值附近复现了同一刺激幅度下放电与非放电响应的共存，在高幅度去极化阻滞附近复现了低放电与高放电两种模态；而神经算子基线在阈值附近抑制放电、在去极化阻滞处模糊了模态间的间隔。

Conclusion: 条件生成建模（流匹配）能够以低成本捕捉单神经元电生理的随机性与多模态动态，优于确定性代理和神经算子基线，为生物物理详细模型提供可行的生成式替代方案。

Abstract: Neurons of the brain exhibit a rich repertoire of electrophysiology dynamics with the same repeated stimulus eliciting very different voltage responses from the same cell. One common approach in biophysically detailed models is to capture this variability through ensembles of deterministic parametrizations, at a cost of hundreds of thousands of CPU hours. Existing machine learning surrogates inherit the same limitation, where a stimulus is mapped to a single voltage response. We address this challenge by learning a conditional generative model for single-neuron electrophysiology, using flow matching with a velocity field conditioned on the input current. On biophysically detailed models of two human cortical interneuron types, the generated responses closely reproduce the electrophysiological feature distributions, spike-time structure, and excitability profiles, even matching the experimental recordings from the corresponding human cortical neurons. Near the firing threshold, firing and non-firing responses coexist at the same stimulus amplitude, and at high amplitudes, ensembles may split into low- and high-firing modes near depolarization block. We show that our model recovers both modes in each case, while a neural operator baseline suppresses spiking near threshold and blurs the gap between modes at depolarization block.

</details>


### [334] [WaveGSSM: Graph Wave State Space Models for Propagating Spatio-Temporal Patterns](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06540)
*Junyou Zhu,Fenying Cai,Ping Xiong,Christian Nauck,Langzhou He,Chao Gao,Jürgen Kurths,Frank Hellmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出WaveGSSM，一种二阶图状态空间模型，为每个节点维护"模式状态"与"变化率状态"两个耦合隐状态，通过图波转移在同一rollout内耦合空间传播与时间演化，在四个时序图基准和全球天气预报上取得一致最优表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时空图模型普遍采用"先空间后时间"（space-then-time）范式：先用GNN编码每个快照，再用时间模块连接表示。该设计虽有效，但未显式刻画模式如何在图上移动。作者通过实证表明，对于传播过程，即使当前场相同，若近期变化率不同，其未来演化也会不同，因此预测状态中需要显式表示"运动"信息。

Method: 提出WaveGSSM，一个二阶图状态空间模型。它在每个节点维护两个耦合的隐状态：一个表示当前模式（pattern state），一个表示其时间变化率（motion/rate of change state）。采用图波转移（graph-wave transition）机制：利用图交互更新运动状态，再用该运动状态推进模式状态，从而在单次rollout中将空间传播与时间演化耦合起来。

Result: 在四个时序图基准与全球天气预报任务上评估。WaveGSSM在时序图基准上整体取得最佳平均性能；在1至5天天气预报中，相对骨干匹配的快照模型将位势（geopotential）RMSE平均降低20.2%，同时更好地保持大尺度大气模式。

Conclusion: 显式建模运动（时间变化率）有利于时序图预测；二阶耦合状态与图波转移设计能有效统一空间传播与时间演化，在时序图与气象预报任务上优于传统"先空间后时间"的快照式骨干模型。

Abstract: Spatio-temporal graph models typically encode each snapshot with a GNN and then connect the resulting representations through a temporal module. This space-then-time design is effective, yet it does not explicitly represent how a pattern moves across the graph. We show empirically that, for a propagating process, the same present field can lead to different futures when its recent rate of change differs, motivating an explicit representation of motion in the predictive state. We introduce WaveGSSM, a second-order graph state-space model that maintains two coupled latent states at each node, one for the current pattern and one for its temporal rate of change. A graph-wave transition updates the motion state through graph interactions and uses it to advance the pattern state, coupling spatial propagation and temporal evolution within a single rollout. We evaluate WaveGSSM on four temporal-graph benchmarks and global weather forecasting. It consistently achieves the best mean performance across the temporal-graph benchmarks and reduces the geopotential RMSE by 20.2% on average for 1- to 5-day weather forecasts relative to a backbone-matched snapshot model, while better preserving large-scale atmospheric patterns.

</details>


### [335] [A Fine-Grained Analysis of the LoRA Fine-Tuning Landscape with Implications for Data Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06542)
*Bowen Zhang,Changrui Fang,Xinsong Ma,Jiaye Teng,Ziye Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LoRA-RIP这一数据相关的受限等距度量，刻画交叉熵目标在LoRA低秩方向上的条件数，证明由该常数决定的充分秩过参数化可消除虚假局部极小，从而将RIP保证推广到超出经典1/3 regime的范围，并支持固定秩预算下的数据选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA已成为参数高效微调的标准方法，但适配秩如何选择这一实际问题尚未解决：秩过小可能导致优化景观条件不良，秩过大则牺牲LoRA的效率优势；已有理论分析对该权衡指导有限，且其保证通常在较为严格的理论设定下成立。

Method: 基于非凸低秩矩阵感知的现代结果，发展更锐利的LoRA景观理论。核心观点是适配秩应取决于数据诱导的优化几何质量而非模型本身。为此引入LoRA-RIP，一种数据相关的受限等距度量，用于刻画交叉熵目标沿LoRA相关低秩方向的条件性。

Result: 证明充分秩过参数化（所需秩由LoRA-RIP常数显式确定）可消除虚假局部极小，将现有基于RIP的保证扩展到经典1/3 regime之外；该刻画进一步支持固定秩预算下的有原则数据选择。语言与视觉任务实验支持理论预测。

Conclusion: 秩与数据质量是两种相互耦合的资源，应联合考虑以实现更高效、更可靠的LoRA微调。

Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become a standard approach for parameter-efficient fine-tuning, yet a fundamental practical question remains unresolved: how should the adapter rank be chosen? An overly small rank may lead to a poorly conditioned optimization landscape, whereas an unnecessarily large rank sacrifices the efficiency that motivates LoRA in the first place. Existing theoretical analyses provide only limited guidance on this trade-off, and their guarantees are typically established under restrictive theoretical settings. We address this gap by developing a substantially sharper landscape theory for LoRA, building on modern results from nonconvex low-rank matrix sensing. Our central insight is that the appropriate adapter rank should depend on the quality of the data-induced optimization geometry, rather than on the model alone. To formalize this connection, we introduce LoRA-RIP, a data-dependent restricted-isometry metric that characterizes the conditioning of the cross-entropy (CE) objective along LoRA-relevant low-rank directions. We prove that sufficient rank over-parameterization, with the required rank explicitly determined by the LoRA-RIP constant, eliminates spurious local minima, thereby extending existing RIP-based guarantees beyond the classical 1/3 regime. This characterization further enables principled data selection under a fixed rank budget. Experiments across language and vision tasks support these theoretical predictions, showing that rank and data quality are two coupled resources that should be jointly considered for more efficient and reliable LoRA fine-tuning.

</details>


### [336] [Empirical Variational Autoencoder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06545)
*Kaede Shiohara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EVA是一种面向连续值序列的通用生成框架，基于VAE证据下界，通过从训练数据中经验学习自回归隐先验（仅需在VAE上加一个线性层），以自预测先验替代标准高斯约束，缓解先验与后验之间的隐分布差距，实现高保真序列生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统VAE中存在先验（标准高斯）与后验之间的隐分布差距（latent distribution gap），导致序列生成的祖先采样保真度受限。作者希望解决这一差距，从而提升连续值序列的生成质量。

Method: 提出Empirical Variational Autoencoder（EVA），该框架基于VAE的证据下界（ELBO），但从训练数据中经验地学习自回归隐先验（autoregressive latent priors）。实现方式仅需在标准VAE之上增加一个额外的单线性层，用自预测先验替代传统标准高斯约束。

Result: 在图像与声音合成任务上的大量实验表明，EVA在生成质量上可与自回归扩散（autoregressive diffusion）基线相竞争，同时推理速度显著更快。

Conclusion: EVA通过经验自回归隐先验有效缓解了VAE的先验-后验分布差距，为连续值序列生成提供了高保真且高效的祖先采样方案，在保真度与推理效率之间取得了良好平衡。

Abstract: We present Empirical Variational Autoencoder, a general generative framework for continuous-valued (i.e., non-vector-quantized) sequences. EVA is based on the evidence lower bound of the Variational Autoencoder (VAE) but learns autoregressive latent priors empirically from training data, which can be implemented only by an additional single linear layer on top of VAEs. By replacing the conventional standard-Gaussian constraint with the self-predicted priors, EVA significantly alleviates the latent distribution gap between prior and posterior which is typically observed in conventional VAEs, and leads to high-fidelity ancestral sampling for sequential data generation. Extensive experiments on image and sound synthesis demonstrate that EVA achieves competitive generation quality with autoregressive diffusion baselines despite its much faster inference time.

</details>


### [337] [LinearPFN: Amortized Variable Selection for Linear Models with Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06580)
*Louis Schiekiera,Max Zimmer,Christophe Roux,Manuel Arnold,Sebastian Pokutta,Fritz Günther*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LinearPFN是一种先验数据拟合的Transformer网络，将线性模型（含主效应与成对交互）的spike-and-slab变量选择后验推断进行摊销，单次前向传播即可输出后验包含概率、后验均值系数和后验预测分布，无需逐数据集拟合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Spike-and-slab回归是变量选择的标准贝叶斯形式，能给出每个候选效应的包含概率，但其成本随候选效应数指数增长，仅在预测变量较少时可精确枚举后验；否则需用模型空间上的MCMC近似，而MCMC对每个数据集都要重新运行，且在固定步数预算内可能不收敛。

Method: 提出LinearPFN：在显式指定的先验下于合成数据集上一次性预训练的先验数据拟合Transformer网络；先验经设计为共轭，使每个固定活跃效应集合的后验具有闭式解；对新数据集单次前向传播即返回后验包含概率、后验均值系数与后验预测分布。

Result: 在精确后验仍可由枚举计算的场景中，网络输出与之一致；在已发表社会科学数据集的真实预测矩阵上，结果由先验生成以已知真实活跃集，LinearPFN在选择AUC和median probability model规则下的F1上均高于五个经典基线，且在系数、交互或噪声偏离先验时仍保持领先。

Conclusion: LinearPFN通过学习摊销spike-and-slab后验推断，在保持与可枚举精确后验一致性的同时，于真实预测矩阵上优于经典基线，并具备对先验偏离的鲁棒性，为变量选择提供免逐数据集拟合的高效推断方案。

Abstract: Spike-and-slab regression is a standard Bayesian formulation of variable selection: it returns a posterior distribution over which candidate effects are active rather than a single selected subset, so that every candidate effect carries an inclusion probability. Its cost grows exponentially with the number of candidate effects, so the posterior can be enumerated exactly only when the number of predictors is small. Beyond that reach, the posterior has to be approximated, typically by Markov chain Monte Carlo over the model space, which requires a fresh run for every dataset and, within a fixed budget of steps, may fail to converge. We present LinearPFN, a prior-data fitted transformer network that amortizes spike-and-slab inference for linear models with main effects and pairwise interactions. The network is pretrained once on synthetic datasets, drawn from an explicitly specified prior, and a single forward pass over a new dataset returns posterior inclusion probabilities, posterior-mean coefficients and posterior predictive distributions with no per-dataset fitting. The prior is conjugate by design, so that the posterior for each fixed set of active effects has a closed form, and wherever the exact posterior is still computable by enumeration we verify the network's outputs against it. On real predictor matrices from published social-science datasets, with outcomes drawn from the prior so that the true active set is known, LinearPFN attains a higher per-dataset selection AUC and a higher F1 under the median probability model rule than five classical baselines. The lead holds when the coefficients, the interactions or the noise depart from the prior. Code: https://github.com/schiekiera/LinearPFN. Trained model: https://huggingface.co/schiekiera/LinearPFN.

</details>


### [338] [Separators Make Carry Propagation Learnable:The Geometry of Latent Carry in a Multiplication Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06605)
*Sama Satariyan,Raphael Cousin,G{é}rard Biau*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在4x4乘法任务上从头训练小型Llama式Transformer（无思维链）发现：输入格式决定成败，数字间插入空格标记使准确率从1%跃升至89%；进位以残差流中环形角度编码于预测槽，并通过激活修补证明其因果作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往Transformer单次前向做多位乘法常失败，且对预训练语言模型的可解释性研究显示其算术靠输入范围启发式而非显式进位。作者希望从头训练可控模型，厘清乘法能力是否可被学习、进位是否以显式机制实现，以及输入格式与内部机制的作用。

Method: 从零训练小型Llama式Transformer，在无思维链条件下学习4x4乘法；比较不同输入格式；分析输出位置的习得顺序与依赖范围；用残差流的几何分析考察预测槽中进位的编码；并用示例间激活修补（匹配列和）验证该状态的因果使用及跨列组装路径。

Result: 在数字间插入空格标记将精确匹配准确率从1%提升至89%。输出位置按进位链顺序学习，依赖范围最长的中间数字最后学会。分隔符标记（预测槽）在残差流中以环形角度编码进位输入，进位值越多样，环占用越多。激活修补显示：最佳模型某中间列在block 4之后仅修补预测槽即可转移源进位，最高达84%；其他列的进位先在相邻答案槽组装再传至自身。剩余错误几乎都是差1，与进位或循环数字编码的小误差一致。

Conclusion: 输入格式显著影响Transformer的算术学习；模型以显式、可因果验证的进位机制进行乘法，进位以环形角度编码并逐列组装；残差错误源于进位或数字编码的微小偏差。

Abstract: Transformers asked to multiply multi-digit numbers in a single forward pass often fail, and interpretability studies of pretrained language models find arithmetic solved by input-range heuristics rather than by an explicit carry. We train small Llama-style transformers from scratch on 4x4 multiplication without chain of thought and find that the input format is decisive: inserting a space token between digits raises exact-match accuracy from 1% to 89%. Output positions are learned in carry-chain order, with the middle digits, which have the longest-range dependencies, learned last. Inside the model, the separator token that predicts each digit (its prediction slot) encodes the carry-in as an angle on a ring in the residual stream; examples with more distinct carry values fill more of the ring. Activation patching between examples matched on the column sum shows that this state is causally used before the last layer: patching the prediction slot alone transfers the source carry in up to 84% of cases after block 4 for one middle column of our best model, while for other columns the carry is first assembled at the neighboring answer slot before reaching its own. Remaining errors are almost always off by one, consistent with a small error on the carry or on the circular digit code.

</details>


### [339] [Frozen Factor or Spectral Band? Disentangling Two Choices in Low-Rank LoRA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06621)
*Adnan Slimane Ali,Ayoub Belfatmi,David Ngwe Pouth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过将LoRA的"子空间选择"与"冻结哪个因子"两个决策分离，研究冻结输入因子A或输出因子B于预训练权重奇异方向（顶部/底部）对微调效果的影响。发现rank 2时冻结A（尤其顶部奇异方向）优于冻结B，优势随rank增大而减弱，且受谱位置、rank和训练条件调节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 谱变体LoRA（如MiCA）同时选择了子空间和冻结哪个因子，两者耦合导致无法厘清各自贡献。作者希望解耦这两个决策，明确因子不对称性的幅度如何依赖于谱位置、rank和训练条件。

Method: 在预训练权重的顶部或底部奇异方向上，分别冻结输入因子A或输出因子B，并对两因子分别设置学习率。在四个任务-模型对上做完整对比（rank 2），在五对任务上对比冻结B与同等预算的自由LoRA，并做单GPU复现、MLP模块组内检验、随机正交基对照等控制实验；此外在OpenBookQA/Qwen2.5-1.5B rank 16上复现PEFT的MiCA实现，并尝试训练得到的oracle输出子空间与部分warm-up。

Result: rank 2时，冻结A的同频带优势大于任一因子内部的频带差异（全部四个完整对比对）；冻结B在五对任务上落后同等预算自由LoRA 8–18个百分点；冻结A优势在单GPU复现、单个MLP模块组、等/更多可训练参数的B冻结对照以及随机正交基冻结下持续存在；因子对比随rank增大而减弱。rank 16时PEFT的MiCA在共享训练配方下落后LoRA 3.08个点。训练得到的oracle输出子空间基本消除低秩缺陷；部分warm-up的增益在三个方向种子上重复出现。因子与频带的排序为描述性结论，近似多重性审计削弱了此前若干显著性声明。

Conclusion: 结果扩展了对已知因子不对称性的认识，表明其幅度取决于谱位置、rank和训练条件。冻结A在低秩下更具优势，但该排序本质上是描述性的，而非统计上稳健的显著性结论。

Abstract: Spectral variants of low-rank adaptation (LoRA) choose both a subspace and which factor to freeze. We separate these choices by freezing the input factor A or output factor B on the top or bottom singular directions of pretrained weights, with learning rates selected separately. At rank 2, the same-band advantage of freezing A is larger than either within-factor band difference on all four task-model pairs with complete comparisons. Freezing B also trails comparable-budget free LoRA by 8-18 percentage points on five pairs spanning a formatting task and OpenBookQA. The A-frozen advantage persists in a single-GPU-model replication and within individual MLP module groups, including controls with equal or greater trainable counts for B frozen, and when A is frozen on a random orthonormal basis. The factor contrast weakens with rank. On OpenBookQA / Qwen2.5-1.5B at rank 16, PEFT's MiCA implementation trails comparable-budget LoRA by 3.08 points under a shared training recipe transferred from the MiCA paper. A trained oracle output subspace largely removes the low-rank deficit; partial warm-up gains recur across three direction seeds. The factor-versus-band ordering is descriptive; an approximate multiplicity audit weakens several earlier significance claims. These results extend known factor asymmetry by showing how its magnitude depends on spectral placement, rank and training conditions.

</details>


### [340] [Differentially Private Mixing of Public Datasets Improves Private Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06636)
*Yufei Chen,Tejumade Afonja,Anvith Thudi,Nicolas Papernot*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出首个在差分隐私下学习多公开数据集混合配比的方法，通过隐私学习低维线性模型寻找最佳预训练数据混合，用于敏感任务DP微调，在X-ray分类与语言建模上均显著提升效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DP训练常导致模型效用下降，先在有"公开"数据上预训练再在敏感数据上DP微调可缓解该问题，但效果取决于公开数据集与敏感数据的相关性。现有做法多依赖单一公开数据集，缺少自动选择与加权多公开数据集混合的隐私保护方法。

Method: 提出首个隐私学习多公开数据集混合配比的流水线：核心思想是用隐私方式学习一个低维线性模型，从而在DP约束下找到针对给定敏感下游任务的最佳公开数据集混合权重；随后用该混合数据预训练模型，再在敏感数据上进行DP微调。

Result: 在NIH ChestX-ray14上进行X-ray疾病分类：相比基线，在各隐私预算下macro AUC最多提升0.037；在ε=1时Cardiomegaly的相对AUC提升达+22.8%。在ENRON邮件数据集上做DP语言建模：使用The Common Pile（公共领域文本数据集集合）的混合预训练，相对基线混合使测试困惑度降低16%。

Conclusion: 通过隐私学习公开数据集的混合配比、再预训练与DP微调，可在多个隐私预算下显著提升DP训练模型的效用，验证了自动定制公开数据混合对敏感下游任务的可行性。

Abstract: Many machine learning applications involve sensitive data and therefore require training under differential privacy (DP). However, DP training often degrades model utility. In some cases, first pre-training the model on "public" data before finetuning with DP on the sensitive data can reduce the drop in utility. However, the success of this depends on how relevant the selected public dataset is to the sensitive data. We introduce the first pipeline that privately learns the mixture of several public datasets to pretrain on for a given sensitive downstream task. Our key insight is that we can privately find the best mixture of multiple public datasets by privately learning a low-dimensional linear model. We tested our method on the NIH dataset for X-ray classification and the ENRON email dataset for language modeling. Applying our method to find tailored mixtures of X-ray datasets to pretrain on for diseases in the NIH ChestX-ray14 dataset, we improved macro AUC by up to 0.037 across privacy budgets compared to the baselines, with gains as large as +22.8% relative AUC on Cardiomegaly at $ε=1$. For DP training on the ENRON dataset, pre-training on our mixture of The Common Pile (a collection of public-domain text datasets) decreased test perplexity by 16% relative to the baseline mixtures.

</details>


### [341] [Beyond the Model: The Critical Role of Data Filtering in Clinical Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06640)
*Noah Subedar,Colin Campbell,Wenjing Zhang,Dan Perri,Sarah Culgin,Andrew Hamilton-Wright*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文主张将临床机器学习中的过滤决策视为科学方法的一部分，而非常规预处理步骤，并呼吁构建可解释、透明的预处理流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床机器学习研究通常在建模前依赖预处理与过滤流程，而这些过滤决策会改变数据集的统计结构，可能人为地降低或提高预测任务的复杂度，进而影响研究结论的可靠性。

Method: 这是一篇立场/观点类论文，通过论证方式提出：应将过滤选择纳入科学方法的范畴，并讨论建立可解释、透明的预处理流程的必要性，使研究者能够理解特定过滤选择的依据及其对数据分布和模型性能的影响。源代码已在 GitHub 公开。

Result: 论文并未报告实证实验结果，而是提出概念性论断：过滤决策会重塑数据分布与任务难度，因此透明化的预处理流程是必要的。

Conclusion: 临床机器学习研究应把过滤等预处理决策当作科学方法的核心组成部分加以审视与记录，而非视作例行的数据清洗步骤。

Abstract: Machine learning (ML) studies using clinical data often rely on preprocessing and filtering pipelines before model development. The filtering decisions made in these pipelines can alter the dataset's statistical structure and may artificially reduce or increase the complexity of the prediction task. We argue that filtering choices should be treated as part of the scientific method rather than as a routine preprocessing step. We further discuss the need for explainable and transparent preprocessing pipelines that allow researchers to understand why specific filtering choices are made and how these choices affect the resulting data distribution and model performance. All of the source code for this work is available on GitHub.

</details>


### [342] [Considering Context: When World Models Need Context Encoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06651)
*Oleg Smirnov,Sofiane Ennadir,John Pertoft,Bjartur Hjaltason,Sara Karimi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"预测充分性"（predictive sufficiency）这一实用判据，用以量化在智能体自身诱导的访问分布下，获取环境隐上下文对下一步预测的增益，并将其分解为历史可恢复部分、需真实上下文的残差部分及有限模型带来的缺陷。基于该判据可判断何时上下文机制真正有用、何时其收益不能归因于信息缺失，从而指导上下文感知算法的机制选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于模型的强化学习中，泛化方法普遍假设智能体无法从自身经验中恢复支配环境动力学的隐上下文，因而需要外部提供。作者认为该假设缺乏检验，需要形式化并实证考察其成立条件，以判断上下文机制何时真正弥补了信息缺失、何时其作用被高估。

Method: 提出"预测充分性"度量，衡量在智能体诱导的访问分布下，接触上下文对下一步预测带来的额外信息；将其分解为历史可恢复部分、需真实上下文的残差部分，以及有限模型导致的缺陷。据此对上下文感知算法按其条件集可针对的预测风险进行分类，并在识别难度递增的多个环境中、在不同先验下进行实证检验。

Result: 预测增益空间（headroom）并不随MDP类别而变化：同一任务在不同先验下，一种设置存在预测增益，另一种设置下则与零无显著差异——此时智能体行为隐式识别出上下文，机制收益无法归因于信息缺失。在增益持续存在的情形中，学习到的状态只能部分暴露该增益，加入真实上下文仍能降低风险。

Conclusion: 作者贡献了一个实用准则，用于将上下文机制与其可获得的信息相匹配，且该准则可直接从普通训练好的智能体上估计，无需参考策略。

Abstract: Methods for generalization in model-based reinforcement learning typically assume that an agent cannot recover the latent context governing the environment dynamics from its own experience, and therefore supplies it externally. We formalize and test this assumption with \emph{predictive sufficiency}, which quantifies what access to the context adds to next-step prediction under the visitation distribution an agent induces, and separates that quantity into a history-recoverable part, a residual requiring the true context, and the deficit added by a finite model. We classify context-aware algorithms by the predictive risk their conditioning set can target and demonstrate across environments of increasing identification difficulty that the headroom does not follow the MDP class. The same task under different priors leaves predictive headroom in one setting and nothing distinguishable from zero in another, where the agent's behavior implicitly identifies the context and any benefit of such a mechanism cannot be attributed to missing information. Where headroom persists, the learned state exposes it only partially, and adding the true context still lowers the risk. Our contribution is a practical criterion for matching contextual mechanisms to the information available to them, estimated from the ordinary trained agent without a reference policy.

</details>


### [343] [The Birkhoff Geometry of Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections: Two Channels, Vertex Viscosity, and Sinkhorn as a Retraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06653)
*Xiaoyu Li,Zhizhou Sha,Chiwun Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在Birkhoff多胞体上为超连接（hyper-connections）及其流形约束版本mHC建立了几何理论：双随机混合器可分解为均值通道（等价残差网络）与差分通道（受第二奇异值压缩），并揭示Sinkhorn-logit映射为全局图册、其梯度即Fisher-Rao梯度、straight-through更新等价于熵镜像下降，理论预测了梯度流的顶点逃逸速率与Sinkhorn的局部收敛因子，实验验证了这些速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超连接将Transformer的残差流扩展为n条并行流，mHC用双随机矩阵逐层混合以约束流形。然而该设计缺乏理论解释：额外宽度为何不会随层数崩塌、Sinkhorn归一化与梯度更新有何几何意义、为何能接近置换顶点，这些均未被刻画。作者旨在给出统一几何理论，解释mHC的有效性与局限。

Method: 理论工具为Birkhoff多胞体上的几何分析。采用双随机混合器的均值-差分通道分解；利用第二奇异值σ₂刻画压缩率；将Sinkhorn-logit映射视为全局图册，推导其梯度为Fisher-Rao梯度、straight-through更新为熵镜像下降；分析logit梯度流下各元素对数变化率与到最近置换顶点距离ε的关系，并计算Sinkhorn局部收敛因子σ₂²。最后用实验验证预测速率。

Result: (1) 双随机混合器将流分解为均值通道（mHC恰为残差网络）与差分通道，后者每层以σ₂ ≤ 1 − n·min H_ij收缩，故额外宽度为具有1/(1−σ₂)层视野的衰减记忆；非负混合器中仅置换不崩塌。(2) Sinkhorn-logit映射为全局图册，其logit梯度即Fisher-Rao梯度，logit梯度流遵循平方Fisher-Rao度量，straight-through更新恰为熵镜像下降。(3) logit梯度流下各元素对数变化速率≤4n³‖∇f‖∞·ε（ε为到最近置换的距离）；梯度流以1/t速率趋近并离开顶点，而镜像下降以指数速率移动。(4) Sinkhorn局部收敛因子为σ₂²，固定迭代预算限制视野。实验证实了所预测速率。

Conclusion: mHC的额外宽度本质上是一种受σ₂控制的衰减记忆，其视野受限于1/(1−σ₂)层及Sinkhorn固定迭代预算；在非负混合器中只有置换能避免差分通道崩塌。Sinkhorn-logit参数化具有良好几何性质（全局图册、Fisher-Rao梯度、等价熵镜像下降），但梯度流仅以1/t速率逃逸顶点，而镜像下降可达指数速率。该理论解释了mHC的有效性与局限性，并为设计更优混合器提供几何指导。

Abstract: Hyper-connections widen the residual stream of a Transformer to $n$ parallel streams. Their manifold-constrained version (mHC) mixes the streams at each layer with a doubly stochastic matrix, which it computes by Sinkhorn normalization of exponentiated logits. We give a geometric theory of this design on the Birkhoff polytope. First, a doubly stochastic mixer splits the stream into a mean channel, on which mHC is exactly a residual network, and a difference channel, which each layer contracts by its second singular value $σ_2 \le 1 - n \min_{ij} H_{ij}$. Thus the extra width is a fading memory with a horizon of $1/(1-σ_2)$ layers, and among nonnegative mixers only the permutations do not collapse. Second, the Sinkhorn-logit map is a global chart, and its logit gradient is exactly the Fisher-Rao gradient. Thus logit gradient flow follows a squared Fisher-Rao metric, and the straight-through update is exactly entropic mirror descent. Third, under logit gradient flow the logarithm of each entry moves at a rate of at most $4n^3\|\nabla f\|_\infty \varepsilon$, where $\varepsilon$ is the distance to the nearest permutation. Thus gradient flow approaches and leaves the vertices only at rate $1/t$, but mirror descent moves at an exponential rate. Fourth, the local convergence factor of Sinkhorn is $σ_2^2$, so a fixed iteration budget limits the horizon. Experiments confirm the predicted rates.

</details>


### [344] [TrustmeWatcher: An Application for Workplace Micro-Sensing and Explainable Well-Being Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06657)
*Chengyu Yu,Leon Jacopo Costa,Zoja Anžur,Mohan Li,Gašper Slapničar,Daniil Kirilenko,Martin Gjoreski,Mitja Luštrek,Marc Langheinrich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TrustmeWatcher 是 TRUST-ME 项目开发的应用，整合 ActivityWatch 计算机活动采集、StreamDeck 问卷、屏幕时间仪表盘、本地 AI 预测与 XAI 解释，并支持隐私控制；论文描述其工作流及 17 名参与者的使用情况。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工作场所感知研究中，长期行为轨迹与自我报告数据的采集工具，往往与向用户返回结果的界面相互分离，导致数据采集与反馈脱节。作者希望构建一套应用将二者连接起来。

Method: TrustmeWatcher 复用 ActivityWatch 的操作系统级 watcher 采集计算机活动，并新增应用层：把行为轨迹转为可交互的屏幕时间仪表盘；同步 StreamDeck 短问卷回答；将问卷与视频高亮并排展示；把活动记录与自我报告对齐为带标签记录。以 ActivityWatch 数据为模型输入，用 AI 预测六个归一化状态分数与一个整体幸福感分数，模型本地运行，仪表盘以语义分档呈现预测，并用 XAI 帮助用户理解活动对预测的贡献。Privacy Control 允许用户暂停或恢复研究使用的摄像头与眼动仪。

Result: 交付了一个已部署的应用与研究流程，整合了活动回顾、研究数据采集、隐私控制、本地预测以及面向参与者的 XAI 评估界面，并在 17 名参与者的记录上进行了使用验证。

Conclusion: 该工作说明将数据采集与结果反馈界面统一到同一应用中的可行性，为工作场所感知研究中本地预测与 XAI 的参与者端评估提供了可复用的系统与流程。

Abstract: Workplace sensing studies combine long-running behaviour traces with self-reports, yet the tools that collect those data often sit apart from the interface that returns results. We present TrustmeWatcher, the application built for the TRUST-ME project to connect this work. TrustmeWatcher reuses ActivityWatch's OS-level watchers for computer-activity collection and adds its own application layer. It turns the collected traces into an interactive screen-time dashboard, synchronizes responses from short questionnaires completed on the StreamDeck, and presents questionnaires alongside video highlights. Activity records and self-reports are aligned into labelled records for model development. The scope of this paper is limited to ActivityWatch data as model input. Artificial intelligence (AI) uses these activity records to predict six normalized state scores and an overall well-being score. The trained model runs locally, and the dashboard presents its predictions in semantic bands. Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) helps users understand how recorded activity contributed to a prediction. Privacy Control lets users pause or resume the camera and eye tracker used by the study. We describe the workflow, its user-device and sensing-setup boundaries, and its use with records from 17 participants. The result is a deployed application and study workflow that integrates activity review, study data collection, privacy control, local prediction, and a participant-facing interface for XAI evaluation.

</details>


### [345] [What Matters for Latent Reasoning with Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06666)
*Yassine Ouali,Adrian Bulat,Georgios Tzimiropoulos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出潜空间推理的五项要求（有用性、多样性、可解释性、可精炼性、高效性），并指出现有方法难以同时满足；作者聚焦于学习潜空间中的流匹配（flow matching），提出统一配方 FLaRe，涵盖潜空间编码内容、流训练位置、答案读取方式及基于模型自身验证思路的最终训练阶段。实验表明 FLaRe 在五项要求上均优于既有潜推理方法，在算术基准上表现更佳，并以约四分之一延迟达到显式 CoT 97% 的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有潜推理方法普遍存在缺陷：从问题中学习捷径、将显式 CoT 蒸馏进权重、或逐 token 模仿显式 CoT，因此难以满足有效潜思维应具备的要求。作者希望明确有效潜思维的标准，并找到能够同时满足这些标准的方法族。

Method: 作者首先提出有效潜思维应满足的五项要求：有用性（有助于得出正确答案而非仅改变答案）、多样性（重采样产生不同推理轨迹）、可解释性（解码出的 CoT 能反映答案实际遵循的推理）、可精炼性（随推理算力增加而改进）、高效性（在相当准确率下比显式 CoT 开销更低）。随后聚焦学习潜空间中的流匹配方法，识别使其奏效的训练选择，提出简洁配方 FLaRe，覆盖潜空间编码内容与塑造方式、流的训练位置、答案读取方式，以及基于模型自身已验证思路的最终训练阶段。

Result: 针对每项要求设计的探针实验显示，FLaRe 在全部五项上均优于先前的潜推理方法；在算术基准上也优于这些方法，并以约四分之一延迟达到显式 CoT 97% 的准确率。

Conclusion: 学习潜空间中的流匹配是满足有效潜思维五项要求的合适方法族，FLaRe 作为简单配方能够同时实现有用、多样、可解释、可精炼且高效的潜推理，在准确率与延迟权衡上优于显式 CoT 和既有潜推理方法。

Abstract: Latent reasoning lets a large language model (LLM) think in a continuous space and verbalize only the answer. We argue that an effective latent thought must meet five requirements: it should be useful, helping produce the correct answer rather than merely changing it, diverse, so that resampling yields different reasoning trajectories, explainable, so that a decoded chain of thought (CoT) reflects reasoning the answer actually follows, refinable with more inference compute, and efficient, costing less than an explicit CoT at comparable accuracy. Current methods rarely meet these requirements: they learn shortcuts from the question, distill the explicit CoT into their weights, or imitate it one token at a time. We focus on flow matching in a learned latent space, the family we argue is best placed to meet them, and identify the training choices that make it work. The result is Flow-based Latent Reasoning (FLaRe), a simple recipe covering what the latent space encodes and how to shape it, where to train the flow, how to read out the answer, and a final stage of training on the model's own verified thoughts. A probe for each requirement shows that FLaRe improves on prior latent methods in all five. It also compares favorably with them on arithmetic benchmarks, while reaching 97% of the accuracy of explicit CoT at a quarter of its latency.

</details>


### [346] [Closing the Context Gap: Activation Alignment for Tabular In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06679)
*Yoel Zeldes*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出激活对齐方法，用全上下文教师指导仅用部分上下文的轻量学生模型，训练无需GPU、数秒至数分钟收敛，在38个数据集和两大表格基础模型上显著提升低数据情形下的预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型通过上下文学习依赖全部训练样本，每次前向传播都需处理所有样本，推理代价高；而简单限制上下文数量虽降低开销，却显著损失性能，因此需要在不放弃全上下文信息的前提下恢复小上下文下的预测能力。

Method: 提出activation alignment：在合成无标签数据上训练一个轻量线性变换，将使用部分上下文的"学生"模型中间激活映射到使用全部数据的"教师"模型激活，从而让模型学会在仅见子集上下文时的行为；该对齐器无需GPU，在普通硬件上数秒至数分钟即可收敛。

Result: 在TabArena的38个分类数据集上，使用TabPFN-3和TabFM两个领先表格基础模型评估，在所有上下文预算下，对齐后的学生模型相较未对齐基线均有广泛且统计显著的提升；在低数据情形下，对齐方法恢复了教师模型近一半的预测优势。

Conclusion: 该方法以低开销实现了紧凑上下文的高推理速度，同时显著缩小了与全上下文教师模型之间的性能差距，是一种实用的表格基础模型加速与性能恢复方案。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models perform in-context learning (ICL) by conditioning predictions on labeled training examples provided as context. Unlike traditional models that separate training from inference, these models must process all training examples in every forward pass, making each prediction expensive. Restricting the number of training examples reduces this cost but substantially degrades performance. Instead of discarding context, we propose activation alignment, a method that leverages the full context to teach a model how to behave when seeing only a subset. This is achieved by training a lightweight linear transformation on synthetic unlabeled data to map the intermediate activations of a data-constrained "student" (using partial context) toward those of a full-context "teacher" (using all data). Training the aligner requires no GPU and converges in seconds to minutes on commodity hardware. We evaluate on 38 classification datasets from the TabArena benchmark using the leading two tabular foundation models, TabPFN-3 and TabFM. Across all context budgets, the aligned student yields broad, statistically significant improvements over the unaligned baseline for both models. In low-data regimes, alignment recovers nearly half of the teacher's predictive advantage. The method provides a practical, low-overhead approach to achieving the inference speed of compact contexts while closing a significant fraction of the performance gap to the full-context teacher.

</details>


### [347] [Learning What to Imitate: Entropy-Aware Distribution Mixing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06671)
*Juan Garcia Giraldo,Matteo Santelmo,Eduard Durech,Imanol Schlag,Valentina Pyatkin,Antoine Bosselut*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"熵感知混合"（Entropy-Aware Mixing）：按学生预测熵对师生分布进行逐token动态插值，缓解小模型蒸馏推理轨迹时的"自信冲突"，稳定蒸馏并提升推理表现、减少遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小语言模型通常以强教师模型的推理轨迹作为学生进行后训练，以高效习得新技能。但轨迹常超出学生分布，逐token模仿会导致"自信冲突"：学生处于低熵、对某个延续高置信，却被迫模仿低概率的教师延续。这种冲突会造成泛化下降与灾难性遗忘。

Method: 提出熵感知混合：以学生预测熵为门控，对师生分布做动态逐token插值；实现凸插值与几何插值两种形式；分别用于离线轨迹生成（先经投机解码，再做SFT）与在线策略的forward-KL蒸馏。

Result: 熵感知混合能稳定蒸馏，在分布内与分布外数学推理上均有提升，且比固定教师监督更好地保留通用能力。最优熵调度依赖训练来源：离线生成轨迹偏好凹形调度（整体教师影响更大），在线策略训练偏好线性或凸形调度（教师影响集中于高熵状态）。

Conclusion: 以学生熵为门控对师生分布做逐token混合，可有效缓解自信冲突、兼顾推理能力与通用能力保持，但最优调度需结合训练来源（离线vs在线）加以选择。

Abstract: Small language models are often post-trained as students on reasoning traces from stronger teacher models to efficiently learn new skills. However, token-level imitation on traces that lie far outside the student's expected distribution often produces \textit{confident conflicts}, whereby the student is required to imitate a continuation that it deems unlikely (i.e., low-probability) despite being confident in a different continuation (i.e., in a low-entropy state). To mitigate the degradation in generalisation and catastrophic forgetting caused by these conflicts, we propose \textbf{Entropy-Aware Mixing}: a dynamic per-token interpolation of the student and teacher distributions, gated by the student's predictive entropy. We implement both convex and geometric interpolations for both offline trace generation (via speculative decoding, then SFT) and on-policy forward-KL distillation. Our results show that entropy-aware mixing stabilises distillation, improving in-distribution and out-of-distribution math reasoning while better preserving general capabilities than fixed-teacher supervision. Nonetheless, the optimal entropy schedule depends on the training source, with offline-generated traces favouring concave schedules (greater overall teacher influence) and on-policy training favouring linear or convex schedules (teacher concentrated in high-entropy states).

</details>


### [348] [BRANCH-MoE: Balance-Aware Tree Routing for Large Embedding Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06725)
*Gang Fu,Adel Javanmard,MohammadHossein Bateni,Vahab Mirrokni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 BRANCH-MoE 路由架构，将专家置于深度 log2 E 的二叉决策树叶子节点，利用指数移动平均估计节点到达流量加权均值作为分支概率中心，无需辅助负载均衡损失即可促进子树均衡利用，并在理论上刻画噪声-滞后权衡、防止路由质量坍缩，实验上在多个数据集上保持任务质量与均衡利用并降低通信开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统扁平路由（flat router）存在两个问题：一是专家利用率不均衡，二是将专家视为无结构集合，其索引不具备拓扑意义。作者希望通过树状层次化结构为专家赋予拓扑关系，同时在不引入辅助负载均衡损失的情况下实现均衡利用，并支持专家共激活与通信局部化。

Method: 提出 BRANCH-MoE：将 E 个专家放置在深度为 log2 E 的二叉决策树叶子节点。每个内部节点的分支概率以到达该节点流量的到达加权平均分数为中心，该均值用指数移动平均（EMA）估计，从而促进两个子子树的利用，且无需辅助负载均衡损失。理论分析包括：EMA 估计存在显式的噪声-滞后权衡；对线性节点映射与对数凹到达分布，证明该机制可防止路由质量坍缩；在冻结路由下，专家执行频率控制其随机梯度收敛速率；当按树前缀将专家分配到设备时，靠近根节点的置信决策可限制跨设备通信。

Result: 在 Criteo 点击率预测、Forest Covertype、HIGGS 和 YearPredictionMSD 上，以 E=16、top-4 路由和五个随机种子，将 BRANCH-MoE 与 Switch softmax、DeepSeek-V3 dynamic-bias、Skywork logit-normalized 及确定性 hash 路由进行对比。结果表明层次化路由能在保持任务质量与均衡利用率的同时，诱导出支持局部化专家共激活与降低通信的拓扑结构。

Conclusion: BRANCH-MoE 通过二叉决策树层次化路由与 EMA 分支中心机制，在不依赖辅助负载均衡损失的情况下实现专家均衡利用，并具备理论基础（防坍缩、收敛速率与通信界）。实验验证层次化路由可兼顾任务质量、均衡利用、专家共激活局部化与通信缩减。

Abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers increase model capacity without a proportional increase in per-example computation. However, conventional flat routers can yield imbalanced expert utilization and treat experts as an unstructured collection, whose indices carry no topological meaning. We introduce {\bf BRANCH-MoE}, a routing architecture that places \(E\) experts at the leaves of a binary decision tree of depth \(\log_2 E\). At each internal node the branching probability is centered on the arrival-weighted mean score of the traffic reaching that node. This mean is estimated using an exponential moving average, which promotes utilization of both child subtrees without an auxiliary load-balancing loss. We show that this moving-average estimate admits an explicit noise-lag trade-off. We prove that for linear node maps and log-concave arrival distributions, this mechanism prevents routing-mass collapse. We further establish that, under a frozen router, an expert's execution frequency controls its stochastic-gradient convergence rate, and that confident decisions near the root bound cross-device communication when experts are assigned to devices by tree prefix. We evaluate BRANCH-MoE against Switch softmax, DeepSeek-V3 dynamic-bias, Skywork logit-normalized, and deterministic hash routing on Criteo click-through-rate prediction, Forest Covertype, HIGGS, and YearPredictionMSD, using \(E=16\), top-\(4\) routing, and five random seeds. Our results show that hierarchical routing can preserve task quality and balanced utilization while inducing a topology that supports localized expert co-activation and reduced communication.

</details>


### [349] [Detecting Nighttime Anomalies from NASA Black Marble Using a Generalized Spatio-Temporally Robust Framework of Machine Leaning Ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06674)
*Srija Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种联合建模 Black Marble M 波段与 DNB 信号的机器学习框架，构建跨区域、跨季节、跨异常类别且覆盖陆海的泛化集成异常探测器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 夜间灯光数据可捕捉火灾、火山喷发、天然气放空燃烧等异常事件的热与光发射信号，但现有检测方法主要依赖热红外波段，对较弱信号的敏感性不足，亟需提升检测灵敏度与泛化能力。

Method: 联合建模 Black Marble 的 M 波段与昼夜波段（DNB）信号，采用迭代方式构建集成异常探测器；探测器在区域、季节、异常类别上具备可扩展性，并延伸至陆地与海洋；基于相关波段与探测器一致性，导出不同置信水平下的检测集。

Result: 在提高真实检测率的同时减少了虚假检测，结果显示出较强的泛化能力，可应用于自然灾害监测与能源开采场景。

Conclusion: 该框架通过多波段联合建模与集成探测策略，实现了时空稳健的异常检测，为夜间灯光异常监测提供了通用且可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: Nighttime lights from NASA's Black Marble product suite capture thermal and light emission signals from anomalous events including fires, volcanic eruptions, and gas flaring. Existing detection approaches rely primarily on thermal bands, limiting sensitivity to weaker signals. We propose a novel machine learning framework that jointly models Black Marble M-band and Day/Night Band (DNB) signals to derive a generalized, spatio-temporally robust ensemble of anomaly detectors. The framework iteratively builds detectors that scale across regions, seasons, anomaly classes, and extends over land and ocean. Detection sets at varying confidence levels are derived based on relevant bands and detector agreement. The approach improves true detection rate while reducing spurious detections and results demonstrate strong generalizability with applications in natural hazard monitoring and energy extraction.

</details>


### [350] [MatrixFormer: A Foundation Model for Matrix Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06751)
*Dwaipayan Saha,Jacob Feitelberg,Kyuseong Choi,Raaz Dwivedi,Anish Agarwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MatrixFormer，一种矩阵原生预训练Transformer，能单次前向传播为所有缺失项预测完整分布，在多个矩阵补全任务上实现零样本竞争性表现，定位为通用矩阵补全基础模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表格基础模型将矩阵补全视为逐项预测，每个目标都需重复上下文，并丢弃了矩阵的二维结构，效率低且信息利用不充分。

Method: MatrixFormer为预训练的矩阵原生Transformer，完全在合成的低秩与潜在因子矩阵上训练，覆盖多样缺失模式；单次前向传播即可为每个缺失项输出完整分布，而非逐项预测。

Result: 以零样本方式和相同模型权重，MatrixFormer在因果推断面板数据任务、语言模型基准分数补全、表格插补及推荐系统矩阵补全上均取得竞争性表现。

Conclusion: MatrixFormer可作为矩阵补全的通用基础模型，验证了矩阵原生、一次性全分布预测范式的有效性。

Abstract: Matrix completion underlies problems from tabular imputation to causal inference, yet existing tabular foundation models treat it as entry-by-entry prediction, repeating context for every target and discarding the matrix's two-dimensional structure. We introduce MatrixFormer, a pre-trained matrix-native transformer that predicts a full distribution for every missing entry in a single forward pass. MatrixFormer is trained entirely on synthetic low-rank and latent-factor matrices under diverse missingness patterns. Applied zero-shot and with the same model weights, MatrixFormer achieves competitive performance on causal inference panel-data tasks, language-model benchmark-score completion, tabular imputation, and recommendation systems matrix completion. These results position MatrixFormer as a general-purpose foundation model for matrix completion.

</details>


### [351] [Improved Convergence of Large Stepsize Gradient Descent for Logistic Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06675)
*Xiaochuan Gong,Ang Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究线性可分数据上逻辑回归使用大步长梯度下降（η=1/ε）的收敛速度。作者证明在任意维度下，GD 能在 O(ln^p(1/ε)) 步内达到损失 ε，其中 p 仅依赖于数据间隔和秩，显著优于已有的 Õ(1/√ε) 加速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分析表明，大步长 GD 在逻辑回归中达到损失 ε 需要 Õ(1/√ε) 步，且损失可能先出现振荡；对振荡动态的精细控制此前仅适用于二维数据。作者希望在任意维度上给出更快的收敛保证。

Method: 将振荡阶段拆分为递归嵌套的区间；数据间隔（margin）和秩限定嵌套深度，而计数论证控制每一深度上的区间数量，从而改进 GD 从振荡阶段到稳定阶段（此后损失单调下降）的过渡时间上界。

Result: 证明 GD 使用大步长 η=1/ε 时，在 O(ln^p(1/ε)) 步内达到损失 ε，其中 p 仅依赖于数据间隔和秩；获得了远快于已有 Õ(1/√ε) 率的收敛速度。

Conclusion: 该工作将大步长 GD 在逻辑回归中从振荡到稳定阶段的过渡时间上界显著收紧，将收敛步复杂度降到关于 1/ε 的多对数级别，并且结果适用于任意维度。

Abstract: We study gradient descent (GD) with a large constant stepsize for logistic regression on linearly separable data. Existing analysis shows an accelerated rate of $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrtε)$ to reach loss $ε$ with an aggressive stepsize, although the loss may initially oscillate. Tighter control of the oscillatory dynamics has been available only for two-dimensional data. We prove a substantially faster rate in arbitrary dimension: GD with a large stepsize $η=1/ε$ reaches loss $ε$ within $O(\ln^{p}(1/ε))$ steps, where $p$ depends only on the margin and the rank of the data. Our proof improves the bound on the transition time of GD from the oscillatory to the stable phase, after which the loss decreases monotonically. We split the oscillatory phase into recursively nested intervals. The margin and the rank bound the nesting depth, and a counting argument bounds the number of intervals at each depth, together yielding the polylogarithmic step complexity.

</details>


### [352] [Sharpen Without Search: On-Policy Distillation of Sequence-Level Power Distribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06804)
*Erfan Baghaei Potraghloo,Seyedarmin Azizi,Arya Fayyazi,Saeid Shokoufa,Mehdi Kamal,Souvik Kundu,Massoud Pedram*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出在线策略幂蒸馏（OPPD），将幂分布采样（sharpening）的效果蒸馏进单次生成，无需增加采样候选数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型采样时，正确答案的单项概率虽高于任一错误答案，但所有错误答案的累计概率更大，因此常采样到错误答案。幂分布（power distribution）通过对完整答案概率取大于1的幂并重归一化，把概率向模型认为最可能的答案偏移（sharpening），从而提升推理表现，但需对每个查询评分大量候选，代价高。作者希望模型能一次生成即产出这种被"锐化"的答案。

Method: 在线策略幂蒸馏（OPPD）：训练中的模型作为提议分布生成候选，用冻结教师模型的幂分布对其加权，构成序列蒙特卡洛采样器；相同概率同时作为极大似然更新中各答案的权重，从而把锐化效应内化到参数中。仅需一个损失系数即可调节模型吸收的锐化指数。

Result: 单次生成精度较同温度未训练模型最高提升23.0分（MATH500）与27.3分（GSM8K）；一次生成比已发表的64候选幂采样高2.4与3.5分，恢复到16候选给未训练模型带来增益的94%。与同一检查点、同预算、使用验证奖励的GRPO相比，OPPD在MATH500、GSM8K、AIME上分别高3.8、4.0、5.4分且不使用参考答案；两者互补，GRPO之后应用OPPD可再加最多9.3分。仅在数学上训练，HumanEval最高提升5.3分。损失系数使吸收的锐化指数在1.19至2.02间可调（普通在线策略蒸馏为1.14），且提升主要发生在模型自身答案上。增益跨模型家族与规模成立，对已用验证奖励训练的模型，降温无效而OPPD在MATH500上仍加4.4分。

Conclusion: OPPD 能够在不改变温度、不解析参考答案的前提下，把幂分布采样的锐化收益蒸馏为单次生成能力，训练成本低、跨模型稳健，且与GRPO等强化学习方法互补，可叠加使用。

Abstract: A language model can give a correct answer more probability than any single incorrect answer and still usually sample an incorrect one, because the incorrect answers together hold more probability. The power distribution raises each complete answer's probability to a power above one and renormalizes, shifting probability toward answers the model finds most likely (sharpening). Sampling from it improves reasoning without changing parameters, but needs many scored candidates per query. We show that a model can instead be trained to produce such answers in one generation. On-policy power distillation (OPPD) runs a sequential Monte Carlo sampler in which the model being trained generates candidates and a frozen teacher's power distribution weights them; the same probabilities weight each answer in a maximum-likelihood update. Training raises single-generation accuracy by up to 23.0 points on MATH500 and 27.3 on GSM8K over the untrained model at the same temperature, and one generation scores 2.4 and 3.5 points above published power sampling with 64 candidates, recovering 94 percent of the gain that 16 candidates give the untrained model. For context, against GRPO trained with verified rewards from the same checkpoint and budget, OPPD scores 3.8, 4.0 and 5.4 points higher on MATH500, GSM8K and AIME using no reference answers; the two are complementary, and OPPD applied after GRPO adds up to 9.3 points. Trained only on mathematics, OPPD raises HumanEval accuracy by up to 5.3 points. One loss coefficient moves the sharpening exponent the model absorbs between 1.19 and 2.02, against 1.14 for ordinary on-policy distillation, and it rises mostly on the model's own answers. Gains hold across model families and sizes, including a model already trained with verified rewards, where lowering the temperature gives nothing and OPPD adds 4.4 points on MATH500. Code: https://github.com/ArminAzizi98/OPPD.

</details>


### [353] [How Sparse Probability Maps Shape Mixture-of-Experts Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06677)
*Tomás Brogueira,Marcos Treviso,Miguel Couceiro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文训练了300M和1B规模的top-2 MoE语言模型（分别使用softmax、1.5-entmax、sparsemax、2-normmax），发现稀疏概率映射产生的"零概率"在训练后并不能真正决定专家参与度，路由器会与概率映射协同适应学习分数分布，专家参与度取决于映射与学习分数的联合行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE路由器通常用softmax并保留top-K专家，使每个token固定使用K个专家。sparsemax、entmax、normmax等稀疏映射能将部分专家概率精确置零，看似可实现token自适应的专家参与。作者想探究这种稀疏性能否在训练后保持，以及稀疏映射是否真能带来差异化的专家参与。

Method: 训练匹配的300M与1B参数、top-2的MoE语言模型，分别采用softmax、1.5-entmax、sparsemax和2-normmax四种概率映射；比较训练后各映射丢弃概率质量、丢弃选中专家的频率、token专家分配情况，并通过分数间隔阈值机制分析路由器学习到的分数分布差异。同时对比稀疏映射与softmax的验证损失，以及推理时增大K的敏感性。

Result: 训练后各映射表现迥异：1B规模下，entmax比softmax少丢弃30%的概率质量，但几乎从不丢弃被选中的专家；sparsemax保留最多质量；normmax将21%的token路由到单个专家。根本原因是每个映射只在最高两个分数间隔达到固定阈值时才丢弃专家，而不同映射学习到的分数分布不同：entmax路由器学到的分数跨度约为softmax的一半，使top-2间隔低于阈值，sparsemax和normmax虽共享同一阈值却学到不同间隔分布。稀疏映射未改善验证损失，但显著提升推理时选择更多专家的鲁棒性：K=2训练的sparsemax在K=8时仅损失0.02 nats，softmax则损失0.58 nats。

Conclusion: 稀疏映射产生零概率的能力本身并不能决定专家参与度；路由器会与概率映射协同适应，调整其学习的分数分布。因此自适应MoE路由设计应围绕概率映射与学习分数的联合行为，而非仅考虑映射本身。

Abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) routers typically apply softmax to the router scores and keep the top-K experts, making every token use exactly K experts. Sparsity-inducing probability maps such as sparsemax, alpha-entmax and normmax can adaptively assign exact zeros to selected experts, and therefore appear to offer token-dependent expert participation, even when using the same top-K machinery. In this work, we study whether and how this sparsity survives training. We train matched 300M and 1B top-2 MoE language models with softmax, 1.5-entmax, sparsemax and 2-normmax, and find that the maps behave very differently once trained: at 1B, entmax discards 30% less probability mass than softmax while almost never dropping a selected expert, sparsemax retains the most mass, and normmax routes 21% of tokens to a single expert. These outcomes are not properties of the maps alone. Each map drops a selected expert only when the gap between the two largest scores reaches a fixed threshold, and the trained routers differ in the score distribution they learn: the entmax router learns scores with roughly half the spread of softmax's, which keeps its top-2 gaps below its threshold, while sparsemax and normmax, which share the same threshold, learn different gap distributions and hence different participation. Routers thus co-adapt their scores to the map, and a map's capacity to produce zeros does not by itself determine expert participation. While none of the sparse maps improves validation loss over softmax, they make the trained models far less sensitive to selecting more experts at inference: sparsemax trained with K=2 loses 0.02 nats when run with K=8, where softmax loses 0.58. Our results indicate that adaptive MoE routing has to be designed around the joint behavior of the probability map and the learned scores, rather than around the map alone.

</details>


### [354] [Deep Learning for Sleep Heart Rate Estimation from Accelerometers: Toward Population-Scale Cardiac Insight Without Optical Sensors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06823)
*Tanbin Islam Rohan,Pranjol Sen Gupta,Tanusree Debi,Nazmus Sakib*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SeqSmoother，一种基于Transformer的时间校正器，从腕部加速度信号估计睡眠心率；相比Nightbeat在覆盖率上更优，但保留区间精度略低，揭示了精度-可用性权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型纵向队列常采集腕部加速度计数据但无光学心率传感，需从已采集的睡眠期运动信号中恢复心脏信息，以利用现有数据获取心率。

Method: SeqSmoother融合谱描述子、Nightbeat衍生的中间频域锚点以及物理启发的次谐波特征（用于识别谐波频率锁定）；所有推理特征均来自腕部加速度，ECG仅用于构造参考HR标签及训练标签质量权重。采用13个被试互斥的留出折进行评估，与官方Nightbeat在60 s窗口、15 s步长协议下对比。

Result: 所有折外预测的被试宏平均MAE为1.60 bpm；在Nightbeat保留的匹配区间上，Nightbeat绝对误差更低（0.615 vs 1.091 bpm），但SeqSmoother覆盖更多有效记录（Nightbeat仅覆盖SeqSmoother可用折外网格的72.85%）；次谐波比识别参考定义的谐波锁定候选者AUROC达0.972。

Conclusion: 结果揭示了学习式时间建模与质量门控信号处理之间的精度-可用性权衡，并为基于加速度的睡眠心率估计中频率跟踪失败的物理启发识别提供了实证支持。

Abstract: Large longitudinal cohorts often contain wrist accelerometry without optical heart-rate sensing, motivating recovery of cardiac information from motion signals already collected during sleep. We present SeqSmoother, a transformer-based temporal corrector for sleep heart rate (HR) estimation from wrist accelerometry. SeqSmoother combines spectral descriptors with an intermediate Nightbeat-derived frequency anchor and a physics-motivated sub-harmonic feature designed to identify harmonic frequency lock-on. All inference-time features are derived from wrist accelerometry, while ECG is used only to construct reference HR labels and training-label quality weights. We evaluate SeqSmoother using 13 participant-disjoint held-out folds and compare it with the official Nightbeat implementation under a matched 60-s window and 15-s step protocol. Across all out-of-fold predictions, SeqSmoother achieved a participant-macro MAE of 1.60 bpm. On Nightbeat-retained matched intervals, Nightbeat achieved lower absolute error than SeqSmoother (0.615 versus 1.091 bpm), while SeqSmoother provided estimates over a larger portion of the eligible recording; Nightbeat produced final estimates for 72.85% of the SeqSmoother-eligible out-of-fold grid. Separately, the proposed sub-harmonic ratio achieved an AUROC of 0.972 for identifying reference-defined harmonic lock-on candidates. These findings reveal an accuracy-availability trade-off between learned temporal modeling and quality-gated signal processing while providing empirical support for a physics-informed approach to identifying frequency-tracking failures in accelerometer-based sleep HR estimation.

</details>


### [355] [Base Models Can Reason By Taking a Cue From Training Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06851)
*Sophie L. Wang,Amil Dravid,Rulin Shao,Kevin Farhat,Sewon Min,Alexei A. Efros*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究表明,起始token线索与后续推理行为间的关联源自训练数据;固定特定线索可使基座模型在数学与编程任务上接近RL模型表现,且可通过数据干预人为制造或消除线索效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究基座模型回复起始token如何与后续推理行为建立关联,以及这种关联的来源(训练数据)与RL训练之间的关系。

Method: 对比固定起始token线索与RL训练模型的表现;分析RL对线索概率的影响;通过因果数据干预将任意词(如"chicken")转为有效推理线索或移除已有线索效果;考察隐藏状态表征与训练集文档类型的相关性;并开展安全领域案例研究。

Result: 线索".\n\nOkay"将Olmo-3-7B的MATH-500 pass@1从42%提升至78%,"Alright,"将Qwen3-14B从72%提升至87%;RL提高线索出现概率,固定线索可恢复大部分RL增益;数据编辑使"Think duck duck goose"与"Think step by step"同样有效;不同线索诱发的隐藏状态与不同训练文档类型相关;安全场景下不同线索引发不同拒答与顺从行为。

Conclusion: token线索的推理效应可追溯至训练数据,线索与推理行为的关联具有可干预性;该机制同样适用于安全行为,提示训练数据分布在塑造模型行为中的核心作用。

Abstract: In this paper, we study how training data creates associations between the tokens at the start of a base model's response and the reasoning behavior that follows. First, we demonstrate that fixing particular starting token cues makes a base model's performance competitive with that of its reinforcement learning (RL)-trained counterparts on math and coding. For instance, the cue ".\n\nOkay" raises Olmo-3-7B's MATH-500 pass@1 accuracy from 42% to 78%, while "Alright," raises Qwen3-14B's from 72% to 87%. Second, RL makes these cues more likely, while fixing them recovers much of its performance gain over the base model. Third, we trace the reasoning effects of token cues to the training data. We perform causal data interventions to turn an arbitrary word, such as "chicken", into an effective reasoning cue, or remove an existing cue's effect. A similar edit makes the prompt instruction "Think duck duck goose" as effective as "Think step by step" at eliciting reasoning. We also find that the hidden state representations induced by different cues correlate with different document types from the training set. Finally, we extend our study of token cues with a case study in language model safety, finding that different cues elicit distinct refusal and compliance behaviors that correspond to different types of training data.

</details>


### [356] [Aligning Multimodal Patient Evidence with Biomedical Knowledge Graphs for Clinical LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06685)
*Jiawen Du,Arshan Ali Khan,Chenhao Zhang,Zachary Plotkin,Li Shen,Qi Long,Yun Li,Can Chen,Tianlong Chen,Nicholas Konz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Clinical questions often depend on linking a patient's multimodal evidence to external biomedical knowledge, yet existing predictive systems rarely represent such links explicitly, so they can neither be traced to their evidence sources nor removed to measure their contributions. We present MM-KG (Multimodal Knowledge Graph), which represents heterogeneous, multimodal patient observations and biomedical concepts as separate layers in one typed graph, joined by explicit alignment edges. First, modality-specific harmonizers convert EHR text, imaging, genomic, and biospecimen data into typed observations mapped to UMLS concepts, which a route-prioritized aligner links to a biomedical knowledge graph. Query-conditioned retrieval then selects a compact subgraph for downstream use by a large language model or a graph neural network. We build MM-KGs for MIMIC-IV and ADNI, and evaluate them with a 2x2 design that separates patient evidence, biomedical knowledge, and their interaction. On questions that require both sources, neither source alone performs far above chance, whereas their combination yields a drug-controlled AUROC interaction of +0.194 on MIMIC and +0.299 on ADNI. On held-out five-candidate ranking, MM-KG outperforms MindMap by +0.131 Hits@1 and leads an adapted GraphCare on the items that require consulting the patient, and deleting the single answer-bearing relation from the retrieved packet returns Hits@1 to the no-knowledge baseline. Finally, query-conditioned retrieval reaches 0.731 AUROC with 6.8x less context than the strongest generic policy, whereas static knowledge graph context gives no consistent gain on ordinary outcome prediction. Knowledge graphs thus benefit clinical LLMs not as background context but as explicit links between multimodal patient evidence and the relation a question requires, and MM-KG makes these links retrievable, traceable, and testable.

</details>


### [357] [OVAL: Output-Aware Local Page Bases for KV Cache Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06686)
*Ashkan Shahbazi,Chayne Thrash,Soheil Kolouri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 output-aware 的页稀疏注意力编码方法，缓解长上下文推理中 KV cache 开销问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文推理中注意力需在持续增长的 KV cache 上计算，开销巨大；现有页稀疏注意力检索方法仅估计注意力分数或页相关性，未直接考虑近似误差对 value 加权注意力输出的影响。

Method: 提出方法，一种基于 key 与 value 联合结构的 output-aware 页编码，同时保留准确检索所需的 key 信息；无需训练，推理时也不需要额外的 value 相关统计量；其存储表示大小与纯 key 谱表示相同，解码打分成本也一致。

Result: 在长推理、长上下文理解与长生成基准上，方法一致优于纯 key 谱基线，并与近期 KV cache 压缩与检索方法具有竞争力；长推理基准上取得较强 avg@k 表现，在若干长上下文理解与生成设置上匹配或超越领先基线，仅有适度解码开销。代码见 https://github.com/Ashkan13776/oval-kv。

Conclusion: 方法以 output-aware 页编码提升页稀疏注意力的检索质量，在保持低存储与低打分成本的同时改善长上下文任务性能。

Abstract: Long context inference with large language models becomes increasingly expensive as attention must operate over an ever growing KV cache. Page sparse attention reduces this cost by representing each KV page compactly and retrieving only a subset for each query. Existing retrieval methods are designed to estimate attention scores or page relevance, but their objectives do not directly account for how approximation errors affect the resulting value weighted attention output. We introduce \method{}, an output aware page encoding derived from the joint structure of keys and values while preserving the key information needed for accurate retrieval. \method{} is training free and requires no additional value dependent statistics at inference time. Once constructed, its stored representation has the same size and decode time scoring cost as a key only spectral representation. Across long reasoning, long context understanding, and long generation benchmarks, \method{} consistently improves over the key only spectral baseline and performs competitively with recent KV cache compression and retrieval methods. On long reasoning benchmarks, it achieves strong avg@\(k\) performance across model benchmark pairs, while matching or surpassing leading baselines on several long context understanding and generation settings with modest decoding overhead. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/Ashkan13776/oval-kv}.

</details>


### [358] [Adapting prior-data fitted networks for tabular anomaly detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06693)
*Maximilian Bershtman,Niv Cohen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出利用PFN（先验数据拟合网络）表征做表格异常检测：免微调的ZEN与基于参考集微调的FOCUS，在ADBench上取得最优平均AUROC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度特征在图像与视频异常检测中效果显著，但在表格数据上收益有限，主要原因是缺乏强力的深度表征。近期PFN成为表格数据表征的潜在来源，但其在异常检测中的适配与利用方式尚不明确。且该任务本身困难：部署前无异常样本，无法有监督调参，且定义正常行为的参考集本身可能混入异常。

Method: 首先使用冻结的TabPFN特征，以样本在特征空间中到最近邻的距离作为异常分数，并研究应选用哪些层及适配该任务的提特征流程；随后利用参考集对模型进行微调，使所得特征更好地分离正常样本与异常。方法分别命名为ZEN（免微调）与FOCUS（微调）。

Result: 在ADBench基准上，免微调的ZEN平均AUROC高于所有基线，微调的FOCUS在其基础上进一步提升；方法还在不同PFN模型间具有泛化性。

Conclusion: PFN表征可有效迁移至表格异常检测；即使仅用冻结特征的最近邻距离也具竞争力，而基于参考集的微调能进一步改善正常/异常的特征可分性，且方法可跨PFN模型泛化。

Abstract: While deep features have transformed anomaly detection in images and video, their impact on tabular data has been less substantial, partly due to the limited availability of strong deep representations. Recently, prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) have emerged as a promising source of such representations for tabular data. In this work, we investigate how PFN representations can be adapted and leveraged for anomaly detection. The question is harder than it looks. No anomalies are available before deploy- ment, so model parameters cannot be tuned with supervision, and the reference set that defines normal behavior may itself contain the very anomalies it is supposed to reveal. We begin our study using frozen TabPFN features. Scoring each sam- ple by its distance to its nearest neighbors in feature space already gives strong results. We identify which layers to use and a feature-extraction procedure suited to the task. Next, to further improve performance, we use the reference set to fine- tune the model, so that the resulting features better separate normal samples from anomalies. On the ADBench benchmark, our fine-tuning free approach (ZEN) reaches a higher mean AUROC than every baseline, and our fine-tuned method (FOCUS) improves on it further. Our approach also generalizes across PFN models.

</details>


### [359] [To Learn is to Wander: Learning Across Graphs and Tasks with Random Walks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06694)
*Louis Tichelman,Xingyue Huang,Jinwoo Kim,İsmail İlkan Ceylan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Wander 图基础模型，通过随机游走统一接口，在单一预训练检查点下跨图模态与任务进行迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图基础模型通常只能局限于特定图模态或特定任务，难以实现跨图、跨特征空间、跨关系模式与跨任务的通用迁移。

Method: 从先验预测（prior-predictive）视角将图学习建模为部分观测图的补全任务；基于随机游走构建统一接口，使同一模型可用于同质图与多关系图，并适应不同特征、标签与关系模式；推理时可扩大结构上下文而不改变已学习参数。

Result: 在适当假设下，Wander 对于有界连通图可通用逼近相应的贝叶斯最优预测器；单一预训练检查点在节点分类、同质链路预测和知识图谱链路预测上达到最优或极具竞争力的表现；跨图模态与任务的联合预训练在保持专门设置性能的同时，带来正迁移并支持推理时组合分别习得的能力。

Conclusion: Wander 通过统一的任务通用接口与随机游走机制，实现了单检查点跨图模态、跨任务的图基础模型，验证了正迁移与能力组合的可行性。

Abstract: Graph foundation models aim to transfer across graphs, feature spaces, relational schemas, and prediction tasks, yet existing approaches typically generalize only within particular graph modalities or tasks. We propose Wander, a graph foundation model designed to operate across these settings within a single pretrained checkpoint. Following the prior-predictive perspective, we formulate graph learning as completion of a partially observed graph. We realize this task-general view through a common interface based on random walks, allowing the same model to operate across homogeneous and multi-relational graphs with varying features, labels, and relational schemas. Wander can increase its structural context at inference time without changing its learned parameters and, under suitable assumptions, universally approximates the corresponding Bayes-optimal predictor on bounded connected graphs. Empirically, a single pretrained checkpoint achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive results across node classification, homogeneous link prediction, and knowledge-graph link prediction. Moreover, joint pretraining across graph modalities and tasks preserves performance in specialized settings while enabling positive transfer and the composition of separately learned capabilities at inference time.

</details>


### [360] [Decoupling Time and Space: A Temporally Conditioned Refinement for EEG Source Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06726)
*Marco Morik,Jesse Palarus,Carmen Vidaurre,Klaus-Robert Müller,Shinichi Nakajima*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出双流框架，将全局时序表示学习与逐时间点空间精修解耦，用于EEG源定位，在合成与真实数据上均取得改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG源定位是严重病态的空間逆问题。现有深度学习方法存在两难：逐帧模型丢失时间上下文，而完整4D时空网络在重建精度与推理成本之间存在架构权衡。

Method: 双流架构：1）基于Transformer的时序条件编码器，通过因子化时空注意力处理整段EEG序列，保留传感器分辨特征；2）固定逆算子将特征映射为源索引条件，输入逐时间步的源空间Transformer或体卷积精修器。训练中引入多样化导联场与显式算子失配。

Result: 在逼真合成数据上，时序先验显著提升空间定位，优于经典与时空基线，尤其在高噪声和多源场景。跨导联场训练与算子失配增强了对未见头几何的迁移，使模板重建接近个体化逆解。仅用合成数据训练的模型可应用于真实EEG，基于睁眼/闭眼源功率差异的 logistic 回归成功解码年龄组。

Conclusion: 显式解耦时序表示与空间精修可有效缓解精度-成本权衡，提升EEG源重建的鲁棒性与跨域泛化能力，并具备向真实数据与下游任务迁移的潜力。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) offers millisecond temporal resolution, but inferring underlying neural sources is a severely ill-posed spatial inverse problem. While deep learning has advanced spatial reconstruction, current architectures face a critical dilemma: frame-by-frame models discard vital temporal context, whereas full 4D spatiotemporal networks introduce an architectural trade-off between reconstruction accuracy and inference cost. We propose a novel two-stream framework that explicitly decouples global temporal representation learning from per-time-point spatial refinement. A Transformer-based Temporal Condition Encoder processes the entire EEG sequence via factorized spatiotemporal attention, retaining sensor-resolved features. A fixed inverse then maps these features into source-indexed conditioning for a per-timestep Source-Space Transformer or volumetric convolutional refiner. Extensive evaluations on realistic synthetic data demonstrate that this temporal prior dramatically improves spatial localization, outperforming classical and spatiotemporal baselines, particularly in high-noise and multi-source regimes. Training across diverse leadfields and explicit operator mismatches improves transfer to unseen head geometries and brings template-based reconstruction closer to subject-specific inversion. Furthermore, we apply the model trained only on synthetic EEG data to real-world EEG. A logistic regressor fit on source power differences in eyes-open, eyes-closed conditions successfully decodes age groups.

</details>


### [361] [Hyperbolic Graph Representation Learning: Embed in One Metric, Optimize with Another](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06745)
*Federico Larroca,Paola Bermolen,Marcelo Fiori,Bernardo Marenco*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出双曲空间中层次图嵌入的梯度学习在极坐标下因角度步长被sinh(r)缩放而"冻结"，并证明该缩放因子可由优化预条件子的一参数族选择；采用"先欧氏布局、后中间曲率精修"的两阶段策略，在真实树上将损失较最优单曲率降低46–74%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 层次图在双曲空间中嵌入的失真低于欧氏空间，但在大半径处，庞加莱球与洛伦兹双叶双曲面模型的数值计算失效，阻碍了基于梯度的学习。极坐标可规避数值问题，却因度量将角度步长乘以半径的双曲正弦，导致角度运动被"冻结"。作者进一步观察到该缩放因子其实是现有实现（如欧氏切空间参数化取半径本身）"默认固定"的一种选择，因此有必要探究是否存在更优的选择。

Method: 将角度步长的缩放因子视为一参数族的优化预条件子，该族对应的曲率从-1连续变化到0，而嵌入本身始终固定在曲率-1。通过分析该族两端（欧氏预条件子与中间曲率预条件子）的性质差异，设计两阶段优化：第一阶段用欧氏预条件子构建整体布局，第二阶段用中间曲率预条件子进行精细调整。

Result: 欧氏预条件子擅长重排布局但精修能力差；中间曲率预条件子一旦在已有布局基础上则精修效果远优。二者结合的两阶段方法在真实世界树上相较最佳单曲率方法将损失降低46–74%。

Conclusion: 极坐标下角度步长的缩放因子并非只有一种合理选择，而是构成曲率从-1到0的预条件子族；不同预条件子负责不同优化阶段。分阶段组合欧氏与中间曲率预条件子可显著提升双曲层次图嵌入的优化效果，为双曲优化器的设计提供了新的自由度。

Abstract: Hierarchical graphs embed in hyperbolic space with lower distortion than in Euclidean space owing to its negative curvature. However, their gradient-based learning is hampered at large radii, where the Poincaré ball and the Lorentz hyperboloid models fail numerically. Polar coordinates avoid this problem, but the hyperbolic metric scales the angular step by the hyperbolic sine of the radius, freezing angular motion. We observe that this factor is a choice, silently fixed by existing implementations: the Euclidean tangent parametrization, for instance, uses the radius itself. We show that other choices are not only possible but preferable. They are endpoints of a one-parameter family of optimization preconditioners with curvatures from $-1$ to $0$, while the embedding remains at curvature $-1$. We show that since the Euclidean preconditioner rearranges a layout but refines it poorly, while an intermediate one refines far better once a layout is in place, combining them in two stages reduces the loss on real-world trees by 46-74% over the best single curvature.

</details>


### [362] [Round-Trip KNN Clustering: multiscale hierarchical cluster detection on directed nearest-neighbour graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06795)
*Eraldo Pereira Marinho,Caetano Mazzoni Ranieri,Fabricio Aparecido Breve*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RTKNNC，一种基于保持KNN双向邻接关系与往复遍历的图聚类方法，无需预设簇数，可多尺度揭示簇的持续与合并，并配有无标签可选精化步骤。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有KNN图聚类常先将有向k近邻关系对称化为无向图，丢失"谁选择谁"的方向信息；同时图连通性可能通过稀疏桥或小重叠区把不同簇错误连接，且方法多需预先给定簇数。

Method: RTKNNC保留邻居关系的两个方向，将"被选择的入边"作为加权投票，决定递归前进—反向遍历中哪些局部连接保持可见；对递增的K重复该过程，观察簇随邻域尺度的持续或合并。在参考反平方模型下的结构精化前，簇只会合并不会分裂。为处理稀疏桥/重叠导致的错误连通，加入可选无标签精化：先检验已形成连通分量是否更适合由两或三个高斯子群描述，仅当子群足够大且与可见KNN图一致时才接受细分。

Result: 在8个合成数据集、K=2…16下，独立的C与Python实现在全部120次参考运行中得到完全相同的划分。精化使ARI在变密度基准上从0.7817提升至0.9627，在稀疏桥基准上从0.8083提升至0.9853。与7种外部聚类方法比较，性能具竞争力，同时保持无标签的簇构建过程。

Conclusion: 保留KNN双向关系并配合无标签精化，可在无需预设簇数的情况下实现稳定、可复现且具竞争力的多尺度聚类；两实现的一致性支持其确定性特征。

Abstract: We introduce Round-Trip KNN Clustering (RTKNNC), a graph-based method for finding cluster structure at several neighbourhood scales without requiring the number of clusters in advance. Unlike approaches that first make a $k$-nearest-neighbour (KNN) graph undirected, RTKNNC keeps both directions of the neighbour relation: which points a given point selects and which points select it. Incoming selections are treated as weighted votes that help decide which local connections remain visible during a recursive forward-and-reverse traversal. Repeating the procedure for increasing $K$ reveals how groups persist or merge as the neighbourhood scale grows; for the reference inverse-square model before structural refinement, clusters can merge but do not split. Because graph connectivity can occasionally join distinct groups through a sparse bridge or a small region of overlap, we add an optional label-free refinement. It first tests whether an already formed component is better described by two or three Gaussian subpopulations, and accepts a subdivision only when the proposed groups are large enough and consistent with the visible KNN graph. Across eight synthetic datasets and $K=2,\ldots,16$, independent C and Python implementations produced identical partitions in all 120 reference runs. Refinement increased adjusted Rand index from $0.7817$ to $0.9627$ on a variable-density benchmark and from $0.8083$ to $0.9853$ on a sparse-bridge benchmark. Comparisons with seven external clustering methods show competitive performance while preserving a label-free cluster-construction process.

</details>


### [363] [H-JEPA: End-to-End Learning of Hierarchical World Models for Visual Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06805)
*Wancong Zhang,Basile Terver,Michael Rabbat,Yann LeCun,Randall Balestriero*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出H-JEPA，端到端训练动作条件JEPA层级，各层在各自潜空间预测更远未来，顶层规划目标、下层以预测为子目标，实现长时程规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程规划需跨时间尺度与抽象层级推理，而现有任务无关JEPA世界模型仅在单一时间尺度或共享潜空间内多视界预测与规划，难以有效分解时间结构。

Method: 端到端训练动作条件JEPA层级，每层在自身学习到的潜空间中预测更远的未来；规划自顶向下：顶层优化向目标的进展，各层预测作为下一层规划器的子目标。

Result: 在四个模拟导航与操作环境中，层级规划优于扁平JEPA；Visual AntMaze上三级层级将成功率从18%提升至73%且规划计算更少；消融表明增益来自时间分解与高层目标表征；结合逆动力学监督可扩展至DROID真实机器人视频，以更低规划计算提升离线规划保真度。

Conclusion: 当数据因素在不同时间尺度演化时，高层丢弃快速、不可预测细节并保留较慢的任务相关状态；层级结构能提升长时程规划效果与效率，并可通过逆动力学监督迁移到真实机器人视频。

Abstract: Long-horizon planning with latent world models requires reasoning across timescales and levels of abstraction. Existing task-agnostic JEPA world models predict and plan at a single timescale or with multiple horizons in one shared latent space. We introduce H-JEPA, an end-to-end recipe for training a hierarchy of action-conditioned JEPAs in which each level predicts farther ahead in its own learned latent space. Planning proceeds top-down: the top level optimizes progress toward the goal, and each level's predictions become subgoals for the planner below it. When factors in the data evolve at separated timescales, higher levels discard fast, unpredictable detail and retain slower task-relevant state. Across four simulated navigation and manipulation environments, hierarchical planning improves over a flat JEPA; on Visual AntMaze, a three-level hierarchy raises success from 18% to 73% using less planner compute. Ablations attribute these gains to both temporal decomposition and higher-level goal representations. With inverse-dynamics supervision, the approach extends to diverse real-robot videos from DROID, where hierarchy improves offline planning fidelity at lower planner compute.

</details>


### [364] [Block Disentanglement in CRL: Bridging Identifiability and Visual State Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06809)
*Emre Acartürk,Pranamya Kulkarni,Puranjay Datta,Karthikeyan Shanmugam,Burak Varıcı,Ali Tajer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对interventional CRL，在更弱的干预假设下建立可识别性保证，得到因果变量的block disentanglement（分块解耦），并将其用于具身视觉状态估计，实现无标签地从图像/视频中恢复机器人系统的潜在物理变量，搭建理论与实践的桥梁。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CRL作为无标签推断方法，在数据标签不可得或不切实际的场景中极具吸引力。尽管CRL的可识别性保证研究已有显著进展，但这些保证通常依赖高度理想化的假设，难以直接应用于现实问题。因此需要放宽假设并验证其在真实场景中的有效性。

Method: 1) 在显著更弱的干预假设下建立可识别性保证，实现因果变量的block disentanglement，其分块结构取决于现实中可用的干预机制；2) 将该block disentanglement框架用于embodied visual state estimation，即直接从视觉数据（图像和视频）中恢复机器人系统的潜在物理变量，无需标注数据。

Result: 理论上，在更弱假设下获得了block disentanglement的可识别性保证；应用上，在受控的具身场景中，即使在存在进一步假设违背的情况下，所得目标仍然有效。

Conclusion: 两个部分互补：理论刻画了弱化假设下的可识别性，应用表明该目标在具身设置中依然有效（尽管假设被进一步违背），从而为无标签CRL从理论走向实际问题提供了theory-to-practice bridge。

Abstract: Causal representation learning (CRL) is the process of recovering causally-related latent variables from high-dimensional observations. As a label-free inference method, CRL is particularly attractive for applications where data labels are unavailable or impractical to obtain. While there has been significant progress in understanding the identifiability guarantees of CRL, such guarantees often hold under highly stylized assumptions, which temper the direct application to real-world problems. This paper has a two-fold objective for interventional CRL. First, it establishes identifiability guarantees for substantially weaker interventional assumptions, resulting in block disentanglement of the causal variables, where the block structure depends on the realistically available intervention mechanisms. Secondly, the block disentanglement framework is used for embodied visual state estimation, in which the objective is to recover the latent physical variables of a robotic system directly from visual data (images and videos) without labeled data. These two components are critically complementary. The block disentanglement theory delineates identifiability guarantees under weakened assumptions, and the application demonstrates that the resulting objective remains effective in a controlled embodied setting despite further assumption violations, providing a theory-to-practice bridge needed to translate the promise of label-free CRL into practical problems.

</details>


### [365] [Private online learning and prediction for Littlestone classes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06822)
*Amartya Sanyal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究差分隐私在线学习与在线预测在可realisable对手下的错误界。通过新的下界（在线学习）与上界（在线预测）证明：对任意有限Littlestone维数 \(d\) 的类，二者样本复杂度相差一个随时间 \(T\) 增长的因子。在线学习下界为 \(\Omega(\frac{d}{\varepsilon}\log^{2/3}T)\)，而在线预测上界为 \(2^{2^{cd^2}}\varepsilon^{-2}\log^2(2/(\varepsilon\delta))\)，与 \(T\) 无关。当 \(\delta=\Theta(1/\log T)\) 时，隐私学习需 \(\Omega((\log T)^{2/3})\) 错误，而隐私预测仅需 \(O((\log\log T)^2)\)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 差分隐私在线学习与在线预测在可realisable情形下的样本复杂度关系尚不明确，尤其在不经意（oblivious）对手设置下，两者是否存在本质分离、以及从学习（需发布假设）到预测（仅需预测）隐私约束的放松能带来多大收益，需要定量刻画；同时已有工作的下界在 \(1/T<\delta<1/\log T\) 区间仍是空白。

Method: 1. 构造针对 \((\varepsilon,\delta)\)-隐私在线学习的新下界技术，基于确定性realisable流，证得任意隐私在线学习器存在长度 \(T\) 的流使期望错误 \(\mathbb{E}[M_T]=\Omega(\frac{d}{\varepsilon}\log^{2/3}T)\)，覆盖此前未解决的 \(\delta\) 区间。2. 构造基于Littlestone维数 \(d\) 的 \((\varepsilon,\delta)\)-联合隐私预测器，其期望错误上界为 \(2^{2^{cd^2}}\varepsilon^{-2}\log^2(2/(\varepsilon\delta))\)，与时间 \(T\) 无关。

Result: 对每个有限Littlestone维数 \(d\) 的类，隐私在线学习与隐私在线预测的样本复杂度相差一个随 \(T\) 增长的因子。具体地，当 \(\delta=\Theta(1/\log T)\) 时，隐私学习需要 \(\Omega((\log T)^{2/3})\) 的期望错误，而隐私预测仅需 \(O((\log\log T)^2)\) 期望错误。上界与 \(T\) 无关，下界首次覆盖 \(1/T<\delta<1/\log T\) 区间。

Conclusion: 在可realisable、不经意对手下，差分隐私在线学习与在线预测存在严格的、随时间增长的复杂度分离：发布假设的隐私代价远高于仅做预测，且该分离对任意有限Littlestone维数类普遍成立。

Abstract: We study mistake bounds for differentially private online learning and online prediction under oblivious realisable adversaries. Online learning requires the learner to release a hypothesis at each time step whereas in online prediction, the learner only needs to make predictions without releasing a hypothesis. Using a novel lower bound for private online learning and an upper bound for private prediction, we show that the sample complexity of these two problems are separated by a factor that grows with the time horizon for every class of finite Littlestone dimension $d$. First, we prove that every $\br{ε,δ}$-private online learner has a deterministic realisable stream of length $T$ on which the mistake bound is at least $\bE\bs{M_T}=\Om{\frac dε\log\br{ T}^{2/3}}$. In particular, this is the first non-trivial lower in the range $1/T<δ<1/\log T)$ left open in earlier works[SR22,DSS24,LWY24]. Second, we prove that for every class of of Littlestone dimension $d$, there exists an $(ε,δ)$-jointly private predictor with at most $2^{2^{cd^2}}ε^{-2}\log^2\br{2/\br{εδ}}$ expected mistakes, independently of $T$, for some absolute constant $c>0$. Thus, for every fixed class of finite Littlestone dimension when $δ=Θ\br{1/\log T}$, private learning requires $\Om{\br{\log T}^{2/3}}$ expected mistakes, whereas private prediction admits $\bigO{\br{\log\log T}^2}$.

</details>


### [366] [Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part II: Rethinking at Fixed Points](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06833)
*Benhao Huang,Chufan Shi,Junlin Chen,Shicheng Wen,Zhengzhong Liu,Eric Xing,Xuezhe Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究循环（looped）语言模型的深度先验与输入注入机制。作者发现循环状态越接近不动点，到达该状态的路径越不重要，从而支持截断反向传播、终止态KV共享（精度几乎无损）、蒸馏学生模型预填充最快1.79倍，以及比回放轨迹反向传播快2倍的RL更新。基于此，提出从预测反馈中学习深度先验（带熵项保持其广度）与正交注入（去除状态中沿输入方向的分量）。在100M至1.6B参数规模上，二者分别相对Huginn的固定深度先验与现有注入方案降低困惑度；1.6B时学习先验配合缩小3倍KV缓存即可匹配全缓存固定深度训练的下游平均表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环语言模型的每次重复都在训练、解码、预填充和强化学习上增加开销。作者试图利用循环状态趋近不动点这一特性来削减这些成本，并改进决定不动点形态的两个核心组件：深度先验与输入注入。
