Method: 1) 利用状态趋近不动点带来路径无关性，实现训练中的截断反向传播、解码中的终止态KV共享、更快的蒸馏学生预填充以及从已保存rollout状态计算梯度的RL更新；2) 用预测反馈学习深度先验，并加入熵项维持先验广度，替代固定深度训练和Huginn的宽先验；3) 提出正交注入，移除状态中沿输入方向的分量，避免注入被放大或抵消。

Result: 在100M到1.6B参数规模上，学习先验与正交注入均分别相对Huginn先验和现有注入方案降低困惑度。1.6B规模下，学习先验配合3倍更小的KV缓存即可达到固定深度训练配全缓存的下游平均性能。预填充最多加速1.79倍，RL梯度计算比回放轨迹反向传播快2倍，KV共享几乎不损失精度。

Conclusion: 循环状态趋近不动点可被系统性地转化为训练与推理的效率收益；基于预测反馈学习的深度先验与正交注入是改进循环语言模型的两项有效手段，在大规模下能以更小缓存保持下游性能，并为截断反向传播、KV共享与高效RL提供了实用基础。

Abstract: Every recurrence of a looped language model adds cost in training, decoding, prefill, and reinforcement learning (RL). The closer recurrent states get to fixed points, the less the path to them matters. This enables truncated backpropagation in training; terminal key-value (KV) sharing for decoding with almost no loss in accuracy; a distilled student that prefills up to 1.79x faster; and RL updates that compute gradients from saved rollout states, 2x faster than backpropagating through the replayed trajectory. We therefore improve the two components of training that shape these fixed points: the depth prior and input injection. Fixed-depth training breaks KV sharing, and Huginn's broad depth prior supports sharing but dilutes supervision at the target depth more than sharing requires; we learn the prior from prediction feedback, with an entropy term that keeps it broad. Existing injection schemes let the state's component along the input amplify or cancel the injection; we remove this component with orthogonal injection. From 100M to 1.6B parameters, the learned prior and orthogonal injection lower perplexity at every scale relative to Huginn's prior and existing injection schemes, respectively. At 1.6B, the learned prior with a 3x smaller KV cache matches the downstream average of fixed-depth training with the full cache.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [367] [Learning Robust Personalized Prompts for LLM-Driven Sequential Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03923)
*Xiaolin Zheng,Qiyong Zhong,Jiajie Su,Xiang Chen*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出LRPRec可学习提示框架，通过个性化提示注入与语义漂移约束，在连续提示学习中兼顾用户级适配与语义稳定性，无需人工调优模板。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM驱动的序列推荐依赖自然语言提示进行自回归生成，但语义等价提示的细微措辞变化会导致性能大幅波动，鲁棒性差且需昂贵的提示工程。连续提示学习虽降低模板依赖，却面临两个交互挑战：共享任务级指令缺乏用户特定推理指导，梯度更新易使连续提示漂出LLM有效语义空间，注入个性化信号更会加剧语义漂移。

Method: 提出LRPRec：从离散模板初始化连续指令提示，并引入两个互补机制。(1) 个性化提示注入：将用户行为编码为偏好嵌入，加性注入共享提示，实现参数高效的用户级适配；(2) 语义漂移约束：将共享提示正则化在其初始化锚点附近的信任域内，保持优化过程中的语义有效性。通过约束共享分量同时允许加性个性化，解耦稳定性与表达力。

Result: 在三个基准数据集上开展大量实验，相比强基线取得一致性提升，同时免除了对背景模板与任务推理模板的人工调优。

Conclusion: LRPRec通过加性个性化与信任域约束的协同设计，有效缓解连续提示学习中的用户适配不足与语义漂移问题，实现稳健且免手工模板工程的LLM序列推荐。

Abstract: LLM-driven sequential recommendation formulates next-item prediction as autoregressive generation conditioned on natural-language prompts. However, minor wording changes in semantically equivalent prompts can cause substantial performance fluctuations, undermining robustness and requiring costly manual prompt engineering. Continuous prompt learning reduces template dependence but faces two interacting challenges: shared task-level instructions lack user-specific reasoning guidance, while gradient updates can push continuous prompts outside the LLM's effective semantic space. Injecting personalized signals can further amplify this semantic drift. To address these challenges, we propose LRPRec, a learnable prompting framework that initializes continuous instruction prompts from discrete templates and introduces two complementary mechanisms. Personalized prompt injection encodes user behavior into a preference embedding and additively injects it into shared prompts, enabling parameter-efficient user-level adaptation. A semantic drift constraint regularizes the shared prompts within a trust region around their initialization anchors to preserve semantic validity during optimization. By constraining the shared component while allowing additive personalization, LRPRec decouples stability from expressiveness. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines while eliminating the need for manual tuning of background and task inference templates.

</details>


### [368] [FICO: Find-Then-Compute for Corpus-Level Spreadsheet Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03958)
*Sandarsita Guntupalli,Lu He,Kang Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出 Find-then-Compute (FiCo)，通过"检索文档摘要—消歧工作簿—在选定完整表上执行受限 SQL"三阶段流程，在 DataBench 与 MiMoTable 上大幅超越前缀 RAG 与 TableRAG 风格基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电子表格集合问答需同时完成两项任务：在众多工作簿中定位正确来源，并在完整表上完成精确计算。现有 RAG 方法（如前缀 RAG、TableRAG 风格）在来源选择与完整表计算之间存在权衡，缺乏将语义检索与结构化计算有效衔接的方案，导致固定计算预算下存在明显的来源选择代价。

Method: FiCo 采取"先定位、后计算"（Find-then-Compute）范式：1）检索文档摘要以缩小候选范围；2）对相似工作簿进行消歧，锁定唯一来源；3）在选定的完整表上执行受限 SQL（constrained SQL），以 schema 为约束进行精确计算。

Result: 在 DataBench（80 数据集、1,810 题）上达 76.2%，较同冻结工作簿选择下的强 TableRAG 风格基线（66.3%）高 9.9 个百分点，较前缀 RAG（12.8%）高 63.4 个百分点；在 MiMoTable 508 题上达 79.7%，前缀 RAG 仅 22.2%。将金标准工作簿提供给强基线可使其由 66.3% 升至 76.3%，揭示固定计算下的 10.0 个百分点来源选择代价。文档召回率 95.1%、可执行 SQL 率 98.5%，但仅 81.3% 的问题能在金标准工作簿上成功执行。

Conclusion: FiCo 的增益源于将语义来源选择与精确、schema 约束的计算相结合；未来改进空间主要在于缩小"可执行 SQL 到正确执行"之间的落差（98.5% 可执行 vs. 81.3% 金标准执行率）。

Abstract: Question answering over spreadsheet collections requires finding the correct workbook and computing over complete tables. We introduce Find-then-Compute (FiCo), which retrieves document summaries, disambiguates similar workbooks, and executes constrained Structured Query Language (SQL) over the selected full table. On DataBench (80 datasets, 1,810 questions), FiCo reaches 76.2% accuracy: 9.9 points above a strong TableRAG-style baseline on the same frozen workbook choices (66.3%) under the tracks' prespecified evaluators, and 63.4 points above prefix RAG (12.8%). On 508 MiMoTable questions, FiCo reaches 79.7%, versus 22.2% for prefix RAG. Giving the strong baseline the gold workbook raises it from 66.3% to 76.3%, exposing a 10.0-point source-selection cost under fixed compute. Despite 95.1% document recall and 98.5% executable SQL, only 81.3% of questions execute on the gold workbook. FiCo's advantage comes from integrating semantic source selection with exact, schema-grounded computation.

</details>


### [369] [Multimodal Dual-Encoder Retrieval for Automated ICD Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04263)
*Abhinav Bohra,Anuj Bohra*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出两阶段框架：先用门控融合的多模态双编码器检索ICD编码，再用LLM重排器对top-k候选排序并给出临床解释，在Micro-F1与Precision上优于多模态双融合分类器基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ICD预测方法存在三大问题：(1) 仅依赖结构化EHR数据或非结构化临床笔记，无法理解多模态患者数据；(2) 难以扩展到大规模ICD编码集（ICD-9超过9K编码），传统分类器需要稠密输出层，且对长尾罕见病泛化差；(3) 缺乏临床可用所需的透明度。

Method: 两阶段框架。第一阶段：多模态双编码器检索模型，通过门控融合（gated fusion）整合结构化与非结构化患者数据，检索候选ICD编码。第二阶段：基于LLM的重排器（re-ranker）对top-k检索候选进行精排，输出排序后的编码及临床相关解释。

Result: 实验显示，所提方法在Micro-F1和Precision指标上均优于多模态双融合分类器基线。

Conclusion: 将门控多模态检索系统与LLM重排相结合，是自动化ICD编码中替代稠密多标签分类的一种实用方案。

Abstract: Accurate International Classification of Diseases (ICD) coding is crucial for large-scale clinical research, documentation, and billing. There are three primary problems with current ICD prediction methods: (1) They are unable to comprehend multimodal patient data because they rely on either structured EHR data or unstructured clinical notes. (2) They also struggle with scalability to a larger amount of ICD codes (9K+ codes in ICD-9), as traditional classifiers need dense output layers and often do not generalize well to long tail rare diseases. (3) They lack transparency for clinical use. To address these challenges, this research proposes a two-stage framework that first retrieves ICD codes using a multimodal dual-encoder retrieval model, where structured and unstructured patient data are integrated through gated fusion. The second stage refines the top-k retrieved candidates with an LLM-based re-ranker that provides ranked codes with clinically relevant explanations. Our experiments show that the proposed approach improves Micro-F1 and Precision over a multimodal dual-fusion classifier baseline. These improvements demonstrate that combining a gated multimodal retrieval system with LLM-based re-ranking is a practical alternative to dense multi-label classification for automated ICD coding.

</details>


### [370] [From Valid to Useful: Post-Verification Acquisition for Recursive Self-Improving Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04302)
*Tonmoy Hasan,Taylor Foust,Shao Tang,Leonardo Neves,Aman Gupta,Hiroto Udagawa,Helder Dias,Daniel Silva,Rohan Ramanath*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出"验证后获取"（post-verification acquisition）问题，并设计DA-RSIR方法：通过对源序列贡献设上限，并用基于BALD与MC dropout的 disagreement 分数对已验证序列排序，以决定哪些序列用于训练下一轮模型。跨4数据集、3模型、2指标的24组对比中全部优于retain-all，23/24取得最高均值，且单轮DA-RSIR即超过retain-all五轮递归最好增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 顺序推荐器可在递归自改进循环中生成合成交互序列并重训。现有方法为抑制误差累积，会验证生成序列是否仍能预测用户真实交互并丢弃漂移序列，但验证过后并不确定哪些已验证序列应训练下一模型。若全部使用，源序列因产生更多已验证序列或更长续写而获得更大影响，而这两个量都不能反映其对下一模型的帮助程度，导致训练数据选择缺乏科学依据。

Method: 将"哪些已验证序列用于训练下一模型"形式化为post-verification acquisition，并提出DA-RSIR。该方法对每个源序列的贡献设上限，避免个别源序列主导；再按模型对增强交互预测的不一致程度对其已验证序列排序，使用由BALD导出、经蒙特卡洛dropout估计的分数。无需额外标签、教师模型或质量评分器。

Result: 在4个数据集、3种推荐模型、2项指标共24组对比中，DA-RSIR全部优于retain-all；其中23/24取得最高均值；两项指标上的总体提升均具统计显著性。单轮DA-RSIR即超过retain-all在五轮递归中的最佳增益。

Conclusion: 研究确立post-verification acquisition为递归自改进中的独立控制点，将"哪些序列通过验证"与"哪些已验证序列用于训练下一模型"区分开，表明验证之后的序列选择对性能有显著且可独立优化的影响。

Abstract: Sequential recommenders can generate synthetic interaction sequences and retrain on the augmented corpus in a recursive self-improvement loop. To limit error accumulation, current methods verify each generated sequence remains predictive of the user's real interactions and discard those that drift away from it. Verification does not, however, determine which verified sequences should train the next model. With every verified sequence used for training, source sequences yielding more verified sequences or longer continuations have more influence, although neither quantity indicates how much those sequences will help the next model.
  We formulate the decision of which verified sequences are used to train the next model as \emph{post-verification acquisition} and introduce {\bf Disagreement-Aware Recursive Self-Improving Recommendation (DA-RSIR)}. DA-RSIR caps each source sequence's contribution and ranks its verified sequences by how much the model's predictions disagree over their augmented interactions. It uses a score derived from Bayesian Active Learning by Disagreement (BALD) and estimated with Monte Carlo (MC) dropout.
  DA-RSIR requires no extra labels, teacher model, or quality scorer. Across four datasets, three recommender models, and two metrics, it improves on the retain-all approach in all $24$ comparisons and attains the highest mean in $23$ of $24$ overall; the aggregate improvement is statistically significant on both metrics. A single DA-RSIR round exceeds the retain-all approach's best gain over five recursive rounds. These findings establish post-verification acquisition as a separate control point in recursive self-improvement, separating which sequences pass verification from which verified sequences are used to train the next model.

</details>


### [371] [Query Generation with Direct Preference Optimization for Document Expansion in E-commerce Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04352)
*Kaihao Li,Feng Liu,Juexin Lin,Xunfan Cai,Zhen Yang,Tony Lee,Ciya Liao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 QGDPO，利用直接偏好优化（DPO）改进 Doc2Query 文档扩展，缓解生成幻觉与重复问题，并在 Walmart.com 全流量上线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Doc2Query 依赖序列到序列模型生成相关查询以缓解信息检索中的"词汇不匹配"问题，但其生成结果常包含与文档无关的幻觉或与文档已有的重复内容，如何训练模型产出高质量、新颖且相关的 token 仍是难题。

Method: QGDPO 先微调基础序列到序列模型，再用相关性模型对预测打分；依据分数构建"胜出/落败"预测对作为相关性偏好，用于 DPO（直接偏好优化）训练；同时用相关性模型过滤低质量预测，仅保留最相关生成内容用于索引。

Result: 相比 Doc2Query 基线，QGDPO 减少 50% 的不相关预测，额外的相关性过滤再去除 14.61%；该方案已在 Walmart.com 全流量生产环境部署，相关性与用户互动均有显著提升。

Conclusion: 以 DPO 为核心、结合相关性模型打分的 QGDPO 流程，能有效抑制无关与重复生成，并通过过滤机制进一步提升索引质量，具备实际生产可行性。

Abstract: Doc2Query, a popular document expansion technique, leverages sequence-to-sequence models to generate relevant queries, effectively addressing the "vocabulary mismatch" problem in information retrieval. However, these models often suffer from generating either hallucinations unrelated to the document or repetitive content already present in the document. Training sequence-to-sequence models to produce high-quality, novel, and relevant tokens remains a significant challenge. To address these issues, we introduce a novel approach, QGDPO, that employs direct preference optimization (DPO) to guide the generation process. We first fine-tune a base sequence-to-sequence model and subsequently utilize a relevance model to score its predictions. Based on these scores, we construct pairs of winning and losing predictions as relevance preferences for the DPO training. Furthermore, we enhance our pipeline by using the relevance model to filter out poor predictions, retaining only the most relevant generated content for indexing. QGDPO effectively eliminates 50% of irrelevant predictions comparing against Doc2Query baselines, while the relevance filter removes an additional 14.61%. This feature has been successfully deployed to production on Walmart.com for full traffic, with a substantial improvement in relevance and user engagement.

</details>


### [372] [ModelLakeFishing: Efficient Retrieval over Million-Scale Model Lakes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04904)
*Xiaoyang Liu,Zhengyuan Dong,Renée J. Miller*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出ModelLakeFishing模型检索框架，在百万级模型湖泊中依据目标数据集、任务和评价指标高效检索候选模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放模型湖泊包含数百万可复用模型，为新数据集筛选合适模型成本高昂，亟需高效的检索方法。

Method: 构建模型-数据集-任务证据图，整合元数据与历史评估；用关系感知图编码器学习模型与查询嵌入；用HNSW索引模型嵌入；查询时先检索1000个候选（不逐一打分），再用训练侧任务先验针对目标指标重排并返回Top 10。

Result: 在3016439个模型、247803个模型-数据集性能对的湖泊上评估，采用三种root-aware划分（将测试性能边排除在表示学习与检索之外）。eligible-query的gold@10均值为0.2968，即在29.68%的合格查询中Top 10包含观测最优模型，并保留穷举基线gold@10的93.47%。预计算查询嵌入后，检索与重排耗时中位数0.747 ms，95分位1.102 ms。

Conclusion: 结果表明，在稀疏关系证据下可对百万级模型湖泊实现高效检索。

Abstract: Open model lakes may contain millions of reusable models, making it costly to identify suitable models for a new dataset. We present ModelLakeFishing, a model-retrieval framework for queries specifying a target dataset, prediction task, and evaluation metric. It consolidates metadata and historical evaluations into a model-dataset-task evidence graph, learns model and query embeddings with a relation-aware graph encoder, and indexes model embeddings using Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) search. At query time, HNSW retrieves 1,000 candidates without scoring every model, after which a training-side task prior reranks candidates for the requested metric and returns the top 10. We evaluate on a lake of 3,016,439 models and 247,803 observed model-dataset performance pairs using three root-aware splits that hold test performance edges out of representation learning and retrieval. ModelLakeFishing achieves a mean eligible-query gold@10 of 0.2968, recovering the observed-best model in the top 10 for 29.68% of eligible queries and retaining 93.47% of the gold@10 of an exhaustive baseline using the same scoring and reranking procedure. Given precomputed query embeddings, retrieval and reranking take 0.747 ms median and 1.102 ms at the 95th percentile. These results demonstrate efficient retrieval over million-model lakes from sparse relational evidence.

</details>


### [373] [Do We Still Need Gazetteers in the Era of LLMs? Chaining Retrieval with a Spatial Neuro-Symbolic Index](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05028)
*Horde-Vo Alexis,Duckham Matt,He Estrid*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文检验"文本编码器可充当可靠空间-语义索引"这一假设，在给定上下文化地名提及的条件下检索地名志知识图谱实体，发现无约束稠密检索与层级约束检索之间存在粗粒度-细粒度权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地理信息检索需处理歧义地名，传统方法依赖地名志进行显式索引，而新近的无地名志方法（稠密检索）隐含假设文本编码器学得的表示可作为可靠的空间-语义索引，该假设尚缺乏系统检验。

Method: 构建空间-语义索引评测设置：由上下文化地名提及检索地名志知识图谱文本所表示的对应实体。在五个冻结文本编码器上比较两种检索策略——对实体表示的暴力最近邻检索，以及用地名志层级约束检索的神经-符号分层束搜索。

Result: 呈现明显的粗粒度与细粒度权衡：无约束稠密检索频繁产生灾难性空间错误；层级约束虽改善粗粒度地理定位，但对细粒度定位指标收益有限，说明普通文本编码器无法捕捉地名志中的精细空间保真度。

Conclusion: 隐式的空间-语义索引假设不成立，文本编码器不足以替代地名志的精细空间信息，未来需在检索中引入显式空间约束或改进空间感知表示。

Abstract: Geographic information retrieval (GeoIR) tasks require systems to interpret ambiguous toponyms for downstream applications. Traditionally, toponym resolution relies on gazetteers to provide an explicit index of place entities and spatial relationships. Recently, gazetteer-free approaches seek to reduce dependence on handcrafted searches: dense retrieval utilizes text encoders to capture rich context, moving beyond the limitations of lexical search. However, text encoders implicitly assume that learned representations can function as reliable spatial-semantic indexes. In this paper, we evaluate this assumption through a spatial-semantic indexing setup: given a contextualized toponym mention, we retrieve the corresponding gazetteer entity represented by text derived from a gazetteer knowledge graph. We benchmark five frozen text encoders under two retrieval strategies: brute-force nearest-neighbor retrieval over entity representations, and a neuro-symbolic hierarchical beam search that constrains retrieval (i.e. chaining the search with gazetteer hierarchy). Experimental results reveal a distinct coarse-versus-fine trade-off. Unconstrained dense retrieval frequently incurs catastrophic spatial errors. Conversely, hierarchical constraints improve coarse geographic grounding, but still yield limited benefit for fine-grained localization metrics: vanilla text encoders fail to capture the fine-scale spatial fidelity encoded in gazetteers. Our code is publicly available at: https://doi.org/10.25439/rmt.31094269

</details>


### [374] [Agentic RAG Evaluation: Budget Allocation Across Questions, Trajectories, and Reads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05034)
*Jingjie Ning,Xueqi Li,Yibo Kong*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 在Agentic RAG中，评测预算可分配到问题数、搜索轨迹与重复回答三类资源上。基于HotpotQA与MuSiQue的检索反馈实验表明：在34.14–34.39M模型token预算下，扩大问题覆盖比增加读次数或轨迹数更能降低标准误；归档预测模型可在3.5%–4.0%误差内预测预算分配；温度置零显著降低答案不一致性而不损害比较精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agentic RAG的评测预算并非单一维度，而是横跨问题数量、搜索轨迹与重复回答三类资源。现有工作缺少对"预算应如何分配"的精度-效率-成本量化分析，本文旨在衡量分配精度、读取效率与成本边界，并检验预测模型与温度设置对结果稳定性的影响。

Method: 在HotpotQA与MuSiQue上开展检索反馈对比实验，固定约34.14–34.39M模型token预算，比较不同问题覆盖数、三/五读与两/三轨迹配置；采用通用化理论框架分离方差来源，并用归档的嵌套模型与Q-only预测模型对预算分配进行预测；另设深度子集审计，并检验温度为零时的答案一致性。

Result: 扩大问题覆盖使标准误较五读降低33%、较三轨迹降低12.6%；嵌套与Q-only预测模型分别在4.0%与3.5%误差内预测分配；超出两轨迹审计后深度子集无明确预测优势；相同token预算下，单读相对拟合最优的方差惩罚为0–9.9%，且Pro模型不确定性较大；按记录模型费用，在每千次请求\$0–1的搜索价格下"更多问题"优于"更多轨迹"，但问题与读取的费用排序仍未定论；温度零将答案分歧率从14.3%降至3.4%，比较精度基本不变。

Conclusion: 在固定token预算的Agentic RAG评测中，优先扩展问题覆盖比增加读取或轨迹更有效；预算分配可被简单预测模型近似刻画，但超出两轨迹后收益递减；温度置零是降低答案方差、维持比较精度的低成本手段。问题与读取之间的费用排序仍待进一步厘清。

Abstract: Evaluation budgets in agentic retrieval-augmented generation span questions, search trajectories, and repeated answers. We measure allocation precision, reading efficiency, and cost boundaries using a retrieval-feedback comparison on HotpotQA and MuSiQue. At 34.14--34.39M model tokens, broader question coverage lowers standard error by 33\% versus five reads and 12.6\% versus three trajectories. Archived nested and Q-only forecasts predict these allocations within 4.0\% and 3.5\%, respectively. Depth subsets establish no clear forecasting advantage beyond the two-trajectory audit. One-read variance penalties relative to the fitted optimum at the same token budget are 0--9.9\%, with substantial Pro uncertainty. Under recorded model fees, more questions beat more trajectories at search prices of \$0--1 per 1,000 requests; question-versus-read fee rankings remain unresolved. Temperature zero cuts answer disagreement from 14.3\% to 3.4\% while comparison precision stays similar. \par\medskip\noindent\textbf{Keywords:} Agentic RAG; Evaluation budget; Generalizability theory; Repeated sampling.

</details>


### [375] [SearchJev: A Fast and Calibrated System-1 Model for Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05107)
*Congfeng Cao,Lipeng Zuo,Konstantinos Papakostas,Qiwei Xu,Songwei Xu,Lun Zhou,Zhaochun Ren,Yougang Lyu,Xiaohui Yan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出SearchJev：一种快速且校准良好的System-1决策模型，将搜索决策与System-2推理生成解耦，直接对合法选项打分；配合SLCD软标签校准学习与SearchDecision-Bench基准，在双系统搜索代理中实现决策提速5.2-5.3倍、校准误差降低41-74%，并在BrowseComp-Plus上端到端加速3.7-4.7倍且准确率由45%提升至最高54%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 搜索代理需频繁做短决策（相关性、证据充分性、搜索动作），而用生成式语言模型承担这些决策带来高延迟与不可靠的置信度；因此需要将短决策从System-2的自回归推理与生成中分离，交由快速且校准良好的System-1模型处理。同时该领域缺乏统一覆盖多类搜索决策的训练与评测基准。

Method: 1) SearchJev：给定搜索状态与决策schema，直接对合法选项打分，不做自回归生成，实现低延迟System-1决策；2) SLCD（Soft-Label Learning for Calibrated Decisions）：从不确定监督中学习决策概率并校准置信度；3) 双系统代理架构：SearchJev处理短决策，将不确定判断委托给System-2，由后者保留规划、查询生成与答案撰写；4) 构建SearchDecision-Bench，统一六类搜索决策用于训练与评测。

Result: 在SearchDecision-Bench上，SearchJev相比同规模Qwen3.5自回归模型提升决策质量，决策速度加快5.2-5.3倍，平均期望校准误差（ECE）降低41-74%；在BrowseComp-Plus上，双系统代理的主动搜索时间提速3.7-4.7倍，同时答案准确率从45%提升至最高54%。

Conclusion: 将搜索中的短决策交由专门训练的、可校准的System-1打分模型处理，并把不确定判断回退给System-2，可在显著降低延迟与校准误差的同时提升答案质量，验证了双系统解耦范式在搜索代理中的有效性。

Abstract: Search agents repeatedly make short decisions about relevance, evidence sufficiency, and search actions. Using generative language models for these decisions introduces latency and unreliable confidence. We present SearchJev, a fast and calibrated System-1 model that separates search decisions from System-2 reasoning and generation. Given a search state and a decision schema, SearchJev directly scores legal options without autoregressive output generation. We propose Soft-Label Learning for Calibrated Decisions (SLCD) to learn decision probabilities from uncertain supervision and calibrate their confidence. In a dual-system search agent, SearchJev handles short decisions and delegates uncertain judgments to System 2, which retains planning, query generation, and answer composition. We also introduce SearchDecision-Bench, a benchmark unifying six types of search decisions for training and evaluation. On SearchDecision-Bench, SEARCHJEV improves decision quality over same-size Qwen3.5 autoregressive models, achieves 5.2-5.3 times faster decisions, and reduces average expected calibration error by 41-74%. On BrowseComp-Plus, the dual-system agents achieve a 3.7-4.7 times speedup in active search time while improving answer accuracy from 45% to up to 54%.

</details>


### [376] [Quality-Aware Cross-Model Computation Reuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05285)
*Jin Cheng,Xiangxiang Dai,Maoli Liu,Ziyi Han,Zhuohua Li,John C. S. Lui*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文将跨模型计算复用建模为在线决策问题，提出质量感知复用调度算法QARS，在质量不确定与耦合调度双重挑战下实现$\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})$遗憾，实验降低综合成本达18.0%、平均遗憾达63.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一个模型计算的中间结果可被其他模型复用，但现有工作侧重工程实现，缺乏复用决策的理论优化。该优化存在两大挑战：一是质量不确定性，即复用对任务质量的影响因模型而异；二是耦合调度，即任务需分担准备可复用结果的成本。二者相互叠加：质量需在线学习，而共享准备结构使得即使质量已知时调度也是NP-hard，从而打破了现有方法的关键假设。

Method: 将跨模型计算复用形式化为在线决策问题，提出质量感知复用调度（QARS）算法。针对质量不确定性，QARS从被选中且可能延迟的反馈中学习任务相关的复用质量，并用乐观估计指导决策；针对耦合调度，联合选择准备哪些结果以及哪些任务使用这些结果，并让调度精度随剩余质量不确定性自适应调整。理论分析在遗憾中分离学习误差与优化误差，并刻画调度精度与计算量之间的权衡。

Result: 完成质量感知停止规则后，算法在保持可行性的同时取得$\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})$遗憾。实验表明QARS在跨模型复用优化上有效，相比最强调度基线，计算与质量损失的综合成本最多降低18.0%，平均遗憾降低63.9%。

Conclusion: QARS为跨模型计算复用的复用决策优化提供了理论与实践框架，兼顾质量在线学习与耦合调度，实现了次线性遗憾与可行性保证，并在实验中显著优于基线。

Abstract: An intermediate result computed by one model can be reused by other models to perform their tasks. Existing work mainly focuses on practical execution, leaving a theoretical gap in optimizing reuse decisions. This optimization faces two challenges: quality uncertainty, because the effect of reuse on task quality is uncertain across models, and coupled scheduling, because tasks need to share the cost of preparing reusable results. These challenges compound each other: quality must be learned online, but the shared preparation structure makes scheduling NP-hard even with known quality, breaking the key assumption in existing methods. We formulate cross-model computation reuse as an online decision problem and develop the Quality-Aware Reuse Scheduling (QARS) algorithm to address it. For quality uncertainty, QARS learns task-dependent reuse quality from selected, possibly delayed feedback and uses optimistic estimates to guide decisions. For coupled scheduling, it jointly chooses which results to prepare and which tasks should use them, adapting scheduling accuracy to the remaining quality uncertainty. For the considered problem, our analysis separates learning and optimization error in regret and quantifies the tradeoff between scheduling accuracy and computation. Completing the quality-aware stopping rule yields $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})$ regret while preserving feasibility. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of QARS in optimizing cross-model reuse, reducing the combined cost of computation and quality loss by up to 18.0%, and mean regret by 63.9% over the strongest scheduling baseline.

</details>


### [377] [Search Engines Never Say No: How Frozen Agents React When the Retrieval Tool Refuses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05348)
*Ramraj Chandradevan,Sayontan Ghosh,Vinoth Selvendran*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文研究"检索工具主动拒答"这一新范式：在索引中不存在答案时，工具返回显式拒答信号而非无关段落。实验表明，未预告的一句话拒答可将冻结搜索智能体的弃答率从23%提升至97%（Qwen3-8B/32B），但不同模型反应差异巨大，且现实触发器的效果远不及oracle，瓶颈在于工具内部的检测器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统搜索工具即使索引中不存在答案也会返回top-k段落，导致智能体看到无关文本而无法获得"未命中"信号，进而产生错误回答。作者希望探究：当工具主动"拒绝"时，冻结的搜索智能体会如何反应，以及何种拒答措辞与触发机制最有效。

Method: 构建"索引空洞"测试床：257个NQ和300个HotpotQA问题，分别在包含或不包含金标段落的21M段落BM25索引中检索。七个智能体接收五种拒答措辞。对比未预告拒答与系统提示指令的效果，并测试从轻量分数预测器到LLM接地判断器的现实触发器。

Result: 未预告的一句话拒答使不可答问题的弃答率平均从23%升至97%（Qwen3-8B/32B），从28%升至57%（Claude Haiku 4.5），错误回答几乎一对一减少，平均优于系统提示指令51个百分点。Search-R1忽略拒答并伪造检索结果；Claude Sonnet 5.5与Opus 5.5改用记忆作答（弃答仅+2点），更遵从系统提示指令（+16）。措辞影响显著：带解释优于裸标记，观测内指令对Haiku具决定性，软性警告无用。现实触发器（分数预测器、LLM判断器）均远不及oracle，所有触发器落在"收益—信号质量"曲线上，该曲线以固定误拒预算下的召回率为触发器定价。

Conclusion: 对合规智能体而言，瓶颈在于工具内部的检测器而非智能体本身；"收益—信号质量"曲线量化了检测器每提升一点召回率的价值，为未来检测器研究指明方向。

Abstract: A search tool never says no: it returns its top-k passages even when the index holds no answer, so the agent sees irrelevant text instead of a miss signal. We ask what frozen search agents do when the tool refuses instead. On an index-hole testbed (257 NQ and 300 HotpotQA questions run with and without their gold passages in a 21M-passage BM25 index), seven agents receive one of five refusal wordings. An un-announced one-sentence refusal raises abstention on unanswerable questions from 23% to 97% on average for Qwen3-8B/32B and from 28% to 57% for Claude Haiku 4.5, cutting wrong answers almost one-for-one and beating a system-prompt instruction by 51 points on average. Search-R1 ignores the refusal and fabricates retrievals; Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 answer from memory (abstention +2 points) and obey a system-prompt directive instead (+16). We also found that wording matters: an explanation beats a bare token; a directive inside the observation is decisive for Haiku; a soft warning is useless. Realistic triggers, from a lightweight score-based predictor to an LLM grounding judge, fall well short of the oracle, and all land on a benefit-versus-signal-quality curve that prices any trigger by its recall at a fixed false-refusal budget: for compliant agents the bottleneck is the detector inside the tool, not the agent, and the curve tells future detector work what each point of recall is worth.

</details>


### [378] [OpticalRec: Unified Optical Vision-Language Representation for Multimodal Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05432)
*Yueqi Wang,Zitian Guo,Yupeng Hou,Yifei Wang,Kibum Kim,Zhenrui Yue,Shuo Xing,Haodong Li,Heming Xia,Renrui Zhang,Zhengzhong Tu,Julian McAuley*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出OpticalRec，首个面向多模态协同过滤的视觉空间统一编码范式：将物品文本元数据渲染为视觉字形，在视觉编码器内实现原生图文交互（感知层），再由语言解码器处理（语义层），利用现代视觉-语言模型的双重注意力机制，并以互信息分析提供理论支撑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态推荐方法通常对视觉与语言模态进行独立编码，再通过拼接等刚性晚期融合方式组合，天然忽略了模态间的原生交互，并引入跨模态语义失真，导致物品表示学习与用户-物品匹配不准确。因此，如何在多模态推荐中编码丰富的物品视觉-语言语义交互，长期是一个瓶颈问题。

Method: OpticalRec采用视觉空间统一编码范式：其一，将物品文本元数据渲染为视觉字形（visual glyphs），使图文交互在视觉编码器内部原生发生，对应感知编码层；其二，将所得表示交由语言解码器进一步处理，对应语义编码层，从而利用现代视觉-语言模型的双重注意力机制。该方法被设计为即插即用模块，可无缝集成到现有多模态协同过滤模型中。理论上通过互信息分析予以支撑。

Result: 在多个强基线与基准上与现有方法相比取得更优性能；作为即插即用模块，引入的额外开销极小，且对渲染文本的字体、颜色、布局等变化具有鲁棒性，并能无缝集成到现有多模态协同过滤模型中。

Conclusion: OpticalRec是首个面向多模态协同过滤的视觉空间统一编码范式，通过渲染文本字形并复用视觉-语言模型的双重注意力，避免了独立编码与刚性晚期融合带来的跨模态语义失真，在理论（互信息）与实验（性能、鲁棒性、低成本、易集成）两方面均得到验证，为多模态推荐中的物品表示学习提供了新的编码思路。

Abstract: Recent advances in vision-language modeling have substantially improved multimodal encoding, retrieval and reasoning. Yet for multimodal recommendation, encoding rich item vision-language semantic interactions remains a long-standing bottleneck, which hampers accurate item representation learning and user-item matching. Mainstream approaches primarily adopt independent encoding of vision and language modality followed by rigid late fusion such as concatenation, inherently omitting native vision-language interactions and introducing cross-modal semantic distortion. To address this challenge, we propose OpticalRec, the first visual-space unified encoding paradigm for multimodal collaborative filtering, a fundamental recommendation setting. Instead of isolated modality-specific encoding, OpticalRec renders item textual metadata as visual glyphs, enabling native image-text interaction within the visual encoder - the perceptual encoding level. The resulting representations are further processed by the language decoder - the semantic encoding level, allowing OpticalRec to exploit the dual-attention mechanism of modern vision-language models that previous encoding methods omitted. OpticalRec's efficacy is theoretically supported by mutual information analysis and empirically demonstrated through superior performance across strong baselines and benchmarks. As a plug-and-play module, OpticalRec (1) introduces minimal cost, (2) is robust against rendered text font, color and layout, etc., and (3) integrates seamlessly into existing multimodal collaborative filtering models.

</details>


### [379] [SCOUT: Supply-Aware Cold-Start Proactive Query Suggestion for Travel Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05619)
*Hao Li,Shashank Reddy,Kedar Bellare,Ashish Jain,Stephanie Moyerman*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出SCOUT框架，用供给侧系统反馈替代需求侧用户反馈，通过GRPO训练实现供给感知的主动查询建议，IMR@18提升12.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式查询建议依赖LLM已广泛应用，但现有方法通过用户偏好（点击、转化）对齐。在旅行搜索场景存在两大局限：一是旅行搜索受物理库存约束，同一查询在不同地点供给差异巨大，仅对齐用户偏好无法保证可供给；二是旅行平台采用分面搜索界面，缺乏自由文本查询日志，导致冷启动问题——无需求侧数据可对齐，也无可用的种子查询。

Method: SCOUT采用自举框架，以供给侧系统反馈替代缺失的需求侧用户反馈；将搜索引擎建模为强化学习环境，从生产环境重排序器的查询-列表匹配分数中提取稠密奖励，并使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）优化策略。

Result: 库存匹配率（IMR@18）提升12.3%，同时保持多样性；在零边际推理成本下达到计算密集型best-of-8策略的效果，使供给感知建议可部署于实时旅行搜索链路。

Conclusion: SCOUT通过供给侧反馈与GRPO优化，解决了旅行搜索中库存约束与冷启动难题，实现了可实时部署的主动式供给感知查询建议。

Abstract: Generative query suggestion, powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), has become increasingly popular in search and conversational systems to reduce user friction and guide intent formulation. Existing approaches align suggestions with user preferences (e.g., clicks or conversions). This works for open-ended applications like chatbots and personal assistants, where the result space is unconstrained or historical user free-text queries are abundant.
  However, applying these methods to travel search presents two limitations. First, travel search is fundamentally constrained by physical inventory; a query (e.g., "romantic beachfront villa") may yield abundant results in Bali but few in Tokyo, so aligning with user preferences is not by itself grounded in what can be offered. Second, travel platforms traditionally rely on faceted search interfaces with no free-text queries. This creates a cold-start problem: without historical query logs there is no demand-side data for alignment, and without a seed query at request time, suggestions must be generated proactively from structured context alone.
  To address these challenges, we propose SCOUT, a bootstrapping framework for supply-aware proactive query suggestion. SCOUT overcomes the data gap by substituting missing demand-side user feedback with supply-side system feedback. It treats the search engine as a reinforcement learning environment, deriving a dense reward from the production reranker's query-listing match scores, and optimizes the policy with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). SCOUT improves inventory match rate (IMR@18) by 12.3% while preserving diversity, matching a compute-intensive best-of-8 policy at zero marginal inference cost and making supply-aware suggestion deployable on a real-time travel search path.

</details>


### [380] [Generate What You Can Trust: Content Credibility in Generative Recommenders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05670)
*Zhuo Cai,Guanghao Wu,Shoujin Wang,Peilin Zhou,Victor W. Chu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出CreGR——首个可信生成式推荐模型，在语义ID分词与生成两个阶段联合优化内容可信度，兼顾准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式推荐（GR）方法普遍只优化推荐准确性，忽视所生成推荐内容的可信度，导致用户暴露于假新闻等不可信内容，带来用户不信任、平台声誉受损乃至社会不稳定等后果。该问题尚未被充分探索。

Method: 在两个核心阶段联合处理可信度：（1）分词阶段，设计可信度感知分词器，显式促使模型为可信与不可信物品分别学习具有判别性的token，从token层面解耦可信度信号；（2）生成阶段，提出基于离散扩散的“保准确性-面向可信度”生成器，引入非对称掩码概率缩减策略，选择性降低与不可信内容相关token对生成过程的贡献，同时保持编码用户偏好信号的token不受影响以维持推荐准确性。

Result: 在三个真实世界数据集上的实验验证了CreGR的有效性。

Conclusion: CreGR是首个面向可信度的生成式推荐模型，通过分词与生成两阶段的联合设计，在保持推荐准确性的同时提升推荐内容可信度，为GR的可信性问题提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) represents items with semantic IDs (i.e., discrete token sequences) and generates target item tokens as recommendations. Despite its promising results, existing methods predominantly optimize for accuracy while neglecting the credibility of the recommendations they generate. This oversight inevitably exposes users to uncredible content (e.g., fake news) with serious societal consequences, including user distrust, reputation harm to platforms, and broader social instability. To address this critical yet underexplored challenge, we propose CreGR, the first credible GR model that jointly tackles content credibility across the two core stages of GR: tokenization and generation. In the tokenization stage, we design a new credibility-aware tokenizer that explicitly encourages the model to learn discriminative tokens respectively for credible and uncredible items, thereby disentangling credibility signals at the token level. Building on this, in the generation stage, we propose a novel accuracy-preserving and credibility-oriented generator grounded in discrete diffusion. Specifically, we introduce an asymmetric masking probability reduction strategy that selectively diminishes the contribution of tokens associated with uncredible content to the generation process, while leaving tokens encoding user preference signals unaffected so as to preserve recommendation accuracy. Experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of CreGR.

</details>


### [381] [Beyond Semantic Similarity: Performance and Costs of Agentic Retrieval for Complex Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05750)
*Reza Esfandiarpoor,Radek Osmulski,Yauhen Babakhin,Gabriel de Souza P. Moreira,Oliver Holworthy,Jie He,Ronay Ak,Jiarui Cai,Ryan Chesler,Bo Liu,Even Oldridge*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文研究将LLM推理能力与检索器语料探索能力结合的"智能体检索"（agentic retrieval），在ReAct循环中解决复杂检索任务；实验表明其效果与泛化性优于标准稠密检索，但代价是极高的延迟与Token消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代信息系统（含大量智能体工作流）使用稠密检索探索非结构化数据，但稠密检索依赖表层语义相似度，难以胜任日益复杂的检索应用；因此需要一种能结合LLM推理与检索器高效探索能力的新范式。

Method: 提出/研究智能体检索：在ReAct智能体循环中，将大语言模型的推理能力与检索器的语料探索能力相结合，以求解复杂检索任务；并在ViDoRe v3与BRIGHT等基准上与标准检索及专用检索方法进行对比实验。

Result: 在相同嵌入模型下，智能体检索的nDCG@10相较标准检索提升8.7个点；专用检索方法在域外任务上表现不佳，而同一整套流程在ViDoRe v3和BRIGHT排行榜上均取得有竞争力的结果，泛化性强。代价方面：平均耗时107.4秒（标准检索0.67秒），每查询消耗764.1K输入Token与5.8K输出Token。

Conclusion: 该研究证明了智能体检索在现代数据系统中的有效性，其优势在于效果提升与跨域泛化，但成本（延迟与Token消耗）显著；未来需研究更高成本效益的检索智能体以实现大规模部署。

Abstract: Modern information systems, including many agentic workflows, use dense retrieval to explore large amounts of unstructured data. However, dense retrieval relies on surface-level semantic similarity, which is insufficient for increasingly complex search applications. Here, we investigate agentic retrieval that combines the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) with the efficient corpus exploration of retrievers in a ReAct agentic loop to solve complex retrieval tasks. In our experiments, we show that agentic retrieval is more effective than standard retrieval, improving nDCG@10 by 8.7 points using the same embedding model. Moreover, while specialized retrieval methods struggle on out-of-domain tasks, agentic retrieval is highly generalizable: the same pipeline achieves competitive results on both the ViDoRe v3 and BRIGHT leaderboards. However, this improvement comes at a cost. On average, agentic retrieval takes 107.4 seconds, compared to 0.67 seconds for standard retrieval, and consumes 764.1K input and 5.8K output tokens per query. In short, our study demonstrates the effectiveness of agentic retrieval in modern data systems and motivates future work on more cost-efficient retrieval agents for large-scale deployment.

</details>


### [382] [Constraint-Aware Conversational Job Recommendation in Code-Mixed Low-Resource Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05787)
*Md Arman Hossain,Mubashir Jawad,Fariha Khandaker Moon,Sonia Binte Siraj,Masfiqur Rahaman,Raihan ul Islam,Ahmed Wasif Reza,Nafis Sadeq*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 JobCCC——面向孟加拉国低资源、代码混合场景的对话式职位推荐基准，包含 22,410 条结构化职位和 988 段多轮求职对话，并提出软约束感知排序框架 W-SCAR，在英/孟混合两种语言下取得更均衡的检索性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话式职位推荐需同时建模语义相关性、用户偏好、任职资格与真实对话中的噪声语言；在低资源、代码混合（英语与罗马化孟加拉语）场景中尤为困难，严格的硬约束匹配会错误剔除本可胜任的职位。现有工作缺乏此类基准与适配方法。

Method: 构建 JobCCC 基准：22,410 条结构化职位 + 988 段来自区域 Reddit 社区的多轮职业咨询对话，每段对话标注动态演化的求职者偏好并链接一个真实职位，且提供语义等价的英文与罗马化孟加拉语-英语两个版本。方法层面对比稀疏 BM25 检索、多语言稠密检索及各自的硬约束过滤变体，提出 W-SCAR 多准则排序框架，融合词汇相关性、语义相关性与经验、地点、学历、薪资的梯度效用，并用 TOPSIS 进行多目标折中排序。

Result: 严格硬约束过滤一致地降低检索效果，原因是不完整的属性抽取与脆弱的属性匹配会不可逆地移除相关职位；W-SCAR 避免破坏性剪枝，在两种语言条件下性能更均衡，英文与 Banglish 的 Hit@10 分别为 37.37% 与 38.43%。代码与数据集已开源。

Conclusion: 在低资源代码混合的对话式职位推荐中，软约束感知的多准则排序优于硬过滤方案，兼顾跨语言稳健性与检索召回；JobCCC 为该方向提供了可复现的评测基准与数据资源。

Abstract: Conversational job recommendation requires jointly modeling semantic relevance, user preferences, eligibility requirements, and the noisy language used in real-world career discussions. These challenges are especially pronounced in low-resource, code-mixed settings, where strict constraint matching can incorrectly eliminate otherwise suitable jobs. We introduce JobCCC, a conversational job recommendation benchmark for Bangladesh comprising 22,410 structured job postings and 988 multi-turn career-advice dialogues derived from regional Reddit communities. Each dialogue is annotated with evolving seeker preferences and linked to a ground-truth job, and is evaluated in semantically equivalent English and Romanized Bangla--English variants. We compare sparse BM25 retrieval, multilingual dense retrieval, and their hard-constraint-filtered counterparts against Weighted Soft-Constraint-Aware Ranking (W-SCAR), our multi-criteria ranking framework that combines lexical relevance, semantic relevance, and graded utilities for experience, location, education, and salary using the Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS). Experiments reveal that strict filtering consistently degrades retrieval because incomplete extraction and brittle attribute matching irreversibly remove relevant jobs. W-SCAR avoids destructive pruning and achieves more balanced performance across the two language conditions, obtaining 37.37% and 38.43% Hit@10 on English and Banglish, respectively. The code and dataset are publicly available at \href{https://github.com/M-Jawad01/Conversational-Job-Recommendation-System-LLM}{GitHub} and \href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/Armans33115/JobCCC-Conversational-Job-Recommendation-Bangladesh}{Hugging Face}, respectively.

</details>


### [383] [MATE: Adaptive Long- and Short-Term User Memory for LLM-Based Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06050)
*Yu Hou*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出 MATE 框架，用双时间视角评估交互并驱动长/短期用户记忆的自适应更新，提升 LLM 增强序列推荐性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 增强推荐系统虽利用丰富物品语义，但仅靠语义表示无法区分哪些历史行为反映持久偏好、哪些仅代表近期兴趣，用户理解中的这一关键问题尚未解决。

Method: MATE（Memory Adaptation with Temporal Evidence）从两个时间视角评估新观测交互：是否被历史行为反复支持、是否与近期交互一致；由该时间证据控制两个用户专属记忆的更新（长期记忆保守保留持久偏好，短期记忆快速适应近期兴趣）；每次推荐时用近期上下文表示动态决定两记忆对当前用户表示的贡献强度。离线训练联合优化下一项预测与时间监督，在线自适应时固定共享模型、仅更新两个用户记忆。

Result: 在 MovieLens-10M、Amazon Luxury Beauty、KuaiRec 三个数据集上，mean NDCG@10 相比最强外部基线提升 7.0–13.2%；进一步分析支持其既能适应近期兴趣，又能保留反复出现的早期偏好的有用信息。

Conclusion: MATE 通过时间证据驱动的长短记忆自适应机制，有效兼顾近期兴趣与持久偏好，为 LLM 增强序列推荐提供了更强的用户建模方案。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-enhanced recommender systems leverage rich item semantics to support personalized recommendation. However, semantic representations alone do not determine which historical behaviors reflect persistent preferences and which mainly indicate recent interests, leaving an important aspect of user understanding unresolved. Recent advances in LLM inference show that newly available information can be used to refine the internal state during inference, thereby improving subsequent predictions. Inspired by this principle, we propose MATE (Memory Adaptation with Temporal Evidence), an adaptive user modeling framework for LLM-enhanced sequential recommendation. MATE first evaluates each newly observed interaction from two temporal perspectives: whether it is repeatedly supported by historical behaviors and whether it is consistent with recent interactions. The resulting temporal evidence controls the updates of two user-specific memories, where the long-term memory conservatively preserves persistent preferences while the short-term memory rapidly adapts to recent interests. For each recommendation, a recent-context representation dynamically determines how strongly the two memories contribute to the current user representation. During offline training, next-item prediction is jointly optimized with temporal supervision, while during online adaptation, the shared model remains fixed and only the two user memories are updated from newly observed interactions. Experiments on MovieLens-10M, Amazon Luxury Beauty, and KuaiRec show that MATE improves mean NDCG@10 over the strongest external baseline by 7.0--13.2%. Further analyses support its ability to adapt to recent interests while retaining useful information about recurring earlier preferences.

</details>


### [384] [Beyond States: Investigating the Effects of Context on User Modeling with Feature-Conditioned Markov Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06060)
*Jana Isabelle Friese,Andreas Konstantin Kruff,Timo Breuer,Philipp Schaer,Norbert Fuhr*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出特征条件化的马尔可夫式用户模型，将转移概率建模为位置、内容与交互特征的函数，在保留状态模型简洁性与效率的同时实现情境感知决策，并通过多层级框架评估情境特征对用户模拟真实性的贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典基于状态的用户模拟方法（如马尔可夫模型）难以纳入对决策有用的情境信息，限制了其在交互式信息检索系统评估中的真实性。

Method: 提出特征条件化的马尔可夫式用户模型，将转移概率表示为位置特征、内容特征和交互衍生特征的函数；采用涵盖预测拟合度与行为保真度的多层级框架，在多个数据集、搜索场景和特征配置下分析不同情境信息来源的作用。

Result: 引入情境特征能够提升模型复现真实用户交互关键方面的能力，但其效果取决于搜索场景与建模目标，不存在通用最优方案，有效模拟需要针对具体任务和场景进行特征选择。

Conclusion: 该框架为任务与场景特定的特征选择提供了实用且可解释的依据，表明情境感知用户模拟应以具体建模目标为导向，而非采用一刀切方案。

Abstract: User behavior simulation is widely used to evaluate interactive information retrieval systems, but classical state-based approaches (e.g., Markov models) have limited ability to incorporate contextual information relevant for decision-making. We address this limitation by introducing a feature-conditioned Markov-style user model, in which transition probabilities are modeled as functions of positional, content-based, and interaction-derived features, enabling context-aware decision making while preserving the structural simplicity and computational efficiency of state-based models. Applying a multi-level framework that assesses predictive fit and behavioral fidelity, we analyze how different sources of contextual information contribute to realistic user simulation across multiple datasets, search settings, and feature configurations. Our results show that incorporating contextual features improves the models' ability to reproduce key aspects of real user interactions, but that their effectiveness hinges on search scenario and modeling objective. Instead of a one-size-fits-all solution, effective simulation requires task- and setting-specific feature selection. Our framework provides a practical and interpretable basis for making these choices.

</details>


### [385] [Commercial Intent in Human-AI Conversations: A Corpus Audit and Architecture for Website Sales Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06205)
*Benjamin Tannenbaum*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 对Aiso提供的725,219条会话记录进行元数据普查，并提出面向对话式销售代理的参考架构与质量规范。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话式销售代理需区分产品咨询与购买承诺、保留显式需求，并将下一步动作建立在最新业务信息之上，因此需要先摸清语料规模与标签分布，再设计系统架构。

Method: 对725,219条记录做聚合普查（会话哈希唯一非空），统计商业/交易标签占比、类别内语言与深度分布、跨批次流行度差异；据此提出结合业务知识、带溯源会话状态与受限动作策略的参考架构，并给出覆盖来源权利、隐私、标签验证、去重与训练-测试分离的质量规范。

Result: 商业记录41,800条（5.76%），交易记录2,387条（0.33%），并集44,187条（6.09%）；商业类中英语占54.31%，深度≥2占41.59%，深度≥4占13.51%；商业标签流行度在三批次间为4.87%–6.35%。

Conclusion: 该研究属元数据审计与技术设计，不验证标签准确性、训练规模或销售转化，且不发布原始会话文本或个人标识；结论推动将语料清单、商业相关性、训练资格与业务结果显式分离。

Abstract: Conversational sales agents must distinguish questions about products from purchase commitments, preserve explicit requirements, and ground the next action in current business information. We report an aggregate census of 725,219 records in an accessible conversation table provided by Aiso and develop a reference architecture for this setting. All records have distinct non-null conversation hashes. Existing metadata labels identify 41,800 commercial records (5.76%) and 2,387 transactional records (0.33%); their union contains 44,187 records (6.09%). Within the commercial category, 54.31% are labeled English, 41.59% have recorded depth of at least two, and 13.51% have depth of at least four. Commercial-label prevalence varies from 4.87% to 6.35% across three source batches. These measurements motivate explicit separation of corpus inventory, commercial relevance, training eligibility, and observed business outcomes. The proposed architecture combines business-grounded knowledge, provenance-bearing conversation state, and a constrained next-action policy. A quality specification addresses source rights, privacy, label validation, deduplication, and training-test separation. The study is a metadata audit and technical design, not a validation of label accuracy, model training volume, or sales conversion. No raw conversation text or personal identifiers are released.

</details>


### [386] [SPRIG: Semantic-ID-enhanced Paths for Knowledge Graph-based Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06590)
*Justin Hangoebl,Marta Moscati,Alessandro B. Melchiorre,Shah Nawaz,Markus Schedl*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出SPRIG，将内容派生的语义ID（SID）融入知识图谱（KG）路径推理，实现互补融合的生成式推荐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式推荐中两大方向各有局限：基于SID的模型缺乏关系性依据（relational grounding）；基于KG的生成式推荐仍将物品表示为与大型嵌入表绑定的不透明token，限制了参数共享与泛化能力。二者互补，因此需要融合。

Method: SPRIG是一种生成式推荐器，将内容派生的SID集成到KG路径推理中。模型在信息丰富的KG路径上训练，路径以离散、内容派生的token表示的物品为终点，从而结合两种方法的优势。

Result: 在电影与音乐推荐数据集上，与序列语言模型、KG增强方法及SID方法等基线的对比中，SPRIG以更少的参数和更低的计算成本取得与先前生成式模型相当（competitive）的性能。

Conclusion: 融合内容派生SID与KG路径推理可在更低参数与计算开销下达到有竞争力的推荐性能，验证了两条研究路线结合的可行性与效率优势。

Abstract: Recommender systems leveraging generative models often generate item identifiers directly, rather than ranking catalog items by a recommendation score. Recent work extends beyond pure sequential interaction signals by incorporating item content and structured relationships among items, with two distinct directions emerging. Semantic IDs (SIDs) enrich item representations by replacing opaque, randomly initialized embeddings with hierarchically quantized discrete codes derived from item content. Knowledge-graph (KG) path reasoning instead generates entity-relation paths that ground recommendations in structured relationships between items, attributes, and external entities, thereby enriching the relational context. These two lines have complementary limitations: SID-based models lack relational grounding, while KG-based generative recommenders still represent items as arbitrary, opaque tokens tied to large embedding tables, limiting parameter sharing and generalization. We propose SPRIG, a generative recommender that integrates content-derived SIDs into KG path reasoning. SPRIG is trained on information-rich KG paths that terminate in items represented as discrete, content-derived tokens, combining the advantages of both approaches. We evaluate SPRIG on movie and music recommendation datasets against baselines spanning sequential language models, KG-augmented methods, and SID-based approaches. Our results show that SPRIG achieves competitive performance over prior generative models while using fewer parameters and a lower compute cost. Code: https://github.com/justinhangoebl/semantic-id-knowledge-graph-recommender

</details>


### [387] [Reading the Mood: Emotion-Guided Book-to-Music Recommendation via CGANs and LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06703)
*Manousos Linardakis,Georgios Alexandridis*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出SAGA-CDR两阶段跨域推荐框架，为书籍匹配情绪一致的音乐，在Amazon与Douban数据集上取得最优评分预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 与文本情绪匹配的背景音乐能增强读者沉浸感、改善阅读体验，因此需要能将书籍与情绪匹配音乐配对的推荐系统。

Method: 第一阶段用transformer构建情感嵌入，经条件生成对抗网络跨域映射，其掩码条件生成器处理缺失情感分量并注入随机性；再用紧凑评分神经网络融合情感交互分与协同过滤先验预测音乐评分。第二阶段用大语言模型将书籍分类到效价-唤醒情绪象限，并据此筛选候选曲目。

Result: 在英文Amazon和中文Douban数据集上，Amazon达到最佳评分预测精度（RMSE 0.98），Douban取得最低RMSE（0.91），排序性能与最强情感感知基线相当，跨语言场景下亦然。

Conclusion: SAGA-CDR通过情感嵌入跨域迁移与情绪象限过滤，实现了情绪对齐的个性化音乐推荐，并验证了跨域、跨语言的有效性。

Abstract: Background music that matches the mood of a text has been shown to make readers feel more immersed and improve their reading experience, motivating recommender systems that pair books with mood-matched music. In this direction, we present Sentiment Aware Generative Adversarial Network for Cross Domain Recommendation (SAGA-CDR), a two-phase cross-domain recommendation framework that personalizes music suggestions and emotionally aligns them with the book being read. In the first phase, transformer-based sentiment embeddings are constructed from user reviews and mapped across domains via a Conditional Generative Adversarial Network, whose mask-conditioned generator handles missing sentiment components and injects stochasticity for richer preference transfer. A compact rating neural network then fuses sentiment-specific interaction scores with a collaborative filtering prior to predict music ratings. In the second phase, large language models classify each book into a valence-arousal emotional quadrant, and candidate tracks are filtered to match that quadrant. Experiments on both the English Amazon and Chinese Douban datasets show that SAGA-CDR achieves the best rating prediction accuracy on Amazon (RMSE 0.98) and the lowest RMSE on Douban (0.91), with ranking performance competitive with the strongest sentiment-aware baseline, even in cross-lingual settings.

</details>


### [388] [Orchestrating Specialized Agents for Trustworthy Enterprise RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.18267)
*Xincheng You,Qi Sun,Neha Bora,Huayi Li,Shubham Goel,Kang Li,Sean Culatana*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: ADORE是一个面向企业知识工作的智能体式RAG框架，用迭代式、用户引导的调研流程替代线性检索，通过结构化记忆库实现可追溯的长文综合，在DeepResearch Bench和DeepConsult上均取得领先表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业级RAG在高风险决策场景中表现不足：需要深度综合、严格可追溯性，并能应对信息不充分的提示。一次性的"检索-写作"流水线常导致摘要浅薄、依据不一致，且缺乏证据完整性的校验机制。

Method: 提出ADORE框架，由中央编排器协调多个专用智能体，将线性检索替换为迭代式、用户引导的调研。核心设计是结构化记忆库（Memory Bank）：一个经过策展的证据存储，含显式的声明-证据链接与章节级可采纳证据。三项技术贡献：(1) 记忆锁定式综合，将报告生成约束在结构化记忆库（声明-证据图）内，实现可追溯声明与有据引用；(2) 证据覆盖度引导执行，通过检索-反思循环审计章节级证据覆盖，触发针对性补充检索，并以证据驱动的停止准则终止；(3) 章节打包式长上下文接地，通过章节级打包、剪枝与保留引用的压缩，使长文综合在上下文限制下可行。

Result: 在评估套件中，ADORE在DeepResearch Bench排名第一（52.65分），并在DeepConsult上取得对商业系统最高的头对头偏好胜率（77.2%）。

Conclusion: 结构化记忆库与证据覆盖度驱动的迭代调研机制能有效提升企业级RAG在深度综合、可追溯性与完整性验证方面的能力；ADORE在企业研究场景下优于现有商业系统。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) shows promise for enterprise knowledge work, yet it often underperforms in high-stakes decision settings that require deep synthesis, strict traceability, and recovery from underspecified prompts. One-pass retrieval-and-write pipelines frequently yield shallow summaries, inconsistent grounding, and weak mechanisms for completeness verification. We introduce ADORE (Adaptive Deep Orchestration for Research in Enterprise), an agentic framework that replaces linear retrieval with iterative, user-steered investigation coordinated by a central orchestrator and a set of specialized agents. ADORE's key insight is that a structured Memory Bank (a curated evidence store with explicit claim-evidence linkage and section-level admissible evidence) enables traceable report generation and systematic checks for evidence completeness. Our contributions are threefold: (1) Memory-locked synthesis - report generation is constrained to a structured Memory Bank (Claim-Evidence Graph) with section-level admissible evidence, enabling traceable claims and grounded citations; (2) Evidence-coverage-guided execution - a retrieval-reflection loop audits section-level evidence coverage to trigger targeted follow-up retrieval and terminates via an evidence-driven stopping criterion; (3) Section-packed long-context grounding - section-level packing, pruning, and citation-preserving compression make long-form synthesis feasible under context limits. Across our evaluation suite, ADORE ranks first on DeepResearch Bench (52.65) and achieves the highest head-to-head preference win rate on DeepConsult (77.2%) against commercial systems.

</details>


<div id='cs.SE'></div>

# cs.SE [[Back]](#toc)

### [389] [Smells and Refactorings for Software Environmental Sustainability: A Systematic Literature Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03838)
*Ornela Danushi,Flavio Sampirisi,Jacopo Soldani,Stefano Forti,Antonio Brogi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过系统性文献综述分析66项研究，识别出20种影响软件环境可持续性的"绿色坏味道"，并将其映射到相应的重构技术。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ICT的环境影响持续增长，需要应对高能耗软件系统以降低其生态足迹。软件即使功能先进，仍可能携带结构性低效，将这些低效识别为"绿色坏味道"可为重构代码、减轻生态影响提供基础。

Method: 对讨论绿色坏味道及其可能重构的文献进行系统性文献综述，分析并分类截至2026年3月发表的66项原始研究。

Result: 识别出20种影响软件环境可持续性的坏味道，每种坏味道均关联一种或多种已知可缓解其负面环境影响的重构技术。

Conclusion: 文献表明学界对解决影响软件系统的绿色坏味道具有兴趣。所编目的绿色坏味道及对应重构可为实践者日常工作流提供实用价值，同时为研究者确立可持续软件工程的新研究方向提供起点。

Abstract: Context: The environmental impact of ICT is constantly growing. Enhancing its environmental sustainability requires dealing with energy-hungry software systems, by possibly reducing their footprint. Objective: To better frame the problem and its persistent nature, software can be viewed as carrying structural inefficiencies regardless of how advanced its functionality may be. Identifying these inefficiencies as "green smells" provides a basis for refactoring code to mitigate its ecological impact. We aim at identifying well-known green smells impacting environmental sustainable software and map them to corresponding refactoring aimed at reducing the impact therein. Method: In this article, we conduct a systematic literature review on the articles that discuss green smells and their possible refactorings. We analyse and classify 66 primary studies published up to March 2026. Results: We identify 20 smells impacting environmental sustainability of software. Each smell is associated with one or more refactoring techniques known to mitigate their negative effects on the environmental sustainability of software. Conclusions: The literature witnesses the interest in resolving the green smells affecting software systems. The catalogued green smells and the corresponding refactorings can provide pragmatic value for practitioners in their daily development workflows, while also offering researchers a starting point to establish new research directions in sustainable software engineering.

</details>


### [390] [Characterizing Open-Source Video Games from a Software Engineering Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03953)
*Henrique Mandelli Canella,Yohan Duarte,Cristiano Politowski,Vinicius Durelli,Andre Takeshi Endo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文从软件工程视角对491款itch.io开源游戏（GitHub托管）进行了实证特征刻画，涵盖类型、人气、仓库活跃度、实现特征与测试实践。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 独立工作室、小团队及个人开发者在预算受限下通过itch.io等平台发布游戏，许多项目以开源形式公开源码。这些开源游戏为软件工程实证研究提供了透明、可及且通常在商业项目中难以获得的开发工件语料，但此前对其整体特征缺乏系统性刻画。

Method: 从itch.io上以开源形式发布于GitHub的491款视频游戏中提取元数据，围绕游戏类型、流行度、仓库活动、实现特征（如游戏引擎）与测试实践进行分析。

Result: 开源游戏类型集中于Puzzle、Action、Platformer等有限类别；在有评分时玩家评分普遍偏高，显示社区接受度较好；仓库大多处于休眠或最低限度维护状态；多数项目采用Godot或Unity引擎；与测试相关的实践文档很少被包含。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了开源视频游戏的开发现状，可为面向小团队与独立开发者的软件工程实践及工具设计提供参考。

Abstract: Video games hold a prominent role in the entertainment industry, which constitutes a multibillion-dollar global market. Within this ecosystem, independent studios, small teams, and solo developers operate with constrained budgets while making their games available through platforms such as itch.io, where many projects are also available as open-source. Where even if the project is fully released, other developers can still have access to the development process through the source code, helping other developers to develop their own games. These open-source games also constitute a valuable corpus for empirical software engineering research, offering transparent access to development artifacts that are typically inaccessible in commercial projects. This study characterizes open-source video games from a Software Engineering standpoint, focusing on their genres, popularity, repository activity, implementation characteristics, and testing practices. To this end, we extracted metadata from 491 video games from itch.io, published as open-source projects in GitHub. The results indicate that open-source games predominantly fall within limited genres (Puzzle, Action, and Platformer), that player ratings, when available, tend to be high, bringing a perception that the community receives well those kind of games, that repositories are largely dormant or minimally maintained, that the majority of these projects adopt either Godot or Unity as their game engine, and that documentation of testing-related practices is seldom included. The results offer insights into the development of open-source video games and may contribute to advancing software engineering practices and tools designed for small teams and independent game developers.

</details>


### [391] [How Do Coding Agents Optimize Software and Report Performance Validation? A Large-Scale Empirical Study of Open-Source Pull Requests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03969)
*Huiyun Peng,Ricardo Calvo,Kelechi G. Kalu,James C. Davis*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该研究对比1130个智能体提交与1130个人工编写的性能优化PR，发现智能体PR合并率更低（54.4% vs 73.3%），但优化策略与验证报告率相近；其更依赖静态推理而非基准测试，且约半数已验证PR缺乏量化性能指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主AI编码智能体已开始向开源项目提交面向性能的PR，但其改动是否符合成熟的优化实践、是否充分论证其声称的性能价值尚不明确，因此需要系统比较智能体与人工性能优化的采纳结果与证据质量。

Method: 扩展MSR 2026 Mining Challenge的407个性能PR试点研究，采集截至2026年6月的1130个智能体PR与1130个人工PR样本；对比两组的采纳结果与补丁特征，并考察其优化策略与验证行为。

Result: 智能体PR合并率显著低于人工PR（54.4% vs 73.3%），但两组优化策略相似、验证报告率相当；智能体更依赖静态推理解释、较少使用基准测试（46.1% vs 57.2%），不过基准使用在研究末期趋于收敛；智能体对代码坏味重构与资源定向改动的验证报告率相当，人工PR则前者更少；两组中约半数已验证PR未报告量化性能指标，且相关权衡极少被量化。

Conclusion: 智能体的性能优化实践已日益接近人类实践，但其支撑证据仍不完整。判断智能体提出的优化是否由严格、量化且多维的证据支撑仍是重要挑战，因此需要能衡量预期效果与相关成本的评估基础设施与评审标准，而非仅以“存在验证”为充分条件。

Abstract: Software performance optimization requires identifying bottlenecks and improvement opportunities, and empirically evaluating the effects and trade-offs across performance objectives. Autonomous AI coding agents submit performance-oriented pull requests (PRs) to open-source projects, yet it remains unclear whether these changes reflect established optimization practices and adequately substantiate their claimed value. Extending our MSR 2026 Mining Challenge pilot study of 407 performance PRs, we analyze a sample of 1,130 agentic and 1,130 human-authored performance PRs collected through June 2026. We compare adoption outcomes and patch characteristics between the two groups, and examine their optimization practices and validation behaviors. The results show that agentic PRs are merged less often than human-authored PRs (54.4% vs. 73.3%), but the two groups use similar optimization strategies and report validation at comparable rates. Agentic PRs rely more on static reasoning and less on benchmarks (46.1% vs. 57.2%), although benchmark use converges by the end of the study period. Agentic PRs also report validation for code-smell refactorings as often as for resource-targeting changes, whereas human-authored PRs do so less often. Across both groups, about half of validated PRs report no quantitative performance metric, and relevant trade-offs are rarely quantified. Agentic optimization practice has become increasingly similar to human practice, but the supporting evidence remains incomplete. Establishing whether agent-proposed optimizations are supported by rigorous, quantitative, and multidimensional evidence remains an important challenge. These findings motivate evaluation infrastructure and review criteria that measure intended effects and relevant costs rather than treating the presence of validation alone as sufficient.

</details>


### [392] [World Requirement Model: Learning Requirement-Change Consequences from Typed Artifact Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04445)
*Yuanpeng He,Lijian Li,Dongming Jin,Huanyao Zhang,Fangjing Li,Linyu Li,Chung-ju Huang,Tianxiang Zhan,Qingsong Wen,Wenpin Jiao*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出世界需求模型（WRM），将需求变更的工程语境编码为带类型的人工产物图，并在共享标识符处预测影响、冲突、违规与缺陷风险等后果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 需求变更会波及相互关联的利益相关者、约束、组件与测试，需要一个能刻画此类工程语境并预测连锁后果的模型。

Method: WRM 将工程语境建模为带类型（typed）的人工产物图；采用关系感知注意力与类型化传播对节点进行语境化；用世界表示与决策表示支撑学习到的动态；共享读出层对影响、冲突、违规、缺陷风险打分，并以辅助目标监督后继邻接与潜变量预测。

Result: 在6个领域282个合成案例中的28个评分案例上，影响MAP达0.724，优于哈希文本MLP的0.623（相对提升16.2%，配对差0.101，条件95%区间[0.044,0.159]）；最低四分位平均AP提升32.4%，等域MAP提升13.3%。扩展语料上4组47案例对比显示MAP增益15.6%–29.1%，五项指标均值全面更高。

Conclusion: WRM 提出了一种以人工产物为寻址单元的世界模型形式化，为语境化后果打分提供了对比性证据，并给出评估需求-世界预测的明确条件；同时指出结果仅刻画所选系统（检查点按评分案例选取、骨干网络不匹配），并给出候选覆盖界及线性影响头无法在固定世界内跨决策重排的局限。

Abstract: Requirement changes can affect connected stakeholders, constraints, components, and tests. We present World Requirement Model (WRM), which encodes this engineering context as a typed artifact graph and predicts consequences at shared artifact identifiers. Relation-aware attention and typed propagation contextualize nodes; world and decision representations support learned dynamics. Shared readouts score impact, conflict, violation, and defect risk; auxiliary objectives supervise successor adjacency and latent prediction. On 28 scored cases from 282 synthetic cases in six domains, WRM obtains impact mean average precision (MAP) of 0.724 versus 0.623 for a hashed-text multilayer perceptron (MLP), a 16.2\% relative gain and paired difference of 0.101 (conditional 95\% interval [0.044,0.159]). Lowest-quarter mean AP improves by 32.4\%, and equal-domain MAP by 13.3\%. Four 47-case comparisons on an expanded corpus show MAP gains of 15.6--29.1\% and higher means on all five reported metrics. The recorded advantage thus extends across score summaries and annotation/training settings. Checkpoints were selected on scored cases, and backbones are unmatched, so these results characterize selected systems. Our analysis establishes candidate-coverage bounds and shows that the current linear impact head cannot rerank a fixed world's artifacts across decisions. WRM contributes an artifact-addressed world-model formulation, comparative evidence for contextual consequence scoring, and explicit conditions for evaluating requirement-world prediction.

</details>


### [393] [Noise-Resilient Testing of Quantum Programs Based on Output Dominance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04461)
*Yuechen Li,Yige Yang,Tao Yue*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 Qomino，一种无需独立噪声估计或缓释阶段、直接从含噪样本判定测试的支配引导量子软件测试方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NISQ 时代的门、退相干与测量误差会扭曲观测输出，使程序缺陷与噪声难以区分；现有噪声感知 QST 方法多在测试预言前先缓释或建模噪声，成本高且依赖标定数据、模型训练或后端特定信息，适用性受限。

Method: Qomino 结合三项机制：分解感知的逆构造、将期望结果与最强观测竞争者对比较、以及针对不确定判定的有界重试。

Result: 在六个 Qiskit 程序的 30 个受控缺陷变体和六个模拟噪声后端上，与统计类、量子专用类及基于学习的六种基线对比，Qomino 在全部六程序上准确率 85.65%，在两程序受限评估中达 99.95%，显著优于对应基线，且在所述设置下速度快于量子专用及基于学习的方法；消融与重试分析支持各主要组件的贡献。

Conclusion: Qomino 可在不进行独立噪声估计或缓释的情况下实现高准确率、较快的含噪量子程序测试判定，其核心组件经消融验证有效。

Abstract: Quantum software testing (QST) is a central quality-assurance activity for checking whether quantum programs conform to their specifications. In the noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) era, gate, decoherence, and measurement errors distort observed outputs, making it difficult to distinguish program defects from noise. The existing noise-aware QST literature typically mitigates or models noise before applying a test oracle. However, these strategies can incur substantial cost and depend on calibration data, model training, or backend-specific information, limiting their applicability. We present Qomino, a dominance-guided QST approach for judging tests from noisy samples without a separate noise-estimation or mitigation phase. The approach combines decomposition-aware inverse construction, comparison of the expected outcome with the strongest observed competitor, and bounded retries for inconclusive decisions. We evaluate Qomino on 30 controlled buggy variants from six Qiskit programs and six simulated noisy backends, comparing it with six baselines spanning statistical, quantum-specific, and learning-based methods. Qomino achieves 85.65% accuracy over all six programs and 99.95% in the restricted two-program evaluation, significantly outperforming the corresponding baselines. Across the evaluated programs and backends under the stated settings, Qomino is faster than the compared quantum-specific and learning-based methods. Ablation and retry analyses support the contributions of its main components.

</details>


### [394] [DreamTest: World-Model Surrogates for Search-Based Testing of Deep Reinforcement Learning Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04494)
*Qinghua Xu,Guancheng Wang,Boxi Yu,Liting Lin,Lionel Briand*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: DreamTest利用世界模型（循环状态空间模型）学习智能体行为与环境动态，通过"想象轨迹"预测DRL智能体测试中的失败，在失败预测、测试生成和失败多样性上显著优于黑盒基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在信息物理系统中测试深度强化学习（DRL）智能体需在部署前发现多样失败，但每次执行代价高昂。现有代理（surrogate）方法将系统视为黑盒，直接预测通过/失败结果，忽略了测试过程的动态展开信息，预测能力受限。

Method: 提出DreamTest——一种基于世界模型的代理测试方法。它改造循环状态空间模型（recurrent state-space model），从智能体的训练日志中学习智能体行为与环境动态。给定候选测试配置，通过"想象轨迹"（imagined rollouts）生成失败分数，用于引导搜索，从而无需在仿真器或真实系统中逐一执行候选配置。

Result: 在Parking、Humanoid、DonkeyCar三个任务上评估失败预测、测试生成与失败多样性：平均AUPRC分别较最强基线提升97%、12%、39%；在五个分布外测试集上增益达145%、29%、44%。在相同仿真验证预算下，"DreamTest+搜索"组合平均多发现29%、22%、79%的新失败。在k=2–40的聚类中，DreamTest生成的失败几乎对所有k都覆盖最多的行为簇。

Conclusion: 基于世界模型的代理测试范式（建模测试展开过程而非直接预测结果）能更有效、更高效地发现DRL智能体的失败，并持续产生行为多样性的失败样本，优于传统黑盒代理方法。

Abstract: Testing deep reinforcement learning (DRL) agents in cyber-physical systems aims to uncover diverse failures before deployment, but each execution can be expensive. Surrogate-assisted testing reduces this cost by learning to predict which test configurations are likely to fail. Prior surrogates treat the system as a black box and predict pass or fail outcomes directly; we instead model how a test unfolds and estimate failure from an imagined episode.
  We introduce DreamTest, a world-model surrogate for testing DRL agents. DreamTest adapts a recurrent state-space model to learn agent behaviour and environment dynamics from the agent's training log. Given a candidate configuration, imagined rollouts produce a failure score that guides search without executing every candidate in a simulator or real system.
  We evaluate DreamTest for failure prediction, test generation, and failure diversity on Parking, Humanoid, and DonkeyCar. Mean area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) exceeds the strongest baseline by 97%, 12%, and 39%, respectively, and gains on five out-of-distribution test sets reach 145%, 29%, and 44%. Under the same simulator-validation budget, the best "DreamTest + search" combinations find 29%, 22%, and 79% more novel failures on average. Across clusterings with k = 2-40, failures generated with DreamTest cover the most behavioural clusters for almost all k, indicating that DreamTest consistently discovers behaviourally diverse failures.

</details>


### [395] [Practical Runtime Enforcement of First-Order Temporal Requirements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04611)
*François Hublet,David Basin,Srđan Krstić*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对复杂时序需求的高效运行时执行算法，识别出MFOTL的一个可低复杂度执行的片段并设计执行算法，实现工具EnfFlash，在基准测试中延迟比EnfGuard低达44倍，在LLM智能体安全策略上低三个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实系统在合规环境下可能需满足数百条复杂时序需求（含对未来的义务），但现有支持复杂策略的执行机制对生产软件过慢，开发者退而采用非时序访问控制与临时插桩，而这些方法随需求复杂度扩展性差。

Method: 识别Metric First-Order Temporal Logic (MFOTL) 的一个片段，该片段支持包括义务在内的丰富实用需求且可低运行时复杂度执行；为该片段设计执行算法，并将需求编译为高效解释的命令式程序，实现于工具EnfFlash。

Result: EnfFlash在标准基准上延迟比此前最先进的EnfGuard低至多44倍，在LLM智能体的安全策略上低至多三个数量级；在社交网络上可执行约400行描述GDPR的MFOTL公式，每次页面视图增加不足15 ms。

Conclusion: EnfFlash既能独立运行于现有基准，也可作为执行后端集成到Web应用中，其低延迟足以满足大多数交互式与实时应用需求。

Abstract: Runtime enforcers observe a system's behavior and exert control over it to ensure that the system always adheres to its requirements. Many natural requirements not only formulate restrictions on the system's present behavior, but also impose obligations on its future behavior; for instance, agentic security may require personal data collected during a run to be erased by some deadline. In an ever-growing compliance landscape, real-world systems may be subject to hundreds of such requirements. However, existing enforcement mechanisms supporting complex policies are often too slow for production software; instead, developers may resort to non-temporal access control mechanisms and ad-hoc instrumentation, but these scale poorly with requirement complexity.
  To address this problem, we introduce an efficient algorithm and tool for enforcing complex temporal requirements and demonstrate its performance. Specifically, we identify a fragment of Metric First-Order Temporal Logic (MFOTL) that can be enforced with low runtime complexity while supporting a rich family of practically relevant requirements, including obligations. We then design an enforcement algorithm for this fragment and implement it in EnfFlash, a novel tool that enforces requirements with latency up to 44x lower than EnfGuard, the previous state-of-the-art enforcer, on standard benchmarks, and up to three orders of magnitude lower on security policies for LLM agents. This performance is achieved by compiling requirements into imperative programs that we efficiently interpret. We evaluate EnfFlash both standalone, on existing benchmarks, and integrated in web applications as an enforcement backend. We demonstrate that it can enforce a substantial 400-line MFOTL formula specifying the GDPR on a social network while adding under 15 ms to each page view, which is sufficient for most interactive and real-time applications.

</details>


### [396] [When Talk Isn't Code: Comparing LLM Agents That Simulate and Develop Software](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04639)
*Xiang Li,Aichun Huang,Mingming Zhang,Zheli Liu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该研究首次在同一套攻击套件与判定标准下，对比大模型"模拟模式"（S-mode，对话中扮演协议实现）与"开发模式"（D-mode，编写程序后被攻击）的安全表现，并以知识探测为基线，评测15个模型在4种协议实现上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前研究分别评估LLM模拟协议实现（如蜜罐）与编写实现两种用途，但均为孤立评估，从未将同一模型的对话答案、生成代码与实际被攻击的程序进行对比，导致无法判断"能说出安全要求"是否等于"能写出安全程序"。

Method: 设计并实现统一测试框架（harness），用同一攻击套件和同一判定预言机同时评判S-mode、D-mode和知识探测三种方式；在四种协议实现上评测15个LLM。针对DNS，通过向规格中增补缺失要求、以及删除已声明规则，分别观察对攻击成功率的影响。

Result: 在完整安全规格下，中位模型在重组、HTTP、防火墙实现上的攻击成功率在两种模式下均不超过4%；DNS上S-mode为13%、D-mode为15%。D-mode中补入缺失的DNS要求可将攻击率从100%降至34%且仅改变该项检查，而删除已声明规则则会削弱其他检查。事前知识探测无法预测程序是否具备某项检查：14个编写DNS解析器的模型中13个能说出该检查，但全部42个程序都缺失它。S-mode可标记82%的真实DNS漏洞，96%的安全情况未被误标，但存在双向误差。

Conclusion: S-mode可作为有价值的初步筛选器，但不能替代D-mode的实际攻击测试；安全要求即便模型能复述，也应以文字明确规定，因为"能说出"与"能实现"之间存在显著鸿沟。

Abstract: LLMs are used both to simulate network protocol implementations, as honeypots do, and to write them. Prior work evaluates the two uses separately, from a model's answers or conversations in one case and from its generated code in the other. We observe that a knowledge probe (asking the model which security checks an implementation needs) and a conversation can credit security checks that the generated program lacks, but no study has compared them with the code the same model writes. To fill this gap, we present the first such comparison between simulation mode (S-mode), where the model plays the implementation in a conversation, and development mode (D-mode), where the model writes the program and the program is attacked, with a knowledge probe as a baseline. We design and implement a harness that judges all three with one attack suite and one oracle, and evaluate 15 LLMs on four protocol implementations. We find that with the full security specification, the median model's attack success is at most 4\% on reassembly, HTTP, and firewall implementations in both modes, but 13\% in S-mode and 15\% in D-mode on DNS. In D-mode, adding the missing DNS requirement to the specification cuts that attack from 100\% to 34\% and changes only that check, whereas deleting a stated rule weakens the program on other checks too. Asking the model beforehand does not predict which checks a program has, since 13 of the 14 models that write a DNS resolver name the check, yet all 42 programs lack it. S-mode is a useful first filter, flagging 82\% of the real DNS vulnerabilities and leaving 96\% of the safe cases unflagged. It errs in both directions, over-reporting security checks that D-mode does not implement and under-reporting checks that D-mode does. S-mode can screen but not replace D-mode testing, and security requirements should be written down even when a model can recite them.

</details>


### [397] [Back to the Future: Regressing Readability Features from LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04641)
*Tairan Wang,Earl T. Barr*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出BTTF（Back To The Future）代码可读性评估模型，将线性回归与信息论特征结合，把语言模型当作测量工具而非黑箱裁判，在多个基准和生产代码变换测试上优于现有基线，并具备特征级可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码可读性支撑软件理解、评审与维护。随着AI编码代理普及，可读代码既便于人类审查代理生成内容，也有助于代理在有限上下文窗口内维护代码。但现有可读性模型在不同数据集上与人类判断不一致，且直接使用LLM评判存在不透明、提示开销大的问题。

Method: BTTF将线性回归与信息论特征结合，不把语言模型作为黑箱裁判，而是作为测量仪器。其特征融合三类信息：传统代码度量、基于嵌入的语义组织、因果语言模型的可预测性，分别刻画源码结构、语义连贯性与上下文意外度。在5个公开人工评级可读性基准及自建人工标注MBJP开发集（共1,100样本）上评估，并在生产代码上进行13种受控的降低可读性变换测试。

Result: 相比最强基线，BTTF平均Spearman相关系数最高提升0.101。在13种受控变换中，Java响应率93.8%、Python 87.6%，分别比Dorn高出14%和19.2%；在本地模型中表现最佳，Java落后最强云端LLM 1.7%、Python落后5.1%。直接LLM基线每次评估平均需1,083个提示词token且不透明。所有特征系数在所有评估配置下均符合其理论方向性效应。

Conclusion: BTTF兼具最先进的基准性能与强变换鲁棒性，并实现特征粒度的可解释性，证明将语言模型用作测量仪器而非黑箱裁判是提升代码可读性评估一致性、鲁棒性与透明度的有效路径。

Abstract: Code readability supports software understanding, review, and maintenance. As AI coding agents become more widely used, readable code helps both humans review agent-generated output and agents maintain code within limited context windows. Yet existing readability models do not consistently agree with human judgements across datasets.
  We introduce BTTF (Back To The Future), pairing linear regression with information-theoretic features. Rather than using language models as black-box judges, BTTF uses them as measurement instruments. It combines traditional code measurements, embedding-based semantic organisation, and causal-LM predictability to capture source structure, semantic coherence, and contextual surprise.
  We evaluate BTTF on five publicly available human-rated readability benchmarks and our manually annotated MBJP development set, totalling 1,100 samples. BTTF improves average Spearman correlation over the strongest baseline by up to 0.101. Across 13 controlled readability-reducing transformations on production code, it achieves response rates of 93.8% in Java and 87.6% in Python, outperforming Dorn by 14% and 19.2%. It performs best among local models and trails the strongest cloud-LLM response by 1.7% in Java and 5.1% in Python. The direct-LLM baselines require an average of 1,083 prompt tokens per evaluation while remaining opaque. BTTF combines state-of-the-art benchmark performance and strong transformation robustness with feature-granular interpretability: every feature coefficient matches its theoretical directional effect across all evaluated model configurations.

</details>


### [398] [RETRACE: From Entangled Repair Histories to Reusable Experience for CI Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04658)
*Rabeya Khatun Muna,Muhammad Ahasanuzzaman,Nakhla Rafi,Yisen Xu,Jinqiu Yang,Tse-Hsun Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: RETRACE 框架从软件历史中重建"问题级"修复经验：通过终点视图（从通过修订中保留的改动反向推理）与开发视图（沿提交历史正向追踪修复演进）双视角，并用 CI 执行证据调和，将经验表示为三级抽象层次；在新失败上检索相关经验指导修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体越来越多地复用先验经验，但多数方法假设"问题"与"解决方案"已经对齐。软件历史几乎不提供这种对齐：一个 PR 可能包含多个 CI 问题、失败尝试、被回滚的编辑以及无关改动，导致"哪些改动解决了哪个问题"被掩盖。

Method: RETRACE 结合两种视图：终点视图从通过修订中保留的改动出发反向推理；开发视图沿提交历史正向追踪修复的演进过程。两者由 CI 执行证据进行调和，恢复出的经验被表示为三种抽象层次，从具体修复到可迁移的修复模式。面对新失败时，检索相关的"问题级"经验来指导修复。

Result: 在 CI-REPAIR-BENCH（涵盖 101 个仓库、12 类失败的 565 个 PR 级修复）上：mini-SWE-agent 的 Pass@1 使用 MiniMax-M2.5 从 19.6% 提升至 31.9%，使用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 从 23.3% 提升至 32.8%；在匹配子集上 Codex 从 15.5% 提升至 27.5%。两种视图结合的效果始终优于单独使用任一视图。

Conclusion: 恢复"问题—改动"之间的对齐关系，能够使历史 CI 修复转化为可复用的修复经验，从而显著提升 LLM 智能体的自动修复能力。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly reuse prior experience, but most approaches assume that problems and solutions are already aligned. Software histories rarely provide this alignment: a pull request (PR) may contain multiple continuous integration (CI) problems, failed attempts, reverted edits, and unrelated changes, obscuring which changes resolve each problem. We present RETRACE, a framework for reconstructing problem-level repair experience from such histories. RETRACE combines an endpoint view that reasons backward from changes retained in the passing revision with a development view that traces repair evolution forward through commit history. CI execution evidence reconciles the two views, and the recovered experience is represented at three abstraction levels, from concrete fixes to transferable repair patterns. For new failures, RETRACE retrieves relevant problem-level experience to guide repair. On CI-REPAIR-BENCH, comprising 565 PR-level repairs from 101 repositories across 12 failure categories, RETRACE improves mini-SWE-agent Pass@1 from 19.6% to 31.9% with MiniMax-M2.5 and from 23.3% to 32.8% with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. On a matched subset, Codex improves from 15.5% to 27.5%. Combining both views consistently outperforms either alone, showing that recovering problem-change alignment enables historical CI repairs to serve as reusable repair experience.

</details>


### [399] [Towards Automatically Pruning Logging Code with Coding Agents: How Far Are We?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04716)
*He Yang Yuan,Haonan Zhang,Xin Wang,An Ran Chen,Kisub Kim,Zishuo Ding,Zhenhao Li*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文研究日志代码删除这一被忽视的维护任务，从Python和Java仓库提取并人工验证真实删除案例，归纳出10种删除模式和11种删除原因，构建LogRem数据集（387个真实案例），并评估四个编码智能体在日志删除任务上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 日志代码有助于调试、监控与维护，但过度日志会引入噪声、增加运行时开销并掩盖诊断信息。已有研究多集中于日志代码的生成与修改，日志删除相对研究不足，因此需要系统研究开发者的日志删除实践并探索自动化方案。

Method: 从Python和Java代码仓库中提取并人工验证日志删除案例，归纳出10种删除模式与11种删除原因；构建LogRem数据集，涵盖直接删除日志语句、删除日志基础设施、日志替换三类共387个真实案例；在多种模型设置下评估四个编码智能体，并将其输出与已接受的真实变更进行对比。

Result: 95.6%至100.0%的智能体输出通过有效性检查，但仅11.1%至19.6%的输出删除了与真实变更相同的日志代码且保留了无关代码。智能体差异体现在漏删、多删和无关代码修改上，在不同删除类别与轨迹间差异显著。执行成本差异较大，但更高成本未带来稳定更优的对齐效果。提交信息与开发者讨论带来最大对齐增益，而分类指导可稳定降低运行时间。
