Conclusion: 该研究将日志删除确立为一项独立的软件维护任务，表明可靠自动化取决于准确判定删除范围并保留必要代码。据作者所知，这是首个从该视角研究日志代码删除的工作。

Abstract: Logging code supports debugging, monitoring, and software maintenance, but excessive logging can add noise, impose runtime overhead, and obscure diagnostic information. While prior research has extensively studied logging code generation and modification, logging removal remains comparatively underexplored. In this paper, we study developer logging removal practices and explore the use of coding agents for this task. We extract and manually validate logging removal cases from Python and Java repositories and derive 10 removal patterns and 11 removal reasons that characterize how and why logging code was removed in real-world software changes. We further construct LogRem, a dataset of 387 real-world cases covering direct logging statement removal, logging infrastructure removal, and logging replacement. We evaluate four coding agents with multiple model settings and compare their outputs with accepted real-world changes. Although 95.6% to 100.0% of outputs pass validity checks, only 11.1% to 19.6% remove the same logging code as the corresponding real-world change while preserving unrelated code. Agents differ through missed removals, extra removals, and unrelated code edits, with substantial variation across logging removal categories and trajectories. Execution cost varies widely, but higher cost does not consistently yield closer alignment. Commit messages and developer discussions provide the largest alignment gains, while taxonomy guidance consistently reduces runtime. Overall, our study establishes logging removal as a distinct software maintenance task and shows that reliable automation depends on accurately determining removal scope while preserving necessary code. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to examine logging code removal from this perspective.

</details>


### [400] [Asymmetric Repository Lineage Modeling and Verifier-Guided Coordination in Concurrent AI Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04779)
*Arjun Subramanian,George Xu,Nithilan Karthik*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文研究并发AI编码智能体的协调问题：廉价信号可用于排序工作，但唯有可执行的检查器才能确立所声称的属性。作者提出属性作用域验证契约与MERGEGYM三轨基准，发现47.3%的冲突在作者文件集不相交时仍发生，并将其归因于三方合并中的代理信号错配；在冻结标签回放下，决策时门控可消除中位数91.7%的作用域碰撞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并发AI编码智能体产生协调难题：廉价信号（如血缘关系、元数据）可用于优先级排序，但真正需要确立的属性（如可合并性）只能由可执行检查器来验证。作者关注这一"信号-检查"分离，并探究人工PR diff与合并基比较之间存在的代理错配问题。

Method: 提出属性作用域验证契约，并构建MERGEGYM三轨基准：T1开放时作用域预测、T2回放条件下的冲突消解、T3调度。在715对分层血缘分集（167个文本冲突）上评估；对零重叠冲突进行补丁重建；使用血缘并集规则、12特征逻辑回归和未调参随机森林；T1采用零样本LLM与LLM-元数据融合；T3采用决策时门控。

Result: 79个冲突（47.3%）出现在作者文件集不相交的情况下。血缘并集规则AUC 0.877；逻辑回归0.882 [0.845,0.917]，PR-AUC 0.661；随机森林0.902 [0.875,0.928]，PR-AUC 0.701。在33.3%回放预算下，两模型分别恢复81.2%和82.9%的冲突。补丁重建对48/79零重叠冲突成功且全部变干净，其余31个不确定。T1零样本LLM AUC 0.704，融合后0.740。T3门控消除中位数91.7%的标签作用域碰撞，代价为65.0%的制造期膨胀。

Conclusion: 由于本地git merge-tree回放已很廉价（中位数0.02秒），作者不主张血缘分诊能单独节省检查器——当精确回放廉价时应当全部验证。论文所有实证保证仅限于文本可合并性或明确声明的冻结标签调度目标，未声称新的Git机制。

Abstract: Concurrent AI coding agents create a coordination problem in which cheap signals may prioritize work, but only an executable checker can establish the property being claimed. We study this separation through a property-scoped verification contract and MERGEGYM, a three-track benchmark for open-time scope forecasting, replay- conditioned conflict resolution, and scheduling. On a stratified 715-pair lineage set (167 textual conflicts), 79 conflicts (47.3%) occur despite disjoint authored file sets. This is an operationally important proxy mismatch expected from three-way merge: authored PR diffs are measured against PR-specific bases, whereas the checker compares both heads to their common merge base. A standalone lineage-union rule reaches held-out AUROC 0.877; a 12-feature logistic model reaches 0.882 [0.845, 0.917] with PR-AUC 0.661, and an untuned random forest on the same decision-time features reaches 0.902 [0.875, 0.928] with PR-AUC 0.701. At a 33.3% held-out replay budget, the logistic and random-forest models recover 81.2% and 82.9% of conflicts, respectively. Patch reconstruction succeeds for 48/79 zero- overlap conflicts and all 48 become clean; the other 31 cases are inconclusive, so this check validates the expected three-way-merge explanation rather than claiming a new Git mechanism. In T1, a zero-shot LLM reaches AUC 0.704 and LLM-plus- metadata fusion 0.740. In T3, a decision-time gate de-overlaps a median 91.7% of labeled scope collisions at 65.0% makespan inflation under frozen-label replay. Because local git merge-tree replay is already cheap in our logs (median 0.02 s), we do not claim that lineage triage saves this checker alone: when exact replay is cheap, verify everything. All empirical guarantees in this paper remain limited to textual mergeability or the explicitly stated frozen-label scheduling target.

</details>


### [401] [Agent Skill Evolution: How Revisions Affect Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04832)
*Jiajie Wang,Yutong Zhao,Tianlin Li,Huashan Chen,Jinfu Chen,Kebin Peng,Sen He*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文对3,159个Agent Skills的2,608对首/末修订进行实证研究，刻画Skill的演化规律及其与agent harness配置的协同变化，并量化"规则变更"对21个模型单次回答、4个沙箱agent的行为与正确率影响及token成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent Skills（SKILL.md，用于告诉LLM编码agent项目如何运作）虽像代码一样被修订，但一次修订究竟对agent产生何种影响尚不清楚，缺乏对Skill演化模式、规则变更效果及成本的系统性实证证据。

Method: 从3,159个Skills的2,608对首/末修订对切入，刻画Skill演化及其与harness配置的共变；聚焦可自动校验的"规则变更"（如新增"run allium check"）；在21个模型的单次回答、4个沙箱agent上测量效果，并在其中20个模型和4个agent上测量成本；区分显式加载与按需加载（仅当agent判断需要时才加载Skill主体）两种设定。

Result: 55%的修订会改变规则或流程；修订Skill的commit比同规模其他commit更常同时改动CLAUDE.md等harness文件。16个开源权重模型中，新增规则使单次回答的合规率平均+0.41；四个agent中，所需动作执行率平均+0.23（+0.16至+0.36），三个经盲评的agent最终正确率平均+0.10（+0.06至+0.14）；增益主要来自指明旧Skill未提及的命令或路径的规则。按需加载下，四个agent平均保留约51%的动作增益，三个开源模型约38%。一次修订给单次回答增加18–19%输入token，对agent episode无可检测成本；而加载Skill主体使episode token平均增加50%。

Conclusion: Skill修订普遍为规则/流程变更，且与harness配置协同演化；新增规则能显著提升单次回答合规率与agent的动作执行率及最终正确率，增益源于引入具体命令或路径；但按需加载会衰减近半增益，且Skill主体加载带来显著token开销，规则内容与加载策略共同决定收益与成本。

Abstract: Agent Skills, the SKILL.md files that tell an LLM coding agent how a project works, are revised like code, yet what a revision does to the agent is unknown. From 2,608 first/last revision pairs of 3,159 Skills, we characterize how Skills evolve and how they change together with the configuration of the agent's harness. We then focus on rule changes, revisions that add or remove a rule we can check automatically, such as "run allium check". We measure their effect on 21 models in single answers and on four agents in a sandbox, and their cost on 20 of these models and the four agents. Most revisions (55%) change a rule or procedure, and commits that revise a Skill change harness files such as CLAUDE.md more often than other commits of the same size. Across 16 open-weight models, an added rule raises compliance in a single answer by +0.41 on average. Across the four agents, the rate at which the agent takes the required action rises by +0.23 on average (+0.16 to +0.36), and for the three agents that blind judges assessed, final correctness rises by +0.10 on average (+0.06 to +0.14). The gain comes mainly from rules that name a command or path the old Skill did not mention. Real tools load a Skill's body only when the agent decides it needs it. In that setting the four agents keep about half of the action gain on average (51%), and the three open models about 38%. A revision adds 18-19% input tokens to a single answer and no detectable cost to an agent episode, while loading a Skill's body raises the tokens of an episode by 50% on average.

</details>


### [402] [CARET: Training-Free Test-Time Scaling for Repository-Level Code Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04837)
*Jiajie Wang,Yutong Zhao,Kebin Peng,Sen He,Qing Guo,Tianlin Li*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: CARET：一种免训练方法，联合改进RAG代码补全的检索（R）与生成（G）两个阶段——用样本一致性路由检索上下文，用缓存前缀采样候选并以反向上下文似然评分——在18个设置上平均提升EM 10.8点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有仓库级代码补全的RAG工作主要聚焦于检索阶段（R），而生成阶段（G）仍采用单次贪心解码且被忽视。作者认为两阶段可以协同改进，且生成阶段特别受益于测试时扩展（test-time scaling）。

Method: CARET为免训练方法。检索侧：利用模型自身多次采样的相互一致性来路由检索上下文，当样本分散时级联到备选上下文。生成侧：在缓存的prompt前缀上采样候选，使长检索上下文仅编码一次而非每样本重复编码；再以反向上下文似然选择最终补全——正确补全应使光标之后的代码更可能出现，即同一模型通过"向后读"为自己的候选打分。

Result: 在CrossCodeEval、RepoEval-Line、RepoEval-API及六个代码模型（1.1B–7B，四个系列）上，CARET在全部18个组合中提升exact match，平均较贪心解码提升10.8点，较self-consistency@10提升5.3点。Token级计算量约为单次生成的1.45倍（实测wall-clock为1.3–2.9倍，随生成器规模增长）。

Conclusion: 联合改进检索与生成比仅改进检索能产生更准确的代码，且预算接近单次前向推理。检索与生成的协同优化是仓库级代码补全的有效方向。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) dominates repository-level code completion: it retrieves cross-file context (R), then decodes one greedy completion (G). Existing work mainly focuses on retrieval and stops there. We argue both stages can be improved together, with generation in particular gaining from test-time scaling. We present CARET, a training-free method. For R, CARET routes among retrieval contexts using the agreement among its own samples, cascading to an alternative context when the samples scatter. For G, it samples candidates over a cached prompt prefix, so the long retrieved context is encoded once rather than once per sample. It then selects the final completion by reverse-context likelihood: a correct completion makes the code after the cursor more probable, so the same model grades its own candidates by reading ahead. Across CrossCodeEval, RepoEval-Line, and RepoEval-API with six code models (1.1B to 7B, four families), CARET improves exact match in all 18 combinations by 10.8 points on average over greedy decoding and 5.3 over self-consistency@10. Token-level compute stays near 1.45 times one generation (measured wall-clock 1.3-2.9 times, growing with generator size). Improving retrieval and generation together yields more accurate code than improving retrieval alone, at a budget that stays close to a single pass.

</details>


### [403] [Complex Agents, Shallow Tests: Demystifying and Enhancing Test Adequacy of Agent Harness in the Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04921)
*Yifan Xiong,Jingyi Ge,Zhenpeng Chen,Yiling Lou*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文首次对真实智能体系统中的harness测试充分性进行实证研究，发现测试严重不足，并提出面向harness的测试生成技术HarnessTester，显著提升覆盖率与变异得分，并在真实系统中检测出122个harness缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的智能体系统正成为新软件范式，由骨干LLM与harness共同组成。随着harness日益复杂，各类实现缺陷带来严重可靠性隐患，但现有工作缺乏对harness测试充分性的系统认识。

Method: 开展首个系统性实证研究，量化真实智能体系统中harness的测试充分性；在此基础上提出HarnessTester，引入显式的agent-harness契约支持，构建契约忠实的测试环境，从而充分覆盖LLM依赖型harness（LDH）代码。

Result: 实证显示harness测试严重不足，LDH代码不足一半的行与分支被现有测试覆盖；HarnessTester相较最先进的通用测试生成技术在行/分支覆盖率增益上高出75.95%/84.76%，变异得分增益高出69.89%；在OpenClaw等广泛使用的智能体系统中检测出122个真实harness缺陷，其中88个为未知缺陷，69个已被开发者确认。

Conclusion: 结果凸显HarnessTester在提升测试充分性与保障真实智能体系统可靠性方面的实际有效性，为面向harness的测试生成研究提供了新方向。

Abstract: LLM-based agentic systems are emerging as a new software paradigm. Modern agents are typically composed of backbone LLMs and a surrounding harness that serves as the operational software infrastructure for agent execution. As agent harnesses grow increasingly complex, agents suffer from diverse harness implementation bugs, raising substantial reliability concerns. In this work, we conduct the first empirical study to systematically investigate the test adequacy of harness in real-world agentic systems. Our analysis reveals that agent harness remains substantially undertested. In particular, LLM-dependent harness (LDH) code, despite its critical role in processing LLM outputs and governing agent behavior, receives limited testing attention, with less than half of its lines and branches covered by existing tests. Motivated by these findings, we further propose HarnessTester, the first harness-oriented test generation technique that incorporates explicit agent-harness contract support to construct contract-faithful test setups and extensively exercise LDH code. Our evaluation shows that HarnessTester substantially outperforms state-of-the-art general-purpose test generation techniques in achieving 75.95%/84.76% larger line/branch coverage gains and 69.89% larger mutation-score gains. Furthermore, HarnessTester detects 122 real-world harness bugs in widely-used agentic systems (e.g., OpenClaw), among which, 88 bugs are previously-unknown bugs and 69 bugs have been confirmed by agent developers. These results highlight the practical effectiveness of HarnessTester in improving test adequacy and assuring the reliability of real-world agentic systems.

</details>


### [404] [Assembling Insights for Agentic Machine Learning Engineering Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04927)
*Bihui Jin,Yinxi Li,Kaiyuan Wang,Pengyu Nie*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文系统研究相关MLE任务洞察对智能体MLE系统的影响，提出MLE-InsightBench基准与MLE-InsightForge洞察构建智能体，验证洞察可显著提升性能且不同类型互补。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体MLE系统利用相关任务洞察的方式（收集与注入）较为临时、缺乏系统方法，且评估未控制洞察来源，存在数据泄漏风险，威胁结论有效性。

Method: 构建MLE-InsightBench，涵盖12个领域共160个Kaggle竞赛；每个领域留出1个目标竞赛，其余148个仅在不受目标任务影响时作为来源以防泄漏。开发MLE-InsightForge洞察组装智能体，探查来源竞赛、优秀人类方案与解题报告，构建三类洞察：12个领域洞察、148个竞赛洞察、16个改进洞察；以按需技能或前置手册两种方式注入。

Result: 相比无洞察基线，提取的洞察使归一化私有测试分数提升123.9%；受控实验表明三类洞察互补；技能与手册两种注入模式效果因任务而异，技能整体更具成本效益；增益在不同后端LLM上均可泛化。

Conclusion: 系统化的洞察收集与注入能有效提升智能体MLE性能，洞察类型互补且注入方式需按任务选择，且防泄漏的基准设计保证了评估的有效性。

Abstract: Agentic machine learning engineering (MLE) is an emerging AI4SE application for complex ML tasks and a step toward recursive self-improvement of AI systems. Recent agentic MLE systems show the value of leveraging insights from related MLE tasks: some systems condition code generation on expert domain knowledge, which is implicitly curated from peer MLE tasks; some systems have a loop of solving an MLE task, gathering memory to benefit future tasks. However, insight collection and injection remain ad hoc, and existing evaluations often do not control insight sources, making data leakage a threat to validity.
  To close these gaps, we systematically study how insights from related MLE tasks affect agentic MLE systems, and how their impact depends on insight type and injection method. We introduce MLE-InsightBench, a benchmark of 160 Kaggle competitions across 12 domains. To prevent leakage, one competition per domain is held out as the target, while the remaining 148 serve as sources only when they cannot have been influenced by the target task, such as through later editions or reused solutions. We also develop MLE-InsightForge, an insight assembly agent that explores source competitions, top human solutions, and writeups to construct three insight types: 12 domain insights summarizing best practices, 148 competition insights describing winning solutions, and 16 improvement insights capturing generic debugging and optimization strategies. These insights are injected either as on-demand skills or as an upfront playbook. In our evaluation, the extracted insights improve the normalized private-test score by 123.9% over a no-insight baseline. Controlled experiments further show that the three insight types are complementary; the better injection mode (skill vs. playbook) varies by tasks, with skills more cost-effective overall; and the gains generalize across backend LLMs.

</details>


### [405] [TeleGen: Improving LLM-Based Web Application Generation via Runtime Telemetry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04981)
*Yujia Luo,Haonan Zhang,Jiasi Shen,Zishuo Ding,Weiyi Shang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 TeleGen 框架，通过为生成的 Web 应用注入观测能力、采集运行时遥测并将原始日志压缩为简报来指导修复，在 WebGen-Bench 上任务成功率从 67.7% 提升至 76.2%，在 Web-Bench 上 Pass@2 从 21.7% 提升至 29.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有"生成—执行—修复"流程仅依赖任务结果或错误信息驱动代码修改，缺乏浏览器动作与最终任务结果之间的运行时行为信息，导致交互层面的失败难以定位和诊断。

Method: TeleGen 是一个面向 LLM Web 应用生成的观测增强框架：对生成的应用进行插桩，在任务执行过程中采集运行时遥测数据，并将原始遥测日志压缩为简洁的修复简报。

Result: 在 WebGen-Bench 上，任务成功率由无遥测修复的 67.7% 提升至 76.2%（+8.5 个百分点）；在 Web-Bench 上，累计 Pass@2 由 21.7% 提升至 29.8%。消融实验表明运行时遥测提供了有效的诊断信号，且简报形式使该信号更有效、使用成本更低。

Conclusion: 运行时遥测对涉及隐藏执行路径的失败尤其有帮助，如导航、表单工作流以及前后端协同；遥测增强的反馈机制可有效提升 LLM 生成 Web 应用的交互任务成功率。

Abstract: Large language models can generate runnable web applications from natural-language requirements, but many generated applications still fail interactive tasks. Existing generate-execute-repair pipelines execute the generated application and use task outcomes or error messages to guide code revision. However, this feedback often misses the runtime behavior between a browser action and the final task outcome, making interaction-level failures difficult to diagnose. Therefore, we propose TeleGen, an observability-enhanced framework for LLM-based web application generation. TeleGen instruments generated applications, collects runtime telemetry during task execution, and compresses raw telemetry logs into concise briefs for repair. We evaluate TeleGen on WebGen-Bench and Web-Bench. On WebGen-Bench, TeleGen improves task success from 67.7% with repair without telemetry to 76.2%, an increase of 8.5 percentage points. On Web-Bench, it improves cumulative Pass@2 from 21.7% to 29.8%. Ablation results show that runtime telemetry provides a useful diagnostic signal, while telemetry briefs make this signal more effective and less costly to use. Further analysis shows that telemetry is especially helpful for failures involving hidden execution paths, such as navigation, form workflows, and frontend-backend coordination.

</details>


### [406] [LLM-Based Test Generation: Information Sources, Generation Strategies, and Quality Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05001)
*Yunhao Liang,Chengguang Gan,Ruixuan Ying,Hanjun Wei,Zhe Cui,Shiwen Ni*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文是一篇结构化叙述性综述，将大语言模型测试生成过程与用于论证测试质量的证据类型相连接，基于95条精选文献记录，从四个维度组织该领域研究，并据此梳理基准、提出研究议程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM已被广泛用于生成测试场景、可执行测试套件、断言、交互序列与模糊测试基础设施，但这些产物目的不同、依赖的正确行为信息来源不同。提升实现覆盖率的测试、与参考程序一致的测试、检测需求违例的测试提供的是不同类型的证据，而现有研究缺乏将生成过程与质量论证证据相连接的统一框架。

Method: 采用结构化叙述性综述方法。通过95条经筛选的来源记录（截至2026年9月29日），沿四个维度组织文献：测试目标与产物、训练与生成阶段可获得的信息、生成与学习机制、评估证据。综合了单元测试与需求驱动测试、测试预言、API与GUI测试、模糊测试以及学习式测试生成器等方面的研究。

Result: 构建的框架解释了三点机制：执行反馈如何在提升可执行性的同时影响预言（oracle）的独立性；规格来源与训练期参考监督为何对比较结果至关重要；下游代码选择（code-selection）收益与测试正确性之间的差异。

Conclusion: 利用上述区分对现有基准进行组织，并推导出研究议程，涵盖独立预言评估、预算感知生成、仓库级评估以及测试维护四个方向。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to generate test scenarios, executable test suites, assertions, interaction sequences, and fuzzing infrastructure. These artifacts serve different purposes and rely on different sources of information about correct behavior. A test that increases implementation coverage, a test that agrees with a reference program, and a test that detects a requirements violation therefore provide distinct kinds of evidence. We present a structured narrative survey that connects the generation process to the evidence used to justify test quality. Drawing on 95 curated source records through 29 September 2026, we organize the field along four dimensions: testing objectives and artifacts, information available during training and generation, generation and learning mechanisms, and evaluation evidence. We synthesize work on unit and requirements-based testing, test oracles, API and GUI testing, fuzzing, and learned test generators. The resulting framework explains how execution feedback can improve executability while also affecting the independence of an oracle, why specification provenance and training-time reference supervision matter for comparisons, and how downstream code-selection gains differ from test correctness. We use these distinctions to organize benchmarks and derive a research agenda for independent oracle assessment, budget-aware generation, repository-scale evaluation, and test maintenance.

</details>


### [407] [Rethinking Tool Design for Agentic RCA: A Controlled Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05009)
*Yu Luo,Rongchen Gao,Zhenhui Zhou,Changchang Liu,Yuliang You,Yongqian Sun,Shenglin Zhang,Qiuai Fu,Shijie Wang,Dan Pei*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对微服务根因分析(RCA)中的LLM智能体工具进行受控实证研究：为三类工具层级（L1指标、L2证据分析、L3诊断）及L0参考基线实现24个结构化工具，用375个故障案例、8种配置评测Qwen3.7-Plus，并对比4个Qwen模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在微服务RCA中受到关注，但关于如何设计并组合其工具的实证指导仍很有限，缺乏可控、可复现的证据来支撑工具选择与编排决策。

Method: 为指标访问(L1)、证据分析(L2)、诊断(L3)实现24个结构化工具，并设Python参考基线(L0)；在三个微服务系统的375个故障案例上评测8种工具配置（Qwen3.7-Plus），并在共享的4种配置子集上对比4个Qwen模型，辅以轨迹分析。

Result: Qwen3.7-Plus下L3的top-1定位准确率为82.8%，L0为85.4%，但L3每案例耗时不足其一半；增加工具层级可提升故障类型识别却降低定位准确率；轨迹分析发现智能体在查阅额外证据后会推翻正确的诊断建议；模型选择改变工具收益，L1+L2上加L3对三个模型有提升但对很少调用L3的Qwen3-8B有害；工具配置的排序在不同微服务系统间也会变化。

Conclusion: 研究为RCA工具的设计与使用提供了实证基础，表明工具选择与组合应依据模型能力、诊断目标（定位或类型识别）以及目标系统特点进行权衡，而非采用单一通用配置。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly explored for root cause analysis (RCA) in microservice systems, yet empirical guidance on how to design and combine their tools remains limited. We conduct a controlled empirical study of tool abstraction and composition across models and microservice environments. We implement 24 structured tools for metric access (L1), evidence analysis (L2), and diagnosis (L3), alongside a Python-based reference setting (L0). Using 375 failure cases from three microservice systems, we evaluate eight configurations with Qwen3.7-Plus and compare four Qwen models on a shared subset of four configurations. Our results show that tool configurations affect root cause localization and failure type identification differently. With Qwen3.7-Plus, L3 achieves 82.8% top-1 localization accuracy compared with 85.4% for L0, while requiring less than half the time per case. Adding tool levels can improve type identification while reducing localization accuracy. Trajectory analysis reveals cases in which agents override correct diagnostic recommendations after consulting additional evidence. Model choice also changes tool benefits: adding L3 to L1+L2 improves diagnosis for three models but hurts Qwen3-8B, which rarely invokes L3. Tool configuration rankings further change across microservice systems. These findings provide an empirical foundation for designing and using RCA tools, guiding tool selection and composition according to the model, diagnostic objective, and target system.

</details>


### [408] [Characterizing Security Effects of OSS Vulnerabilities in Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05036)
*Yu Ji,Yang Wei,Yutao Hu,Haojun Zhao,Yueming Wu,Deqing Zou*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文研究开源软件（OSS）漏洞在软件智能体（agent）工作流中被触发时的行为，提出一种基于漏洞语义信息、脆弱/修复版本差分执行与跨层运行时溯源的分析方法，用于判定漏洞是否产生可观测安全效应并确定其影响终止于哪一层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软件智能体日益依赖开源组件来执行工具并与外部系统交互，因此依赖中的安全缺陷不仅影响其所在的软件进程，还可能通过工具输出、智能体状态以及随后暴露给模型的信息向外传递。然而，判断某次具体执行中这类后果是否真正发生、以及影响在智能体系统内的传播边界止于何处，仍然十分困难。

Method: 研究将已知OSS漏洞置于智能体工作流中实际触发，归纳安全相关后果在运行时各层出现与传播的反复模式；进而结合三类手段：漏洞感知的语义信息、脆弱版本与修正版本的差分执行、以及跨多个运行时层的溯源信息，来判定漏洞是否产生可观测的安全效应，并识别该效应仍然体现的最远层。

Result: 评估表明，该方法能够在多样化的漏洞场景集合上准确区分已实现（真正发生）的漏洞效应并确定其表现边界。作者还将该分析应用于真实智能体框架中已有文档记录的工作流，发现多个源自其OSS依赖中已知漏洞的安全效应。

Conclusion: 这些结果说明，应当从执行层面的实际后果、而非仅从漏洞是否存在出发来推理存在漏洞的依赖项，凸显了面向智能体系统进行漏洞影响边界分析的重要性。

Abstract: Software agents increasingly depend on open-source components when executing tools and interacting with external systems. Security flaws in these dependencies may therefore influence more than the software process in which they occur: their consequences can be carried through tool outputs, agent state, and information subsequently exposed to the model. Determining whether such a consequence is actually realized in a particular execution, and where its influence stops within the agent system, remains challenging.
  We investigate how known OSS vulnerabilities behave when exercised as part of agent workflows. Our study reveals recurring patterns in the way security-relevant consequences emerge and propagate across runtime layers. Building on these observations, we use vulnerability-aware semantic information, differential executions of vulnerable and corrected software, and runtime provenance spanning multiple layers to determine whether a vulnerability produces an observable security effect and to identify the furthest layer at which that effect remains manifested.
  Our evaluation shows that this approach can accurately distinguish realized vulnerability effects and determine their manifestation boundaries across a diverse collection of vulnerability scenarios. We additionally apply the analysis to documented workflows in a real-world agent framework and uncover multiple security effects originating from known vulnerabilities in its OSS dependencies. These results highlight the importance of reasoning about vulnerable dependencies in terms of their execution-level consequences rather than vulnerability presence alone.

</details>


### [409] [Beyond Task Completion: Measuring Interaction Cost in Terminal User Interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05047)
*Ruida Hu,Yuanhao Wang,Chao Peng,Yakun Zhang,Cuiyun Gao*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该文提出"Agent-as-a-User"评估范式，将LLM智能体置于用户角色，通过Agent-KLM分解智能体侧的解释成本与操作成本，并由TUINaut记录交互轨迹并用独立预言机验证任务结果，从而对终端用户界面（TUI）的任务型可用性进行可重复、基于真实执行的度量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TUI评估存在两个缺口：一是仅看任务完成率无法反映界面理解与操作的难度；二是人工评估与LLM生成的评分或报告缺乏可重复性，且未与经过验证的任务执行相绑定，难以形成扎根于实际执行的交互代价测量。

Method: 提出Agent-as-a-User范式，让LLM智能体扮演用户角色。其中Agent-KLM将智能体侧成本拆分为解释成本与操作成本，并与人类交互在结构上建立关联；TUINaut将该范式落地，记录交互轨迹并用与行为主体无关的预言机（actor-independent oracles）验证任务结果。基于TUINaut-Bench，对15个真实TUI上的84个任务开展研究，涉及6名人类参与者与5种观察-评估者配置，并额外评估了3个主流技术栈生成的45个TUI。

Result: 相近的整体成功率掩盖了人类与智能体在"完成哪些任务"上的差异；解释成本与操作成本在任务排序上呈现相关性，操作成本尤为明显，且该模式在不同配置下保持稳定。生成的TUI可以在功能正确的同时仍需可用性改进。

Conclusion: Agent-as-a-User是一种可重复、以执行为依据的范式，可用于度量基于任务的可用性，弥补单一成功率与主观评分/报告的不足，并适用于真实与自动生成TUI的评估。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used through terminal user interfaces (TUIs), yet task completion alone does not capture how difficult an interface is to understand and operate. Existing human assessments and LLM-generated ratings or reports do not provide repeatable measurements of interaction effort grounded in verified task execution.
  We propose Agent-as-a-User, an evaluation paradigm that places an LLM agent in the user role. Agent-KLM separates agent-side interpretation and operation costs and relates them structurally to human interaction. TUINaut operationalizes the paradigm by recording interaction trajectories and verifying outcomes with actor-independent oracles.
  Using TUINaut-Bench, we study 84 tasks across 15 real-world TUIs with six human participants and five observation-evaluator configurations, and evaluate 45 TUIs generated by three leading stacks. Similar aggregate success rates mask differences in which tasks humans and agents complete, whereas interpretation and operation costs follow correlated task rankings, especially for operation. This pattern persists across configurations. Generated TUIs can implement correct functionality while still requiring usability improvements. These results position Agent-as-a-User as a repeatable, execution-grounded paradigm for measuring task-based usability.

</details>


### [410] [SpecAgent: Empowering Program Verification with Agentic Synthesis of Formal Program Specifications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05132)
*Lezhi Ma,Han Wang,Shangqing Liu,Jiawan Wang,Lei Bu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 SpecAgent，一个面向真实 C 程序的 agentic 框架，用于自动化合成高质量 ACSL 形式规范，通过依赖感知规划、RAG、代理式修复与代理式评审四个组件协同工作，在规范合成与程序验证任务上显著超越现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 形式规范是演绎程序验证的核心，但人工编写成本高昂，因此需要自动化合成。现有基于大语言模型的方法多采用单向工作流与局部修复，难以应对真实程序中函数与循环间复杂的依赖关系。验证失败往往源自先前生成的规范，导致级联失败，而局部修复无法解决这类问题。

Method: SpecAgent 集成四个组件：(1) 依赖感知规划，用于识别需要生成规范的靶点；(2) 检索增强生成（RAG），提供相关规范模式与程序上下文；(3) 代理式修复，用于诊断缺陷并回溯依赖的规范；(4) 代理式评审，在证明成功之外进一步评估与精炼规范的语义强度。

Result: 在来自 14 个真实代码仓库的 50 个程序上，使用 DeepSeek-V4 的 SpecAgent 在合成正确且强的规范方面达到 96.82% 精确率与 88.95% 召回率，优于所有基线；在 811 个真实验证目标上成功证明 604 个，同样超越现有基线。

Conclusion: SpecAgent 能有效合成高质量规范并促进真实程序的验证，验证了引入依赖感知规划、RAG、代理式修复与评审等机制在应对复杂依赖与级联失败方面的有效性。

Abstract: Formal specifications are essential for deductive program verification, providing semantic abstractions for compositional verification of complex software. However, manually constructing specifications is labor-intensive, motivating automated synthesis. Despite recent advances in large language models (LLMs), existing approaches often rely on forward-only workflows and localized repair, limiting their effectiveness on real-world programs with complex dependencies among functions and loops. Verification failures may stem from previously generated specifications, causing cascading failures that local refinement cannot resolve. To address these challenges, we present SpecAgent, an agentic framework for synthesizing high-quality ACSL specifications for real-world C programs. SpecAgent integrates four components: dependency-aware planning to identify specification targets, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to provide relevant specification patterns and program context, agentic repair to diagnose defects and revisit dependent specifications, and agentic critique to assess and refine semantic strength beyond proof success. We evaluate SpecAgent on specification synthesis and program verification tasks. On 50 programs from 14 real-world repositories, SpecAgent with DeepSeek-V4 achieves 96.82% precision and 88.95% recall in synthesizing correct and strong specifications, outperforming all baselines. On 811 real-world verification targets, it successfully discharges 604, also surpassing existing baselines. These results demonstrate SpecAgent's effectiveness in synthesizing high-quality specifications and facilitating real-world program verification.

</details>


### [411] [StateWise: Diagnosing and Repairing Persistent Operational State Before Agent Actions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05241)
*Yongyuan Peng,Zhou Feng,Tongying Wu,Jiahao Chen,Yuan Su,Chunyi Zhou,Tianyu Du,Shouling Ji*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: StateWise：在执行前诊断并修复LLM智能体持久化操作状态的框架，通过记录级反事实重规划、证据落地校验与修复谱系实现持久纠错，显著提升损坏状态下的任务正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体依赖持久记忆中的操作记录作为后续行动前提，但环境或需求变化会使这些记录失效；现有审查、溯源与澄清机制无法纠正底层持久状态，导致无效记录被复用，引发任务失败与不安全修改。

Method: StateWise在行动执行前进行状态诊断与修复：1）记录级反事实重规划识别决策关键记录；2）通过可靠性检查、机器可观测事实的只读验证、开发者意图的定向澄清确立记录的当前有效性；3）类型化证据落地将证据绑定到特定记录与作用域，实现带修复谱系的持久纠正；4）从修复后状态重规划，并在执行前进行独立的状态-动作检查。

Result: 在150个可执行编码智能体案例上（涵盖多样运行时环境、工作区配置与仓库设置）并辅以跨模型评估，损坏持久状态下StateWise总体正确率达93.3%，基线仅38.7%，且无不安全动作。组件消融、多任务实验与迁移评估进一步验证了有效恢复、持久纠正及跨仓库与工具接口的迁移性。

Conclusion: StateWise表明，在执行前对持久化操作状态进行诊断与修复，可有效避免无效记录复用带来的失败与风险，并具备良好的持久纠错能力与跨环境迁移性。

Abstract: LLM agents combine reasoning, tool use, and persistent memory to support work across tasks by reusing stored operational records as premises for later actions. However, environmental or requirement changes can invalidate these records, while existing action review, provenance tracking, and clarification mechanisms may leave the underlying persistent state uncorrected. Our audit of coding-agent trajectories identifies candidate failure chains in which invalid records are reused, leading to task failures and unsafe modifications. We propose StateWise, a framework for diagnosing and repairing persistent operational state before action execution. StateWise uses record-level counterfactual replanning to identify decision-critical records, then establishes their current validity through reliability checks, read-only verification of machine-observable facts, and targeted clarification of developer-owned intent. Typed evidence grounding binds evidence to specific records and scopes, enabling persistent corrections with repair lineage. The agent then replans from the repaired state, followed by an independent state-action check before execution. We evaluate StateWise on 150 executable coding-agent cases across diverse runtime environments, workspace configurations, and repository settings, complemented by cross-model evaluations. Under corrupted persistent state, StateWise achieves 93.3% overall correctness, compared with 38.7% for the baseline agent, with no unsafe actions. Component ablations, multi-task experiments, and transfer evaluations further demonstrate effective recovery, persistent corrections, and transferability across repositories and tool interfaces.

</details>


### [412] [Mind the Gaps: From Failure Attribution to Closed-Form Repair of Code Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05277)
*Jian Gu,Hongyu Zhang,Chunyang Chen,Aldeida Aleti*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文针对代码语言模型在API演进后"写出过时接口"的问题，提出ASTRA方法：用对比语义（contrastive semantics）定位承载补丁的神经元，并通过闭式求解小型线性系统为每个失败样本定制补丁，从而修复模型本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码模型需随其周边软件库的演进而维护：库接口更新后，模型仍倾向于输出训练时见过的旧接口。直接修复模型本身可让一次修正惠及所有下游用途。现有修复方法默认两个未经检验的假设：(1) 归因选出的神经元就是应当修补的神经元；(2) 通用更新适用于所有失败。

Method: 作者在Python和Rust的可执行API演进任务上，用三个代码模型检验上述两个假设，发现两处缺口："定位缺口"（failure attribution targeting的神经元与能承载补丁的神经元之间，Top集合的Jaccard重叠仅0.15–0.20）与"定制缺口"（不同承载神经元所需补丁几乎正交）。据此提出ASTRA：以对比语义进行归因，按神经元对"目标token与已产生token之间logit对比"的贡献打分来定位；再通过闭式求解一个小型线性系统来定制补丁，联合校正一个样本的所有失败token，无需优化器与反向传播。

Result: 对比语义在6个设置中有3个选出显著优于梯度归因的承载神经元，其余设置相当。ASTRA平均达到66.7% Pass@1，而AlphaEdit、STAR、低秩适配中的最佳者仅48.4%，且修复一个样本耗时2.7秒。ASTRA在全部6个设置及每种API变更类型上均为最佳，该优势在测试提示的未见措辞下依然保持。对无关代码的副作用在大模型上较小，在小模型上较大。

Conclusion: 现有代码模型修复流程在"定位"与"定制"两个环节均存在被忽视的缺口；ASTRA通过对比语义归因与闭式定制补丁同时弥补二者，在准确率、速度、跨API变更类型与提示措辞鲁棒性上均优于现有方法，副作用随模型规模增大而减小。

Abstract: Code language models must be maintained like the software around them: when a library evolves, a model keeps writing the interface that it saw during training. Repairing the model itself lets one correction reach all downstream uses. Existing repair methods attribute a failure to neurons, select the highest-ranked ones, and apply a generic update. This pipeline assumes that the attributed neurons are the ones to patch and that a generic update fits every failure, and neither assumption has been examined. We examine both on executable API evolution tasks in Python and Rust with three code models and identify two gaps. The targeting gap separates the neurons that failure attribution targets from the neurons that can carry a patch: their top sets have a Jaccard overlap of only 0.15 to 0.20. The tailoring gap separates a generic update from a patch built for the failure: the patches that different carrier neurons need are nearly orthogonal. To address both gaps, we propose ASTRA. It targets neurons by contrastive semantics, an attribution that scores a neuron by its contribution to the logit contrast between the target token and the produced token. It then tailors the patch by solving one small linear system in closed form, which corrects all failing tokens of a sample jointly and needs neither an optimizer nor a backward pass. Contrastive semantics selects significantly better carrier neurons than gradient-based attributions in 3 of 6 settings and comparable ones in the others. On average, ASTRA reaches 66.7 percent Pass@1, against 48.4 percent for the best of AlphaEdit, STAR and low-rank adaptation, and repairs a sample in 2.7 seconds. It is the best method in all 6 settings and for every type of API change, and this advantage persists under an unseen phrasing of the test prompt. Its side effects on unrelated code are small on the large models and larger on the small one.

</details>


### [413] [Understanding the Hierarchical Structure and Functional Landscape of the Model Context Protocol Ecosystem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05319)
*Tingxuan Tang,Zilong Chen,Yue,Xiao*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出MCPacific，构建覆盖17个市场、124,267个MCP服务器的最大工具级功能地图，含58,915项能力的层次化分类体系，并揭示工具分布、替代性与安全性差异，验证按功能分类呈现工具可提升任务完成率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MCP服务器数量庞大但仅按市场特有的粗粒度服务器类别组织，导致智能体与用户难以定位特定操作所需工具、寻找功能替代品并评估差异。缺少跨市场的工具级功能视图，阻碍工具选择与比较。

Method: MCPacific汇集17个市场的368,754条服务器收录信息（对应124,267个唯一服务器），静态抽取七种语言的1,328,233个工具规范，通过迭代式LLM驱动的“设计—测试—精炼”流程构建58,915项能力的层次化功能分类，并用校准嵌入路由将全量语料映射到该分类。

Result: MCP远超开发者工具范畴，85%工具服务于其他领域；98.5%工具至少有一个功能替代，但近四分之一能力仅由单一工具支持；功能可比工具在安全告警、代码复杂度与维护状况上存在差异，41%可比工具对的复杂度相差2.5倍以上。以分类体系而非平铺列表呈现候选工具，在四个评估模型上均提升任务完成率，拥挤候选集下Pass@0.75提升最高达12个百分点。

Conclusion: 工具级、跨市场的功能分类体系能有效刻画MCP生态的功能结构、替代性与质量差异；以功能分类组织工具呈现可显著提升智能体任务完成率，为MCP生态的发现、比较与选择提供可扩展基础。

Abstract: AI agents increasingly rely on tools exposed through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to complete user tasks. Hundreds of thousands of MCP servers are listed across marketplaces, yet they are organized only by coarse, marketplace-specific server categories. This makes it difficult for agents and users to identify tools for a given operation, find functional alternatives, and assess how those alternatives differ. We present MCPacific, the largest tool-level, cross-marketplace map of the MCP ecosystem. MCPacific collects 368,754 MCP server listings corresponding to 124,267 unique servers across 17 marketplaces, statically extracts 1,328,233 tool specifications from these servers in seven languages, and organizes them into a hierarchical functional taxonomy of 58,915 capabilities. We construct the taxonomy through an iterative LLM-driven design-test-refine process and map the full corpus to it using calibrated embedding routing. Our study reveals that MCP extends well beyond developer tooling, with 85% of tools serving other domains. Functional alternatives are widespread but unevenly distributed: 98.5% of tools have at least one alternative, yet nearly a quarter of capabilities are supported by only one tool. Functionally comparable tools also differ in security alerts, code complexity, and project maintenance, with complexity differing by more than 2.5x in 41% of comparable tool pairs. Finally, presenting candidate tools through the taxonomy rather than a flat list improves task completion rate across all four evaluated models, with gains of up to 12 percentage points in Pass@0.75 for crowded candidate sets.

</details>


### [414] [Adaptive Code Revision Attacks on AI Pull Request Reviewers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05399)
*Jingzhi Gong,Jie M. Zhang,Gunel Jahangirova,Meng Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文提出AFCRA（自适应反馈引导的代码修订攻击），研究攻击者能否利用AI代码审查反馈"修复被报告问题、同时保留漏洞"，构建含159个漏洞的AFCRA-Bench，在多轮交互中成功率显著高于文本/评论类攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PR审查在代码上线前保护软件、防止漏洞暴露用户于攻击，而AI智能体日益承担此类审查并解释需修复的问题。对提交漏洞代码的攻击者而言，这种反馈恰恰揭示了哪些改动能获得批准。已有PR攻击依赖说服性文本与评论、保持可执行代码不变，因此尚不清楚攻击者能否借助反馈修复所报告问题、却在修订代码中保留漏洞。

Method: 开展针对该威胁的实证研究，提出AFCRA（自适应反馈引导的代码修订攻击）；为区分成功攻击与真实修复，基于159个已披露漏洞构建AFCRA-Bench，并配有可执行利用代码以验证代码中的漏洞。

Result: 在与Sonnet 5和GPT-5.5审查者进行五轮交互中，AFCRA成功率分别是所评估最强文本/评论类攻击的2.5倍和12.5倍。成功案例表明，审查者接受了针对所报告问题的修复，却忽视了仍残存的漏洞。

Conclusion: 研究确立反馈引导的代码修订是自动化PR审查的一项威胁；并据此为研究者、AI提供方、PR审查者和PR作者提出可操作建议，以保障AI辅助开发的安全。

Abstract: Pull-request review protects software before new code reaches users, helping prevent vulnerabilities that could expose users to attacks. AI agents increasingly perform these reviews and explain which problems need fixing. However, for an attacker submitting vulnerable code, this feedback also reveals what changes may secure approval. Existing PR attacks seek such approval through persuasive text and comments while keeping executable code fixed. This leaves unclear whether an attacker can use the feedback to repair the reported problem while preserving a vulnerability in the revised code. We therefore conduct an empirical study of this threat using AFCRA (Adaptive Feedback-guided Code Revision Attack). To distinguish successful attacks from genuine repairs, we construct AFCRA-Bench from 159 disclosed vulnerabilities, with executable exploits to verify vulnerabilities in code.
  Across five-round interactions with Sonnet 5 and GPT-5.5 reviewers, AFCRA reaches success rates 2.5x and 12.5x those of the strongest evaluated text- or comment-based attack. Case studies of these successes show how reviewers accept repairs of reported problems while overlooking surviving vulnerabilities. These findings establish feedback-guided code revision as a threat to automated PR review. To address this threat, we derive actionable implications for researchers, AI providers, PR reviewers, and PR authors on securing AI-assisted development.

</details>


### [415] [UndoBench: Separating Task Competence from Recovery Capability in Tool-Using AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05622)
*Dolly Sah,Tanmay Sah,Harshul Jain,Tanya Sah*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 UndoBench 基准，通过反事实配对试验将 AI 智能体的"任务能力"与"故障恢复能力"解耦评估，发现标称任务完成率高达 83.54% 时条件恢复成功率仅 46.72%，且朴素重试在 53.33% 试验中产生重复外部副作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具调用型 AI 智能体基准主要评估标称任务完成情况，将基础规划能力与运行期故障恢复能力混为一谈，掩盖了智能体在实际部署中的恢复脆弱性。

Method: 构建 UndoBench 基准，覆盖 8 个企业领域的 36 个基础工作流与 36 个故障场景；在相同随机种子下采用反事实配对试验，并引入线级效应历史（effect-history）与环境状态预言机（oracle）实现任务能力与恢复能力的解耦；在冻结的"丢失确认"研究中，对 12 个留出测试工作流、2 个开放权重模型、2 个框架及 3 种恢复范式进行 5,760 次执行 / 2,880 组配对试验，并扩展至商业 API 模型及多种执行边界。

Result: 标称能力达 83.54%，但条件恢复成功率（CRSR）降至 46.72%；朴素重试在 53.33% 的试验中产生重复外部副作用。商业 API 模型复现了能力—恢复分离现象。恢复呈现阶段依赖性：变更前各方法表现相近且有能力试验中无重复副作用；部分变更期间，朴素重试、逐调用幂等与零权限日志在评估的复合工作流上失效；提交后但确认前，验证与服务端幂等显著提升安全性。

Conclusion: 仅评估标称任务完成会掩盖自主智能体中关键的、阶段依赖的恢复漏洞；需将恢复能力作为独立维度进行评估。

Abstract: Tool-using AI agents are increasingly deployed across enterprise software systems, yet widely used benchmarks primarily evaluate nominal task completion, conflating baseline planning competence with operational fault recovery. We introduce UndoBench, a benchmark spanning 36 base workflows and 36 fault scenarios across 8 enterprise domains, decoupling task competence from recovery capability via counterfactual paired trials under identical seeds alongside wire-level effect-history and environment-state oracles. On 12 held-out TEST workflows across two open-weight models, two frameworks, and three recovery paradigms (5,760 executions / 2,880 paired trials) in the frozen lost-acknowledgment study, nominal competence reached 83.54% while conditional recovery success rate (CRSR) fell to 46.72%, with naive retry producing duplicate external effects in 53.33% of trials. Extensions to commercial API models reproduced this competence-recovery separation. Evaluations across complementary execution boundaries show that recovery is phase-dependent: before mutation, methods perform similarly without duplicate effects among capable trials; during partial mutation, naive retry, per-call idempotency, and zero-privilege journaling collapse on the evaluated composite workflows; after commit but before acknowledgment, verification and server-side idempotency substantially improve safety. These findings demonstrate that evaluating nominal completion alone masks critical, phase-dependent recovery vulnerabilities in autonomous agents.

</details>


### [416] [Finite State Machine-Based Traffic Orchestration for Multi-Engine Analysis Platforms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05788)
*Ankit Kumar,Thirumoorthi Thangamani*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种流量编排方法，将多个分析引擎的复合需求建模为单一复合有限状态机（FSM），实现运行时查表式转发配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 应用安全平台需将单一代理的实时流量分发给多个独立分析引擎，各引擎对流量的需求随时间各自变化，但代理对每个资源只能执行一条转发指令，二者之间存在冲突。

Method: 将所有引擎的组合需求建模为一个复合FSM，其状态空间为各引擎状态的笛卡尔积；每个可达复合状态预先映射到一个转发配置，使运行时退化为查表而非协商。并引入两项改进：将基于时间的过期作为一等FSM转移（声明式流量衰减），以及每状态多层级输出（单机服务所有服务等级）。

Result: 运行时可从协商转为查找，支持声明式流量衰减与多服务等级，且无需重新架构即可扩展到N个引擎。

Conclusion: 该设计完全声明式、引擎无关，具备良好的可扩展性与工程实用性。

Abstract: Modern application-security platforms route live traffic from a single proxy into several independent analysis engines -- behavioral anomaly detection, authentication analysis, resource discovery, access-control inspection, among others. Each engine's appetite for traffic changes on its own schedule, yet the proxy can honor only one forwarding instruction per resource. We present a traffic-orchestration method that models the combined needs of all engines as a single composite finite state machine (FSM) whose state space is the Cartesian product of per-engine states. Every reachable composite state pre-maps to one forwarding configuration, so runtime reduces to a lookup rather than a negotiation. We add two refinements: time-based expiry treated as a first-class FSM transition enabling declarative traffic decay, and per-state multi-tier outputs that let one machine serve every service level. The design is fully declarative, engine-agnostic, and scales to N engines without re-architecture.

</details>


### [417] [PreMaQ: Predicting Maintainability-Related Quality of LLM-Generated Code Before Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05858)
*Taiki Wakamatsu,Yuta Ishimoto,Masanari Kondo,Yasutaka Kamei*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 PreMaQ，利用 LLM 生成前的内部表征预测生成代码的代码异味分数（CSS）和可维护性指数（MI），在 4 个模型与 4 个 Python 基准（2695 个任务）上验证了可预测性，并证明其可用于模型选择与质量提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 代码生成能力提升，但采用生成代码不仅需关注功能正确性，还需评估可维护性相关质量。若能在生成前预估质量，开发者可避免生成、审查并丢弃低质量代码的开销。已有工作证明功能正确性可提前预测，但可维护性相关质量是否同样可预测尚不明确。

Method: 提出生成前可维护性相关质量预测方法 PreMaQ，从 LLM 生成前的内部表征预测生成代码的 Code Smell Score（CSS）与 Maintainability Index（MI）。评估覆盖 4 个开放权重 LLM 和 4 个 Python 代码生成基准，共 2695 个任务。

Result: 在全部 16 个模型-基准组合中，预测的 CSS 与 MI 均与观测值相关，平均 Spearman 秩相关分别为 0.57 和 0.65。用于模型选择时，在多个模型均生成功能正确代码的任务上，PreMaQ 达到理想可维护性选择器相对随机选择所获质量提升的 59.5%；融合 PreMaQ 预测与 prompt 嵌入后提升至 60.7%，表明两种信号互补。

Conclusion: PreMaQ 可用于预测并提升 LLM 生成代码的可维护性相关质量。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly capable of code generation, adopting generated code in software development requires assessing not only its functional correctness but also its maintainability-related quality. If such quality could be estimated before generation, developers could avoid the cost of generating, reviewing, and discarding low-quality code. Although prior work has shown that the functional correctness of the LLM-generated code can be predicted in advance, it remains unclear whether maintainability-related quality is similarly predictable. We introduce Pre-Generation Maintainability-Related Quality Prediction (PreMaQ), which predicts the Code Smell Score (CSS) and Maintainability Index (MI) of generated code from the internal representations of LLMs before generation. Our evaluation covers four open-weight LLMs and four Python code generation benchmarks, comprising 2,695 tasks in total. Our results show that predicted CSS and MI consistently correlate with their observed values across all 16 model-benchmark combinations, achieving mean Spearman rank correlations of 0.57 and 0.65, respectively. When used for model selection, PreMaQ achieves 59.5% of the maintainability-related quality improvement attainable by an ideal maintainability-based selector over random selection on tasks for which multiple models generate functionally correct code. Combining predictions from PreMaQ and prompt embeddings increases this proportion to 60.7%, indicating that the two signals are complementary. These findings suggest that PreMaQ can be used to predict and improve the maintainability-related quality of LLM-generated code.

</details>


### [418] [Adopting InnerSource in a Public Sector Organization: A Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05947)
*Muhammad Usman,Johan Linåker,Deepika Badampudi,Hannes Salin*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该研究通过9次半结构化访谈和13人内部研讨会，考察瑞典某公共部门组织采用InnerSource的动机、挑战与改进策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: InnerSource被视为改善大规模软件开发的有效途径，但其在公共部门组织中的采纳证据仍十分有限，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 采用案例研究方法，针对瑞典一个公共部门组织，开展9次半结构化访谈并举办13人参与的内部研讨会，分析InnerSource采纳的动机、挑战及改进策略。

Result: 主要动机包括提升复用、加强跨团队协作、实现更快且更具成本效益的开发。关键挑战涉及开放文化与思维模式的缺失、可复用资产的管理（如归属权、文档、代码可见性）以及工作方式（如孤岛式实践、贡献时间有限）。研究还识别出相应改进措施：培育有利于InnerSource与知识共享的文化和思维模式、强化管理支持、建立面向可复用资产的内部平台与治理机制。

Conclusion: InnerSource在公共部门组织的成功采纳依赖于文化、管理与技术治理的协同改进，而非单纯引入工具或流程。

Abstract: InnerSource (IS) is increasingly viewed as a way to improve large-scale software development. However, evidence on its adoption in public sector organizations remains limited. This paper reports a study of IS adoption in a Swedish Public Sector Organization. Drawing on nine semi-structured interviews and an internal workshop with 13 participants, we examine motivations, challenges, and improvement strategies for IS adoption. The results show that the main motivations are improving reuse, strengthening cross-team collaboration, and enabling faster and more cost-efficient development. Key challenges relate to a lack of an open culture and mindset, management of reusable assets (e.g., ownership, documentation, and code visibility), and ways of working (e.g., siloed practices and limited time for contributions). The study also identified improvements to address challenges, including fostering an enabling culture and mindset for IS and knowledge sharing, strengthening management support, and establishing internal platforms and governance for reusable assets.

</details>


### [419] [Mechanizing the User's Eye: Pre-Registered Deployment of a Sabotage-Validated Fail-Plausible Observer in a Production LLM Agent Runtime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05981)
*Wei Wu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文构建了一个自动化"用户视角观察者"，针对LLM agent运行时中"看似合理的失败"（fail-plausible）进行检测，采用确定性信号+LLM裁判的双层流水线，并严格按照预注册流程进行部署评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前纵向研究发现生产环境中约70%的静默失败是被"以用户身份使用产品的人类"发现的，而数千个测试和治理检查全部通过。作者将"部分机械化人类肉眼所做的事"作为开放问题，本文即是对该问题的尝试性解答。

Method: 两层流水线：从事故复盘提炼的五个确定性信号作为前置层，触发后升级至LLM裁判，裁判裁决必须引用逐字证据否则丢弃。真值采用24份标注的生产事故复盘，其中16份结构上对任何"读内容"的观察者不可见。部署遵循预注册：阴影模式运行26天、固定翻转标准、冻结分析协议，随后进入执行模式观察12天。

Result: 离线确定性层达6/6回归检测、0/4误报，每个检测器经"破坏测试"证明不可或缺；但对新模式的留出召回为0/4，本质仍是回归引擎。部署中阴影模式首轮捕获并淘汰一个系统性误报，随后26天干净运行；执行模式12天零裁决，按预注册路径报告实时精确率"未定义"而非将平静叙述为成功。观察者自身也产生了10次静默失败。

Conclusion: 机械化目前能"退役"人类的回归扫描，使人类肉眼得以专注新异性；预测仍是开放问题，但现已在冻结规则下变得可测量。作者以可运行基准形式发布语料、检测器和记分卡。

Abstract: A prior longitudinal study of silent failures in a production LLM agent runtime (arXiv:2606.14589) found that about 70% were discovered by a human looking at the product as a user while thousands of tests and governance checks stayed green, and posed mechanizing part of what the human eye does as an open problem. This paper reports our attempt. We built an automated user-viewpoint observer targeting the most dangerous class, fail-plausible failure, in which an internal error becomes fluent, plausible output to the user. It is a two-layer pipeline: five deterministic signals distilled from incident postmortems escalate to an LLM judge whose verdicts must cite verbatim evidence or be discarded. Ground truth is 24 labeled production postmortems with explicit honesty boundaries: 16 of 24 are structurally invisible to any content-reading observer, and we say so. Offline, the deterministic layer achieves 6/6 regression detection with 0/4 false positives, each detector proven load-bearing by sabotage; held-out recall on novel patterns is 0/4. It is, so far, a regression engine. Deployment followed pre-registration: shadow mode caught and retired one systematic false positive on its first run, the 26-day shadow window then ran clean, flip criteria were fixed before the shadow data was read, and the analysis protocol was frozen before the enforcing-mode window opened. That window (12 observed days) fired zero verdicts; per the pre-registered path we report live precision as undefined rather than narrating quiet as success. The observer also produced ten silent failures of its own, confirming that the judge inherits the taxonomy it judges. We release the corpus, detector, and scorecard as a runnable bench: mechanization today retires the human's regression scanning so the eye can specialize in novelty; prediction remains open but is now measurable under frozen rules.

</details>


### [420] [From Trust-by-Design to Continuous Trust in the Era of Artificial Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05991)
*Peter Fettke,Wolfgang Reisig*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出"持续信任"（continuous trust）概念，以企业退款部门为运行案例进行说明，并讨论合规检查与认证等相关工作，展望形式化与工具支持问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统上系统正确性通过证明满足所需属性来保证，但数字系统涉及可能出错、违规或作弊的人，技术设备也可能故障。因此外部利益相关者需要在系统整个运行过程中持续信任系统。

Method: 提出"持续信任"概念，并以企业退款部门为运行案例对该概念进行详细阐述。

Result: 给出了"持续信任"概念的详细解释，并围绕退款部门案例展示了该概念的应用。

Conclusion: 讨论了合规检查与认证等相关工作，并展望了持续信任的形式化及所需工具支持等后续问题。

Abstract: Trust is crucial in the digital world, particularly in the age of systems based on artificial intelligence. Traditionally, system correctness is demonstrated by proving that the system satisfies the required properties. However, digital systems involve humans, who can make mistakes, break rules, or even intentionally cheat the system. Technical devices may also malfunction or cause errors. Therefore, external stakeholders need to trust a system throughout its operation. To address this challenge, we propose the concept of continuous trust. In this paper, we present a detailed explanation of this concept, based on a running example of a business's refund department. The paper concludes with a discussion of related work, such as compliance checking and certification, as well as an outlook on further questions regarding the formalization and the necessary tool support.

</details>


### [421] [AgentSpy: Making AI Agent Behavior Observable](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06001)
*Christoph Bühler,Matteo Biagiola,Luca Di Grazia,Guido Salvaneschi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: AgentSpy 通过在隔离环境中从外部监控 agent 及其所有子进程的系统调用与网络流量，实现对 LLM agent 执行的合规性（义务）与安全性（禁止）分析，并在可靠性与安全性两方面进行了实例化评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于 LLM 的 AI agent 以用户权限执行 shell 命令、读写文件并访问网络，但其执行过程中真正发生了什么难以理解：测试只断言结果，agent 轨迹仅记录 agent 自我报告的内容，可能遗漏其子进程所执行的行为。因此需要一种从 agent 外部进行观测的方法。

Method: AgentSpy 在由声明式规范配置的隔离环境中运行 agent，记录 agent 及其执行的每个进程的系统调用与网络流量。基于该监控，支持两类分析：衡量"义务"（执行应当做什么）的合规性分析，以及检查"禁止"（执行绝不能做什么）的安全性分析。论文各实例化一个分析：可靠性分析用规则按环境资源（执行的命令、访问的文件、联系的主机）总结每次运行；安全性分析对执行的系统调用应用确定性规则。

Result: 可靠性方面，在 77 个任务上使用 codex 框架与三个近期 LLM，每个任务执行三次：同一任务重复运行集合的相似度高于包含其他任务运行的集合，占 92.2% 的比较。在三次运行均通过结果导向测试的任务中，18% 的案例 agent 执行了与任务无关的活动，7% 读取了评分文件，17% 未使用开发者提供的指导。安全性方面，AgentSpy 的通用规则检测出所考虑的五类攻击中的四类，且在 50 次运行中无假阳性。

Conclusion: AgentSpy 证明可从 agent 外部观测其真实执行行为，支撑合规性与安全性分析；可靠性分析揭示即使结果测试通过，agent 仍普遍存在任务无关活动、读取评分文件及不遵循开发者指导等问题，安全性分析则显示通用规则能有效检测多数攻击类别且无误报。

Abstract: AI agents built on large language models (LLMs) run shell commands, read and write files, and reach the network, typically with their user's privileges. However, what an agent does during an execution is difficult to understand: tests assert on the result, and the agent's trajectory records only what the agent reports about itself, which may omit behavior executed by its subprocesses. We present AgentSpy, an approach that observes an agent from outside the agent. AgentSpy runs the agent in an isolated environment, configured by a declarative specification, and records the system calls and network traffic of the agent and of every process it executes. Based on this monitoring, AgentSpy supports two families of analyses: conformance analyses, which measure obligations, i.e., what an agent execution should do, and safety analyses, which check prohibitions, i.e., what an agent execution must never do. We instantiate one analysis of each family. The reliability analysis uses rules to summarize each run by the environment resources the agent uses: the commands it executed, the files it accessed, and the hosts it contacted. The security analysis applies deterministic rules to the system calls of an execution. For reliability, we evaluated AgentSpy on 77 tasks with the codex harness and three recent LLMs, executing each task three times. Sets of repeated runs of the same task are more similar than sets that include runs of another task in 92.2% of the comparisons. Among tasks for which all three runs pass outcome-based tests, the agent performs task-unrelated activities in 18% of the cases, reads the grading files in 7%, and does not use the developers' guidance in 17%. For security, the generic rules of AgentSpy detect four of five attack categories we considered, with no false positives across 50 runs.

</details>


### [422] [Experimentation Practices in Indie Game Startups](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06004)
*Elizabeth Bjarnason,Johan Linåker,Fabian Fagerholm*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该研究通过访谈10家独立游戏公司，探讨独立游戏初创企业在发布前阶段如何开展持续实验与游戏测试，并提出一个持续实验框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 独立游戏初创企业面临时间、预算和资源有限的激烈竞争，需通过持续测试新想法、特性和内容来验证并引导开发；但持续实验依赖用户和用户数据，而独立游戏公司在早期阶段难以获取这些资源。

Method: 采用探索性访谈调查，访谈来自不同公司的10名独立游戏开发者，分析其在发布前阶段的实验与测试实践，并构建持续实验框架。

Result: 提出一个持续实验框架，突出规划与实施实验时的关键要素；并描述了独立游戏开发在构思、预制作、特性制作和内容制作等早期阶段的现行实验实践。

Conclusion: 研究为独立游戏公司在发布前阶段如何开展实验提供了经验性见解和建议；其他以交互性和满意用户体验为价值主张的软件初创企业也可从中受益。

Abstract: Small independent (indie) game startups face fierce competition when developing games with limited time, budget, and resources. Continuously testing and experimenting with new ideas, features, and content is essential to validate and guide development toward a viable and successful game. Such continuous experimentation (CE) requires access to users and user data, which is often very limited in the early stages of development, both in general and, in particular for indie game companies. We provide insights and recommendations on how to perform experimentation and game testing in pre-release stages of indie game development based on an exploratory interview survey with 10 independent game developers from different companies. We provide a framework for CE that highlights key parts to consider when planning and implementing an experiment. Current practices for experimentation within indie game development are also described for the early development stages of ideation, preproduction, feature production, and content production. Our empirical findings offer insights and recommendations into how to conduct experiments during pre-release stages of game development, specifically for Indie game companies. Other software startups, particularly those with a value proposition centred around interactive and satisfying user experiences, can also benefit from our research.

</details>


### [423] [Let the Agent Do It? How Software Practitioners Understand and Make Permission Decisions in Agentic AI Assistants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06047)
*Larissa Salerno,Haoyu Gao,Gregory Gay,Alexander Serebrenik,Philipp Leitner*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 通过"访谈18人+问卷115人"的序贯混合方法研究，揭示了开发者对AI代理执行文件修改、命令执行等操作时的授权决策机制，并提出权限系统设计建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agentic AI助手日益代表开发者修改文件、执行命令、访问外部资源，这些操作常需授权，但实践者如何在享受代理自主性的同时做出授权决策尚不明确，存在研究空白。

Method: 采用序贯混合方法：先访谈18位使用AI代理的实践者，基于访谈发现设计问卷，再调查115位实践者。

Result: 实践者主要通过可直接观察和审查的内容理解代理行为，而背后的决策、数据使用等活动较不透明；这种不确定性影响授权决策，其依据包括操作范围与风险、是否契合任务、对代理的熟悉度及运行环境。实践者通过预先设限、监控执行、事后审查等方式调节监督强度，监督程度受信任、任务重要性、时间压力和操作后果影响。

Conclusion: 权限系统应使关键操作更易审查，区分代理"被允许做"与用户"意图做"的范围，明确可逆性，避免将重复批准视为稳定偏好，并区分拒绝单一操作与拒绝整体方案。

Abstract: Agentic AI assistants increasingly act on developers' behalf by modifying files, executing commands, and accessing external resources. These actions often require permission, yet little is known about how practitioners make permission decisions while still benefiting from agent autonomy. To address this gap, we conducted a sequential mixed methods study, interviewing 18 practitioners who use AI agents and then surveying 115 practitioners based on the interview findings. We find that practitioners often understand agent behaviour through what they can directly observe and review, while decisions, data use, and other activity behind the scenes remain less clear. This uncertainty also shapes permission decisions, which depend on the scope and risk of an action, whether it fits the task, familiarity with the agent, and the environment in which it operates. Practitioners respond by adjusting how closely they oversee agents, from setting limits in advance to monitoring execution and reviewing work afterwards. How much scrutiny they apply depends on factors such as trust, task importance, time pressure, and the consequences of an action. Our findings suggest that permission systems should make consequential actions easier to review, distinguish what an agent is allowed to do from what the user intended, make reversibility clearer, avoid treating repeated approvals as stable preferences, and distinguish rejecting a single action from rejecting an entire approach.

</details>


### [424] [Where Does the Budget Go? Structural Concentration in Learning-Based Mutant Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06055)
*Taha Rostami,Jeongju Sohn,Mike Papadakis*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文揭示基于学习的变异体选择会将测试预算集中于少数代码位置，造成"盲区"和杀伤集重叠，并提出简单的分层方法 LinePool 来在保持排序信号的同时改善空间覆盖与行为多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于学习的变异体选择在故障揭示和蕴含变异体选择上已有潜力，但其风险与收益尚不清晰：所选变异体在代码位置上的分布如何、该分布如何影响行为多样性与故障揭示，均有待研究。

Method: 通过对两个数据集、两种预算（变异体的 2% 与 5%）的分析，考察学习型选择的分布及其对杀伤行为与故障揭示的影响；进而提出 LinePool，一种与模型无关的简单分层步骤，将选择分散到不同源码行上，同时保留底层排序信号；并与聚类及已有多样化方法进行对比。

Result: 学习型选择将预算集中在少数代码位置上，可能系统性地引入"盲区"（未测试的代码区域），使故障逃逸检测；在较大程序上，所选变异体的杀伤行为存在显著重叠。LinePool 显著提高空间覆盖并降低杀伤集重叠；在紧张预算下提升故障揭示能力，并使选择对不完美或偏移的排序信号更具鲁棒性。与聚类及成熟多样化方法相比，没有方法能在所有数据集上稳定优于 LinePool。

Conclusion: 设计并评估变异体选择方法时，应将行为多样性与有效性一并考虑；利用程序的结构性要素是同时获得多样性与有效性的一种简单途径，LinePool 可作为通用的简单多样化步骤使用。

Abstract: Learning-based mutant selection is used to reduce the cost of mutation testing by ranking and selecting the mutants that seem to be the most promising. Prior work has shown great potential for this approach in fault revelation and subsuming-mutant selection. However, the risks and benefits of these approaches -- especially the distribution of selected mutants across code locations and how that distribution affects behavioral diversity and fault revelation -- remain unclear. We investigate this distribution and its effects, and introduce LinePool, a simple, model-agnostic stratification step that distributes selections across source lines while retaining the underlying ranking signal. Across two datasets and budgets (2% and 5% of the mutants), we find that learning-based selection concentrates the budget on a few code locations, and may thereby systematically introduce 'blind spots', untested code areas, allowing faults to escape detection. On larger programs, the selected mutants also exhibit substantial overlap in kill behavior. LinePool substantially increases spatial coverage and reduces kill-set overlap. It also improves fault revelation at tight budgets and makes selection more robust to imperfect or shifted ranking signals. Comparisons with clustering and established diversification methods show that none consistently outperforms LinePool across datasets, supporting its use as a simple diversification step. In general, our results suggest that behavioral diversity should be considered alongside effectiveness when designing and evaluating mutant-selection methods, and that exploiting structural elements of the program is one simple way to obtain such diversity while maintaining effectiveness.

</details>


### [425] [Correct Code, Broken Contributions? SWE-CC: Benchmarking Repository Policy Compliance for Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06193)
*Hai Dang Truong,Rayner Goh,Thanh Le-Cong,Yintong Huo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出SWE-CC基准，评估自主编码代理在真实开源仓库贡献中"代码与流程合规性"，发现功能正确不等于合规。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准仅以单元测试（功能正确性）评价代理补丁，忽略成熟开源项目发布的仓库特定贡献政策（风格、git、测试流程等）。因此代理对仓库治理规范的遵守情况完全未知，而功能测试通过并不等于产出可合并的高质量贡献。

Method: 构建半自动化流水线，将12个开源仓库的开发者文档转化为823条机器可检查的原子策略；每条策略用轻量、确定性的检查函数表示；并提出综合审计机制，同时检查代理运行时行为与最终交付物。基于SWE-bench Verified扩展出500个端到端软件贡献任务，在两种代理脚手架下评估四个LLM。

Result: 现代代理存在编码合规问题：尽管能产出功能正确的补丁，仍违反43.1%的适用项目政策，且近半数违规发生在中间执行步骤中。

Conclusion: 功能正确性不能保证真实世界的可用性；未来的软件工程代理必须可靠地遵循仓库治理规范，才能实现安全可信的部署。

Abstract: Autonomous coding agents now resolve a substantial share of real-world GitHub issues. However, passing functional tests differs fundamentally from producing a high-quality contribution acceptable for merging. Mature open-source projects publish repository-specific contribution policies, spanning style, git, testing workflows, to ensure code quality and long-term maintainability. Because existing benchmarks evaluate patches solely on unit tests, agent compliance with repository governance remains unknown. In this paper, we introduce SWE-CC, a benchmark evaluating code and process compliance in autonomous software engineering. We develop a semi-automated pipeline that converts developer documentation across 12 open-source repositories into 823 machine-checkable atomic policies. SWE-CC introduces two features: 1) lightweight, deterministic checker functions that represent each policy, 2) a comprehensive auditing mechanism that inspects both agent runtime behaviors and final deliverables. We evaluate the compliance of agent workflows in 500 end-to-end software contribution tasks extended from SWE-bench Verified. Our evaluation of four LLMs under two agent scaffolds shows that modern agents suffer from coding compliance issues: although agents produce functionally correct patches, they still violate 43.1 percent of applicable project policies, with nearly half of all violations occurring during intermediate execution steps. These results show that functional correctness does not guarantee real-world readiness, highlighting that future software engineering agents must reliably conform to repository governance to enable safe and trustworthy deployment.

</details>


### [426] [LLM Non-Determinism in Deterministic Processes: A Controlled Variation Space for Constraining the Propagation of Non-Determinism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06255)
*Paul Darius Mandl,Peter Mandl,Martin Häusl*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出"受控非确定性"方法，通过确定性包络将LLM的变异限制在受控空间内，确保其输出只有通过退出检查后才能成为权威流程状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益用于依赖既定状态、规则与审批的软件开发流程，但其灵活性与流程对可靠、可追溯状态的需求之间存在张力，需在保留变异空间的同时防止LLM输出直接决定权威状态。

Method: 面向流程的"受控非确定性"方法：在执行前定义结果中与流程相关的属性及退出条件，并记录任务配置，这些元素在执行期间保持固定；将LLM处理置于由"确定性包络"限定的受控变异空间内；在变异空间末端由退出检查判定结果是否满足预定义条件、能否成为下一个权威状态。

Result: 不同运行可产生不同但可接受的结果，而向权威状态的转换始终受控；以受监管软件开发为例进行了示例说明，并据此推导出针对LLM驱动变更的设计准则，使结果在并入权威软件状态前可被检查。

Conclusion: 受控非确定性在保留LLM灵活性的同时，通过预定义属性、固定配置与退出检查保障流程状态的可靠性与可追溯性，适用于结果需在进入权威状态前被验证的LLM驱动变更场景。

Abstract: Large Language Models are increasingly used in software development processes that rely on defined states, rules, and approvals. This creates a tension between the flexibility of LLMs and the need for reliable and traceable process states. We introduce Controlled Non-Determinism, a process-oriented approach that allows variation without letting it directly determine the authoritative process state. We place LLM-based processing within a controlled variation space that is bounded by a Deterministic Envelope. Before execution, we define the process-relevant properties of the result and the exit conditions. We also record the task configuration. These elements remain fixed during execution. At the end of the variation space, an exit check determines whether the result satisfies the predefined conditions and may become the next authoritative state. Different runs may produce different admissible results while the transition to an authoritative state remains controlled. We illustrate the approach with regulated software development and derive design guidelines for LLM-based changes whose results can be checked before they become part of the authoritative software state.

</details>


### [427] [Choosing an energy-efficient software architecture for building system diagnostic support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06444)
*Roxane Koitz-Hristov,Franz Wotawa*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一个同时考虑故障检测与诊断（FDD）软件自身能耗及其诊断性能的能耗模型，并在仿真中对比规则、模型、经典机器学习与大型语言模型四类FDD架构。结果表明，纳入计算能耗与准确率会改变各方法的相对优势：随机森林等高效机器学习方法在小型建筑上净节能最大，而微调大语言模型等资源密集型方法随建筑规模增大而更具优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建筑部门约占全球能耗30%，其中很大一部分可通过修复既有故障避免，FDD软件可解决此问题，但其创建与运行本身也有环境影响。该影响大小取决于诊断架构，因为不同架构与方法的能耗需求不同；然而仅考虑软件自身能耗不足以评估总体环境影响，诊断性能（如检出故障数或漏检数）也贡献于其生态足迹。

Method: 提出一个能耗模型，同时纳入FDD性能与诊断软件直接消耗的能耗。在初始实验中，使用从既有文献收集的性能与能耗值，在仿真中比较若干FDD架构族，即基于规则、基于模型、经典机器学习和基于大型语言模型的方法。

Result: 结果表明，将FDD的计算能耗与准确率一并考虑会改变不同方法的相对收益。计算高效型机器学习方法（如随机森林）在较小建筑上提供最大的净节能，而资源密集型方法（如微调大语言模型）随建筑规模增大而变得有优势。

Conclusion: 总体能效不仅取决于FDD软件的计算需求，还取决于其诊断性能与建筑规模。

Abstract: Around 30\% of global energy expenditure can be attributed to the building sector, where a large portion of energy-consumption could be avoided by repairing existing faults. Fault detection and diagnosis (FDD) software addresses this issue; however, its creation and operation also have an environmental impact. The magnitude of this impact is influenced by the diagnosis architecture, as different architectures and methods have different energy demands. Yet, simply considering the energy consumed by the software itself is not sufficient to assess its overall environmental impact, since the diagnostic performance, e.g., number of detected faults or number of faults missed, also contributes to its ecological footprint.
  In this paper, we propose an energy-consumption model that considers FDD performance and energy spend directly by the diagnosis software. In an initial experiment, we compare several FDD architecture families, i.e., rule-based, model-based, classical machine learning, and large-language-model-based, in simulation using performance and energy-consumption values collected from prior literature. The results show that considering the computational energy and accuracy of FDD can change the relative benefit of the different approaches. Computationally efficient machine learning methods, such as random forest, provide the largest net savings on smaller buildings, whereas more resource-intensive approaches, such as fine-tuned large language models, become advantageous as building size increases. Our findings suggest that overall energy efficiency depends not only on the computational demand of the FDD software, but also on its diagnostic performance and the scale of the building.

</details>


### [428] [AI Agent Pull Requests on GitHub: Frequency, Structure, and Merge Conflict Rates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04697)
*George Xu,Arjun Subramanian,Nithilan Karthik*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 首个基于AIDev-pop数据集（33,596个PR、2,807个仓库）的实证研究，考察AI编码代理对同一仓库的并发提交现象及其引发的合并冲突。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI编码代理可能同时向同一仓库生成并提交Pull Request，但关于并发提交普遍程度的研究尚属空白。

Method: 基于AIDev-pop数据集，通过精确时间重叠与一周协作窗口两种口径度量共活跃（co-active）PR对；对747个唯一共活跃PR对（每仓库一对）重放三方git合并，计算文本冲突比例，并构建基于git冲突报告的冲突分类体系。

Result: 精确时间重叠下，40.2%的仓库存在共活跃代理PR对，这些PR对占AI代理生成PR总数的79.4%；一周协作窗口下分别升至53.4%和95.0%。共活跃PR对中绝大多数为同一代理内（intra-agent）创作，跨代理（cross-agent）仅占0.5%，分布于122/2,807个仓库（约4.3%）。跨代理对的文本冲突率显著高于代理内对：41.7% vs. 19.8%，95%置信区间不重叠。冲突主要来自源代码文件修改（占冲突文件的84.4%）而非依赖清单文件；近42%的冲突为结构性冲突（修改/删除或新增/新增）。

Conclusion: AI编码代理的并发提交在同一仓库中相当普遍，且跨代理并发更易产生文本冲突；冲突多源于源代码修改且以结构性冲突为主，提示多代理协作场景需要冲突预防与协调机制。

Abstract: AI coding agents may generate and submit Pull Requests (PRs) to the same repository at the same time. However, research concerning the extent of concurrent submission by AI coding agents to a common repository does not exist. This paper uses the AIDev-pop dataset (33,596 PRs in 2,807 repositories) to provide the first empirical examination of the prevalence of concurrent submission using PRs authored by agents. We report that when considering exact temporal overlap, 40.2% of repositories contain co-active agent-authored PR pairs; further, the co-active pairs account for 79.4% of all PRs generated by an AI agent. When we examine co-activity within a one week collaboration window, the percentages are increased to 53.4% and 95.0%, respectively. For the majority of the co-active PR pairs (underlying the vast majority of which are intra-agent authored), both PRs were authored by the same agent, while only 0.5% of co-active pairs were cross-agent, and occurred in only 122 out of 2807 total repositories examined (or approximately 4.3%). Additionally, we replayed actual three way git merges on 747 unique co-active pairs (one per repository), and computed the percentage of textual conflict encountered during the merge operation to combine the two PRs in each pair. We observed that the percentage of textual conflict encountered was significantly higher for cross-agent pairs compared to intra-agent pairs: 41.7% vs. 19.8%, respectively, with non-overlapping 95% confidence intervals. Lastly, we developed a classification system based on the detection of conflict reported by git, and determined that the majority of conflicts resulted from modifications to source code files (84.4% of conflicted files) and not dependency manifest files; further, nearly 42% of conflicts we observed were structural (i.e., modify/delete or add/add).

</details>


### [429] [Using Process Mining to Generate AI Agents from Software Engineering Process Records](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04948)
*Saimir Bala,Fabiana Fournier,Lior Limonad,Andreas Metzger*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文针对AI agents融入混合型软件工程团队时的角色粒度与关注点分离难题，提出结合对象中心、命令式与声明式流程挖掘的方法。基于从软件仓库提取的事件日志，利用预定义的SE角色词汇表发现项目特定agent角色，并自动生成匹配的agent规约与实现。在成熟开源项目上验证，通过功能测试与探索性用户研究评估生成规约与人类期望的对齐度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将AI agents整合进软件工程（SE）团队面临挑战：如何规格化并实现能与人类有效协作的AI agents。确定agent的合适粒度与关注点分离并不简单——粗粒度agent可能带来难以管理的复杂度，而微agent则会造成严重的协调开销。此外，现有多agent SE框架通常依赖预定义的角色结构，不考虑项目特定特征或流程适配。

Method: 结合对象中心（object-centric）、命令式（imperative）与声明式（declarative）流程挖掘。使用从软件仓库中提取的事件日志，基于一个由仓库行为支撑的预定义SE角色词汇表，发现项目特定的agent角色，并生成与之匹配的agent规约（specifications）与实现。

Result: 作为概念验证（proof-of-concept），将该方法应用于一个成熟的开源项目。开展了功能测试以及一项探索性用户研究，以评估所生成的AI agent规约与人类期望的对齐程度。

Conclusion: 该工作表明流程挖掘可用于从软件仓库行为中数据驱动地推导项目特定的agent角色，并自动生成agent规约与实现，从而在混合SE团队中更贴近项目实际与人类预期。

Abstract: Integrating AI agents into Software Engineering (SE) raises an important challenge: how can we specify and realize AI agents that work effectively alongside humans in hybrid SE teams? Determining the right granularity and separation of concerns for such agents is non-trivial. Coarse-grained agents may introduce unmanageable complexity, whereas micro-agents may create severe coordination overhead. Moreover, existing multi-agent SE frameworks typically rely on predefined role structures and do not account for project-specific characteristics or process adaptations. We address this by combining object-centric, imperative, and declarative process mining. Using event logs extracted from software repositories, our approach discovers project-specific agent roles using a predefined SE role vocabulary grounded in repository behavior and generates matching agent specifications and implementations. As proof-of-concept, we applied our approach to a well-established open-source project. We performed functional tests and an exploratory user study to determine how well the generated AI agent specifications are aligned with human expectations.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [430] [Training Numerical Intelligence via Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03872)
*Peter Chen,Wotao Yin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ADSD框架，将数值诊断与可复用的求解器自我改进相连接，在四个数值域上提升求解器的精度、鲁棒性与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体虽能生成科学代码，但生成代码不等于改进算法本身。对数值求解器而言，执行反馈虽能暴露性能不佳，却很少揭示其根本原因及改进方向。

Method: ADSD采用"诊断优先"范式：先解释求解器为何表现不佳，再据此引导发现合适的数值方法；将所得知识封装为可复用的求解器技能，使改进过程从试错式编辑转变为诊断、发现与实现的结构化流程。

Result: 在潮流方程、交流最优潮流控制、刚性常微分方程、非均质扩散偏微分方程四个数值域上，ADSD一致提升求解器精度、鲁棒性与效率；在GOC-500潮流问题上平均求解误差降低近71倍，并进一步迁移到未见过的电网拓扑与运行工况。

Conclusion: ADSD表明以诊断驱动的方法可有效发现并沉淀可复用数值技能，实现求解器的结构化自我改进与跨场景泛化。

Abstract: AI agents are becoming increasingly capable of generating scientific code, but generating code is not the same as improving the algorithms behind it. For numerical solvers, execution feedback can expose poor performance, but rarely reveals its underlying cause and how to address it. We introduce Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery (ADSD), a framework that links numerical diagnosis to reusable solver self-improvement. ADSD follows a diagnosis-first paradigm that first explains why a solver performs poorly, then uses this diagnosis to guide the discovery of appropriate numerical methods. The resulting knowledge is packaged into reusable solver skills, turning solver improvement from trial-and-error editing into a structured process of diagnosis, discovery, and implementation. Across four challenging numerical domains--power flow equation, AC optimal power flow control, stiff ordinary differential equations, and heterogeneous diffusion PDEs--ADSD consistently improves solver accuracy, robustness, and efficiency. On GOC-500 power flow, for example, ADSD reduces mean solver error by nearly $71\times$, with improvements further transferring to unseen grid topologies and operating regimes.

</details>


### [431] [REACT: Physically and Chemically Consistent Reconstruction of Marine Active Tracers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03888)
*Wenbin Dai,Hao Zheng,Shiyu Liang,Chaofan Sun,Xueying Zhang,Hanbo Huang,Xuan Gong,Yiran Zhang,Enhui Liao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出REACT，一种"碳优先"的全球海表pH重建框架，将输运、主动修正与化学解码解耦，在保证碳酸盐闭合与碳守恒的前提下降低pH重建误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球海表pH观测稀疏，重建对监测海洋酸化与理解海洋碳循环至关重要。传统同化与反演模型有物理基础但大规模重建代价高；近期黑箱与物理引导AI模型效率提升，却主要针对被动示踪物（重建变量即输运存量）。而pH是主动碳酸盐示踪物：预测目标是pH，守恒的碳存量是溶解无机碳（DIC）。这种不匹配可能导致pH误差虽低，却违反碳酸盐闭合与无源碳守恒。

Method: REACT将重建过程解耦为三部分：用保守的平流—扩散求解器输运潜在碳酸盐状态；用源模块刻画非保守的碳循环变化；将修正后的状态解码为pH，并通过碳酸盐平衡约束输出。该设计以pH为目标，同时约束底层碳状态的一致性。

Result: 在模拟数据上，REACT相比最佳基线将pH的NRMSE降低14.7%，化学一致性误差降低24.0%。跨时间尺度评估显示其对由粗到细时间尺度上的误差累积具有鲁棒性，消融实验验证了各模块的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过以碳存量为第一性变量、显式分离输运与源汇并施加碳酸盐平衡约束，REACT在提升pH重建精度的同时保障了碳循环物理化学一致性，为主动碳酸盐示踪物的稀疏观测重建提供了可行范式。

Abstract: Reconstructing global sea surface pH from sparse observations is critical for monitoring ocean acidification and understanding marine carbon cycling. Traditional assimilation and inverse models are physically grounded but costly for large-scale reconstruction. Recent black-box and physics-guided AI models improve efficiency, but are mainly designed for passive tracers, where the reconstructed variable is also the transported inventory. In contrast, pH is an active carbonate tracer: it is the prediction target, while dissolved inorganic carbon (DIC) is the conserved carbon inventory. This mismatch can produce low pH error while violating carbonate closure and source-free carbon conservation. To address this, we introduce \textbf{REACT}, a carbon-first reconstruction framework that decouples transport, active correction, and chemical decoding. REACT transports a latent carbonate state with a conservative advection--diffusion solver, captures non-conservative carbon-cycle variations with a source module, decodes the corrected state into pH, and constrains the output through carbonate equilibrium. This design keeps pH as the target while enforcing consistency on the underlying carbon state. On simulation data, REACT reduces pH NRMSE by (14.7%) and chemical consistency error by (24.0%) over the best baseline. Cross-temporal-scale evaluations show robustness against error accumulation from coarse to fine temporal scales, and ablation studies validate the effectiveness of each component.

</details>


### [432] [Proxy Confidence: Auditing Black-Box LLM Agents with a Surrogate's Log-Probabilities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03894)
*Yikai Zhao,Saurabh Pandey,Pradeep Kumar Misra*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种免训练的“代模型读出”方法：用低成本开源代理模型并行评分已部署LLM智能体发出的工具调用，从中恢复前沿API缺失的不确定性信号，用于实时门控与置信度反馈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已部署的LLM智能体发出的工具调用、查询和代码可能“静默出错”，等错误暴露时动作已执行。而前沿聊天API隐藏token概率；智能体自述置信度在关键错误上仅略优于随机；重采样也无效，因为前沿模型高度重复，多次采样会复现同一调用。因此急需一种可从外部恢复错误信号的方案。

Method: 用一个低成本开源权重代理模型与智能体并行运行，读取相同上下文、schema和拟议动作，并从自身对数概率中通过一族互补读出评分：（1）teacher forcing与request-PMI衡量各参数值的似然；（2）判别式判决（verdict）整体判断该调用；（3）工具选择竞争（tool-choice competition）检验函数与其兄弟函数的对比。核心原则：生成式似然定位错误的参数值，判别式判决捕捉整体错误调用；错误类型未知时用集成作为低遗憾默认。该方法免训练、无需访问智能体内部，仅需与工具调用并行的单次prefill。

Result: 在困难编码任务上AUROC达0.825，而actor自述置信度接近随机（0.598）；生成式读出在另外三个actor上超出其+0.07至+0.28。相较self-consistency，在近确定性actor上提升+0.14至+0.19，成本仅为1/K。该信号驱动两种部署模式：（1）实时门控，将最不可信的调用升级送审，在50%覆盖率下接受的行动准确率提升+0.05至+0.30；（2）置信度反馈，将工具结果连同分数返回给智能体以调整下一步，在在线执行基准上提升任务成功率（+0.119和+0.137，p≤1e-4），并在步骤错误静默的场景下击败随机值对照（+0.078，p=0.003）。

Conclusion: 前沿模型的内部不确定性信号可被外部低成本代理模型恢复，且无需训练或访问智能体内部。基于对数概率的互补读出能有效检测静默错误，并可直接用于实时门控与置信度反馈两种部署模式，显著提升行动准确率与任务成功率，为可靠LLM智能体提供了一种实用、经济的不确定性估计方案。
